text_en: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a narration of the things that have been accomplished among us,
text_la: Quoniam quidem multi conati sunt ordinare narrationem, quæ in nobis completæ sunt, rerum:
text_pt: Tendo, pois, muitos empreendido pôr em ordem a narração dos fatos que entre nós se cumpriram,
text_el: Ἐπειδήπερ πολλοὶ ἐπεχείρησαν ἀνατάξασθαι διήγησιν περὶ τῶν πεπληροφορημένων ἐν ἡμῖν πραγμάτων,

text_en: according as they have delivered them unto us, who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and ministers of the word:
text_la: sicut tradiderunt nobis, qui ab initio ipsi viderunt, et ministri fuerunt sermonis:
text_pt: Segundo nos transmitiram os mesmos que os presenciaram desde oprincípio, e foram ministros da palavra,
text_el: καθὼς παρέδοσαν ἡμῖν οἱ ἀπ' ἀρχῆς αὐτόπται καὶ ὑπηρέται γενόμενοι τοῦ λόγου,

text_en: It seemed good to me also, having diligently attained to all things from the beginning, to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus,
text_la: visum est et mihi, assecuto omnia a principio diligenter, ex ordine tibi scribere, optime Theophile,
text_pt: Pareceu-me também a mim conveniente descrevê-los a ti, ó excelente Teófilo, por sua ordem, havendo-me já informado minuciosamente de tudo desde o princípio;
text_el: ἔδοξε κἀμοὶ παρηκολουθηκότι ἄνωθεν πᾶσιν ἀκριβῶς καθεξῆς σοι γράψαι, κράτιστε Θεόφιλε,

text_en: that you may know the verity of those words in which you have been instructed.
text_la: ut cognoscas eorum verborum, de quibus eruditus es, veritatem.
text_pt: Para que conheças a certeza das coisas de que já estás informado.
text_el: ἵνα ἐπιγνῷς περὶ ὧν κατηχήθης λόγων τὴν ἀσφάλειαν.

text_en: There was in the days of Herod , the king of Judea , a certain priest named Zachary, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron , and her name Elizabeth .
text_la: Fuit in diebus Herodis, regis Judææ, sacerdos quidam nomine Zacharias de vice Abia, et uxor illius de filiabus Aaron, et nomen ejus Elisabeth.
text_pt: Existiu, no tempo de Herodes, rei da Judéia, um sacerdote chamado Zacarias, da ordem de Abias, e cuja mulher era das filhas de Arão; e o seu nome era Isabel.
text_el: Ἐγένετο ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Ἡρῴδου βασιλέως τῆς Ἰουδαίας ἱερεύς τις ὀνόματι Ζαχαρίας ἐξ ἐφημερίας Ἀβιά, καὶ γυνὴ αὐτῷ ἐκ τῶν θυγατέρων Ἀαρών, καὶ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῆς Ἐλισάβετ.

text_en: And they were both just before God , walking in all the commandments and justifications of the Lord without blame.
text_la: Erant autem justi ambo ante Deum, incedentes in omnibus mandatis et justificationibus Domini sine querela.
text_pt: E eram ambos justos perante Deus, andando sem repreensão em todos os mandamentos e preceitos do Senhor.
text_el: ἦσαν δὲ δίκαιοι ἀμφότεροι ἐναντίον τοῦ θεοῦ, πορευόμενοι ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ἐντολαῖς καὶ δικαιώμασιν τοῦ κυρίου ἄμεμπτοι.

text_en: And they had no son, for that Elizabeth was barren: and they both were well advanced in years.
text_la: Et non erat illis filius, eo quod esset Elisabeth sterilis, et ambo processissent in diebus suis.
text_pt: E não tinham filhos, porque Isabel era estéril, e ambos eram avançados em idade.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἦν αὐτοῖς τέκνον, καθότι ἦν [ἡ] Ἐλισάβετ στεῖρα, καὶ ἀμφότεροι προβεβηκότες ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτῶν ἦσαν.

text_en: And it came to pass, when he executed the priestly function in the order of his course before God ,
text_la: Factum est autem, cum sacerdotio fungeretur in ordine vicis suæ ante Deum,
text_pt: E aconteceu que, exercendo ele o sacerdócio diante de Deus, na ordem da sua turma,
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ ἱερατεύειν αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ τάξει τῆς ἐφημερίας αὐτοῦ ἔναντι τοῦ θεοῦ,

text_en: according to the custom of the priestly office , it was his lot to offer incense , going into the temple of the Lord .
text_la: secundum consuetudinem sacerdotii, sorte exiit ut incensum poneret, ingressus in templum Domini:
text_pt: Segundo o costume sacerdotal, coube-lhe em sorte entrar no templo do Senhor para oferecer o incenso.
text_el: κατὰ τὸ ἔθος τῆς ἱερατείας ἔλαχε τοῦ θυμιᾶσαι εἰσελθὼν εἰς τὸν ναὸν τοῦ κυρίου,

text_en: And all the multitude of the people was praying without, at the hour of incense .
text_la: et omnis multitudo populi erat orans foris hora incensi.
text_pt: E toda a multidão do povo estava fora, orando, à hora do incenso.
text_el: καὶ πᾶν τὸ πλῆθος ἦν τοῦ λαοῦ προσευχόμενον ἔξω τῇ ὥρᾳ τοῦ θυμιάματος.

text_en: And there appeared to him an angel of the Lord , standing on the right side of the altar of incense .
text_la: Apparuit autem illi angelus Domini, stans a dextris altaris incensi.
text_pt: E um anjo do Senhor lhe apareceu, posto em pé, à direita do altar do incenso.
text_el: ὤφθη δὲ αὐτῷ ἄγγελος κυρίου ἑστὼς ἐκ δεξιῶν τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου τοῦ θυμιάματος.

text_en: And Zachary seeing him, was troubled: and fear fell upon him.
text_la: Et Zacharias turbatus est videns, et timor irruit super eum.
text_pt: E Zacarias, vendo-o, turbou-se, e caiu temor sobre ele.
text_el: καὶ ἐταράχθη Ζαχαρίας ἰδών, καὶ φόβος ἐπέπεσεν ἐπ' αὐτόν.

text_en: But the angel said to him: Fear not, Zachary, for your prayer is heard: and your wife Elizabeth shall bear you a son. And you shall call his name John .
text_la: Ait autem ad illum angelus : Ne timeas, Zacharia, quoniam exaudita est deprecatio tua : et uxor tua Elisabeth pariet tibi filium, et vocabis nomen ejus Joannem:
text_pt: Mas o anjo lhe disse: Zacarias, não temas, porque a tua oração foi ouvida, e Isabel, tua mulher, dará à luz um filho, e lhe porás o nome de João.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ ἄγγελος: μὴ φοβοῦ, Ζαχαρία, διότι εἰσηκούσθη ἡ δέησίς σου, καὶ ἡ γυνή σου Ἐλισάβετ γεννήσει υἱόν σοι, καὶ καλέσεις τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰωάννην:

text_en: And you shall have joy and gladness : and many shall rejoice in his nativity.
text_la: et erit gaudium tibi, et exsultatio, et multi in nativitate ejus gaudebunt:
text_pt: E terás prazer e alegria, e muitos se alegrarão no seu nascimento,
text_el: καὶ ἔσται χαρά σοι καὶ ἀγαλλίασις, καὶ πολλοὶ ἐπὶ τῇ γενέσει αὐτοῦ χαρήσονται.

text_en: For he shall be great before the Lord and shall drink no wine nor strong drink: and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost , even from his mother's womb.
text_la: erit enim magnus coram Domino : et vinum et siceram non bibet, et Spiritu Sancto replebitur adhuc ex utero matris suæ:
text_pt: Porque será grande diante do Senhor, e não beberá vinho, nem bebida forte, e será cheio do Espírito Santo, já desde o ventre de sua mãe.
text_el: ἔσται γὰρ μέγας ἐνώπιον κυρίου, καὶ οἶνον καὶ σίκερα οὐ μὴ πίῃ, καὶ πνεύματος ἁγίου πλησθήσεται ἔτι ἐκ κοιλίας μητρὸς αὐτοῦ,

text_en: And he shall convert many of the children of Israel to the Lord their God .
text_la: et multos filiorum Israël convertet ad Dominum Deum ipsorum:
text_pt: E converterá muitos dos filhos de Israel ao Senhor seu Deus,
text_el: καὶ πολλοὺς τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ ἐπιστρέψει ἐπὶ κύριον τὸν θεὸν αὐτῶν:

text_en: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias : that he may turn the hearts of the fathers unto the children and the incredulous to the wisdom of the just , to prepare unto the Lord a perfect people.
text_la: et ipse præcedet ante illum in spiritu et virtute Eliæ : ut convertat corda patrum in filios, et incredulos ad prudentiam justorum, parare Domino plebem perfectam.
text_pt: E irá adiante dele no espírito e virtude de Elias, para converter os corações dos pais aos filhos, e os rebeldes à prudência dos justos, com o fim de preparar ao Senhor um povo bem disposto.
text_el: καὶ αὐτὸς προελεύσεται ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ ἐν πνεύματι καὶ δυνάμει Ἠλίου, ἐπιστρέψαι καρδίας πατέρων ἐπὶ τέκνα καὶ ἀπειθεῖς ἐν φρονήσει δικαίων, ἑτοιμάσαι κυρίῳ λαὸν κατεσκευασμένον.

text_en: And Zachary said to the angel : Whereby shall I know this? For I am an old man , and my wife is advanced in years.
text_la: Et dixit Zacharias ad angelum : Unde hoc sciam? ego enim sum senex, et uxor mea processit in diebus suis.
text_pt: Disse então Zacarias ao anjo: Como saberei isto? pois eu já sou velho, e minha mulher avançada em idade.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ζαχαρίας πρὸς τὸν ἄγγελον: κατὰ τί γνώσομαι τοῦτο; ἐγὼ γάρ εἰμι πρεσβύτης καὶ ἡ γυνή μου προβεβηκυῖα ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτῆς.

text_en: And the angel answering, said to him: I am Gabriel , who stand before God and am sent to speak to you and to bring you these good tidings.
text_la: Et respondens angelus dixit ei : Ego sum Gabriel, qui asto ante Deum : et missus sum loqui ad te, et hæc tibi evangelizare.
text_pt: E, respondendo o anjo, disse-lhe: Eu sou Gabriel, que assisto diante de Deus, e fui enviado a falar-te e dar-te estas alegres novas.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ ἄγγελος εἶπεν αὐτῷ: ἐγώ εἰμι Γαβριὴλ ὁ παρεστηκὼς ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ ἀπεστάλην λαλῆσαι πρὸς σὲ καὶ εὐαγγελίσασθαί σοι ταῦτα:

text_en: And behold, you shall be dumb and shall not be able to speak until the day wherein these things shall come to pass: because you have not believed my words, which shall be fulfilled in their time.
text_la: Et ecce eris tacens, et non poteris loqui usque in diem quo hæc fiant, pro eo quod non credidisti verbis meis, quæ implebuntur in tempore suo.
text_pt: E eis que ficarás mudo, e não poderás falar até ao dia em que estas coisas aconteçam; porquanto não creste nas minhas palavras, que a seu tempo se hão de cumprir.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἔσῃ σιωπῶν καὶ μὴ δυνάμενος λαλῆσαι ἄχρι ἧς ἡμέρας γένηται ταῦτα, ἀνθ' ὧν οὐκ ἐπίστευσας τοῖς λόγοις μου, οἵτινες πληρωθήσονται εἰς τὸν καιρὸν αὐτῶν.

text_en: And the people were waiting for Zachary: and they wondered that he tarried so long in the temple .
text_la: Et erat plebs exspectans Zachariam : et mirabantur quod tardaret ipse in templo.
text_pt: E o povo estava esperando a Zacarias, e maravilhava-se de que tanto se demorasse no templo.
text_el: καὶ ἦν ὁ λαὸς προσδοκῶν τὸν Ζαχαρίαν, καὶ ἐθαύμαζον ἐν τῷ χρονίζειν ἐν τῷ ναῷ αὐτόν.

text_en: And when he came out, he could not speak to them: and they understood that he had seen a vision in the temple . And he made signs to them and remained dumb.
text_la: Egressus autem non poterat loqui ad illos, et cognoverunt quod visionem vidisset in templo. Et ipse erat innuens illis, et permansit mutus.
text_pt: E, saindo ele, não lhes podia falar; e entenderam que tinha tido uma visão no templo. E falava por acenos, e ficou mudo.
text_el: ἐξελθὼν δὲ οὐκ ἐδύνατο λαλῆσαι αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἐπέγνωσαν ὅτι ὀπτασίαν ἑώρακεν ἐν τῷ ναῷ: καὶ αὐτὸς ἦν διανεύων αὐτοῖς, καὶ διέμενεν κωφός.

text_en: And it came to pass, after the days of his office were accomplished, he departed to his own house.
text_la: Et factum est, ut impleti sunt dies officii ejus, abiit in domum suam:
text_pt: E sucedeu que, terminados os dias de seu ministério, voltou para sua casa.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἐπλήσθησαν αἱ ἡμέραι τῆς λειτουργίας αὐτοῦ, ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And after those days, Elizabeth his wife conceived and hid herself five months, saying:
text_la: post hos autem dies concepit Elisabeth uxor ejus, et occultabat se mensibus quinque, dicens:
text_pt: E, depois daqueles dias, Isabel, sua mulher, concebeu, e por cinco meses se ocultou, dizendo:
text_el: μετὰ δὲ ταύτας τὰς ἡμέρας συνέλαβεν Ἐλισάβετ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ: καὶ περιέκρυβεν ἑαυτὴν μῆνας πέντε, λέγουσα

text_en: Thus has the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he has had regard to take away my reproach among men .
text_la: Quia sic fecit mihi Dominus in diebus, quibus respexit auferre opprobrium meum inter homines.
text_pt: Assim me fez o Senhor, nos dias em que atentou em mim, para destruir o meu opróbrio entre os homens.
text_el: ὅτι οὕτως μοι πεποίηκεν κύριος ἐν ἡμέραις αἷς ἐπεῖδεν ἀφελεῖν ὄνειδός μου ἐν ἀνθρώποις.

text_en: And in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God into a city of Galilee , called Nazareth ,
text_la: In mense autem sexto, missus est angelus Gabriel a Deo in civitatem Galilææ, cui nomen Nazareth,
text_pt: E, no sexto mês, foi o anjo Gabriel enviado por Deus a uma cidade da Galiléia, chamada Nazaré,
text_el: Ἐν δὲ τῷ μηνὶ τῷ ἕκτῳ ἀπεστάλη ὁ ἄγγελος Γαβριὴλ ἀπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ εἰς πόλιν τῆς Γαλιλαίας ᾗ ὄνομα Ναζαρὲθ

text_en: to a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph , of the house of David : and the virgin's name was Mary .
text_la: ad virginem desponsatam viro, cui nomen erat Joseph, de domo David : et nomen virginis Maria.
text_pt: A uma virgem desposada com um homem, cujo nome era José, da casa de Davi; e o nome da virgem era Maria.
text_el: πρὸς παρθένον ἐμνηστευμένην ἀνδρὶ ᾧ ὄνομα Ἰωσὴφ ἐξ οἴκου Δαυίδ, καὶ τὸ ὄνομα τῆς παρθένου Μαριάμ.

text_en: And the angel being come in, said unto her: Hail , full of grace , the Lord is with you: blessed are you among women .
text_la: Et ingressus angelus ad eam dixit : Ave gratia plena : Dominus tecum : benedicta tu in mulieribus.
text_pt: E, entrando o anjo aonde ela estava, disse: Salve, agraciada; o Senhor é contigo; bendita és tu entre as mulheres.
text_el: καὶ εἰσελθὼν πρὸς αὐτὴν εἶπεν: χαῖρε, κεχαριτωμένη, ὁ κύριος μετὰ σοῦ.

text_en: Who having heard, was troubled at his saying and thought with herself what manner of salutation this should be.
text_la: Quæ cum audisset, turbata est in sermone ejus, et cogitabat qualis esset ista salutatio.
text_pt: E, vendo-o ela, turbou-se muito com aquelas palavras, e considerava que saudação seria esta.
text_el: ἡ δὲ ἐπὶ τῷ λόγῳ διεταράχθη, καὶ διελογίζετο ποταπὸς εἴη ὁ ἀσπασμὸς οὗτος.

text_en: And the angel said to her: Fear not, Mary , for you have found grace with God .
text_la: Et ait angelus ei : Ne timeas, Maria : invenisti enim gratiam apud Deum.
text_pt: Disse-lhe, então, o anjo: Maria, não temas, porque achaste graça diante de Deus.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ ἄγγελος αὐτῇ: μὴ φοβοῦ, Μαριάμ: εὗρες γὰρ χάριν παρὰ τῷ θεῷ:

text_en: Behold you shall conceive in your womb and shall bring forth a son: and you shall call his name Jesus .
text_la: Ecce concipies in utero, et paries filium, et vocabis nomen ejus Jesum:
text_pt: E eis que em teu ventre conceberás e darás à luz um filho, e pôr-lhe-ás o nome de Jesus.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ συλλήμψῃ ἐν γαστρὶ καὶ τέξῃ υἱόν, καὶ καλέσεις τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦν.

text_en: He shall be great and shall be called the Son of the Most High . And the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of David his father: and he shall reign in the house of Jacob for ever.
text_la: hic erit magnus, et Filius Altissimi vocabitur, et dabit illi Dominus Deus sedem David patris ejus : et regnabit in domo Jacob in æternum,
text_pt: Este será grande, e será chamado filho do Altíssimo; e o Senhor Deus lhe dará o trono de Davi, seu pai;
text_el: οὗτος ἔσται μέγας καὶ υἱὸς ὑψίστου κληθήσεται, καὶ δώσει αὐτῷ κύριος ὁ θεὸς τὸν θρόνον Δαυὶδ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ,

text_en: And of his kingdom there shall be no end.
text_la: et regni ejus non erit finis.
text_pt: E reinará eternamente na casa de Jacó, e o seu reino não terá fim.
text_el: καὶ βασιλεύσει ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Ἰακὼβ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας, καὶ τῆς βασιλείας αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔσται τέλος.

text_en: And Mary said to the angel : How shall this be done, because I know not man?
text_la: Dixit autem Maria ad angelum : Quomodo fiet istud, quoniam virum non cognosco?
text_pt: E disse Maria ao anjo: Como se fará isto, visto que não conheço homem algum?
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Μαριὰμ πρὸς τὸν ἄγγελον: πῶς ἔσται τοῦτο, ἐπεὶ ἄνδρα οὐ γινώσκω;

text_en: And the angel answering, said to her: The Holy Ghost shall come upon you and the power of the Most High shall overshadow you. And therefore also the Holy which shall be born of you shall be called the Son of God .
text_la: Et respondens angelus dixit ei : Spiritus Sanctus superveniet in te, et virtus Altissimi obumbrabit tibi. Ideoque et quod nascetur ex te sanctum, vocabitur Filius Dei.
text_pt: E, respondendo o anjo, disse-lhe: Descerá sobre ti o Espírito Santo, e a virtude do Altíssimo te cobrirá com a sua sombra; por isso também o Santo, que de ti há de nascer, será chamado Filho de Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ ἄγγελος εἶπεν αὐτῇ, πνεῦμα ἅγιον ἐπελεύσεται ἐπὶ σέ, καὶ δύναμις ὑψίστου ἐπισκιάσει σοι: διὸ καὶ τὸ γεννώμενον ἅγιον κληθήσεται, υἱὸς θεοῦ.

text_en: And behold your cousin Elizabeth , she also has conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her that is called barren.
text_la: Et ecce Elisabeth cognata tua, et ipsa concepit filium in senectute sua : et hic mensis sextus est illi, quæ vocatur sterilis:
text_pt: E eis que também Isabel, tua prima, concebeu um filho em sua velhice; e é este o sexto mês para aquela que era chamada estéril;
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ Ἐλισάβετ ἡ συγγενίς σου καὶ αὐτὴ συνείληφεν υἱὸν ἐν γήρει αὐτῆς, καὶ οὗτος μὴν ἕκτος ἐστὶν αὐτῇ τῇ καλουμένῃ στείρᾳ:

text_en: Because no word shall be impossible with God .
text_la: quia non erit impossibile apud Deum omne verbum.
text_pt: Porque para Deus nada é impossível.
text_el: ὅτι οὐκ ἀδυνατήσει παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ πᾶν ῥῆμα.

text_en: And Mary said: Behold the handmaid of the Lord: be it done to me according to your word. And the angel departed from her.
text_la: Dixit autem Maria : Ecce ancilla Domini : fiat mihi secundum verbum tuum. Et discessit ab illa angelus.
text_pt: Disse então Maria: Eis aqui a serva do Senhor; cumpra-se em mim segundo a tua palavra. E o anjo ausentou-se dela.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Μαριάμ: ἰδοὺ ἡ δούλη κυρίου: γένοιτό μοι κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμά σου. καὶ ἀπῆλθεν ἀπ' αὐτῆς ὁ ἄγγελος.

text_en: And Mary rising up in those days, went into the hill country with haste into a city of Juda .
text_la: Exsurgens autem Maria in diebus illis, abiit in montana cum festinatione, in civitatem Juda:
text_pt: E, naqueles dias, levantando-se Maria, foi apressada às montanhas, a uma cidade de Judá,
text_el: Ἀναστᾶσα δὲ Μαριὰμ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ταύταις ἐπορεύθη εἰς τὴν ὀρεινὴν μετὰ σπουδῆς εἰς πόλιν Ἰούδα,

text_en: And she entered into the house of Zachary and saluted Elizabeth .
text_la: et intravit in domum Zachariæ, et salutavit Elisabeth.
text_pt: E entrou em casa de Zacarias, e saudou a Isabel.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον Ζαχαρίου καὶ ἠσπάσατο τὴν Ἐλισάβετ.

text_en: And it came to pass that when Elizabeth heard the salutation of Mary , the infant leaped in her womb. And Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost .
text_la: Et factum est, ut audivit salutationem Mariæ Elisabeth, exsultavit infans in utero ejus : et repleta est Spiritu Sancto Elisabeth:
text_pt: E aconteceu que, ao ouvir Isabel a saudação de Maria, a criancinha saltou no seu ventre; e Isabel foi cheia do Espírito Santo.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἤκουσεν τὸν ἀσπασμὸν τῆς Μαρίας ἡ Ἐλισάβετ, ἐσκίρτησεν τὸ βρέφος ἐν τῇ κοιλίᾳ αὐτῆς. καὶ ἐπλήσθη πνεύματος ἁγίου ἡ Ἐλισάβετ,

text_en: And she cried out with a loud voice and said: Blessed are you among women and blessed is the fruit of your womb.
text_la: et exclamavit voce magna, et dixit : Benedicta tu inter mulieres, et benedictus fructus ventris tui.
text_pt: E exclamou com grande voz, e disse: Bendita és tu entre as mulheres, e bendito o fruto do teu ventre.
text_el: καὶ ἀνεφώνησεν κραυγῇ μεγάλῃ καὶ εἶπεν: εὐλογημένη σὺ ἐν γυναιξίν, καὶ εὐλογημένος ὁ καρπὸς τῆς κοιλίας σου.

text_en: And whence is this to me that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
text_la: Et unde hoc mihi, ut veniat mater Domini mei ad me?
text_pt: E de onde me provém isto a mim, que venha visitar-me a mãe do meu Senhor?
text_el: καὶ πόθεν μοι τοῦτο ἵνα ἔλθῃ ἡ μήτηρ τοῦ κυρίου μου πρὸς ἐμέ;

text_en: For behold as soon as the voice of your salutation sounded in my ears, the infant in my womb leaped for joy .
text_la: Ecce enim ut facta est vox salutationis tuæ in auribus meis, exsultavit in gaudio infans in utero meo.
text_pt: Pois eis que, ao chegar aos meus ouvidos a voz da tua saudação, a criancinha saltou de alegria no meu ventre.
text_el: ἰδοὺ γὰρ ὡς ἐγένετο ἡ φωνὴ τοῦ ἀσπασμοῦ σου εἰς τὰ ὦτά μου, ἐσκίρτησεν ἐν ἀγαλλιάσει τὸ βρέφος ἐν τῇ κοιλίᾳ μου.

text_en: And blessed are you that have believed , because those things shall be accomplished that were spoken to you by the Lord.
text_la: Et beata, quæ credidisti, quoniam perficientur ea, quæ dicta sunt tibi a Domino.
text_pt: Bem-aventurada a que creu, pois hão de cumprir-se as coisas que da parte do Senhor lhe foram ditas.
text_el: καὶ μακαρία ἡ πιστεύσασα ὅτι ἔσται τελείωσις τοῖς λελαλημένοις αὐτῇ παρὰ κυρίου.

text_en: And Mary said: My soul does magnify the Lord .
text_la: Et ait Maria : Magnificat anima mea Dominum :
text_pt: Disse então Maria: A minha alma engrandece ao Senhor,
text_el: Καὶ εἶπεν Μαριάμ:

text_en: And my spirit has rejoiced in God my Saviour .
text_la: et exsultavit spiritus meus in Deo salutari meo.
text_pt: E o meu espírito se alegra em Deus meu Salvador;
text_el: μεγαλύνει ἡ ψυχή μου τὸν κύριον, καὶ ἠγαλλίασεν τὸ πνεῦμά μου ἐπὶ τῷ θεῷ τῷ σωτῆρί μου,

text_en: Because he has regarded the humility of his handmaid: for behold from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed .
text_la: Quia respexit humilitatem ancillæ suæ : ecce enim ex hoc beatam me dicent omnes generationes,
text_pt: Porque atentou na baixeza de sua serva; Pois eis que desde agora todas as gerações me chamarão bem-aventurada,
text_el: ὅτι ἐπέβλεψεν ἐπὶ τὴν ταπείνωσιν τῆς δούλης αὐτοῦ. ἰδοὺ γὰρ ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν μακαριοῦσίν με πᾶσαι αἱ γενεαί,

text_en: Because he that is mighty has done great things to me: and holy is his name .
text_la: quia fecit mihi magna qui potens est : et sanctum nomen ejus,
text_pt: Porque me fez grandes coisas o Poderoso; E santo é seu nome.
text_el: ὅτι ἐποίησέν μοι μεγάλα ὁ δυνατός. καὶ ἅγιον τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ,

text_en: And his mercy is from generation unto generations , to them that fear him.
text_la: et misericordia ejus a progenie in progenies timentibus eum.
text_pt: E a sua misericórdia é de geração em geração Sobre os que o temem.
text_el: καὶ τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ εἰς γενεὰς καὶ γενεὰς τοῖς φοβουμένοις αὐτόν.

text_en: He has showed might in his arm: he has scattered the proud in the conceit of their heart.
text_la: Fecit potentiam in brachio suo : dispersit superbos mente cordis sui.
text_pt: Com o seu braço agiu valorosamente; Dissipou os soberbos no pensamento de seus corações.
text_el: ἐποίησεν κράτος ἐν βραχίονι αὐτοῦ, διεσκόρπισεν ὑπερηφάνους διανοίᾳ καρδίας αὐτῶν:

text_en: He has put down the mighty from their seat and has exalted the humble .
text_la: Deposuit potentes de sede, et exaltavit humiles.
text_pt: Depôs dos tronos os poderosos, E elevou os humildes.
text_el: καθεῖλεν δυνάστας ἀπὸ θρόνων καὶ ὕψωσεν ταπεινούς,

text_en: He has filled the hungry with good things: and the rich he has sent empty away.
text_la: Esurientes implevit bonis : et divites dimisit inanes.
text_pt: Encheu de bens os famintos, E despediu vazios os ricos.
text_el: πεινῶντας ἐνέπλησεν ἀγαθῶν καὶ πλουτοῦντας ἐξαπέστειλεν κενούς.

text_en: He has received Israel his servant, being mindful of his mercy.
text_la: Suscepit Israël puerum suum, recordatus misericordiæ suæ :
text_pt: Auxiliou a Israel seu servo, Recordando-se da sua misericórdia;
text_el: ἀντελάβετο Ἰσραὴλ παιδὸς αὐτοῦ, μνησθῆναι ἐλέους,

text_en: As he spoke to our fathers: to Abraham and to his seed for ever.
text_la: sicut locutus est ad patres nostros, Abraham et semini ejus in sæcula.
text_pt: Como falou a nossos pais, Para com Abraão e a sua posteridade, para sempre.
text_el: καθὼς ἐλάλησεν πρὸς τοὺς πατέρας ἡμῶν, τῷ Ἀβραὰμ καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.

text_en: And Mary abode with her about three months. And she returned to her own house.
text_la: Mansit autem Maria cum illa quasi mensibus tribus : et reversa est in domum suam.
text_pt: E Maria ficou com ela quase três meses, e depois voltou para sua casa.
text_el: Ἔμεινεν δὲ Μαριὰμ σὺν αὐτῇ ὡς μῆνας τρεῖς, καὶ ὑπέστρεψεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτῆς.

text_en: Now Elizabeth's full time of being delivered had come: and she brought forth a son.
text_la: Elisabeth autem impletum est tempus pariendi, et peperit filium.
text_pt: E completou-se para Isabel o tempo de dar à luz, e teve um filho.
text_el: Τῇ δὲ Ἐλισάβετ ἐπλήσθη ὁ χρόνος τοῦ τεκεῖν αὐτήν, καὶ ἐγέννησεν υἱόν.

text_en: And her neighbors and kinsfolk heard that the Lord had showed his great mercy towards her: and they congratulated with her.
text_la: Et audierunt vicini et cognati ejus quia magnificavit Dominus misericordiam suam cum illa, et congratulabantur ei.
text_pt: E os seus vizinhos e parentes ouviram que tinha Deus usado para com ela de grande misericórdia, e alegraram-se com ela.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσαν οἱ περίοικοι καὶ οἱ συγγενεῖς αὐτῆς ὅτι ἐμεγάλυνεν κύριος τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτῆς, καὶ συνέχαιρον αὐτῇ.

text_en: And it came to pass that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child: and they called him by his father's name Zachary.
text_la: Et factum est in die octavo, venerunt circumcidere puerum, et vocabant eum nomine patris sui Zachariam.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, ao oitavo dia, vieram circuncidar o menino, e lhe chamavam Zacarias, o nome de seu pai.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ὀγδόῃ ἦλθον περιτεμεῖν τὸ παιδίον, καὶ ἐκάλουν αὐτὸ ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ Ζαχαρίαν.

text_en: And his mother answering, said: Not so. But he shall be called John .
text_la: Et respondens mater ejus, dixit : Nequaquam, sed vocabitur Joannes.
text_pt: E, respondendo sua mãe, disse: Não, porém será chamado João.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθεῖσα ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ εἶπεν: οὐχί, ἀλλὰ κληθήσεται Ἰωάννης.

text_en: And they said to her: There is none of your kindred that is called by this name .
text_la: Et dixerunt ad illam : Quia nemo est in cognatione tua, qui vocetur hoc nomine.
text_pt: E disseram-lhe: Ninguém há na tua parentela que se chame por este nome.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς αὐτὴν ὅτι οὐδείς ἐστιν ἐκ τῆς συγγενείας σου ὃς καλεῖται τῷ ὀνόματι τούτῳ.

text_en: And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called.
text_la: Innuebant autem patri ejus, quem vellet vocari eum.
text_pt: E perguntaram por acenos ao pai como queria que lhe chamassem.
text_el: ἐνένευον δὲ τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ τὸ τί ἂν θέλοι καλεῖσθαι αὐτό.

text_en: And demanding a writing table, he wrote, saying: John is his name . And they all wondered.
text_la: Et postulans pugillarem scripsit, dicens : Joannes est nomen ejus. Et mirati sunt universi.
text_pt: E, pedindo ele uma tabuinha de escrever, escreveu, dizendo: O seu nome é João. E todos se maravilharam.
text_el: καὶ αἰτήσας πινακίδιον ἔγραψεν λέγων: Ἰωάννης ἐστὶν ὄνομα αὐτοῦ. καὶ ἐθαύμασαν πάντες.

text_en: And immediately his mouth was opened and his tongue loosed: and he spoke, blessing God .
text_la: Apertum est autem illico os ejus, et lingua ejus, et loquebatur benedicens Deum.
text_pt: E logo a boca se lhe abriu, e a língua se lhe soltou; e falava, louvando a Deus.
text_el: ἀνεῴχθη δὲ τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ παραχρῆμα καὶ ἡ γλῶσσα αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐλάλει εὐλογῶν τὸν θεόν.

text_en: And fear came upon all their neighbours: and all these things were noised abroad over all the hill country of Judea .
text_la: Et factus est timor super omnes vicinos eorum : et super omnia montana Judææ divulgabantur omnia verba hæc:
text_pt: E veio temor sobre todos os seus vizinhos, e em todas as montanhas da Judéia foram divulgadas todas estas coisas.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐπὶ πάντας φόβος τοὺς περιοικοῦντας αὐτούς, καὶ ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ ὀρεινῇ τῆς Ἰουδαίας διελαλεῖτο πάντα τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα,

text_en: And all they that had heard them laid them up in their heart, saying: What an one, do you think, shall this child be? For the hand of the Lord was with him.
text_la: et posuerunt omnes qui audierant in corde suo, dicentes : Quis, putas, puer iste erit? etenim manus Domini erat cum illo.
text_pt: E todos os que as ouviam as conservavam em seus corações, dizendo: Quem será, pois, este menino? E a mão do Senhor estava com ele.
text_el: καὶ ἔθεντο πάντες οἱ ἀκούσαντες ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῶν, λέγοντες: τί ἄρα τὸ παιδίον τοῦτο ἔσται; καὶ γὰρ χεὶρ κυρίου ἦν μετ' αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And Zachary his father was filled with the Holy Ghost . And he prophesied , saying:
text_la: Et Zacharias pater ejus repletus est Spiritu Sancto : et prophetavit, dicens:
text_pt: E Zacarias, seu pai, foi cheio do Espírito Santo, e profetizou, dizendo:
text_el: Καὶ Ζαχαρίας ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ ἐπλήσθη πνεύματος ἁγίου καὶ ἐπροφήτευσεν λέγων:

text_en: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel : because he has visited and wrought the redemption of his people.
text_la: Benedictus Dominus Deus Israël, quia visitavit, et fecit redemptionem plebis suæ :
text_pt: Bendito o Senhor Deus de Israel, Porque visitou e remiu o seu povo,
text_el: εὐλογητὸς κύριος ὁ θεὸς τοῦ Ἰσραήλ, ὅτι ἐπεσκέψατο καὶ ἐποίησεν λύτρωσιν τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ,

text_en: And has raised up an horn of salvation to us, in the house of David his servant.
text_la: et erexit cornu salutis nobis in domo David pueri sui,
text_pt: E nos levantou uma salvação poderosa Na casa de Davi seu servo.
text_el: καὶ ἤγειρεν κέρας σωτηρίας ἡμῖν ἐν οἴκῳ Δαυὶδ παιδὸς αὐτοῦ,

text_en: As he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets , who are from the beginning.
text_la: sicut locutum est per os sanctorum, qui a sæculo sunt, prophetarum ejus :
text_pt: Como falou pela boca dos seus santos profetas, desde o princípio do mundo;
text_el: καθὼς ἐλάλησεν διὰ στόματος τῶν ἁγίων ἀπ' αἰῶνος προφητῶν αὐτοῦ,

text_en: Salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all that hate us.
text_la: salutem ex inimicis nostris, et de manu omnium qui oderunt nos :
text_pt: Para nos livrar dos nossos inimigos e da mão de todos os que nos odeiam;
text_el: σωτηρίαν ἐξ ἐχθρῶν ἡμῶν καὶ ἐκ χειρὸς πάντων τῶν μισούντων ἡμᾶς:

text_en: To perform mercy to our fathers and to remember his holy testament.
text_la: ad faciendam misericordiam cum patribus nostris : et memorari testamenti sui sancti :
text_pt: Para manifestar misericórdia a nossos pais, E lembrar-se da sua santa aliança,
text_el: ποιῆσαι ἔλεος μετὰ τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν καὶ μνησθῆναι διαθήκης ἁγίας αὐτοῦ,

text_en: The oath , which he swore to Abraham our father, that he would grant to us.
text_la: jusjurandum, quod juravit ad Abraham patrem nostrum, daturum se nobis
text_pt: E do juramento que jurou a Abraão nosso pai,
text_el: ὅρκον ὃν ὤμοσεν πρὸς Ἀβραὰμ τὸν πατέρα ἡμῶν, τοῦ δοῦναι ἡμῖν

text_en: That being delivered from the hand of our enemies, we may serve him without fear:
text_la: ut sine timore, de manu inimicorum nostrorum liberati, serviamus illi
text_pt: De conceder-nos que, Libertados da mão de nossos inimigos, o serviríamos sem temor,
text_el: ἀφόβως ἐκ χειρὸς ἐχθρῶν ῥυσθέντας λατρεύειν αὐτῷ

text_en: In holiness and justice before him, all our days.
text_la: in sanctitate et justitia coram ipso, omnibus diebus nostris.
text_pt: Em santidade e justiça perante ele, todos os dias da nossa vida.
text_el: ἐν ὁσιότητι καὶ δικαιοσύνῃ ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ πάσαις ταῖς ἡμέραις ἡμῶν.

text_en: And you, child, shall be called the prophet of the Highest: for you shall, go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways:
text_la: Et tu puer, propheta Altissimi vocaberis : præibis enim ante faciem Domini parare vias ejus,
text_pt: E tu, ó menino, serás chamado profeta do Altíssimo, Porque hás de ir ante a face do Senhor, a preparar os seus caminhos;
text_el: καὶ σὺ δέ παιδίον, προφήτης ὑψίστου κληθήσῃ: προπορεύσῃ γὰρ ἐνώπιον κυρίου ἑτοιμάσαι ὁδοὺς αὐτοῦ,

text_en: To give knowledge of salvation to his people, unto the remission of their sins .
text_la: ad dandam scientiam salutis plebi ejus in remissionem peccatorum eorum
text_pt: Para dar ao seu povo conhecimento da salvação, Na remissão dos seus pecados;
text_el: τοῦ δοῦναι γνῶσιν σωτηρίας τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ ἐν ἀφέσει ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: Through the bowels of the mercy of our God , in which the Orient from on high has visited us:
text_la: per viscera misericordiæ Dei nostri, in quibus visitavit nos, oriens ex alto :
text_pt: Pelas entranhas da misericórdia do nosso Deus, Com que o oriente do alto nos visitou;
text_el: διὰ σπλάγχνα ἐλέους θεοῦ ἡμῶν, ἐν οἷς ἐπισκέψεται ἡμᾶς ἀνατολὴ ἐξ ὕψους,

text_en: To enlighten them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death: to direct our feet into the way of peace.
text_la: illuminare his qui in tenebris et in umbra mortis sedent : ad dirigendos pedes nostros in viam pacis.
text_pt: Para iluminar aos que estão assentados em trevas e na sombra da morte; A fim de dirigir os nossos pés pelo caminho da paz.
text_el: ἐπιφᾶναι τοῖς ἐν σκότει καὶ σκιᾷ θανάτου καθημένοις, τοῦ κατευθῦναι τοὺς πόδας ἡμῶν εἰς ὁδὸν εἰρήνης.

text_en: And the child grew and was strengthened in spirit: and was in the deserts until the day of his manifestation to Israel .
text_la: Puer autem crescebat, et confortabatur spiritu : et erat in desertis usque in diem ostensionis suæ ad Israël.
text_pt: E o menino crescia, e se robustecia em espírito. E esteve nos desertos até ao dia em que havia de mostrar-se a Israel.
text_el: Τὸ δὲ παιδίον ηὔξανεν καὶ ἐκραταιοῦτο πνεύματι, καὶ ἦν ἐν ταῖς ἐρήμοις ἕως ἡμέρας ἀναδείξεως αὐτοῦ πρὸς τὸν Ἰσραήλ.

text_en: And it came to pass that in those days there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus that the whole world should be enrolled.
text_la: Factum est autem in diebus illis, exiit edictum a Cæsare Augusto ut describeretur universus orbis.
text_pt: E aconteceu naqueles dias que saiu um decreto da parte de César Augusto, para que todo o mundo se alistasse
text_el: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις ἐξῆλθεν δόγμα παρὰ Καίσαρος Αὐγούστου ἀπογράφεσθαι πᾶσαν τὴν οἰκουμένην.

text_en: This enrolling was first made by Cyrinus, the governor of Syria .
text_la: Hæc descriptio prima facta est a præside Syriæ Cyrino:
text_pt: (Este primeiro alistamento foi feito sendo Quirino presidente da Síria).
text_el: αὕτη ἀπογραφὴ πρώτη ἐγένετο ἡγεμονεύοντος τῆς Συρίας Κυρηνίου.

text_en: And all went to be enrolled, every one into his own city.
text_la: et ibant omnes ut profiterentur singuli in suam civitatem.
text_pt: E todos iam alistar-se, cada um à sua própria cidade.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύοντο πάντες ἀπογράφεσθαι, ἕκαστος εἰς τὴν ἑαυτοῦ πόλιν.

text_en: And Joseph also went up from Galilee , out of the city of Nazareth , into Judea , to the city of David , which is called Bethlehem : because he was of the house and family of David .
text_la: Ascendit autem et Joseph a Galilæa de civitate Nazareth in Judæam, in civitatem David, quæ vocatur Bethlehem : eo quod esset de domo et familia David,
text_pt: E subiu também José da Galiléia, da cidade de Nazaré, à Judéia, à cidade de Davi, chamada Belém (porque era da casa e família de Davi),
text_el: ἀνέβη δὲ καὶ Ἰωσὴφ ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας ἐκ πόλεως Ναζαρὲθ εἰς τὴν Ἰουδαίαν εἰς πόλιν Δαυὶδ ἥτις καλεῖται Βηθλέεμ, διὰ τὸ εἶναι αὐτὸν ἐξ οἴκου καὶ πατριᾶς Δαυίδ,

text_en: To be enrolled with Mary his espoused wife, who was with child.
text_la: ut profiteretur cum Maria desponsata sibi uxore prægnante.
text_pt: A fim de alistar-se com Maria, sua esposa, que estava grávida.
text_el: ἀπογράψασθαι σὺν Μαριὰμ τῇ ἐμνηστευμένῃ αὐτῷ, οὔσῃ ἐγκύῳ.

text_en: And it came to pass that when they were there, her days were accomplished that she should be delivered.
text_la: Factum est autem, cum essent ibi, impleti sunt dies ut pareret.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, estando eles ali, se cumpriram os dias em que ela havia de dar à luz.
text_el: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ εἶναι αὐτοὺς ἐκεῖ ἐπλήσθησαν αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ τεκεῖν αὐτήν,

text_en: And she brought forth her first born son and wrapped him up in swaddling clothes and laid him in a manger : because there was no room for them in the inn.
text_la: Et peperit filium suum primogenitum, et pannis eum involvit, et reclinavit eum in præsepio : quia non erat eis locus in diversorio.
text_pt: E deu à luz a seu filho primogênito, e envolveu-o em panos, e deitou-o numa manjedoura, porque não havia lugar para eles na estalagem.
text_el: καὶ ἔτεκεν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτῆς τὸν πρωτότοκον, καὶ ἐσπαργάνωσεν αὐτὸν καὶ ἀνέκλινεν αὐτὸν ἐν φάτνῃ, διότι οὐκ ἦν αὐτοῖς τόπος ἐν τῷ καταλύματι.

text_en: And there were in the same country shepherds watching and keeping the night watches over their flock.
text_la: Et pastores erant in regione eadem vigilantes, et custodientes vigilias noctis super gregem suum.
text_pt: Ora, havia naquela mesma comarca pastores que estavam no campo, e guardavam, durante as vigílias da noite, o seu rebanho.
text_el: Καὶ ποιμένες ἦσαν ἐν τῇ χώρᾳ τῇ αὐτῇ ἀγραυλοῦντες καὶ φυλάσσοντες φυλακὰς τῆς νυκτὸς ἐπὶ τὴν ποίμνην αὐτῶν.

text_en: And behold an angel of the Lord stood by them and the brightness of God shone round about them: and they feared with a great fear.
text_la: Et ecce angelus Domini stetit juxta illos, et claritas Dei circumfulsit illos, et timuerunt timore magno.
text_pt: E eis que o anjo do Senhor veio sobre eles, e a glória do Senhor os cercou de resplendor, e tiveram grande temor.
text_el: καὶ ἄγγελος κυρίου ἐπέστη αὐτοῖς καὶ δόξα κυρίου περιέλαμψεν αὐτούς, καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν φόβον μέγαν.

text_en: And the angel said to them: Fear not; for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy that shall be to all the people:
text_la: Et dixit illis angelus : Nolite timere : ecce enim evangelizo vobis gaudium magnum, quod erit omni populo:
text_pt: E o anjo lhes disse: Não temais, porque eis aqui vos trago novas de grande alegria, que será para todo o povo:
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ ἄγγελος: μὴ φοβεῖσθε: ἰδοὺ γὰρ εὐαγγελίζομαι ὑμῖν χαρὰν μεγάλην ἥτις ἔσται παντὶ τῷ λαῷ,

text_en: For, this day is born to you a Saviour, who is Christ the Lord , in the city of David .
text_la: quia natus est vobis hodie Salvator, qui est Christus Dominus, in civitate David.
text_pt: Pois, na cidade de Davi, vos nasceu hoje o Salvador, que é Cristo, o Senhor.
text_el: ὅτι ἐτέχθη ὑμῖν σήμερον σωτὴρ ὅς ἐστιν Χριστὸς κύριος ἐν πόλει Δαυίδ:

text_en: And this shall be a sign unto you. You shall find the infant wrapped in swaddling clothes and laid in a manger .
text_la: Et hoc vobis signum : invenietis infantem pannis involutum, et positum in præsepio.
text_pt: E isto vos será por sinal: Achareis o menino envolto em panos, e deitado numa manjedoura.
text_el: καὶ τοῦτο ὑμῖν σημεῖον, εὑρήσετε βρέφος ἐσπαργανωμένον καὶ κείμενον ἐν φάτνῃ.

text_en: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army, praising God and saying:
text_la: Et subito facta est cum angelo multitudo militiæ cælestis laudantium Deum, et dicentium:
text_pt: E, no mesmo instante, apareceu com o anjo uma multidão dos exércitos celestiais, louvando a Deus, e dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐξαίφνης ἐγένετο σὺν τῷ ἀγγέλῳ πλῆθος στρατιᾶς οὐρανίου αἰνούντων τὸν θεὸν καὶ λεγόντων:

text_en: Glory to God in the highest : and on earth peace to men of good will.
text_la: Gloria in altissimis Deo, et in terra pax hominibus bonæ voluntatis.
text_pt: Glória a Deus nas alturas, Paz na terra, boa vontade para com os homens.
text_el: δόξα ἐν ὑψίστοις θεῷ καὶ ἐπὶ γῆς εἰρήνη ἐν ἀνθρώποις εὐδοκίας.

text_en: And it came to pass, after the angels departed from them into heaven , the shepherds said one to another: Let us go over to Bethlehem and let us see this word that has come to pass, which the Lord has showed to us.
text_la: Et factum est, ut discesserunt ab eis angeli in cælum : pastores loquebantur ad invicem : Transeamus usque Bethlehem, et videamus hoc verbum, quod factum est, quod Dominus ostendit nobis.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, ausentando-se deles os anjos para o céu, disseram os pastores uns aos outros: Vamos, pois, até Belém, e vejamos isso que aconteceu, e que o Senhor nos fez saber.
text_el: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἀπῆλθον ἀπ' αὐτῶν εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν οἱ ἄγγελοι, οἱ ποιμένες ἐλάλουν πρὸς ἀλλήλους: διέλθωμεν δὴ ἕως Βηθλέεμ καὶ ἴδωμεν τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο τὸ γεγονὸς ὃ ὁ κύριος ἐγνώρισεν ἡμῖν.

text_en: And they came with haste: and they found Mary and Joseph , and the infant lying in the manger .
text_la: Et venerunt festinantes : et invenerunt Mariam, et Joseph, et infantem positum in præsepio.
text_pt: E foram apressadamente, e acharam Maria, e José, e o menino deitado na manjedoura.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθαν σπεύσαντες, καὶ ἀνεῦραν τήν τε Μαριὰμ καὶ τὸν Ἰωσὴφ καὶ τὸ βρέφος κείμενον ἐν τῇ φάτνῃ:

text_en: And seeing, they understood of the word that had been spoken to them concerning this child.
text_la: Videntes autem cognoverunt de verbo, quod dictum erat illis de puero hoc.
text_pt: E, vendo-o, divulgaram a palavra que acerca do menino lhes fora dita;
text_el: ἰδόντες δὲ ἐγνώρισαν περὶ τοῦ ῥήματος τοῦ λαληθέντος αὐτοῖς περὶ τοῦ παιδίου τούτου.

text_en: And all that heard wondered: and at those things that were told them by the shepherds.
text_la: Et omnes qui audierunt, mirati sunt : et de his quæ dicta erant a pastoribus ad ipsos.
text_pt: E todos os que a ouviram se maravilharam do que os pastores lhes diziam.
text_el: καὶ πάντες οἱ ἀκούσαντες ἐθαύμασαν περὶ τῶν λαληθέντων ὑπὸ τῶν ποιμένων πρὸς αὐτούς:

text_en: But Mary kept all these words, pondering them in her heart.
text_la: Maria autem conservabat omnia verba hæc, conferens in corde suo.
text_pt: Mas Maria guardava todas estas coisas, conferindo-as em seu coração.
text_el: ἡ δὲ Μαρία πάντα συνετήρει τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα συμβάλλουσα ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῆς.

text_en: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.
text_la: Et reversi sunt pastores glorificantes et laudantes Deum in omnibus quæ audierant et viderant, sicut dictum est ad illos.
text_pt: E voltaram os pastores, glorificando e louvando a Deus por tudo o que tinham ouvido e visto, como lhes havia sido dito.
text_el: καὶ ὑπέστρεψαν οἱ ποιμένες, δοξάζοντες καὶ αἰνοῦντες τὸν θεὸν ἐπὶ πᾶσιν οἷς ἤκουσαν καὶ εἶδον καθὼς ἐλαλήθη πρὸς αὐτούς.

text_en: And after eight days were accomplished, that the child should be circumcised , his name was called JESUS, which was called by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
text_la: Et postquam consummati sunt dies octo, ut circumcideretur puer, vocatum est nomen ejus Jesus, quod vocatum est ab angelo priusquam in utero conciperetur.
text_pt: E, quando os oito dias foram cumpridos, para circuncidar o menino, foi-lhe dado o nome de Jesus, que pelo anjo lhe fora posto antes de ser concebido.
text_el: Καὶ ὅτε ἐπλήσθησαν ἡμέραι ὀκτὼ τοῦ περιτεμεῖν αὐτόν, καὶ ἐκλήθη τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦς, τὸ κληθὲν ὑπὸ τοῦ ἀγγέλου πρὸ τοῦ συλλημφθῆναι αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ κοιλίᾳ.

text_en: And after the days of her purification, according to the law of Moses , were accomplished, they carried him to Jerusalem , to present him to the Lord:
text_la: Et postquam impleti sunt dies purgationis ejus secundum legem Moysi, tulerunt illum in Jerusalem, ut sisterent eum Domino,
text_pt: E, cumprindo-se os dias da purificação dela, segundo a lei de Moisés, o levaram a Jerusalém, para o apresentarem ao Senhor
text_el: Καὶ ὅτε ἐπλήσθησαν αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ καθαρισμοῦ αὐτῶν, κατὰ τὸν νόμον Μωϋσέως, ἀνήγαγον αὐτὸν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα παραστῆσαι τῷ κυρίῳ,

text_en: As it is written in the law of the Lord: Every male opening the womb shall be called holy to the Lord:
text_la: sicut scriptum est in lege Domini : Quia omne masculinum adaperiens vulvam, sanctum Domino vocabitur:
text_pt: (Segundo o que está escrito na lei do Senhor: Todo o macho primogênito será consagrado ao Senhor);
text_el: καθὼς γέγραπται ἐν νόμῳ κυρίου ὅτι πᾶν ἄρσεν διανοῖγον μήτραν ἅγιον τῷ κυρίῳ κληθήσεται,

text_en: And to offer a sacrifice , according as it is written in the law of the Lord, a pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons:
text_la: et ut darent hostiam secundum quod dictum est in lege Domini, par turturum, aut duos pullos columbarum.
text_pt: E para darem a oferta segundo o disposto na lei do Senhor: Um par de rolas ou dois pombinhos.
text_el: καὶ τοῦ δοῦναι θυσίαν κατὰ τὸ εἰρημένον ἐν τῷ νόμῳ, κυρίου, ζεῦγος τρυγόνων ἢ δύο νοσσοὺς περιστερῶν.

text_en: And behold there was a man in Jerusalem named Simeon : and this man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel . And the Holy Ghost was in him.
text_la: Et ecce homo erat in Jerusalem, cui nomen Simeon, et homo iste justus, et timoratus, exspectans consolationem Israël : et Spiritus Sanctus erat in eo.
text_pt: Havia em Jerusalém um homem cujo nome era Simeão; e este homem era justo e temente a Deus, esperando a consolação de Israel; e o Espírito Santo estava sobre ele.
text_el: Καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄνθρωπος ἦν ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ ᾧ ὄνομα Συμεών, καὶ ὁ ἄνθρωπος οὗτος δίκαιος καὶ εὐλαβής, προσδεχόμενος παράκλησιν τοῦ Ἰσραήλ, καὶ πνεῦμα ἦν ἅγιον ἐπ' αὐτόν:

text_en: And he had received an answer from the Holy Ghost , that he should not see death before he had seen the Christ of the Lord .
text_la: Et responsum acceperat a Spiritu Sancto, non visurum se mortem, nisi prius videret Christum Domini.
text_pt: E fora-lhe revelado, pelo Espírito Santo, que ele não morreria antes de ter visto o Cristo do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἦν αὐτῷ κεχρηματισμένον ὑπὸ τοῦ πνεύματος τοῦ ἁγίου, μὴ ἰδεῖν θάνατον πρὶν ἢ ἂν ἴδῃ τὸν Χριστὸν κυρίου.

text_en: And he came by the Spirit into the temple . And when his parents brought in the child Jesus , to do for him according to the custom of the law,
text_la: Et venit in spiritu in templum. Et cum inducerent puerum Jesum parentes ejus, ut facerent secundum consuetudinem legis pro eo,
text_pt: E pelo Espírito foi ao templo e, quando os pais trouxeram o menino Jesus, para com ele procederem segundo o uso da lei,
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν ἐν τῷ πνεύματι εἰς τὸ ἱερόν: καὶ ἐν τῷ εἰσαγαγεῖν τοὺς γονεῖς τὸ παιδίον Ἰησοῦν τοῦ ποιῆσαι αὐτοὺς κατὰ τὸ εἰθισμένον τοῦ νόμου περὶ αὐτοῦ,

text_en: he also took him into his arms and blessed God and said:
text_la: et ipse accepit eum in ulnas suas : et benedixit Deum, et dixit:
text_pt: Ele, então, o tomou em seus braços, e louvou a Deus, e disse:
text_el: καὶ αὐτὸς ἐδέξατο αὐτὸ εἰς τὰς ἀγκάλας καὶ εὐλόγησεν τὸν θεὸν καὶ εἶπεν:

text_en: Now dismiss your servant , O Lord, according to your word in peace:
text_la: Nunc dimittis servum tuum Domine, secundum verbum tuum in pace :
text_pt: Agora, Senhor, despedes em paz o teu servo, Segundo a tua palavra;
text_el: νῦν ἀπολύεις τὸν δοῦλόν σου, δέσποτα, κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμά σου ἐν εἰρήνῃ:

text_en: Because my eyes have seen your salvation ,
text_la: quia viderunt oculi mei salutare tuum,
text_pt: Pois já os meus olhos viram a tua salvação,
text_el: ὅτι εἶδον οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου τὸ σωτήριόν σου,

text_en: which you have prepared before the face of all peoples:
text_la: quod parasti ante faciem omnium populorum:
text_pt: A qual tu preparaste perante a face de todos os povos;
text_el: ὃ ἡτοίμασας κατὰ πρόσωπον πάντων τῶν λαῶν,

text_en: A light to the revelation of the Gentiles and the glory of your people Israel .
text_la: lumen ad revelationem gentium, et gloriam plebis tuæ Israël.
text_pt: Luz para iluminar as nações, E para glória de teu povo Israel.
text_el: φῶς εἰς ἀποκάλυψιν ἐθνῶν καὶ δόξαν λαοῦ σου Ἰσραήλ.

text_en: And his father and mother were wondering at those things which were spoken concerning him.
text_la: Et erat pater ejus et mater mirantes super his quæ dicebantur de illo.
text_pt: E José, e sua mãe, se maravilharam das coisas que dele se diziam.
text_el: καὶ ἦν ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ μήτηρ θαυμάζοντες ἐπὶ τοῖς λαλουμένοις περὶ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And Simeon blessed them and said to Mary his mother: Behold this child is set for the fall and for the resurrection of many in Israel and for a sign which shall be contradicted.
text_la: Et benedixit illis Simeon, et dixit ad Mariam matrem ejus : Ecce positus est hic in ruinam et in resurrectionem multorum in Israël, et in signum cui contradicetur:
text_pt: E Simeão os abençoou, e disse a Maria, sua mãe: Eis que este é posto para queda e elevação de muitos em Israel, e para sinal que é contraditado
text_el: καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτοὺς Συμεὼν καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς Μαριὰμ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ: ἰδοὺ οὗτος κεῖται εἰς πτῶσιν καὶ ἀνάστασιν πολλῶν ἐν τῷ Ἰσραὴλ καὶ εἰς σημεῖον ἀντιλεγόμενον.

text_en: And your own soul a sword shall pierce, that, out of many hearts thoughts may be revealed.
text_la: et tuam ipsius animam pertransibit gladius ut revelentur ex multis cordibus cogitationes.
text_pt: (E uma espada traspassará também a tua própria alma); para que se manifestem os pensamentos de muitos corações.
text_el: καὶ σοῦ αὐτῆς τὴν ψυχὴν διελεύσεται ῥομφαία, ὅπως ἂν ἀποκαλυφθῶσιν ἐκ πολλῶν καρδιῶν διαλογισμοί.

text_en: And there was one Anna , a prophetess , the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser . She was far advanced in years and had lived with her husband seven years from her virginity.
text_la: Et erat Anna prophetissa, filia Phanuel, de tribu Aser : hæc processerat in diebus multis, et vixerat cum viro suo annis septem a virginitate sua.
text_pt: E estava ali a profetisa Ana, filha de Fanuel, da tribo de Aser. Esta era já avançada em idade, e tinha vivido com o marido sete anos, desde a sua virgindade;
text_el: Καὶ ἦν Ἅννα προφῆτις, θυγάτηρ Φανουήλ, ἐκ φυλῆς Ἀσήρ: αὕτη προβεβηκυῖα ἐν ἡμέραις πολλαῖς, Ζήσασα μετὰ ἀνδρὸς ἔτη ἑπτὰ ἀπὸ τῆς παρθενίας αὐτῆς,

text_en: And she was a widow until fourscore and four years: who departed not from the temple , by fastings and prayers serving night and day.
text_la: Et hæc vidua usque ad annos octoginta quatuor : quæ non discedebat de templo, jejuniis et obsecrationibus serviens nocte ac die.
text_pt: E era viúva, de quase oitenta e quatro anos, e não se afastava do templo, servindo a Deus em jejuns e orações, de noite e de dia.
text_el: καὶ αὐτὴ χήρα ἕως ἐτῶν ὀγδοήκοντα τεσσάρων, ἣ οὐκ ἀφίστατο τοῦ ἱεροῦ νηστείαις καὶ δεήσεσιν λατρεύουσα νύκτα καὶ ἡμέραν.

text_en: Now she, at the same hour, coming in, confessed to the Lord: and spoke of him to all that looked for the redemption of Israel .
text_la: Et hæc, ipsa hora superveniens, confitebatur Domino : et loquebatur de illo omnibus, qui exspectabant redemptionem Israël.
text_pt: E sobrevindo na mesma hora, ela dava graças a Deus, e falava dele a todos os que esperavam a redenção em Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ ἐπιστᾶσα ἀνθωμολογεῖτο τῷ θεῷ καὶ ἐλάλει περὶ αὐτοῦ πᾶσιν τοῖς προσδεχομένοις λύτρωσιν Ἰερουσαλήμ.

text_en: And after they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee , to their city Nazareth .
text_la: Et ut perfecerunt omnia secundum legem Domini, reversi sunt in Galilæam in civitatem suam Nazareth.
text_pt: E, quando acabaram de cumprir tudo segundo a lei do Senhor, voltaram à Galiléia, para a sua cidade de Nazaré.
text_el: Καὶ ὡς ἐτέλεσαν πάντα τὰ κατὰ τὸν νόμον κυρίου, ἐπέστρεψαν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν εἰς πόλιν ἑαυτῶν Ναζαρέθ.

text_en: And the child grew and waxed strong, full of wisdom: and the grace of God was in him.
text_la: Puer autem crescebat, et confortabatur plenus sapientia : et gratia Dei erat in illo.
text_pt: E o menino crescia, e se fortalecia em espírito, cheio de sabedoria; e a graça de Deus estava sobre ele.
text_el: τὸ δὲ παιδίον ηὔξανεν καὶ ἐκραταιοῦτο πληρούμενον σοφίᾳ, καὶ χάρις θεοῦ ἦν ἐπ' αὐτό.

text_en: And his parents went every year to Jerusalem , at the solemn day of the pasch .
text_la: Et ibant parentes ejus per omnes annos in Jerusalem, in die solemni Paschæ.
text_pt: Ora, todos os anos iam seus pais a Jerusalém à festa da páscoa;
text_el: Καὶ ἐπορεύοντο οἱ γονεῖς αὐτοῦ κατ' ἔτος εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ τῇ ἑορτῇ τοῦ πάσχα.

text_en: And when he was twelve years old, they going up into Jerusalem , according to the custom of the feast,
text_la: Et cum factus esset annorum duodecim, ascendentibus illis Jerosolymam secundum consuetudinem diei festi,
text_pt: E, tendo ele já doze anos, subiram a Jerusalém, segundo o costume do dia da festa.
text_el: καὶ ὅτε ἐγένετο ἐτῶν δώδεκα, ἀναβαινόντων αὐτῶν κατὰ τὸ ἔθος τῆς ἑορτῆς,

text_en: and having fulfilled the days, when they returned, the child Jesus remained in Jerusalem . And his parents knew it not.
text_la: consummatisque diebus, cum redirent, remansit puer Jesus in Jerusalem, et non cognoverunt parentes ejus.
text_pt: E, regressando eles, terminados aqueles dias, ficou o menino Jesus em Jerusalém, e não o soube José, nem sua mãe.
text_el: καὶ τελειωσάντων τὰς ἡμέρας, ἐν τῷ ὑποστρέφειν αὐτοὺς ὑπέμεινεν Ἰησοῦς ὁ παῖς ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ, καὶ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν οἱ γονεῖς αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And thinking that he was in the company, they came a day's journey and sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.
text_la: Existimantes autem illum esse in comitatu, venerunt iter diei, et requirebant eum inter cognatos et notos.
text_pt: Pensando, porém, eles que viria de companhia pelo caminho, andaram caminho de um dia, e procuravam-no entre os parentes e conhecidos;
text_el: νομίσαντες δὲ αὐτὸν εἶναι ἐν τῇ συνοδίᾳ ἦλθον ἡμέρας ὁδὸν καὶ ἀνεζήτουν αὐτὸν ἐν τοῖς συγγενεῦσιν καὶ τοῖς γνωστοῖς,

text_en: And not finding him, they returned into Jerusalem , seeking him.
text_la: Et non invenientes, regressi sunt in Jerusalem, requirentes eum.
text_pt: E, como o não encontrassem, voltaram a Jerusalém em busca dele.
text_el: καὶ μὴ εὑρόντες ὑπέστρεψαν εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἀναζητοῦντες αὐτόν.

text_en: And it came to pass, that, after three days, they found him in the temple , sitting in the midst of the doctors , hearing them and asking them questions.
text_la: Et factum est, post triduum invenerunt illum in templo sedentem in medio doctorum, audientem illos, et interrogantem eos.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, passados três dias, o acharam no templo, assentado no meio dos doutores, ouvindo-os, e interrogando-os.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ ἡμέρας τρεῖς εὗρον αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καθεζόμενον ἐν μέσῳ τῶν διδασκάλων καὶ ἀκούοντα αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπερωτῶντα αὐτούς:

text_en: And all that heard him were astonished at his wisdom and his answers.
text_la: Stupebant autem omnes qui eum audiebant, super prudentia et responsis ejus.
text_pt: E todos os que o ouviam admiravam a sua inteligência e respostas.
text_el: ἐξίσταντο δὲ πάντες οἱ ἀκούοντες αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῇ συνέσει καὶ ταῖς ἀποκρίσεσιν αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And seeing him, they wondered. And his mother said to him: Son, why have you done so to us? Behold your father and I have sought you sorrowing.
text_la: Et videntes admirati sunt. Et dixit mater ejus ad illum : Fili, quid fecisti nobis sic? ecce pater tuus et ego dolentes quærebamus te.
text_pt: E quando o viram, maravilharam-se, e disse-lhe sua mãe: Filho, por que fizeste assim para conosco? Eis que teu pai e eu ansiosos te procurávamos.
text_el: καὶ ἰδόντες αὐτὸν ἐξεπλάγησαν, καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ: τέκνον, τί ἐποίησας ἡμῖν οὕτως; ἰδοὺ ὁ πατήρ σου καὶ ἐγὼ ὀδυνώμενοι ζητοῦμέν ἐζητοῦμέν σε.

text_en: And he said to them: How is it that you sought me? Did you not know that I must be about my father's business?
text_la: Et ait ad illos : Quid est quod me quærebatis? nesciebatis quia in his quæ Patris mei sunt, oportet me esse?
text_pt: E ele lhes disse: Por que é que me procuráveis? Não sabeis que me convém tratar dos negócios de meu Pai?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς: τί ὅτι ἐζητεῖτέ με; οὐκ ᾔδειτε ὅτι ἐν τοῖς τοῦ πατρός μου δεῖ εἶναί με;

text_en: And they understood not the word that he spoke unto them.
text_la: Et ipsi non intellexerunt verbum quod locutus est ad eos.
text_pt: E eles não compreenderam as palavras que lhes dizia.
text_el: καὶ αὐτοὶ οὐ συνῆκαν τὸ ῥῆμα ὃ ἐλάλησεν αὐτοῖς.

text_en: And he went down with them and came to Nazareth and was subject to them. And his mother kept all these words in her heart.
text_la: Et descendit cum eis, et venit Nazareth : et erat subditus illis. Et mater ejus conservabat omnia verba hæc in corde suo.
text_pt: E desceu com eles, e foi para Nazaré, e era-lhes sujeito. E sua mãe guardava no seu coração todas estas coisas.
text_el: καὶ κατέβη μετ' αὐτῶν καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς Ναζαρέθ, καὶ ἦν ὑποτασσόμενος αὐτοῖς. καὶ ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ διετήρει πάντα τὰ ῥήματα ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῆς.

text_en: And Jesus advanced in wisdom and age and grace with God and men .
text_la: Et Jesus proficiebat sapientia, et ætate, et gratia apud Deum et homines.
text_pt: E crescia Jesus em sabedoria, e em estatura, e em graça para com Deus e os homens.
text_el: καὶ Ἰησοῦς προέκοπτεν τῇ σοφίᾳ καὶ ἡλικίᾳ καὶ χάριτι παρὰ θεῷ καὶ ἀνθρώποις.

text_en: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar , Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea , and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee , and Philip his brother tetrarch of Iturea and the country of Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilina,
text_la: Anno autem quintodecimo imperii Tiberii Cæsaris, procurante Pontio Pilato Judæam, tetrarcha autem Galiææ Herode, Philippo autem fratre ejus tetrarcha Iturææ, et Trachonitidis regionis, et Lysania Abilinæ tetrarcha,
text_pt: E no ano quinze do império de Tibério César, sendo Pôncio Pilatos presidente da Judéia, e Herodes tetrarca da Galiléia, e seu irmão Filipe tetrarca da Ituréia e da província de Traconites, e Lisânias tetrarca de Abilene,
text_el: Ἐν ἔτει δὲ πεντεκαιδεκάτῳ τῆς ἡγεμονίας Τιβερίου Καίσαρος, ἡγεμονεύοντος Ποντίου Πιλάτου τῆς Ἰουδαίας, καὶ τετρααρχοῦντος τῆς Γαλιλαίας Ἡρῴδου, Φιλίππου δὲ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ τετρααρχοῦντος τῆς Ἰτουραίας καὶ Τραχωνίτιδος χώρας, καὶ Λυσανίου τῆς Ἀβιληνῆς τετρααρχοῦντος,

text_en: under the high priests Annas and Caiphas , the word of the Lord was made unto John , the son of Zachary, in the desert .
text_la: sub principibus sacerdotum Anna et Caipha : factum est verbum Domini super Joannem, Zachariæ filium, in deserto.
text_pt: Sendo Anás e Caifás sumos sacerdotes, veio no deserto a palavra de Deus a João, filho de Zacarias.
text_el: ἐπὶ ἀρχιερέως Ἅννα καὶ Καϊάφα, ἐγένετο ῥῆμα θεοῦ ἐπὶ Ἰωάννην τὸν Ζαχαρίου υἱὸν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ.

text_en: And he came into all the country about the Jordan , preaching the baptism of penance for the remission of sins ,
text_la: Et venit in omnem regionem Jordanis, prædicans baptismum pœnitentiæ in remissionem peccatorum,
text_pt: E percorreu toda a terra ao redor do Jordão, pregando o batismo de arrependimento, para o perdão dos pecados;
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς πᾶσαν περίχωρον τοῦ Ἰορδάνου κηρύσσων βάπτισμα μετανοίας εἰς ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν,

text_en: as it was written in the book of the sayings of Isaiah the prophet : "A voice of one crying in the wilderness : Prepare the way of the Lord, make straight his paths.
text_la: sicut scriptum est in libro sermonum Isaiæ prophetæ : Vox clamantis in deserto : Parate viam Domini; rectas facite semitas ejus :
text_pt: Segundo o que está escrito no livro das palavras do profeta Isaías, que diz: Voz do que clama no deserto: Preparai o caminho do Senhor; Endireitai as suas veredas.
text_el: ὡς γέγραπται ἐν βίβλῳ λόγων Ἠσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου: φωνὴ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ: ἑτοιμάσατε τὴν ὁδὸν κυρίου, εὐθείας ποιεῖτε τὰς τρίβους αὐτοῦ:

text_en: Every valley shall be filled and every mountain and hill shall be brought low, and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways plain.
text_la: omnis vallis implebitur, et omnis mons, et collis humiliabitur : et erunt prava in directa, et aspera in vias planas :
text_pt: Todo o vale se encherá, E se abaixará todo o monte e outeiro; E o que é tortuoso se endireitará, E os caminhos escabrosos se aplanarão;
text_el: πᾶσα φάραγξ πληρωθήσεται καὶ πᾶν ὄρος καὶ βουνὸς ταπεινωθήσεται, καὶ ἔσται τὰ σκολιὰ εἰς εὐθείας καὶ αἱ τραχεῖαι εἰς ὁδοὺς λείας:

text_en: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God ."
text_la: et videbit omnis caro salutare Dei.
text_pt: E toda a carne verá a salvação de Deus.
text_el: καὶ ὄψεται πᾶσα σὰρξ τὸ σωτήριον τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: He said therefore to the multitudes that went forth to be baptized by him: You offspring of vipers, who has showed you to flee from the wrath to come?
text_la: Dicebat ergo ad turbas quæ exibant ut baptizarentur ab ipso : Genimina viperarum, quis ostendit vobis fugere a ventura ira?
text_pt: Dizia, pois, João à multidão que saía para ser batizada por ele: Raça de víboras, quem vos ensinou a fugir da ira que está para vir?
text_el: Ἔλεγεν οὖν τοῖς ἐκπορευομένοις ὄχλοις βαπτισθῆναι ὑπ' αὐτοῦ: γεννήματα ἐχιδνῶν, τίς ὑπέδειξεν ὑμῖν φυγεῖν ἀπὸ τῆς μελλούσης ὀργῆς;

text_en: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of penance : and do not begin to say, We have Abraham for our father. For I say unto you that God is able of these stones, to raise up children to Abraham .
text_la: Facite ergo fructus dignos pœnitentiæ, et ne cœperitis dicere : Patrem habemus Abraham. Dico enim vobis quia potens est Deus de lapidibus istis suscitare filios Abrahæ.
text_pt: Produzi, pois, frutos dignos de arrependimento, e não comeceis a dizer em vós mesmos: Temos Abraão por pai; porque eu vos digo que até destas pedras pode Deus suscitar filhos a Abraão.
text_el: ποιήσατε οὖν καρποὺς ἀξίους τῆς μετανοίας: καὶ μὴ ἄρξησθε λέγειν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς: πατέρα ἔχομεν τὸν Ἀβραάμ: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι δύναται ὁ θεὸς ἐκ τῶν λίθων τούτων ἐγεῖραι τέκνα τῷ Ἀβραάμ.

text_en: For now the axe is laid to the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that brings not forth good fruit shall be cut down and cast into the fire.
text_la: Jam enim securis ad radicem arborum posita est. Omnis ergo arbor non faciens fructum bonum, excidetur, et in ignem mittetur.
text_pt: E também já está posto o machado à raiz das árvores; toda a árvore, pois, que não dá bom fruto, corta-se e lança-se no fogo.
text_el: ἤδη δὲ καὶ ἡ ἀξίνη πρὸς τὴν ῥίζαν τῶν δένδρων κεῖται: πᾶν οὖν δένδρον μὴ ποιοῦν καρπὸν [καλὸν] ἐκκόπτεται καὶ εἰς πῦρ βάλλεται.

text_en: And the people asked him, saying: What then shall we do?
text_la: Et interrogabant eum turbæ, dicentes : Quid ergo faciemus?
text_pt: E a multidão o interrogava, dizendo: Que faremos, pois?
text_el: Καὶ ἐπηρώτων αὐτὸν οἱ ὄχλοι λέγοντες: τί οὖν ποιήσωμεν;

text_en: And he answering, said to them: He that has two coats, let him give to him that has none; and he that has meat, let him do in like manner.
text_la: Respondens autem dicebat illis : Qui habet duas tunicas, det non habenti : et qui habet escas, similiter faciat.
text_pt: E, respondendo ele, disse-lhes: Quem tiver duas túnicas, reparta com o que não tem, e quem tiver alimentos, faça da mesma maneira.
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς: ὁ ἔχων δύο χιτῶνας μεταδότω τῷ μὴ ἔχοντι, καὶ ὁ ἔχων βρώματα ὁμοίως ποιείτω.

text_en: And the publicans also came to be baptized and said to him: Master, what shall we do?
text_la: Venerunt autem et publicani ut baptizarentur, et dixerunt ad illum : Magister, quid faciemus?
text_pt: E chegaram também uns publicanos, para serem batizados, e disseram-lhe: Mestre, que devemos fazer?
text_el: ἦλθον δὲ καὶ τελῶναι βαπτισθῆναι καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς αὐτόν: διδάσκαλε, τί ποιήσωμεν;

text_en: But he said to them: Do nothing more than that which is appointed you.
text_la: At ille dixit ad eos : Nihil amplius, quam quod constitutum est vobis, faciatis.
text_pt: E ele lhes disse: Não peçais mais do que o que vos está ordenado.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς: μηδὲν πλέον παρὰ τὸ διατεταγμένον ὑμῖν πράσσετε.

text_en: And the soldiers also asked him, saying: And what shall we do? And he said to them: Do violence to no man , neither calumniate any man ; and be content with your pay.
text_la: Interrogabant autem eum et milites, dicentes : Quid faciemus et nos? Et ait illis : Neminem concutiatis, neque calumniam faciatis : et contenti estote stipendiis vestris.
text_pt: E uns soldados o interrogaram também, dizendo: E nós que faremos? E ele lhes disse: A ninguém trateis mal nem defraudeis, e contentai-vos com o vosso soldo.
text_el: ἐπηρώτων δὲ αὐτὸν καὶ στρατευόμενοι λέγοντες: τί ποιήσωμεν καὶ ἡμεῖς; καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: μηδένα διασείσητε, μηδὲ συκοφαντήσητε, καὶ ἀρκεῖσθε τοῖς ὀψωνίοις ὑμῶν.

text_en: And as the people were of opinion, and all were thinking in their hearts of John , that perhaps he might be the Christ :
text_la: Existimante autem populo, et cogitantibus omnibus in cordibus suis de Joanne, ne forte ipse esset Christus,
text_pt: E, estando o povo em expectação, e pensando todos de João, em seus corações, se porventura seria o Cristo,
text_el: Προσδοκῶντος δὲ τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ διαλογιζομένων πάντων ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις αὐτῶν περὶ τοῦ Ἰωάννου, μήποτε αὐτὸς εἴη ὁ Χριστός,

text_en: John answered, saying unto all: I indeed baptize you with water: but there shall come one mightier than I, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to loose. He shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire;
text_la: respondit Joannes, dicens omnibus : Ego quidem aqua baptizo vos : veniet autem fortior me, cujus non sum dignus solvere corrigiam calceamentorum ejus : ipse vos baptizabit in Spiritu Sancto et igni:
text_pt: Respondeu João a todos, dizendo: Eu, na verdade, batizo-vos com água, mas eis que vem aquele que é mais poderoso do que eu, do qual não sou digno de desatar a correia das alparcas; esse vos batizará com o Espírito Santo e com fogo.
text_el: ἀπεκρίνατο λέγων πᾶσιν ὁ Ἰωάννης: ἐγὼ μὲν ὕδατι βαπτίζω ὑμᾶς: ἔρχεται δὲ ὁ ἰσχυρότερός μου, οὗ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἱκανὸς λῦσαι τὸν ἱμάντα τῶν ὑποδημάτων αὐτοῦ, αὐτὸς ὑμᾶς βαπτίσει ἐν πνεύματι ἁγίῳ καὶ πυρί:

text_en: whose fan is in his hand: and he will purge his floor and will gather the wheat into his barn: but the chaff he will burn with unquenchable fire.
text_la: cujus ventilabrum in manu ejus, et purgabit aream suam, et congregabit triticum in horreum suum, paleas autem comburet igni inextinguibili.
text_pt: Ele tem a pá na sua mão; e limpará a sua eira, e ajuntará o trigo no seu celeiro, mas queimará a palha com fogo que nunca se apaga.
text_el: οὗ τὸ πτύον ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ διακαθᾶραι τὴν ἅλωνα αὐτοῦ καὶ συναγαγεῖν τὸν σῖτον εἰς τὴν ἀποθήκην αὐτοῦ, τὸ δὲ ἄχυρον κατακαύσει πυρὶ ἀσβέστῳ.

text_en: And many other things exhorting did he preach to the people.
text_la: Multa quidem et alia exhortans evangelizabat populo.
text_pt: E assim, admoestando-os, muitas outras coisas também anunciava ao povo.
text_el: Πολλὰ μὲν οὖν καὶ ἕτερα παρακαλῶν εὐηγγελίζετο τὸν λαόν:

text_en: But Herod the tetrarch , when he was reproved by him for Herodias , his brother's wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done:
text_la: Herodes autem tetrarcha cum corriperetur ab illo de Herodiade uxore fratris sui, et de omnibus malis quæ fecit Herodes,
text_pt: Sendo, porém, o tetrarca Herodes repreendido por ele por causa de Herodias, mulher de seu irmão Filipe, e por todas as maldades que Herodes tinha feito,
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἡρῴδης ὁ τετραάρχης, ἐλεγχόμενος ὑπ' αὐτοῦ περὶ Ἡρῳδιάδος τῆς γυναικὸς τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ περὶ πάντων ὧν ἐποίησεν πονηρῶν ὁ Ἡρῴδης,

text_en: He added this also above all and shut up John in prison .
text_la: adjecit et hoc super omnia, et inclusit Joannem in carcere.
text_pt: Acrescentou a todas as outras ainda esta, a de encerrar João num cárcere.
text_el: προσέθηκεν καὶ τοῦτο ἐπὶ πᾶσιν, κατέκλεισεν τὸν Ἰωάννην ἐν φυλακῇ.

text_en: Now it came to pass, when all the people were baptized , that Jesus also being baptized and praying , heaven was opened.
text_la: Factum est autem cum baptizaretur omnis populus, et Jesu baptizato, et orante, apertum est cælum:
text_pt: E aconteceu que, como todo o povo se batizava, sendo batizado também Jesus, orando ele, o céu se abriu;
text_el: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ βαπτισθῆναι ἅπαντα τὸν λαὸν καὶ Ἰησοῦ βαπτισθέντος καὶ προσευχομένου ἀνεῳχθῆναι τὸν οὐρανὸν,

text_en: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape, as a dove , upon him. And a voice came from heaven : You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased.
text_la: et descendit Spiritus Sanctus corporali specie sicut columba in ipsum : et vox de cælo facta est : Tu es filius meus dilectus, in te complacui mihi.
text_pt: E o Espírito Santo desceu sobre ele em forma corpórea, como pomba; e ouviu-se uma voz do céu, que dizia: Tu és o meu Filho amado, em ti me comprazo.
text_el: καὶ καταβῆναι τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον σωματικῷ εἴδει ὡς περιστερὰν ἐπ' αὐτόν, καὶ φωνὴν ἐξ οὐρανοῦ γενέσθαι, σὺ εἶ ὁ υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός, ἐν σοὶ εὐδόκησα.

text_en: And Jesus himself was beginning about the age of thirty years: being (as it was supposed) the son of Joseph , who was of Heli , who was of Mathat,
text_la: Et ipse Jesus erat incipiens quasi annorum triginta, ut putabatur, filius Joseph, qui fuit Heli, qui fuit Mathat,
text_pt: E o mesmo Jesus começava a ser de quase trinta anos, sendo (como se cuidava) filho de José, e José de Heli,
text_el: Καὶ αὐτὸς ἦν Ἰησοῦς ἀρχόμενος ὡσεὶ ἐτῶν τριάκοντα, ὢν υἱός, ὡς ἐνομίζετο, Ἰωσὴφ τοῦ Ἠλὶ

text_en: who was of Levi, who was of Melchi, who was of Janne, who was of Joseph,
text_la: qui fuit Levi, qui fuit Melchi, qui fuit Janne, qui fuit Joseph,
text_pt: E Heli de Matã, e Matã de Levi, e Levi de Melqui, e Melqui de Janai, e Janai de José,
text_el: τοῦ Μαθθὰτ τοῦ Λευὶ τοῦ Μελχὶ τοῦ Ἰανναὶ τοῦ Ἰωσὴφ

text_en: who was of Mathathias , who was of Amos, who was of Nahum, who was of Hesli, who was of Nagge,
text_la: qui fuit Mathathiæ, qui fuit Amos, qui fuit Nahum, qui fuit Hesli, qui fuit Nagge,
text_pt: E José de Matatias, e Matatias de Amós, e Amós de Naum, e Naum de Esli, e Esli de Nagaí,
text_el: τοῦ Ματταθίου τοῦ Ἀμὼς τοῦ Ναοὺμ τοῦ Ἑσλὶ τοῦ Ναγγαὶ

text_en: who was of Mahath, who was of Mathathias , who was of Semei, who was of Joseph, who was of Juda ,
text_la: qui fuit Mahath, qui fuit Mathathiæ, qui fuit Semei, qui fuit Joseph, qui fuit Juda,
text_pt: E Nagaí de Máate, e Máate de Matatias, e Matatias de Semei, e Semei de José, e José de Jodá,
text_el: τοῦ Μάαθ τοῦ Ματταθίου τοῦ Σεμεῒν τοῦ Ἰωσὴχ τοῦ Ἰωδὰ

text_en: who was of Joanna, who was of Reza, who was of Zorobabel, who was of Salathiel, who was of Neri,
text_la: qui fuit Joanna, qui fuit Resa, qui fuit Zorobabel, qui fuit Salatheil, qui fuit Neri,
text_pt: E Jodá de Joanã, e Joanã de Resá, e Resá de Zorobabel, e Zorobabel de Salatiel, e Salatiel de Neri,
text_el: τοῦ Ἰωανὰν τοῦ Ῥησὰ τοῦ Ζοροβαβὲλ τοῦ Σαλαθιὴλ τοῦ Νηρὶ

text_en: who was of Melchi, who was of Addi, who was of Cosan, who was of Helmadan, who was of Her,
text_la: qui fuit Melchi, qui fuit Addi, qui fuit Cosan, qui fuit Elmadan, qui fuit Her,
text_pt: E Neri de Melqui, e Melqui de Adi, e Adi de Cosã, e Cosã de Elmadã, e Elmadã de Er,
text_el: τοῦ Μελχὶ τοῦ Ἀδδὶ τοῦ Κωσὰμ τοῦ Ἐλμαδὰμ τοῦ Ἢρ

text_en: who was of Jesus, who was of Eliezer, who was of Jorim, who was of Mathat, who was of Levi,
text_la: qui fuit Jesu, qui fuit Eliezer, qui fuit Jorim, qui fuit Mathat, qui fuit Levi,
text_pt: E Er de Josué, e Josué de Eliézer, e Eliézer de Jorim, e Jorim de Matã, e Matã de Levi,
text_el: τοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Ἐλιέζερ τοῦ Ἰωρὶμ τοῦ Μαθθὰτ τοῦ Λευὶ

text_en: who was of Simeon, who was of Judas, who was of Joseph, who was of Jona, who was of Eliakim,
text_la: qui fuit Simeon, qui fuit Juda, qui fuit Joseph, qui fuit Jona, qui fuit Eliakim,
text_pt: E Levi de Simeão, e Simeão de Judá, e Judá de José, e José de Jonã, e Jonã de Eliaquim,
text_el: τοῦ Συμεὼν τοῦ Ἰούδα τοῦ Ἰωσὴφ τοῦ Ἰωνὰμ τοῦ Ἐλιακὶμ

text_en: who was of Melea, who was of Menna, who was of Mathatha, who was of Nathan , who was of David ,
text_la: qui fuit Melea, qui fuit Menna, qui fuit Mathatha, qui fuit Natham, qui fuit David,
text_pt: E Eliaquim de Meleá, e Meleá de Mená, e Mená de Matatá, e Matatá de Natã, e Natã de Davi,
text_el: τοῦ Μελεὰ τοῦ Μεννὰ τοῦ Ματταθὰ τοῦ Ναθὰμ τοῦ Δαυὶδ

text_en: who was of Jesse, who was of Obed, who was of Booz, who was of Salmon, who was of Naasson,
text_la: qui fuit Jesse, qui fuit Obed, qui fuit Booz, qui fuit Salmon, qui fuit Naasson,
text_pt: E Davi de Jessé, e Jessé de Obede, e Obede de Boaz, e Boaz de Salá, e Salá de Naassom,
text_el: τοῦ Ἰεσσαὶ τοῦ Ἰωβὴδ τοῦ Βόος τοῦ Σαλὰ τοῦ Ναασσὼν

text_en: who was of Aminadab, who was of Aram, who was of Esron, who was of Phares, who was of Judas ,
text_la: qui fuit Aminadab, qui fuit Aram, qui fuit Esron, qui fuit Phares, qui fuit Judæ,
text_pt: E Naassom de Aminadabe, e Aminadabe de Arão, e Arão de Esrom, e Esrom Perez, e Perez de Judá,
text_el: τοῦ Ἀδμὶν τοῦ Ἀρνὶ τοῦ Ἑσρὼμ τοῦ Φάρες τοῦ Ἰούδα

text_en: who was of Jacob , who was of Isaac , who was of Abraham , who was of Thare, who was of Nachor,
text_la: qui fuit Jacob, qui fuit Isaac, qui fuit Abrahæ, qui fuit Thare, qui fuit Nachor,
text_pt: E Judá de Jacó, e Jacó de Isaque, e Isaque de Abraão, e Abraão de Terá, e Terá de Nacor,
text_el: τοῦ Ἰακὼβ τοῦ Ἰσαὰκ τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ τοῦ Θάρα τοῦ Ναχὼρ

text_en: who was of Sarug, who was of Ragau, who was of Phaleg, who was of Heber, who was of Sale,
text_la: qui fuit Sarug, qui fuit Ragau, qui fuit Phaleg, qui fuit Heber, qui fuit Sale,
text_pt: E Nacor de Seruque, e Seruque de Ragaú, e Ragaú de Fáleque, e Fáleque de Eber, e Eber de Salá,
text_el: τοῦ Σεροὺχ τοῦ Ῥαγαὺ τοῦ Φάλεκ τοῦ Ἔβερ τοῦ Σαλὰ

text_en: who was of Cainan, who was of Arphaxad, who was of Sem , who was of Noe , who was of Lamech,
text_la: qui fuit Cainan, qui fuit Arphaxad, qui fuit Sem, qui fuit Noë, qui fuit Lamech,
text_pt: E Salá de Cainã, e Cainã de Arfaxade, e Arfaxade de Sem, e Sem de Noé, e Noé de Lameque,
text_el: τοῦ Καϊνὰμ τοῦ Ἀρφαξὰδ τοῦ Σὴμ τοῦ Νῶε τοῦ Λάμεχ

text_en: who was of Mathusale , who was of Henoch , who was of Jared, who was of Malaleel, who was of Cainan,
text_la: qui fuit Methusale, qui fuit Henoch, qui fuit Jared, qui fuit Malaleel, qui fuit Cainan,
text_pt: E Lameque de Matusalém, e Matusalém de Enoque, e Enoque de Jarete, e Jarete de Maleleel, e Maleleel de Cainã,
text_el: τοῦ Μαθουσαλὰ τοῦ Ἑνὼχ τοῦ Ἰάρετ τοῦ Μαλελεὴλ τοῦ Καϊνὰμ

text_en: who was of Henos, who was of Seth, who was of Adam , who was of God .
text_la: qui fuit Henos, qui fuit Seth, qui fuit Adam, qui fuit Dei.
text_pt: E Cainã de Enos, e Enos de Sete, e Sete de Adão, e Adão de Deus.
text_el: τοῦ Ἐνὼς τοῦ Σὴθ τοῦ Ἀδὰμ τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost , returned from the Jordan and was led the by the spirit into the desert ,
text_la: Jesus autem plenus Spiritu Sancto regressus est a Jordane : et agebatur a Spiritu in desertum
text_pt: E Jesus, cheio do Espírito Santo, voltou do Jordão e foi levado pelo Espírito ao deserto;
text_el: Ἰησοῦς δὲ πλήρης πνεύματος ἁγίου ὑπέστρεψεν ἀπὸ τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, καὶ ἤγετο ἐν τῷ πνεύματι ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ

text_en: for the space of forty days, and was tempted by the devil . And he ate nothing in those days. And when they were ended, he was hungry.
text_la: diebus quadraginta, et tentabatur a diabolo. Et nihil manducavit in diebus illis : et consummatis illis esuriit.
text_pt: E quarenta dias foi tentado pelo diabo, e naqueles dias não comeu coisa alguma; e, terminados eles, teve fome.
text_el: ἡμέρας τεσσεράκοντα πειραζόμενος ὑπὸ τοῦ διαβόλου. καὶ οὐκ ἔφαγεν οὐδὲν ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις, καὶ συντελεσθεισῶν αὐτῶν ἐπείνασεν.

text_en: And the devil said to him: If you be the Son of God , say to this stone that it be made bread.
text_la: Dixit autem illi diabolus : Si Filius Dei es, dic lapidi huic ut panis fiat.
text_pt: E disse-lhe o diabo: Se tu és o Filho de Deus, dize a esta pedra que se transforme em pão.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ διάβολος: εἰ υἱὸς εἶ τοῦ θεοῦ, εἰπὲ τῷ λίθῳ τούτῳ ἵνα γένηται ἄρτος.

text_en: And Jesus answered him: is written that Man lives not by bread alone, but by every word of God .
text_la: Et respondit ad illum Jesus : Scriptum est : Quia non in solo pane vivit homo, sed in omni verbo Dei.
text_pt: E Jesus lhe respondeu, dizendo: Está escrito que nem só de pão viverá o homem, mas de toda a palavra de Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ Ἰησοῦς: γέγραπται ὅτι οὐκ ἐπ' ἄρτῳ μόνῳ ζήσεται ὁ ἄνθρωπος.

text_en: And the devil led him into a high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
text_la: Et duxit illum diabolus in montem excelsum, et ostendit illi omnia regna orbis terræ in momento temporis,
text_pt: E o diabo, levando-o a um alto monte, mostrou-lhe num momento de tempo todos os reinos do mundo.
text_el: καὶ ἀναγαγὼν αὐτὸν ἔδειξεν αὐτῷ πάσας τὰς βασιλείας τῆς οἰκουμένης ἐν στιγμῇ χρόνου:

text_en: And he said to him: To you will I give all this power and the glory of them. For to me they are delivered: and to whom I will, I give them.
text_la: et ait illi : Tibi dabo potestatem hanc universam, et gloriam illorum : quia mihi tradita sunt, et cui volo do illa.
text_pt: E disse-lhe o diabo: Dar-te-ei a ti todo este poder e a sua glória; porque a mim me foi entregue, e dou-o a quem quero.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ διάβολος: σοὶ δώσω τὴν ἐξουσίαν ταύτην ἅπασαν καὶ τὴν δόξαν αὐτῶν, ὅτι ἐμοὶ παραδέδοται καὶ ᾧ ἐὰν θέλω δίδωμι αὐτήν:

text_en: If you therefore will adore before me, all shall be yours.
text_la: Tu ergo si adoraveris coram me, erunt tua omnia.
text_pt: Portanto, se tu me adorares, tudo será teu.
text_el: σὺ οὖν ἐὰν προσκυνήσῃς ἐνώπιον ἐμοῦ, ἔσται σοῦ πᾶσα.

text_en: And Jesus answering said to him. It is written: You shall adore the Lord your God , and him only shall you serve.
text_la: Et respondens Jesus, dixit illi : Scriptum est : Dominum Deum tuum adorabis, et illi soli servies.
text_pt: E Jesus, respondendo, disse-lhe: Vai-te para trás de mim, Satanás; porque está escrito: Adorarás o Senhor teu Deus, e só a ele servirás.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ: γέγραπται: κύριον τὸν θεόν σου προσκυνήσεις καὶ αὐτῷ μόνῳ λατρεύσεις.

text_en: And he brought him to Jerusalem and set him on a pinnacle of the temple and said to him: If you be the Son of God , cast yourself from hence.
text_la: Et duxit illum in Jerusalem, et statuit eum super pinnam templi, et dixit illi : Si Filius Dei es, mitte te hinc deorsum.
text_pt: Levou-o também a Jerusalém, e pô-lo sobre o pináculo do templo, e disse-lhe: Se tu és o Filho de Deus, lança-te daqui abaixo;
text_el: ἤγαγεν δὲ αὐτὸν εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ καὶ ἔστησεν ἐπὶ τὸ πτερύγιον τοῦ ἱεροῦ, καὶ εἶπεν [αὐτῷ]: εἰ υἱὸς εἶ τοῦ θεοῦ, βάλε σεαυτὸν ἐντεῦθεν κάτω:

text_en: For it is written that He has given his angels charge over you that they keep you.
text_la: Scriptum est enim quod angelis suis mandavit de te, ut conservent te:
text_pt: Porque está escrito: Mandará aos seus anjos, acerca de ti, que te guardem,
text_el: γέγραπται γὰρ ὅτι τοῖς ἀγγέλοις αὐτοῦ ἐντελεῖται περὶ σοῦ τοῦ διαφυλάξαι σε,

text_en: And that in their hands they shall bear you up, lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone.
text_la: et quia in manibus tollent te, ne forte offendas ad lapidem pedem tuum.
text_pt: E que te sustenham nas mãos, Para que nunca tropeces com o teu pé em alguma pedra.
text_el: καὶ ὅτι ἐπὶ χειρῶν ἀροῦσίν σε, μήποτε προσκόψῃς πρὸς λίθον τὸν πόδα σου.

text_en: And Jesus answering, said to him: It is said: You shall not tempt the Lord your God .
text_la: Et respondens Jesus, ait illi : Dictum est : Non tentabis Dominum Deum tuum.
text_pt: E Jesus, respondendo, disse-lhe: Dito está: Não tentarás ao Senhor teu Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι εἴρηται: οὐκ ἐκπειράσεις κύριον τὸν θεόν σου.

text_en: And all the temptation being ended, the devil departed from him for a time.
text_la: Et consummata omni tentatione, diabolus recessit ab illo, usque ad tempus.
text_pt: E, acabando o diabo toda a tentação, ausentou-se dele por algum tempo.
text_el: καὶ συντελέσας πάντα πειρασμὸν ὁ διάβολος ἀπέστη ἀπ' αὐτοῦ ἄχρι καιροῦ.

text_en: And Jesus returned in the power of the spirit, into Galilee : and the fame of him went out through the whole country.
text_la: Et regressus est Jesus in virtute Spiritus in Galilæam, et fama exiit per universam regionem de illo.
text_pt: Então, pela virtude do Espírito, voltou Jesus para a Galiléia, e a sua fama correu por todas as terras em derredor.
text_el: Καὶ ὑπέστρεψεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῇ δυνάμει τοῦ πνεύματος εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν: καὶ φήμη ἐξῆλθεν καθ' ὅλης τῆς περιχώρου περὶ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And he taught in their synagogues and was magnified by all.
text_la: Et ipse docebat in synagogis eorum, et magnificabatur ab omnibus.
text_pt: E ensinava nas suas sinagogas, e por todos era louvado.
text_el: καὶ αὐτὸς ἐδίδασκεν ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς αὐτῶν, δοξαζόμενος ὑπὸ πάντων.

text_en: And he came to Nazareth , where he was brought up: and he went into the synagogue , according to his custom, on the sabbath day : and he rose up to read.
text_la: Et venit Nazareth, ubi erat nutritus, et intravit secundum consuetudinem suam die sabbati in synagogam, et surrexit legere.
text_pt: E, chegando a Nazaré, onde fora criado, entrou num dia de sábado, segundo o seu costume, na sinagoga, e levantou-se para ler.
