text_la: Respondens Simon dixit : Æstimo quia is cui plus donavit. At ille dixit ei : Recte judicasti.
text_pt: E Simão, respondendo, disse: Tenho para mim que é aquele a quem mais perdoou. E ele lhe disse: Julgaste bem.
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς Σίμων εἶπεν: ὑπολαμβάνω ὅτι ᾧ τὸ πλεῖον ἐχαρίσατο. ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῷ: ὀρθῶς ἔκρινας.

text_en: And turning to the woman , he said unto Simon: Do you see this woman ? I entered into your house: you gave me no water for my feet. But she with tears has washed my feet ; and with her hairs has wiped them.
text_la: Et conversus ad mulierem, dixit Simoni : Vides hanc mulierem? Intravi in domum tuam, aquam pedibus meis non dedisti : hæc autem lacrimis rigavit pedes meos, et capillis suis tersit.
text_pt: E, voltando-se para a mulher, disse a Simão: Vês tu esta mulher? Entrei em tua casa, e não me deste água para os pés; mas esta regou-me os pés com lágrimas, e os enxugou com os cabelos de sua cabeça.
text_el: καὶ στραφεὶς πρὸς τὴν γυναῖκα τῷ Σίμωνι ἔφη: βλέπεις ταύτην τὴν γυναῖκα; εἰσῆλθόν σου εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν, ὕδωρ μοι ἐπὶ πόδας οὐκ ἔδωκας: αὕτη δὲ τοῖς δάκρυσιν ἔβρεξέν μου τοὺς πόδας καὶ ταῖς θριξὶν αὐτῆς ἐξέμαξεν.

text_en: You gave me no kiss . But she, since she came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.
text_la: Osculum mihi non dedisti : hæc autem ex quo intravit, non cessavit osculari pedes meos.
text_pt: Não me deste ósculo, mas esta, desde que entrou, não tem cessado de me beijar os pés.
text_el: φίλημά μοι οὐκ ἔδωκας: αὕτη δὲ ἀφ' ἧς εἰσῆλθον οὐ διέλιπεν καταφιλοῦσά μου τοὺς πόδας.

text_en: My head with oil you did not anoint. But she with ointment has anointed my feet.
text_la: Oleo caput meum non unxisti : hæc autem unguento unxit pedes meos.
text_pt: Não me ungiste a cabeça com óleo, mas esta ungiu-me os pés com ungüento.
text_el: ἐλαίῳ τὴν κεφαλήν μου οὐκ ἤλειψας: αὕτη δὲ μύρῳ ἤλειψεν τοὺς πόδας μου.

text_en: Wherefore, I say to you: Many sins are forgiven her, because she has loved much. But to whom less is forgiven, he loves less.
text_la: Propter quod dico tibi : remittuntur ei peccata multa, quoniam dilexit multum. Cui autem minus dimittitur, minus diligit.
text_pt: Por isso te digo que os seus muitos pecados lhe são perdoados, porque muito amou; mas aquele a quem pouco é perdoado pouco ama.
text_el: οὗ χάριν, λέγω σοι, ἀφέωνται αἱ ἁμαρτίαι αὐτῆς αἱ πολλαί, ὅτι ἠγάπησεν πολύ: ᾧ δὲ ὀλίγον ἀφίεται, ὀλίγον ἀγαπᾷ.

text_en: And he said to her: Your sins are forgiven you.
text_la: Dixit autem ad illam : Remittuntur tibi peccata.
text_pt: E disse-lhe a ela: Os teus pecados te são perdoados.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῇ: ἀφέωνταί σου αἱ ἁμαρτίαι.

text_en: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves: Who is this that forgives sins also?
text_la: Et cœperunt qui simul accumbebant, dicere intra se : Quis est hic qui etiam peccata dimittit?
text_pt: E os que estavam à mesa começaram a dizer entre si: Quem é este, que até perdoa pecados?
text_el: καὶ ἤρξαντο οἱ συνανακείμενοι λέγειν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς: τίς οὗτός ἐστιν, ὃς καὶ ἁμαρτίας ἀφίησιν;

text_en: And he said to the woman : Your faith has made you safe. Go in peace.
text_la: Dixit autem ad mulierem : Fides tua te salvam fecit : vade in pace.
text_pt: E disse à mulher: A tua fé te salvou; vai-te em paz.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς τὴν γυναῖκα: ἡ πίστις σου σέσωκέν σε, πορεύου εἰς εἰρήνην.

text_en: And it came to pass afterwards he travelled through the cities and towns, preaching and evangelizing the kingdom of God : and the twelve with him:
text_la: Et factum est deinceps, et ipse iter faciebat per civitates, et castella prædicans, et evangelizans regnum Dei : et duodecim cum illo,
text_pt: E aconteceu, depois disto, que andava de cidade em cidade, e de aldeia em aldeia, pregando e anunciando o evangelho do reino de Deus; e os doze iam com ele,
text_el: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ καθεξῆς καὶ αὐτὸς διώδευεν κατὰ πόλιν καὶ κώμην κηρύσσων καὶ εὐαγγελιζόμενος τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ οἱ δώδεκα σὺν αὐτῷ,

text_en: And certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who is called Magdalen, out of whom seven devils had gone forth,
text_la: et mulieres aliquæ, quæ erant curatæ a spiritibus malignis et infirmatibus : Maria, quæ vocatur Magdalene, de qua septem dæmonia exierant,
text_pt: E algumas mulheres que haviam sido curadas de espíritos malignos e de enfermidades: Maria, chamada Madalena, da qual saíram sete demônios;
text_el: καὶ γυναῖκές τινες αἳ ἦσαν τεθεραπευμέναι ἀπὸ πνευμάτων πονηρῶν καὶ ἀσθενειῶν, Μαρία ἡ καλουμένη Μαγδαληνή, ἀφ' ἧς δαιμόνια ἑπτὰ ἐξεληλύθει,

text_en: and Joanna the wife of Chusa, Herod's steward, and Susanna and many others who ministered unto him of their substance.
text_la: et Joanna uxor Chusæ procuratoris Herodis, et Susanna, et aliæ multæ, quæ ministrabant ei de facultatibus suis.
text_pt: E Joana, mulher de Cuza, procurador de Herodes, e Suzana, e muitas outras que o serviam com seus bens.
text_el: καὶ Ἰωάννα γυνὴ Χουζᾶ ἐπιτρόπου Ἡρῴδου καὶ Σουσάννα καὶ ἕτεραι πολλαί, αἵτινες διηκόνουν αὐτοῖς ἐκ τῶν ὑπαρχόντων αὐταῖς.

text_en: And when a very great multitude was gathered together and hastened out of the cities, unto him, he spoke by a similitude.
text_la: Cum autem turba plurima convenirent, et de civitatibus properarent ad eum, dixit per similitudinem:
text_pt: E, ajuntando-se uma grande multidão, e vindo de todas as cidades ter com ele, disse por parábola:
text_el: Συνιόντος δὲ ὄχλου πολλοῦ καὶ τῶν κατὰ πόλιν ἐπιπορευομένων πρὸς αὐτὸν εἶπεν διὰ παραβολῆς:

text_en: The sower went out to sow his seed. And as he sowed, some fell by the way side. And it was trodden down: and the fowls of the air devoured it.
text_la: Exiit qui seminat, seminare semen suum. Et dum seminat, aliud cecidit secus viam, et conculcatum est, et volucres cæli comederunt illud.
text_pt: Um semeador saiu a semear a sua semente e, quando semeava, caiu alguma junto do caminho, e foi pisada, e as aves do céu a comeram;
text_el: ἐξῆλθεν ὁ σπείρων τοῦ σπεῖραι τὸν σπόρον αὐτοῦ. καὶ ἐν τῷ σπείρειν αὐτὸν ὃ μὲν ἔπεσεν παρὰ τὴν ὁδόν, καὶ κατεπατήθη καὶ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ κατέφαγεν αὐτό:

text_en: And other some fell upon a rock. And as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it had no moisture.
text_la: Et aliud cecidit supra petram : et natum aruit, quia non habebat humorem.
text_pt: E outra caiu sobre pedra e, nascida, secou-se, pois que não tinha umidade;
text_el: καὶ ἕτερον κατέπεσεν ἐπὶ τὴν πέτραν, καὶ φυὲν ἐξηράνθη διὰ τὸ μὴ ἔχειν ἰκμάδα:

text_en: And other some fell among thorns. And the thorns growing up with it, choked it.
text_la: Et aliud cecidit inter spinas, et simul exortæ spinæ suffocaverunt illud.
text_pt: E outra caiu entre espinhos e crescendo com ela os espinhos, a sufocaram;
text_el: καὶ ἕτερον ἔπεσεν ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἀκανθῶν, καὶ συμφυεῖσαι αἱ ἄκανθαι ἀπέπνιξαν αὐτό:

text_en: And other some fell upon good ground and, being sprung up, yielded fruit a hundredfold. Saying these things, he cried out: He that has ears to hear, let him hear.
text_la: Et aliud cecidit in terram bonam : et ortum fecit fructum centuplum. Hæc dicens clamabat : Qui habet aures audiendi, audiat.
text_pt: E outra caiu em boa terra, e, nascida, produziu fruto, a cento por um. Dizendo ele estas coisas, clamava: Quem tem ouvidos para ouvir, ouça.
text_el: καὶ ἕτερον ἔπεσεν εἰς τὴν γῆν τὴν ἀγαθήν, καὶ φυὲν ἐποίησεν καρπὸν ἑκατονταπλασίονα. ταῦτα λέγων ἐφώνει: ὁ ἔχων ὦτα ἀκούειν ἀκουέτω.

text_en: And his disciples asked him what this parable might be.
text_la: Interrogabant autem eum discipuli ejus, quæ esset hæc parabola.
text_pt: E os seus discípulos o interrogaram, dizendo: Que parábola é esta?
text_el: Ἐπηρώτων δὲ αὐτὸν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ τίς αὕτη εἴη ἡ παραβολή.

text_en: To whom he said: To you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God ; but to the rest in parables , that seeing they may not see and hearing may not understand.
text_la: Quibus ipse dixit : Vobis datum est nosse mysterium regni Dei, ceteris autem in parabolis : ut videntes non videant, et audientes non intelligant.
text_pt: E ele disse: A vós vos é dado conhecer os mistérios do reino de Deus, mas aos outros por parábolas, para que vendo, não vejam, e ouvindo, não entendam.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν: ὑμῖν δέδοται γνῶναι τὰ μυστήρια τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ θεοῦ, τοῖς δὲ λοιποῖς ἐν παραβολαῖς, ἵνα βλέποντες μὴ βλέπωσιν καὶ ἀκούοντες μὴ συνιῶσιν.

text_en: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God .
text_la: Est autem hæc parabola : Semen est verbum Dei.
text_pt: Esta é, pois, a parábola: A semente é a palavra de Deus;
text_el: ἔστιν δὲ αὕτη ἡ παραβολή. ὁ σπόρος ἐστὶν ὁ λόγος τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: And they by the way side are they that hear: then the devil comes and takes the word out of their heart, lest believing they should be saved.
text_la: Qui autem secus viam, hi sunt qui audiunt : deinde venit diabolus, et tollit verbum de corde eorum, ne credentes salvi fiant.
text_pt: E os que estão junto do caminho, estes são os que ouvem; depois vem o diabo, e tira-lhes do coração a palavra, para que não se salvem, crendo;
text_el: οἱ δὲ παρὰ τὴν ὁδόν εἰσιν οἱ ἀκούσαντες, εἶτα ἔρχεται ὁ διάβολος καὶ αἴρει τὸν λόγον ἀπὸ τῆς καρδίας αὐτῶν, ἵνα μὴ πιστεύσαντες σωθῶσιν.

text_en: Now they upon the rock are they who when they hear receive the word with joy : and these have no roots: for they believe for a while and in time of temptation they fall away.
text_la: Nam qui supra petram, qui cum audierint, cum gaudio suscipiunt verbum : et hi radices non habent : qui ad tempus credunt, et in tempore tentationis recedunt.
text_pt: E os que estão sobre pedra, estes são os que, ouvindo a palavra, a recebem com alegria, mas, como não têm raiz, apenas crêem por algum tempo, e no tempo da tentação se desviam;
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἐπὶ τῆς πέτρας οἳ ὅταν ἀκούσωσιν μετὰ χαρᾶς δέχονται τὸν λόγον, καὶ οὗτοι ῥίζαν οὐκ ἔχουσιν, οἳ πρὸς καιρὸν πιστεύουσιν καὶ ἐν καιρῷ πειρασμοῦ ἀφίστανται.

text_en: And that which fell among thorns are they who have heard and, going their way, are choked with the cares and riches and pleasures of this life and yield no fruit.
text_la: Quod autem in spinas cecidit : hi sunt qui audierunt, et a sollicitudinibus, et divitiis, et voluptatibus vitæ euntes, suffocantur, et non referunt fructum.
text_pt: E a que caiu entre espinhos, esses são os que ouviram e, indo pordiante, são sufocados com os cuidados e riquezas e deleites da vida, e não dão fruto com perfeição;
text_el: τὸ δὲ εἰς τὰς ἀκάνθας πεσόν, οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ ἀκούσαντες, καὶ ὑπὸ μεριμνῶν καὶ πλούτου καὶ ἡδονῶν τοῦ βίου πορευόμενοι συμπνίγονται καὶ οὐ τελεσφοροῦσιν.

text_en: But that on the good ground are they who in a good and perfect heart, hearing the word, keep it and bring forth fruit in patience.
text_la: Quod autem in bonam terram : hi sunt qui in corde bono et optimo audientes verbum retinent, et fructum afferunt in patientia.
text_pt: E a que caiu em boa terra, esses são os que, ouvindo a palavra, a conservam num coração honesto e bom, e dão fruto com perseverança.
text_el: τὸ δὲ ἐν τῇ καλῇ γῇ, οὗτοί εἰσιν οἵτινες ἐν καρδίᾳ καλῇ καὶ ἀγαθῇ ἀκούσαντες τὸν λόγον κατέχουσιν καὶ καρποφοροῦσιν ἐν ὑπομονῇ.

text_en: Now no man lighting a candle covers it with a vessel or puts it under a bed: but sets it upon a candlestick, that they who come in may see the light.
text_la: Nemo autem lucernam accendens, operit eam vase, aut subtus lectum ponit : sed supra candelabrum ponit, ut intrantes videant lumen.
text_pt: E ninguém, acendendo uma candeia, a cobre com algum vaso, ou a põe debaixo da cama; mas põe-na no velador, para que os que entram vejam a luz.
text_el: Οὐδεὶς δὲ λύχνον ἅψας καλύπτει αὐτὸν σκεύει ἢ ὑποκάτω κλίνης τίθησιν, ἀλλ' ἐπὶ λυχνίας τίθησιν, ἵνα οἱ εἰσπορευόμενοι βλέπωσιν τὸ φῶς.

text_en: For there is not anything secret that shall not be made manifest, nor hidden that shall not be known and come abroad.
text_la: Non est enim occultum, quod non manifestetur : nec absconditum, quod non cognoscatur, et in palam veniat.
text_pt: Porque não há coisa oculta que não haja de manifestar-se, nem escondida que não haja de saber-se e vir à luz.
text_el: οὐ γάρ ἐστιν κρυπτὸν ὃ οὐ φανερὸν γενήσεται, οὐδὲ ἀπόκρυφον ὃ οὐ μὴ γνωσθῇ καὶ εἰς φανερὸν ἔλθῃ.

text_en: Take heed therefore how you hear. For whosoever has, to him shall be given: and whosoever has not, that also which he thinks he has shall be taken away from him.
text_la: Videte ergo quomodo audiatis? Qui enim habet, dabitur illi : et quicumque non habet, etiam quod putat se habere, auferetur ab illo.
text_pt: Vede, pois, como ouvis; porque a qualquer que tiver lhe será dado, e a qualquer que não tiver até o que parece ter lhe será tirado.
text_el: βλέπετε οὖν πῶς ἀκούετε: ὃς ἂν γὰρ ἔχῃ, δοθήσεται αὐτῷ, καὶ ὃς ἂν μὴ ἔχῃ, καὶ ὃ δοκεῖ ἔχειν ἀρθήσεται ἀπ' αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And his mother and brethren came unto him: and they could not come at him for the crowd.
text_la: Venerunt autem ad illum mater et fratres ejus, et non poterant adire eum præ turba.
text_pt: E foram ter com ele sua mãe e seus irmãos, e não podiam aproximar-se dele, por causa da multidão.
text_el: Παρεγένετο δὲ πρὸς αὐτὸν ἡ μήτηρ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ οὐκ ἠδύναντο συντυχεῖν αὐτῷ διὰ τὸν ὄχλον.

text_en: And it was told him: Your mother and your brethren stand without, desiring to see you.
text_la: Et nuntiatum est illi : Mater tua et fratres tui stant foris, volentes te videre.
text_pt: E foi-lhe dito: Estão lá fora tua mãe e teus irmãos, que querem ver-te.
text_el: ἀπηγγέλη δὲ αὐτῷ ἡ μήτηρ σου καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοί σου ἑστήκασιν ἔξω ἰδεῖν θέλοντές σε.

text_en: Who answering, said to them: My mother and my brethren are they who hear the word of God and do it.
text_la: Qui respondens, dixit ad eos : Mater mea et fratres mei hi sunt, qui verbum Dei audiunt et faciunt.
text_pt: Mas, respondendo ele, disse-lhes: Minha mãe e meus irmãos são aqueles que ouvem a palavra de Deus e a executam.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς: μήτηρ μου καὶ ἀδελφοί μου οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ ἀκούοντες καὶ ποιοῦντες.

text_en: And it came to pass on a certain day that he went into a little ship with his disciples . And he said to them: Let us go over to the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.
text_la: Factum est autem in una dierum : et ipse ascendit in naviculam, et discipuli ejus, et ait ad illos : Transfretemus trans stagnum. Et ascenderunt.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, num daqueles dias, entrou num barco com seus discípulos, e disse-lhes: Passemos para o outro lado do lago. E partiram.
text_el: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν μιᾷ τῶν ἡμερῶν καὶ αὐτὸς ἐνέβη εἰς πλοῖον καὶ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς: διέλθωμεν εἰς τὸ πέραν τῆς λίμνης: καὶ ἀνήχθησαν.

text_en: And when they were sailing, he slept. And there came down a storm of wind upon the lake: and they were filled and were in danger.
text_la: Et navigantibus illis, obdormivit, et descendit procella venti in stagnum, et complebantur, et periclitabantur.
text_pt: E, navegando eles, adormeceu; e sobreveio uma tempestade de vento no lago, e enchiam-se de água, estando em perigo.
text_el: πλεόντων δὲ αὐτῶν ἀφύπνωσεν: καὶ κατέβη λαῖλαψ ἀνέμου εἰς τὴν λίμνην, καὶ συνεπληροῦντο καὶ ἐκινδύνευον.

text_en: And they came and awaked him, saying: Master, we perish. But he arising, rebuked the wind and the rage of the water. And it ceased: and there was a calm.
text_la: Accedentes autem suscitaverunt eum, dicentes : Præceptor, perimus. At ille surgens, increpavit ventum, et tempestatem aquæ, et cessavit : et facta est tranquillitas.
text_pt: E, chegando-se a ele, o despertaram, dizendo: Mestre, Mestre, perecemos. E ele, levantando-se, repreendeu o vento e a fúria da água; e cessaram, e fez-se bonança.
text_el: προσελθόντες δὲ διήγειραν αὐτὸν λέγοντες: ἐπιστάτα ἐπιστάτα, ἀπολλύμεθα. ὁ δὲ διεγερθεὶς ἐπετίμησεν τῷ ἀνέμῳ καὶ τῷ κλύδωνι τοῦ ὕδατος: καὶ ἐπαύσαντο, καὶ ἐγένετο γαλήνη.

text_en: And he said to them: Where is your faith ? Who being afraid, wondered, saying one to another: Who is this (think you), that he commands both the winds and the sea: and they obey him?
text_la: Dixit autem illis : Ubi est fides vestra? Qui timentes, mirati sunt ad invicem, dicentes : Quis putas hic est, quia et ventis, et mari imperat, et obediunt ei?
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Onde está a vossa fé? E eles, temendo, maravilharam-se, dizendo uns aos outros: Quem é este, que até aos ventos e à água manda, e lhe obedecem?
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς: ποῦ ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν; φοβηθέντες δὲ ἐθαύμασαν, λέγοντες πρὸς ἀλλήλους: τίς ἄρα οὗτός ἐστιν, ὅτι καὶ τοῖς ἀνέμοις ἐπιτάσσει καὶ τῷ ὕδατι, καὶ ὑπακούουσιν αὐτῷ;

text_en: And they sailed to the country of the Gerasens , which is over against Galilee .
text_la: Et navigaverunt ad regionem Gerasenorum, quæ est contra Galilæam.
text_pt: E navegaram para a terra dos gadarenos, que está defronte da Galiléia.
text_el: Καὶ κατέπλευσαν εἰς τὴν χώραν τῶν Γερασηνῶν, ἥτις ἐστὶν ἀντιπέρα τῆς Γαλιλαίας.

text_en: And when he had come forth to the land, there met him a certain man who had a devil now a very long time. And he wore no clothes: neither did he abide in a house, but in the sepulchres.
text_la: Et cum egressus esset ad terram, occurrit illi vir quidam, qui habebat dæmonium jam temporibus multis, et vestimento non induebatur, neque in domo manebat, sed in monumentis.
text_pt: E, quando desceu para terra, saiu-lhe ao encontro, vindo da cidade, um homem que desde muito tempo estava possesso de demônios, e não andava vestido, nem habitava em qualquer casa, mas nos sepulcros.
text_el: ἐξελθόντι δὲ αὐτῷ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ὑπήντησεν ἀνήρ τις ἐκ τῆς πόλεως ἔχων δαιμόνια, καὶ χρόνῳ ἱκανῷ οὐκ ἐνεδύσατο ἱμάτιον, καὶ ἐν οἰκίᾳ οὐκ ἔμενεν ἀλλ' ἐν τοῖς μνήμασιν.

text_en: And when he saw Jesus , he fell down before him. And crying out with a loud voice, he said: What have I to do with you, Jesus , Son of the most high God ? I beseech you, do not torment me.
text_la: Is, ut vidit Jesum, procidit ante illum : et exclamans voce magna, dixit : Quid mihi et tibi est, Jesu Fili Dei Altissimi? obsecro te, ne me torqueas.
text_pt: E, quando viu a Jesus, prostrou-se diante dele, exclamando, e dizendo com grande voz: Que tenho eu contigo, Jesus, Filho do Deus Altíssimo? Peço-te que não me atormentes.
text_el: ἰδὼν δὲ τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἀνακράξας προσέπεσεν αὐτῷ καὶ φωνῇ μεγάλῃ εἶπεν: τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί, Ἰησοῦ υἱὲ [τοῦ θεοῦ] τοῦ ὑψίστου; δέομαί σου, μή με βασανίσῃς.

text_en: For he commanded the unclean spirit to go out of the man . For many times it seized him: and he was bound with chains and kept in fetters: and breaking the bonds, he was driven by the devil into the deserts.
text_la: Præcipiebat enim spiritui immundo ut exiret ab homine. Multis enim temporibus arripiebat illum, et vinciebatur catenis, et compedibus custoditus. Et ruptis vinculis agebatur a dæmonio in deserta.
text_pt: Porque tinha ordenado ao espírito imundo que saísse daquele homem; pois já havia muito tempo que o arrebatava. E guardavamno preso, com grilhões e cadeias; mas, quebrando as prisões, era impelido pelo demônio para os desertos.
text_el: παρήγγελλεν γὰρ τῷ πνεύματι τῷ ἀκαθάρτῳ ἐξελθεῖν ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου: πολλοῖς γὰρ χρόνοις συνηρπάκει αὐτόν, καὶ ἐδεσμεύετο ἁλύσεσιν καὶ πέδαις φυλασσόμενος, καὶ διαρρήσσων τὰ δεσμὰ ἠλαύνετο ἀπὸ τοῦ δαιμονίου εἰς τὰς ἐρήμους.

text_en: And Jesus asked him, saying: What is your name ? But he said: Legion. Because many devils were entered into him.
text_la: Interrogavit autem illum Jesus, dicens : Quod tibi nomen est? At ille dixit : Legio : quia intraverant dæmonia multa in eum.
text_pt: E perguntou-lhe Jesus, dizendo: Qual é o teu nome? E ele disse: Legião; porque tinham entrado nele muitos demônios.
text_el: ἐπηρώτησεν δὲ αὐτὸν ὁ Ἰησοῦς: Τί σοι ὄνομά ἐστιν; ὁ δὲ εἶπεν, λεγιών, ὅτι εἰσῆλθεν δαιμόνια πολλὰ εἰς αὐτόν.

text_en: And they besought him that he would not command them to go into the abyss .
text_la: Et rogabant illum ne imperaret illis ut in abyssum irent.
text_pt: E rogavam-lhe que os não mandasse para o abismo.
text_el: καὶ παρεκάλουν αὐτὸν ἵνα μὴ ἐπιτάξῃ αὐτοῖς εἰς τὴν ἄβυσσον ἀπελθεῖν.

text_en: And there was there a herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would allow them to enter into them. And he allowed them.
text_la: Erat autem ibi grex porcorum multorum pascentium in monte : et rogabant eum, ut permitteret eis in illos ingredi. Et permisit illis.
text_pt: E andava ali pastando no monte uma vara de muitos porcos; e rogaram-lhe que lhes concedesse entrar neles; e concedeu-lho.
text_el: ἦν δὲ ἐκεῖ ἀγέλη χοίρων ἱκανῶν βοσκομένη ἐν τῷ ὄρει, καὶ παρεκάλεσαν αὐτὸν ἵνα ἐπιτρέψῃ αὐτοῖς εἰς ἐκείνους εἰσελθεῖν. καὶ ἐπέτρεψεν αὐτοῖς.

text_en: The devils therefore went out of the man and entered into the swine. And the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake and were stifled.
text_la: Exierunt ergo dæmonia ab homine, et intraverunt in porcos : et impetu abiit grex per præceps in stagnum, et suffocatus est.
text_pt: E, tendo saído os demônios do homem, entraram nos porcos, e a manada precipitou-se de um despenhadeiro no lago, e afogou-se.
text_el: ἐξελθόντα δὲ τὰ δαιμόνια ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου εἰσῆλθον εἰς τοὺς χοίρους, καὶ ὥρμησεν ἡ ἀγέλη κατὰ τοῦ κρημνοῦ εἰς τὴν λίμνην καὶ ἀπεπνίγη.

text_en: Which when they that fed them saw done, they fled away and told it in the city and in the villages .
text_la: Quod ut viderunt factum qui pascebant, fugerunt, et nuntiaverunt in civitatem et in villas.
text_pt: E aqueles que os guardavam, vendo o que acontecera, fugiram, e foram anunciá-lo na cidade e nos campos.
text_el: ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ βόσκοντες τὸ γεγονὸς ἔφυγον καὶ ἀπήγγειλαν εἰς τὴν πόλιν καὶ εἰς τοὺς ἀγρούς.

text_en: And they went out to see what was done. And they came to Jesus and found the man out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at his feet, clothed and in his right mind. And they were afraid.
text_la: Exierunt autem videre quod factum est, et venerunt ad Jesum, et invenerunt hominem sedentem, a quo dæmonia exierant, vestitum ac sana mente, ad pedes ejus, et timuerunt.
text_pt: E saíram a ver o que tinha acontecido, e vieram ter com Jesus. Acharam então o homem, de quem haviam saído os demônios, vestido, e em seu juízo, assentado aos pés de Jesus; e temeram.
text_el: ἐξῆλθον δὲ ἰδεῖν τὸ γεγονὸς, καὶ ἦλθον πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν, καὶ εὗρον καθήμενον τὸν ἄνθρωπον, ἀφ' οὗ τὰ δαιμόνια ἐξῆλθεν, ἱματισμένον καὶ σωφρονοῦντα παρὰ τοὺς πόδας [τοῦ] Ἰησοῦ, καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν.

text_en: And they also that had seen told them how he had been healed from the legion.
text_la: Nuntiaverunt autem illis et qui viderant, quomodo sanus factus esset a legione:
text_pt: E os que tinham visto contaram-lhes também como fora salvo aquele endemoninhado.
text_el: ἀπήγγειλαν δὲ αὐτοῖς οἱ ἰδόντες πῶς ἐσώθη ὁ δαιμονισθείς.

text_en: And all the multitude of the country of the Gerasens besought him to depart from them: for they were taken with great fear. And he, going up into the ship, returned back again.
text_la: et rogaverunt illum omnis multitudo regionis Gerasenorum ut discederet ab ipsis : quia magno timore tenebantur. Ipse autem ascendens navim, reversus est.
text_pt: E toda a multidão da terra dos gadarenos ao redor lhe rogou que se retirasse deles; porque estavam possuídos de grande temor. E entrando ele no barco, voltou.
text_el: καὶ ἠρώτησεν αὐτὸν ἅπαν τὸ πλῆθος τῆς περιχώρου τῶν Γερασηνῶν ἀπελθεῖν ἀπ' αὐτῶν, ὅτι φόβῳ μεγάλῳ συνείχοντο: αὐτὸς δὲ ἐμβὰς εἰς πλοῖον ὑπέστρεψεν.

text_en: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him. But Jesus sent him away, saying:
text_la: Et rogabat illum vir, a quo dæmonia exierant, ut cum eo esset. Dimisit autem eum Jesus, dicens:
text_pt: E aquele homem, de quem haviam saído os demônios, rogou-lhe que o deixasse estar com ele; mas Jesus o despediu, dizendo:
text_el: ἐδεῖτο δὲ αὐτοῦ ὁ ἀνὴρ ἀφ' οὗ ἐξεληλύθει τὰ δαιμόνια, εἶναι σὺν αὐτῷ: ἀπέλυσεν δὲ αὐτὸν λέγων:

text_en: Return to your house and tell how great things God has done to you. And he went through the whole city, publishing how great things Jesus had done to him.
text_la: Redi in domum tuam, et narra quanta tibi fecit Deus. Et abiit per universam civitatem, prædicans quanta illi fecisset Jesus.
text_pt: Torna para tua casa, e conta quão grandes coisas te fez Deus. E ele foi apregoando por toda a cidade quão grandes coisas Jesus lhe tinha feito.
text_el: ὑπόστρεφε εἰς τὸν οἶκόν σου, καὶ διηγοῦ ὅσα σοι ἐποίησεν ὁ θεός. καὶ ἀπῆλθεν, καθ' ὅλην τὴν πόλιν κηρύσσων ὅσα ἐποίησεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς.

text_en: And it came to pass that when Jesus was returned, the multitude received him: for they were all waiting for him.
text_la: Factum est autem cum rediisset Jesus, excepit illum turba : erunt enim omnes exspectantes eum.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, quando voltou Jesus, a multidão o recebeu, porque todos o estavam esperando.
text_el: ἐν δὲ τῷ ὑποστρέφειν τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἀπεδέξατο αὐτὸν ὁ ὄχλος: ἦσαν γὰρ πάντες προσδοκῶντες αὐτόν.

text_en: And behold there came a man whose name was Jairus: and he was a ruler of the synagogue . And he fell down at the feet of Jesus , beseeching him that he would come into his house:
text_la: Et ecce venit vir, cui nomen Jairus, et ipse princeps synagogæ erat : et cecidit ad pedes Jesu, rogans eum ut intraret in domum ejus,
text_pt: E eis que chegou um homem de nome Jairo, que era príncipe da sinagoga; e, prostrando-se aos pés de Jesus, rogava-lhe que entrasse em sua casa;
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἦλθεν ἀνὴρ ᾧ ὄνομα Ἰάϊρος, καὶ οὗτος ἄρχων τῆς συναγωγῆς ὑπῆρχεν: καὶ πεσὼν παρὰ τοὺς πόδας Ἰησοῦ παρεκάλει αὐτὸν εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ,

text_en: For he had an only daughter, almost twelve years old, and she was dying. And it happened as he went that he was thronged by the multitudes.
text_la: quia unica filia erat ei fere annorum duodecim, et hæc moriebatur. Et contigit, dum iret, a turba comprimebatur.
text_pt: Porque tinha uma filha única, quase de doze anos, que estava à morte. E indo ele, apertava-o a multidão.
text_el: ὅτι θυγάτηρ μονογενὴς ἦν αὐτῷ ὡς ἐτῶν δώδεκα καὶ αὐτὴ ἀπέθνῃσκεν. ἐν δὲ τῷ ὑπάγειν αὐτὸν οἱ ὄχλοι συνέπνιγον αὐτόν.

text_en: And there was a certain woman having an issue of blood twelve years, who had bestowed all her substance on physicians and could not be healed by any.
text_la: Et mulier quædam erat in fluxu sanguinis ab annis duodecim, quæ in medicos erogaverat omnem substantiam suam, nec ab ullo potuit curari:
text_pt: E uma mulher, que tinha um fluxo de sangue, havia doze anos, e gastara com os médicos todos os seus haveres, e por nenhum pudera ser curada,
text_el: καὶ γυνὴ οὖσα ἐν ῥύσει αἵματος ἀπὸ ἐτῶν δώδεκα, ἥτις οὐκ ἴσχυσεν ἀπ' οὐδενὸς θεραπευθῆναι,

text_en: She came behind him and touched the hem of his garment: and immediately the issue of her blood stopped.
text_la: accessit retro, et tetigit fimbriam vestimenti ejus : et confestim stetit fluxus sanguinis ejus.
text_pt: Chegando por detrás dele, tocou na orla do seu vestido, e logo estancou o fluxo do seu sangue.
text_el: προσελθοῦσα ὄπισθεν ἥψατο τοῦ κρασπέδου τοῦ ἱματίου αὐτοῦ, καὶ παραχρῆμα ἔστη ἡ ῥύσις τοῦ αἵματος αὐτῆς.

text_en: And Jesus said: Who is it that touched me? And all denying, Peter and they that were with him said: Master, the multitudes throng and press you; and do you say, who touched me?
text_la: Et ait Jesus : Quis est, qui me tetigit? Negantibus autem omnibus, dixit Petrus, et qui cum illo erant : Præceptor, turbæ te comprimunt, et affligunt, et dicis : Quis me tetigit?
text_pt: E disse Jesus: Quem é que me tocou? E, negando todos, disse Pedro e os que estavam com ele: Mestre, a multidão te aperta e te oprime, e dizes: Quem é que me tocou?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς: τίς ὁ ἁψάμενός μου; ἀρνουμένων δὲ πάντων εἶπεν ὁ Πέτρος: Ἐπιστάτα, οἱ ὄχλοι συνέχουσίν σε καὶ ἀποθλίβουσιν.

text_en: And Jesus said: Somebody has touched me; for I know that virtue has gone out from me.
text_la: Et dicit Jesus : Tetigit me aliquis : nam ego novi virtutem de me exiisse.
text_pt: E disse Jesus: Alguém me tocou, porque bem conheci que de mim saiu virtude.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν: ἥψατό μού τις: ἐγὼ γὰρ ἔγνων δύναμιν ἐξεληλυθυῖαν ἀπ' ἐμοῦ.

text_en: And the woman seeing that she was not hid, came trembling and fell down before his feet and declared before all the people for what cause she had touched him, and how she was immediately healed.
text_la: Videns autem mulier, quia non latuit, tremens venit, et procidit ante pedes ejus : et ob quam causam tetigerit eum, indicavit coram omni populo : et quemadmodum confestim sanata sit.
text_pt: Então, vendo a mulher que não podia ocultar-se, aproximou-se tremendo e, prostrando-se ante ele, declarou-lhe diante de todo o povo a causa por que lhe havia tocado, e como logo sarara.
text_el: ἰδοῦσα δὲ ἡ γυνὴ ὅτι οὐκ ἔλαθεν, τρέμουσα ἦλθεν καὶ προσπεσοῦσα αὐτῷ δι' ἣν αἰτίαν ἥψατο αὐτοῦ ἀπήγγειλεν ἐνώπιον παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ, καὶ ὡς ἰάθη παραχρῆμα.

text_en: But he said to her: Daughter, your faith has made you whole. Go your way in peace.
text_la: At ipse dixit ei : Filia, fides tua salvam te fecit : vade in pace.
text_pt: E ele lhe disse: Tem bom ânimo, filha, a tua fé te salvou; vai em paz.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῇ: θυγάτηρ, ἡ πίστις σου σέσωκέν σε: πορεύου εἰς εἰρήνην.

text_en: As he was yet speaking, there comes one to the ruler of the synagogue , saying to him: Your daughter is dead: trouble him not.
text_la: Adhuc illo loquente, venit quidam ad principem synagogæ, dicens ei : Quia mortua est filia tua, noli vexare illum.
text_pt: Estando ele ainda falando, chegou um dos do príncipe da sinagoga, dizendo: A tua filha já está morta, não incomodes o Mestre.
text_el: Ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος ἔρχεταί τις παρὰ τοῦ ἀρχισυναγώγου λέγων ὅτι τέθνηκεν ἡ θυγάτηρ σου, μηκέτι σκύλλε τὸν διδάσκαλον.

text_en: And Jesus hearing this word, answered the father of the maid: Fear not. Believe only: and she shall be safe.
text_la: Jesus autem, audito hoc verbo, respondit patri puellæ : Noli timere, crede tantum, et salva erit.
text_pt: Jesus, porém, ouvindo-o, respondeu-lhe, dizendo: Não temas; crê somente, e será salva.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἀκούσας ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ: μὴ φοβοῦ: μόνον πίστευσον, καὶ σωθήσεται.

text_en: And when he had come to the house, he suffered not any man to go in with him, but Peter and James and John , and the father and mother of the maiden.
text_la: Et cum venisset domum, non permisit intrare secum quemquam, nisi Petrum, et Jacobum, et Joannem, et patrem, et matrem puellæ.
text_pt: E, entrando em casa, a ninguém deixou entrar, senão a Pedro, e a Tiago, e a João, e ao pai e a mãe da menina.
text_el: ἐλθὼν δὲ εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν οὐκ ἀφῆκεν εἰσελθεῖν τινα σὺν αὐτῷ εἰ μὴ Πέτρον καὶ Ἰωάννην καὶ Ἰάκωβον καὶ τὸν πατέρα τῆς παιδὸς καὶ τὴν μητέρα.

text_en: And all wept and mourned for her. But he said: Weep not. The maid is not dead, but sleeps.
text_la: Flebant autem omnes, et plangebant illam. At ille dixit : Nolite flere : non est mortua puella, sed dormit.
text_pt: E todos choravam, e a pranteavam; e ele disse: Não choreis; não está morta, mas dorme.
text_el: ἔκλαιον δὲ πάντες καὶ ἐκόπτοντο αὐτήν. ὁ δὲ εἶπεν: μὴ κλαίετε: οὐ γὰρ ἀπέθανεν ἀλλὰ καθεύδει.

text_en: And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.
text_la: Et deridebant eum, scientes quod mortua esset.
text_pt: E riam-se dele, sabendo que estava morta.
text_el: καὶ κατεγέλων αὐτοῦ, εἰδότες ὅτι ἀπέθανεν.

text_en: But he taking her by the hand, cried out, saying: Maid, arise.
text_la: Ipse autem tenens manum ejus clamavit, dicens : Puella, surge.
text_pt: Mas ele, pondo-os todos fora, e pegando-lhe na mão, clamou, dizendo: Levanta-te, menina.
text_el: αὐτὸς δὲ κρατήσας τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῆς ἐφώνησεν λέγων: ἡ παῖς, ἔγειρε.

text_en: And her spirit returned: and she arose immediately. And he bid them give her to eat.
text_la: Et reversus est spiritus ejus, et surrexit continuo. Et jussit illi dari manducare.
text_pt: E o seu espírito voltou, e ela logo se levantou; e Jesus mandou que lhe dessem de comer.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτῆς, καὶ ἀνέστη παραχρῆμα, καὶ διέταξεν αὐτῇ δοθῆναι φαγεῖν.

text_en: And her parents were astonished, whom he charged to tell no man what was done.
text_la: Et stupuerunt parentes ejus, quibus præcepit ne alicui dicerent quod factum erat.
text_pt: E seus pais ficaram maravilhados; e ele lhes mandou que a ninguém dissessem o que havia sucedido.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέστησαν οἱ γονεῖς αὐτῆς: ὁ δὲ παρήγγειλεν αὐτοῖς μηδενὶ εἰπεῖν τὸ γεγονός.

text_en: Then calling together the twelve apostles , he gave them power and authority over all devils and to cure diseases.
text_la: Convocatis autem duodecim Apostolis, dedit illis virtutem et potestatem super omnia dæmonia, et ut languores curarent.
text_pt: E, convocando os seus doze discípulos, deu-lhes virtude e poder sobre todos os demônios, para curarem enfermidades.
text_el: Συγκαλεσάμενος δὲ τοὺς δώδεκα ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς δύναμιν καὶ ἐξουσίαν ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ δαιμόνια καὶ νόσους θεραπεύειν,

text_en: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God and to heal the sick.
text_la: Et misit illos prædicare regnum Dei, et sanare infirmos.
text_pt: E enviou-os a pregar o reino de Deus, e a curar os enfermos.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτοὺς κηρύσσειν τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἰᾶσθαι,

text_en: And he said to them: Take nothing for your journey, neither staff, nor scrip, nor bread, nor money; neither have two coats.
text_la: Et ait ad illos : Nihil tuleritis in via, neque virgam, neque peram, neque panem, neque pecuniam, neque duas tunicas habeatis.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Nada leveis convosco para o caminho, nem bordões, nem alforje, nem pão, nem dinheiro; nem tenhais duas túnicas.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς: μηδὲν αἴρετε εἰς τὴν ὁδόν, μήτε ῥάβδον μήτε πήραν μήτε ἄρτον μήτε ἀργύριον, μήτε δύο χιτῶνας ἔχειν.

text_en: And whatsoever house you shall enter into, abide there and depart not from thence.
text_la: Et in quamcumque domum intraveritis, ibi manete, et inde ne exeatis.
text_pt: E em qualquer casa em que entrardes, ficai ali, e de lá saireis.
text_el: καὶ εἰς ἣν ἂν οἰκίαν εἰσέλθητε, ἐκεῖ μένετε καὶ ἐκεῖθεν ἐξέρχεσθε.

text_en: And whosoever will not receive you, when you go out of that city, shake off even the dust of your feet, for a testimony against them.
text_la: Et quicumque non receperint vos : exeuntes de civitate illa, etiam pulverem pedum vestrorum excutite in testimonium supra illos.
text_pt: E se em qualquer cidade vos não receberem, saindo vós dali, sacudi o pó dos vossos pés, em testemunho contra eles.
text_el: καὶ ὅσοι ἂν μὴ δέχωνται ὑμᾶς, ἐξερχόμενοι ἀπὸ τῆς πόλεως ἐκείνης τὸν κονιορτὸν ἀπὸ τῶν ποδῶν ὑμῶν ἀποτινάσσετε εἰς μαρτύριον ἐπ' αὐτούς.

text_en: And going out, they went about through the towns, preaching the gospel and healing every where.
text_la: Egressi autem circuibant per castella evangelizantes, et curantes ubique.
text_pt: E, saindo eles, percorreram todas as aldeias, anunciando o evangelho, e fazendo curas por toda a parte.
text_el: ἐξερχόμενοι δὲ διήρχοντο κατὰ τὰς κώμας εὐαγγελιζόμενοι καὶ θεραπεύοντες πανταχοῦ.

text_en: Now Herod, the tetrarch , heard of all things that were done by him. And he was in a doubt , because it was said
text_la: Audivit autem Herodes tetrarcha omnia quæ fiebant ab eo, et hæsitabat eo quod diceretur
text_pt: E o tetrarca Herodes ouviu todas as coisas que por ele foram feitas, e estava em dúvida, porque diziam alguns que João ressuscitara dentre os mortos; e outros que Elias tinha aparecido;
text_el: Ἤκουσεν δὲ Ἡρῴδης ὁ τετραάρχης τὰ γινόμενα πάντα, καὶ διηπόρει διὰ τὸ λέγεσθαι ὑπό τινων ὅτι Ἰωάννης ἠγέρθη ἐκ νεκρῶν,

text_en: by some that John was risen from the dead: but by other some, that Elias had appeared: and by others, that one of the old prophets was risen again .
text_la: a quibusdam : Quia Joannes surrexit a mortuis : a quibusdam vero : Quia Elias apparuit : ab aliis autem : Quia propheta unus de antiquis surrexit.
text_pt: E outros que um profeta dos antigos havia ressuscitado.
text_el: ὑπό τινων δὲ ὅτι Ἠλίας ἐφάνη, ἄλλων δὲ ὅτι προφήτης τις τῶν ἀρχαίων ἀνέστη.

text_en: And Herod said: John I have beheaded. But who is this of whom I hear such things? And he sought to see him.
text_la: Et ait Herodes : Joannem ego decollavi : quis est autem iste, de quo ego talia audio? Et quærebat videre eum.
text_pt: E disse Herodes: A João mandei eu degolar; quem é, pois, este de quem ouço dizer tais coisas? E procurava vê-lo.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ [ὁ] Ἡρῴδης: Ἰωάννην ἐγὼ ἀπεκεφάλισα: τίς δέ ἐστιν οὗτος περὶ οὗ ἀκούω τοιαῦτα; καὶ ἐζήτει ἰδεῖν αὐτόν.

text_en: And the apostles , when they were returned, told him all they had done. And taking them, he went aside into a desert place , apart, which belongs to Bethsaida .
text_la: Et reversi Apostoli, narraverunt illi quæcumque fecerunt : et assumptis illis secessit seorsum in locum desertum, qui est Bethsaidæ.
text_pt: E, regressando os apóstolos, contaram-lhe tudo o que tinham feito. E, tomando-os consigo, retirou-se para um lugar deserto de uma cidade chamada Betsaida.
text_el: Καὶ ὑποστρέψαντες οἱ ἀπόστολοι διηγήσαντο αὐτῷ ὅσα ἐποίησαν. καὶ παραλαβὼν αὐτοὺς ὑπεχώρησεν κατ' ἰδίαν εἰς πόλιν καλουμένην Βηθσαϊδά.

text_en: Which when the people knew , they followed him: and he received them and spoke to them of the kingdom of God and healed them who had need of healing.
text_la: Quod cum cognovissent turbæ, secutæ sunt illum : et excepit eos, et loquebatur illis de regno Dei, et eos, qui cura indigebant, sanabat.
text_pt: E, sabendo-o a multidão, o seguiu; e ele os recebeu, e falava-lhes do reino de Deus, e sarava os que necessitavam de cura.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ὄχλοι γνόντες ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ, καὶ ἀποδεξάμενος αὐτοὺς ἐλάλει αὐτοῖς περὶ τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ τοὺς χρείαν ἔχοντας θεραπείας ἰᾶτο.

text_en: Now the day began to decline. And the twelve came and said to him: Send away the multitude, that, going into the towns and villages round about, they may lodge and get victuals; for we are here in a desert place .
text_la: Dies autem cœperat declinare, et accedentes duodecim dixerunt illi : Dimitte turbas, ut euntes in castella villasque quæ circa sunt, divertant, et inveniant escas : quia hic in loco deserto sumus.
text_pt: E já o dia começava a declinar; então, chegando-se a ele os doze, disseram-lhe: Despede a multidão, para que, indo aos lugares e aldeias em redor, se agasalhem, e achem o que comer; porque aqui estamos em lugar deserto.
text_el: ἡ δὲ ἡμέρα ἤρξατο κλίνειν: προσελθόντες δὲ οἱ δώδεκα εἶπαν αὐτῷ: ἀπόλυσον τὸν ὄχλον, ἵνα πορευθέντες εἰς τὰς κύκλῳ κώμας καὶ ἀγροὺς καταλύσωσιν καὶ εὕρωσιν ἐπισιτισμόν, ὅτι ὧδε ἐν ἐρήμῳ τόπῳ ἐσμέν.

text_en: But he said to them: Give you them to eat. And they said: We have no more than five loaves and two fishes; unless perhaps, we should go and buy food for all this multitude.
text_la: Ait autem ad illos : Vos date illis manducare. At illi dixerunt : Non sunt nobis plus quam quinque panes et duo pisces : nisi forte nos eamus, et emamus in omnem hanc turbam escas.
text_pt: Mas ele lhes disse: Dai-lhes vós de comer. E eles disseram: Não temos senão cinco pães e dois peixes, salvo se nós próprios formos comprar comida para todo este povo.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτούς: δότε αὐτοῖς φαγεῖν. ὑμεῖς οἱ δὲ εἶπαν. οὐκ εἰσὶν ἡμῖν πλεῖον ἢ ἄρτοι πέντε καὶ ἰχθύες δύο, εἰ μήτι πορευθέντες ἡμεῖς ἀγοράσωμεν εἰς πάντα τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον βρώματα.

text_en: Now there were about five thousand men . And he said to his disciples : Make them sit down by fifties in a company.
text_la: Erant autem fere viri quinque millia. Ait autem ad discipulos suos : Facite illos discumbere per convivia quinquagenos.
text_pt: Porquanto estavam ali quase cinco mil homens. Disse, então, aos seus discípulos: Fazei-os assentar, em ranchos de cinqüenta em cinqüenta.
text_el: ἦσαν γὰρ ὡσεὶ ἄνδρες πεντακισχίλιοι. εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ: κατακλίνατε αὐτοὺς κλισίας ὡσεὶ ἀνὰ πεντήκοντα.

text_en: And they did so and made them all sit down.
text_la: Et ita fecerunt: et discumbere fecerunt omnes.
text_pt: E assim o fizeram, fazendo-os assentar a todos.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν οὕτως καὶ κατέκλιναν ἅπαντας.

text_en: And taking the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven and blessed them: and he broke and distributed to his disciples , to set before the multitude.
text_la: Acceptis autem quinque panibus et duobus piscibus, respexit in cælum, et benedixit illis : et fregit, et distribuit discipulis suis, ut ponerent ante turbas.
text_pt: E, tomando os cinco pães e os dois peixes, e olhando para o céu, abençoou-os, e partiu-os, e deu-os aos seus discípulos para os porem diante da multidão.
text_el: λαβὼν δὲ τοὺς πέντε ἄρτους καὶ τοὺς δύο ἰχθύας, ἀναβλέψας εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν εὐλόγησεν αὐτοὺς καὶ κατέκλασεν, καὶ ἐδίδου τοῖς μαθηταῖς παραθεῖναι τῷ ὄχλῳ.

text_en: And they did all eat and were filled. And there were taken up of fragments that remained to them, twelve baskets.
text_la: Et manducaverunt omnes, et saturati sunt. Et sublatum est quod superfuit illis, fragmentorum cophini duodecim.
text_pt: E comeram todos, e saciaram-se; e levantaram, do que lhes sobejou, doze alcofas de pedaços.
text_el: καὶ ἔφαγον καὶ ἐχορτάσθησαν πάντες, καὶ ἤρθη τὸ περισσεῦσαν αὐτοῖς κλασμάτων, κόφινοι δώδεκα.

text_en: And it came to pass, as he was alone praying , his disciples also were with him: and he asked them, saying: Whom do the people say that I am?
text_la: Et factum est cum solus esset orans, erant cum illo et discipuli : et interrogavit illos, dicens : Quem me dicunt esse turbæ?
text_pt: E aconteceu que, estando ele só, orando, estavam com ele os discípulos; e perguntou-lhes, dizendo: Quem diz a multidão que eu sou?
text_el: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ εἶναι αὐτὸν προσευχόμενον κατὰ μόνας συνῆσαν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταί, καὶ ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτοὺς λέγων: τίνα με οἱ ὄχλοι λέγουσιν εἶναι;

text_en: But they answered and said: John the Baptist ; but some say Elias : and others say that one of the former prophets is risen again .
text_la: At illi responderunt, et dixerunt : Joannem Baptistam, alii autem Eliam, alii vero quia unus propheta de prioribus surrexit.
text_pt: E, respondendo eles, disseram: João o Batista; outros, Elias, e outros que um dos antigos profetas ressuscitou.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἀποκριθέντες εἶπαν: Ἰωάννην τὸν βαπτιστήν, ἄλλοι δὲ Ἠλίαν, ἄλλοι δὲ ὅτι προφήτης τις τῶν ἀρχαίων ἀνέστη.

text_en: And he said to them: But whom do you say that I am? Simon Peter answering, said: The Christ of God .
text_la: Dixit autem illis : Vos autem quem me esse dicitis? Respondens Simon Petrus, dixit : Christum Dei.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: E vós, quem dizeis que eu sou? E, respondendo Pedro, disse: O Cristo de Deus.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς: ὑμεῖς δὲ τίνα με λέγετε εἶναι; Πέτρος δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν: τὸν Χριστὸν τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: But he strictly charging them, commanded they should tell this to no man .
text_la: At ille increpans illos, præcepit ne cui dicerent hoc,
text_pt: E, admoestando-os, mandou que a ninguém referissem isso,
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἐπιτιμήσας αὐτοῖς παρήγγειλεν μηδενὶ λέγειν τοῦτο,

text_en: Saying: The Son of man must suffer many things and be rejected by the ancients and chief priests and scribes and be killed and the third day rise again .
text_la: dicens : Quia oportet Filium hominis multa pati, et reprobari a senioribus, et principibus sacerdotum, et scribis, et occidi, et tertia die resurgere.
text_pt: Dizendo: É necessário que o Filho do homem padeça muitas coisas, e seja rejeitado dos anciãos edos escribas, e seja morto, e ressuscite ao terceiro dia.
text_el: εἰπὼν ὅτι δεῖ τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου πολλὰ παθεῖν καὶ ἀποδοκιμασθῆναι ἀπὸ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων καὶ ἀρχιερέων καὶ γραμματέων καὶ ἀποκτανθῆναι καὶ τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ ἐγερθῆναι.

text_en: And he said to all: If any man will come after me, let him deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow me.
text_la: Dicebat autem ad omnes : Si quis vult post me venire, abneget semetipsum, et tollat crucem suam quotidie, et sequatur me.
text_pt: E dizia a todos: Se alguém quer vir após mim, negue-se a si mesmo, e tome cada dia a sua cruz, e siga-me.
text_el: Ἔλεγεν δὲ πρὸς πάντας: εἴ τις θέλει ὀπίσω μου ἔρχεσθαι, ἀρνησάσθω ἑαυτὸν καὶ ἀράτω τὸν σταυρὸν αὐτοῦ καθ' ἡμέραν, καὶ ἀκολουθείτω μοι.

text_en: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: for he that shall lose his life for my sake shall save it.
text_la: Qui enim voluerit animam suam salvam facere, perdet illam : nam qui perdiderit animam suam propter me, salvam faciet illam.
text_pt: Porque, qualquer que quiser salvar a sua vida, perdê-la-á; mas qualquer que, por amor de mim, perder a sua vida, a salvará.
text_el: ὃς γὰρ ἂν θέλῃ τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ σῶσαι, ἀπολέσει αὐτήν: ὃς δ' ἂν ἀπολέσῃ τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ, οὗτος σώσει αὐτήν.

text_en: For what is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world and lose himself and cast away himself?
text_la: Quid enim proficit homo, si lucretur universum mundum, se autem ipsum perdat, et detrimentum sui faciat?
text_pt: Porque, que aproveita ao homem granjear o mundo todo, perdendo-se ou prejudicando-se a si mesmo?
text_el: τί γὰρ ὠφελεῖται ἄνθρωπος κερδήσας τὸν κόσμον ὅλον, ἑαυτὸν δὲ ἀπολέσας ἢ ζημιωθείς;

text_en: For he that shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him the Son of man shall be ashamed, when he shall come in his majesty and that of his Father and of the holy angels .
text_la: Nam qui me erubuerit, et meos sermones : hunc Filius hominis erubescet cum venerit in majestate sua, et Patris, et sanctorum angelorum.
text_pt: Porque, qualquer que de mim e das minhas palavras se envergonhar, dele se envergonhará o Filho do homem, quando vier na sua glória, e na do Pai e dos santos anjos.
text_el: ὃς γὰρ ἂν ἐπαισχυνθῇ με καὶ τοὺς ἐμοὺς λόγους, τοῦτον ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐπαισχυνθήσεται, ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἐν τῇ δόξῃ αὐτοῦ καὶ τοῦ πατρὸς καὶ τῶν ἁγίων ἀγγέλων.

text_en: But I tell you of a truth : There are some standing here that shall not taste death till they see the kingdom of God .
text_la: Dico autem vobis vere : sunt aliqui hic stantes, qui non gustabunt mortem donec videant regnum Dei.
text_pt: E em verdade vos digo que, dos que aqui estão, alguns há que não provarão a morte até que vejam o reino de Deus.
text_el: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν ἀληθῶς, εἰσίν τινες τῶν αὐτοῦ ἑστηκότων οἳ οὐ μὴ γεύσωνται θανάτου ἕως ἂν ἴδωσιν τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: And it came to pass, about eight days after these words, that he took Peter and James and John and went up into a mountain to pray .
text_la: Factum est autem post hæc verba fere dies octo, et assumpsit Petrum, et Jacobum, et Joannem, et ascendit in montem ut oraret.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, quase oito dias depois destas palavras, tomou consigo a Pedro, a João e a Tiago, e subiu ao monte a orar.
text_el: Ἐγένετο δὲ μετὰ τοὺς λόγους τούτους, ὡσεὶ ἡμέραι ὀκτὼ, παραλαβὼν Πέτρον καὶ Ἰωάννην καὶ Ἰάκωβον ἀνέβη εἰς τὸ ὄρος προσεύξασθαι.

text_en: And whilst he prayed , the shape of his countenance was altered and his raiment became white and glittering.
text_la: Et facta est, dum oraret, species vultus ejus altera : et vestitus ejus albus et refulgens.
text_pt: E, estando ele orando, transfigurou-se a aparência do seu rosto, e a sua roupa ficou branca e mui resplandecente.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ προσεύχεσθαι αὐτὸν τὸ εἶδος τοῦ προσώπου αὐτοῦ ἕτερον καὶ ὁ ἱματισμὸς αὐτοῦ λευκὸς ἐξαστράπτων.

text_en: And behold two men were talking with him. And they were Moses and Elias ,
text_la: Et ecce duo viri loquebantur cum illo. Erant autem Moyses et Elias,
text_pt: E eis que estavam falando com ele dois homens, que eram Moisés e Elias,
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄνδρες δύο συνελάλουν αὐτῷ, οἵτινες ἦσαν Μωϋσῆς καὶ Ἠλίας,

text_en: appearing in majesty. And they spoke of his decease that he should accomplish in Jerusalem .
text_la: visi in majestate : et dicebant excessum ejus, quem completurus erat in Jerusalem.
text_pt: Os quais apareceram com glória, e falavam da sua morte, a qual havia de cumprir-se em Jerusalém.
text_el: οἳ ὀφθέντες ἐν δόξῃ ἔλεγον τὴν ἔξοδον αὐτοῦ, ἣν ἤμελλεν πληροῦν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ.

text_en: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep. And waking, they saw his glory and the two men that stood with him.
text_la: Petrus vero, et qui cum illo erant, gravati erant somno. Et evigilantes viderunt majestatem ejus, et duos viros qui stabant cum illo.
text_pt: E Pedro e os que estavam com ele estavam carregados de sono; e, quando despertaram, viram a sua glória e aqueles dois homens que estavam com ele.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Πέτρος καὶ οἱ σὺν αὐτῷ ἦσαν βεβαρημένοι ὕπνῳ: διαγρηγορήσαντες δὲ εἶδον τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ καὶ τοὺς δύο ἄνδρας τοὺς συνεστῶτας αὐτῷ.

text_en: And it came to pass that, as they were departing from him, Peter says to Jesus : Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles, one for you, and one for Moses ; and one for Elias : not knowing what he said.
text_la: Et factum est cum discederent ab illo, ait Petrus ad Jesum : Præceptor, bonum est nos hic esse : et faciamus tria tabernacula, unum tibi, et unum Moysi, et unum Eliæ : nesciens quid diceret.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, quando aqueles se apartaram dele, disse Pedro a Jesus: Mestre, bom é que nós estejamos aqui, e façamos três tendas: uma para ti, uma para Moisés, e uma para Elias, não sabendo o que dizia.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ διαχωρίζεσθαι αὐτοὺς ἀπ' αὐτοῦ εἶπεν ὁ Πέτρος πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν: ἐπιστάτα, καλόν ἐστιν ἡμᾶς ὧδε εἶναι, καὶ ποιήσωμεν σκηνὰς τρεῖς, μίαν σοὶ καὶ μίαν Μωϋσεῖ καὶ μίαν Ἠλίᾳ, μὴ εἰδὼς ὃ λέγει.

text_en: And as he spoke these things, there came a cloud and overshadowed them. And they were afraid when they entered into the cloud.
text_la: Hæc autem illo loquente, facta est nubes, et obumbravit eos : et timuerunt, intrantibus illis in nubem.
text_pt: E, dizendo ele isto, veio uma nuvem que os cobriu com a sua sombra; e, entrando eles na nuvem, temeram.
text_el: ταῦτα δὲ αὐτοῦ λέγοντος ἐγένετο νεφέλη καὶ ἐπεσκίαζεν αὐτούς: ἐφοβήθησαν δὲ ἐν τῷ εἰσελθεῖν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν νεφέλην.

text_en: And a voice came out of the cloud; saying: This is my beloved son. Hear him.
text_la: Et vox facta est de nube, dicens : Hic est Filius meus dilectus, ipsum audite.
text_pt: E saiu da nuvem uma voz que dizia: Este é o meu amado Filho; a ele ouvi.
text_el: καὶ φωνὴ ἐγένετο ἐκ τῆς νεφέλης λέγουσα: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ υἱός μου ὁ ἐκλελεγμένος, αὐτοῦ ἀκούετε.

text_en: And whilst the voice was uttered Jesus was found alone. And they held their peace and told no man in those days any of these things which they had seen.
text_la: Et dum fieret vox, inventus est Jesus solus. Et ipsi tacuerunt, et nemini dixerunt in illis diebus quidquam ex his quæ viderant.
text_pt: E, tendo soado aquela voz, Jesus foi achado só; e eles calaram-se, e por aqueles dias não contaram a ninguém nada do que tinham visto.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ γενέσθαι τὴν φωνὴν εὑρέθη Ἰησοῦς μόνος. καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐσίγησαν καὶ οὐδενὶ ἀπήγγειλαν ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις οὐδὲν ὧν ἑώρακαν.

text_en: And it came to pass the day following, when they came down from the mountain, there met him a great multitude.
text_la: Factum est autem in sequenti die, descendentibus illis de monte, occurrit illis turba multa.
text_pt: E aconteceu, no dia seguinte, que, descendo eles do monte, lhes saiu ao encontro uma grande multidão;
text_el: Ἐγένετο δὲ τῇ ἑξῆς ἡμέρᾳ κατελθόντων αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄρους συνήντησεν αὐτῷ ὄχλος πολύς.

text_en: And behold a man among the crowd cried out, saying: Master, I beseech you, look upon my son, because he is my only one.
text_la: Et ecce vir de turba exclamavit, dicens : Magister, obsecro te, respice in filium meum quia unicus est mihi:
text_pt: E eis que um homem da multidão clamou, dizendo: Mestre, peço-te que olhes para meu filho, porque é o único que eu tenho.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀνὴρ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄχλου ἐβόησεν λέγων: διδάσκαλε, δέομαί σου ἐπιβλέψαι ἐπὶ τὸν υἱόν μου, ὅτι μονογενής μοί ἐστιν,

text_en: And lo, a spirit seizes him, and he suddenly cries out, and he throws him down and tears him, so that he foams; and bruising him, he hardly departs from him.
text_la: et ecce spiritus apprehendit eum, et subito clamat, et elidit, et dissipat eum cum spuma, et vix discedit dilanians eum:
text_pt: Eis que um espírito o toma e de repente clama, e o despedaça até espumar; e só o larga depois de o ter quebrantado.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ πνεῦμα λαμβάνει αὐτόν καὶ ἐξαίφνης κράζει καὶ σπαράσσει αὐτὸν μετὰ ἀφροῦ, καὶ μόλις ἀποχωρεῖ ἀπ' αὐτοῦ συντρῖβον αὐτόν.

text_en: And I desired your disciples to cast him out : and they could not.
text_la: et rogavi discipulos tuos ut ejicerent illum, et non potuerunt.
text_pt: E roguei aos teus discípulos que o expulsassem, e não puderam.
text_el: καὶ ἐδεήθην τῶν μαθητῶν σου ἵνα ἐκβάλωσιν αὐτό, καὶ οὐκ ἠδυνήθησαν.

text_en: And Jesus , answering, said: O faithless and perverse generation , how long shall I be with you and suffer you? Bring hither your son.
text_la: Respondens autem Jesus, dixit : O generatio infidelis, et perversa, usquequo ero apud vos, et patiar vos? adduc huc filium tuum.
text_pt: E Jesus, respondendo, disse: Ó geração incrédula e perversa! até quando estarei ainda convosco e vos sofrerei? Traze-me aqui o teu filho.
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν: ὦ γενεὰ ἄπιστος καὶ διεστραμμένη, ἕως πότε ἔσομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ ἀνέξομαι ὑμῶν; προσάγαγε ὧδε τὸν υἱόν σου.

text_en: And as he was coming to him, the devil threw him down and tore him.
text_la: Et cum accederet, elisit illum dæmonium, et dissipavit.
text_pt: E, quando vinha chegando, o demônio o derrubou e convulsionou; porém, Jesus repreendeu o espírito imundo, e curou o menino, e o entregou a seu pai.
text_el: ἔτι δὲ προσερχομένου αὐτοῦ ἔρρηξεν αὐτὸν τὸ δαιμόνιον καὶ συνεσπάραξεν: ἐπετίμησεν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς τῷ πνεύματι τῷ ἀκαθάρτῳ, καὶ ἰάσατο τὸν παῖδα καὶ ἀπέδωκεν αὐτὸν τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit and cured the boy and restored him to his father.
text_la: Et increpavit Jesus spiritum immundum, et sanavit puerum, et reddidit illum patri ejus.
text_pt: E todos pasmavam da majestade de Deus. E, maravilhando-se todos de todas as coisas que Jesus fazia, disse aos seus discípulos:
text_el: ἐξεπλήσσοντο δὲ πάντες ἐπὶ τῇ μεγαλειότητι τοῦ θεοῦ. Πάντων δὲ θαυμαζόντων ἐπὶ πᾶσιν οἷς ἐποίει, εἶπεν πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ:

text_en: And all were astonished at the mighty power of God . But while all wondered at all the things he did, he said to his disciples : Lay you up in your hearts these words, for it shall come to pass that the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men .
text_la: Stupebant autem omnes in magnitudine Dei : omnibusque mirantibus in omnibus quæ faciebat, dixit ad discipulos suos : Ponite vos in cordibus vestris sermones istos : Filius enim hominis futurum est ut tradatur in manus hominum.
text_pt: Ponde vós estas palavras em vossos ouvidos, porque o Filho do homem será entregue nas mãos dos homens.
text_el: θέσθε ὑμεῖς εἰς τὰ ὦτα ὑμῶν τοὺς λόγους τούτους: ὁ γὰρ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου μέλλει παραδίδοσθαι εἰς χεῖρας ἀνθρώπων.

text_en: But they understood not this word: and it was hid from them, so that they perceived it not. And they were afraid to ask him concerning this word.
text_la: At illi ignorabant verbum istud, et erat velatum ante eos ut non sentirent illud : et timebant eum interrogare de hoc verbo.
text_pt: Mas eles não entendiam esta palavra, que lhes era encoberta, para que a não compreendessem; e temiam interrogá-lo acerca desta palavra.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἠγνόουν τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο, καὶ ἦν παρακεκαλυμμένον ἀπ' αὐτῶν ἵνα μὴ αἴσθωνται αὐτό, καὶ ἐφοβοῦντο ἐρωτῆσαι αὐτὸν περὶ τοῦ ῥήματος τούτου.

text_en: And there entered a thought into them, which of them should be greater.
text_la: Intravit autem cogitatio in eos quis eorum major esset.
text_pt: E suscitou-se entre eles uma discussão sobre qual deles seria o maior.
text_el: Εἰσῆλθεν δὲ διαλογισμὸς ἐν αὐτοῖς, τὸ τίς ἂν εἴη μείζων αὐτῶν.

text_en: But Jesus seeing the thoughts of their hearts, took a child and set him by him,
text_la: At Jesus videns cogitationes cordis illorum, apprehendit puerum, et statuit illum secus se,
text_pt: Mas Jesus, vendo o pensamento de seus corações, tomou um menino, pô-lo junto a si,
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἰδὼς τὸν διαλογισμὸν τῆς καρδίας αὐτῶν, ἐπιλαβόμενος παιδίον ἔστησεν αὐτὸ παρ' ἑαυτῷ,

text_en: and said to them: Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receives me; and whosoever shall receive me receives him that sent me. For he that is the lesser among you all, he is the greater.
text_la: et ait illis : Quicumque susceperit puerum istum in nomine meo, me recipit : et quicumque me receperit, recipit eum qui me misit. Nam qui minor est inter vos omnes, hic major est.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Qualquer que receber este menino em meu nome, recebe-me a mim; e qualquer que me receber a mim, recebe o que me enviou; porque aquele que entre vós todos for o menor, esse mesmo será grande.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: ὃς ἐὰν δέξηται τοῦτο τὸ παιδίον ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου, ἐμὲ δέχεται: καὶ ὃς ἂν ἐμὲ δέξηται, δέχεται τὸν ἀποστείλαντά με: ὁ γὰρ μικρότερος ἐν πᾶσιν ὑμῖν ὑπάρχων οὗτός ἐστιν μέγας.

text_en: And John , answering, said: Master, we saw a certain man casting out devils in your name : and we forbade him, because he follows not with us.
text_la: Respondens autem Joannes dixit : Præceptor, vidimus quemdam in nomine tuo ejicientem dæmonia, et prohibuimus eum : quia non sequitur nobiscum.
text_pt: E, respondendo João, disse: Mestre, vimos um que em teu nome expulsava os demônios, e lho proibimos, porque não te segue conosco.
text_el: Ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ Ἰωάννης εἶπεν: ἐπιστάτα, εἴδομέν τινα ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ἐκβάλλοντα δαιμόνια, καὶ ἐκωλύομεν αὐτὸν, ὅτι οὐκ ἀκολουθεῖ μεθ' ἡμῶν.

text_en: And Jesus said to him: Forbid him not: for he that is not against you is for you.
text_la: Et ait ad illum Jesus : Nolite prohibere : qui enim non est adversum vos, pro vobis est.
text_pt: E Jesus lhe disse: Não o proibais, porque quem não é contra nós é por nós.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτὸν Ἰησοῦς: μὴ κωλύετε: ὃς γὰρ οὐκ ἔστιν καθ' ὑμῶν, ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ἐστιν.

text_en: And it came to pass, when the days of his assumption were accomplishing, that he steadfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem .
text_la: Factum est autem dum complerentur dies assumptionis ejus, et ipse faciem suam firmavit ut iret in Jerusalem.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, completando-se os dias para a sua assunção, manifestou o firme propósito de ir a Jerusalém.
text_el: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ συμπληροῦσθαι τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ἀναλήμψεως αὐτοῦ καὶ αὐτὸς τὸ πρόσωπον ἐστήρισεν τοῦ πορεύεσθαι εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ,

text_en: And he sent messengers before his face: and going, they entered into a city of the Samaritans , to prepare for him.
text_la: Et misit nuntios ante conspectum suum: et euntes intraverunt in civitatem Samaritanorum ut parerent illi.
text_pt: E mandou mensageiros adiante de si; e, indo eles, entraram numa aldeia de samaritanos, para lhe prepararem pousada,
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ἀγγέλους πρὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ. καὶ πορευθέντες εἰσῆλθον εἰς κώμην Σαμαριτῶν, ὡς ἑτοιμάσαι αὐτῷ:

text_en: And they received him not, because his face was of one going to Jerusalem .
text_la: Et non receperunt eum, quia facies ejus erat euntis in Jerusalem.
text_pt: Mas não o receberam, porque o seu aspecto era como de quem ia a Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐδέξαντο αὐτόν, ὅτι τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἦν πορευόμενον εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ.

text_en: And when his disciples , James and John , had seen this, they said: Lord, will you that we command fire to come down from heaven and consume them?
text_la: Cum vidissent autem discipuli ejus Jacobus et Joannes, dixerunt : Domine, vis dicimus ut ignis descendat de cælo, et consumat illos?
text_pt: E os seus discípulos, Tiago e João, vendo isto, disseram: Senhor, queres que digamos que desça fogo do céu e os consuma, como Elias também fez?
text_el: ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ Ἰάκωβος καὶ Ἰωάννης εἶπαν: κύριε, θέλεις εἴπωμεν πῦρ καταβῆναι ἀπὸ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἀναλῶσαι αὐτούς;

text_en: And turning, he rebuked them, saying: you know not of what spirit you are.
text_la: Et conversus increpavit illos, dicens : Nescitis cujus spiritus estis.
text_pt: Voltando-se, porém, repreendeu-os, e disse: Vós não sabeis de que espírito sois.
text_el: στραφεὶς δὲ ἐπετίμησεν αὐτοῖς.

text_en: The Son of man came not to destroy souls , but to save. And they went into another town.
text_la: Filius hominis non venit animas perdere, sed salvare. Et abierunt in aliud castellum.
text_pt: Porque o Filho do homem não veio para destruir as almas dos homens, mas para salvá-las. E foram para outra aldeia.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν εἰς ἑτέραν κώμην.

text_en: And it came to pass, as they walked in the way, that a certain man said to him: I will follow you wherever you go.
text_la: Factum est autem : ambulantibus illis in via, dixit quidam ad illum : Sequar te quocumque ieris.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, indo eles pelo caminho, lhe disse um: Senhor, seguir-te-ei para onde quer que fores.
text_el: Καὶ πορευομένων αὐτῶν ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ εἶπέν τις πρὸς αὐτόν, ἀκολουθήσω σοι ὅπου ἐὰν ἀπέρχῃ.

text_en: Jesus said to him: The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air nests: but the Son of man has not where to lay his head.
text_la: Dixit illi Jesus : Vulpes foveas habent, et volucres cæli nidos : Filius autem hominis non habet ubi caput reclinet.
text_pt: E disse-lhe Jesus: As raposas têm covis, e as aves do céu, ninhos, mas o Filho do homem não tem onde reclinar a cabeça.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς: αἱ ἀλώπεκες φωλεοὺς ἔχουσιν καὶ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ κατασκηνώσεις, ὁ δὲ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου οὐκ ἔχει ποῦ τὴν κεφαλὴν κλίνῃ.

text_en: But he said to another: Follow me. And he said: Lord, suffer me first to go and to bury my father.
text_la: Ait autem ad alterum : Sequere me : ille autem dixit : Domine, permitte mihi primum ire, et sepelire patrem meum.
text_pt: E disse a outro: Segue-me. Mas ele respondeu: Senhor, deixa que primeiro eu vá a enterrar meu pai.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς ἕτερον: ἀκολούθει μοι. ὁ δὲ εἶπεν: ἐπίτρεψόν μοι πρῶτον ἀπελθόντι θάψαι τὸν πατέρα μου.

text_en: And Jesus said to him: Let the dead bury their dead: but go and preach the kingdom of God .
text_la: Dixitque ei Jesus : Sine ut mortui sepeliant mortuos suos : tu autem vade, et annuntia regnum Dei.
text_pt: Mas Jesus lhe observou: Deixa aos mortos o enterrar os seus mortos; porém tu vai e anuncia o reino de Deus.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ: ἄφες τοὺς νεκροὺς θάψαι τοὺς ἑαυτῶν νεκρούς, σὺ δὲ ἀπελθὼν διάγγελλε τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: And another said: I will follow you, Lord; but let me first take my leave of them that are at my house.
text_la: Et ait alter : Sequar te Domine, sed permitte mihi primum renuntiare his quæ domi sunt.
text_pt: Disse também outro: Senhor, eu te seguirei, mas deixa-me despedir primeiro dos que estão em minha casa.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ καὶ ἕτερος: ἀκολουθήσω σοι, κύριε: πρῶτον δὲ ἐπίτρεψόν μοι ἀποτάξασθαι τοῖς εἰς τὸν οἶκόν μου.

text_en: Jesus said to him: No man putting his hand to the plough and looking back is fit for the kingdom of God .
text_la: Ait ad illum Jesus : Nemo mittens manum suam ad aratrum, et respiciens retro, aptus est regno Dei.
text_pt: E Jesus lhe disse: Ninguém, que lança mão do arado e olha para trás, é apto para o reino de Deus.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ [πρὸς αὐτὸν] ὁ Ἰησοῦς: οὐδεὶς ἐπιβαλὼν τὴν χεῖρα ἐπ' ἄροτρον καὶ βλέπων εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω εὔθετός ἐστιν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: And after these things, the Lord appointed also other seventy-two. And he sent them two and two before his face into every city and place whither he himself was to come.
text_la: Post hæc autem designavit Dominus et alios septuaginta duos : et misit illos binos ante faciem suam in omnem civitatem et locum, quo erat ipse venturus.
text_pt: E depois disto designou o Senhor ainda outros setenta, e mandou-os adiante da sua face, de dois em dois, a todas as cidades e lugares aonde ele havia de ir.
text_el: Μετὰ δὲ ταῦτα ἀνέδειξεν ὁ κύριος ἑτέρους ἑβδομήκοντα [δύο], καὶ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτοὺς ἀνὰ δύο [δύο] πρὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ εἰς πᾶσαν πόλιν καὶ τόπον οὗ ἤμελλεν αὐτὸς ἔρχεσθαι.

text_en: And he said to them: The harvest indeed is great, but the labourers are few. Pray therefore the Lord of the harvest that he send labourers into his harvest.
text_la: Et dicebat illis : Messis quidem multa, operarii autem pauci. Rogate ergo dominum messis ut mittat operarios in messem suam.
text_pt: E dizia-lhes: Grande é, em verdade, a seara, mas os obreiros são poucos; rogai, pois, ao Senhor da seara que envie obreiros para a sua seara.
text_el: ἔλεγεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτούς: ὁ μὲν θερισμὸς πολύς, οἱ δὲ ἐργάται ὀλίγοι: δεήθητε οὖν τοῦ κυρίου τοῦ θερισμοῦ ὅπως ἐργάτας ἐκβάλῃ εἰς τὸν θερισμὸν αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Go: Behold I send you as lambs among wolves.
text_la: Ite : ecce ego mitto vos sicut agnos inter lupos.
text_pt: Ide; eis que vos mando como cordeiros ao meio de lobos.
text_el: ὑπάγετε: ἰδοὺ ἀποστέλλω ὑμᾶς ὡς ἄρνας ἐν μέσῳ λύκων.

text_en: Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.
text_la: Nolite portare sacculum, neque peram, neque calceamenta, et neminem per viam salutaveritis.
text_pt: Não leveis bolsa, nem alforje, nem alparcas; e a ninguém saudeis pelo caminho.
text_el: μὴ βαστάζετε βαλλάντιον, μὴ πήραν, μὴ ὑποδήματα: καὶ μηδένα κατὰ τὴν ὁδὸν ἀσπάσησθε.

text_en: Into whatever house you enter, first say: Peace be to this house.
text_la: In quamcumque domum intraveritis, primum dicite : Pax huic domui:
text_pt: E, em qualquer casa onde entrardes, dizei primeiro: Paz seja nesta casa.
text_el: εἰς ἣν δ' ἂν εἰσέλθητε οἰκίαν, πρῶτον λέγετε: εἰρήνη τῷ οἴκῳ τούτῳ.

text_en: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon him: but if not, it shall return to you.
text_la: et si ibi fuerit filius pacis, requiescet super illum pax vestra : sin autem, ad vos revertetur.
text_pt: E, se ali houver algum filho de paz, repousará sobre ele a vossa paz; e, se não, voltará para vós.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν ἐκεῖ ᾖ υἱὸς εἰρήνης, ἐπαναπαήσεται ἐπ' αὐτὸν ἡ εἰρήνη ὑμῶν: εἰ δὲ μή γε, ἐφ' ὑμᾶς ἀνακάμψει.

text_en: And in the same house, remain, eating and drinking such things as they have: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Remove not from house to house.
text_la: In eadem autem domo manete, edentes et bibentes quæ apud illos sunt : dignus est enim operarius mercede sua. Nolite transire de domo in domum.
text_pt: E ficai na mesma casa, comendo e bebendo do que eles tiverem, pois digno é o obreiro de seu salário. Não andeis de casa em casa.
text_el: ἐν αὐτῇ δὲ τῇ οἰκίᾳ μένετε, ἐσθίοντες καὶ πίνοντες τὰ παρ' αὐτῶν: ἄξιος γὰρ ὁ ἐργάτης τοῦ μισθοῦ αὐτοῦ. μὴ μεταβαίνετε ἐξ οἰκίας εἰς οἰκίαν.

text_en: And into what city soever you enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you.
text_la: Et in quamcumque civitatem intraveritis, et susceperint vos, manducate quæ apponuntur vobis:
text_pt: E, em qualquer cidade em que entrardes, e vos receberem, comei do que vos for oferecido.
text_el: καὶ εἰς ἣν ἂν πόλιν εἰσέρχησθε καὶ δέχωνται ὑμᾶς, ἐσθίετε τὰ παρατιθέμενα ὑμῖν,

text_en: And heal the sick that are therein and say to them: The kingdom of God has come near unto you.
text_la: et curate infirmos, qui in illa sunt, et dicite illis : Appropinquavit in vos regnum Dei.
text_pt: E curai os enfermos que nela houver, e dizei-lhes: É chegado a vós o reino de Deus.
text_el: καὶ θεραπεύετε τοὺς ἐν αὐτῇ ἀσθενεῖς, καὶ λέγετε αὐτοῖς: ἤγγικεν ἐφ' ὑμᾶς ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: But into whatsoever city you enter, and they receive you not, going forth into the streets thereof, say:
text_la: In quamcumque autem civitatem intraveritis, et non susceperint vos, exeuntes in plateas ejus, dicite:
text_pt: Mas em qualquer cidade, em que entrardes e vos não receberem, saindo por suas ruas, dizei:
text_el: εἰς ἣν δ' ἂν πόλιν εἰσέλθητε καὶ μὴ δέχωνται ὑμᾶς, ἐξελθόντες εἰς τὰς πλατείας αὐτῆς εἴπατε:

text_en: Even the very dust of your city that cleaves to us, we wipe off against you. Yet know this, that the kingdom of God is at hand.
text_la: Etiam pulverem, qui adhæsit nobis de civitate vestra, extergimus in vos : tamen hoc scitote, quia appropinquavit regnum Dei.
text_pt: Até o pó, que da vossa cidade se nos pegou, sacudimos sobre vós. Sabei, contudo, isto, que já o reino de Deus é chegado a vós.
text_el: καὶ τὸν κονιορτὸν τὸν κολληθέντα ἡμῖν ἐκ τῆς πόλεως ὑμῶν εἰς τοὺς πόδας ἀπομασσόμεθα ὑμῖν: πλὴν τοῦτο γινώσκετε ὅτι ἤγγικεν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: I say to you, it shall be more tolerable at that day for Sodom than for that city.
text_la: Dico vobis, quia Sodomis in die illa remissius erit, quam illi civitati.
text_pt: E digo-vos que mais tolerância haverá naquele dia para Sodoma do que para aquela cidade.
text_el: λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι Σοδόμοις ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἀνεκτότερον ἔσται ἢ τῇ πόλει ἐκείνῃ.

text_en: Woe to you, Corozain! Woe to you, Bethsaida ! For if in Tyre and Sidon had been wrought the mighty works that have been wrought in you, they would have done penance long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
text_la: Væ tibi Corozain! væ tibi Bethsaida! quia si in Tyro et Sidone factæ fuissent virtutes quæ factæ sunt in vobis, olim in cilicio et cinere sedentes pœniterent.
text_pt: Ai de ti, Corazim, ai de ti, Betsaida! Porque, se em Tiro e em Sidom se fizessem as maravilhas que em vós foram feitas, já há muito, assentadas em saco e cinza, se teriam arrependido.
text_el: Οὐαί σοι, Χοραζίν, οὐαί σοι Βηθσαϊδά: ὅτι εἰ ἐν Τύρῳ καὶ Σιδῶνι ἐγενήθησαν αἱ δυνάμεις αἱ γενόμεναι ἐν ὑμῖν, πάλαι ἂν ἐν σάκκῳ καὶ σποδῷ καθήμενοι μετενόησαν.

text_en: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment than for you.
text_la: Verumtamen Tyro et Sidoni remissius erit in judicio, quam vobis.
text_pt: Portanto, para Tiro e Sidom haverá menos rigor, no juízo, do que para vós.
text_el: πλὴν Τύρῳ καὶ Σιδῶνι ἀνεκτότερον ἔσται ἐν τῇ κρίσει ἢ ὑμῖν.

text_en: And you, Capharnaum , which are exalted unto heaven , you shall be thrust down to hell .
text_la: Et tu Capharnaum, usque ad cælum exaltata, usque ad infernum demergeris.
text_pt: E tu, Cafarnaum, que te levantaste até ao céu, até ao inferno serás abatida.
text_el: καὶ σύ, Καφαρναούμ, μὴ ἕως οὐρανοῦ ὑψωθήσῃ; ἕως τοῦ ᾅδου καταβήσῃ.

text_en: He that hears you hears me: and he that despises you despises me: and he that despises me despises him that sent me.
text_la: Qui vos audit, me audit : et qui vos spernit, me spernit. Qui autem me spernit, spernit eum qui misit me.
text_pt: Quem vos ouve a vós, a mim me ouve; e quem vos rejeita a vós, a mim me rejeita; e quem a mim me rejeita, rejeita aquele que me enviou.
text_el: Ὁ ἀκούων ὑμῶν ἐμοῦ ἀκούει, καὶ ὁ ἀθετῶν ὑμᾶς ἐμὲ ἀθετεῖ: ὁ δὲ ἐμὲ ἀθετῶν ἀθετεῖ τὸν ἀποστείλαντά με.

text_en: And the seventy-two returned with joy , saying: Lord, the devils also are subject to us in your name .
text_la: Reversi sunt autem septuaginta duo cum gaudio, dicentes : Domine, etiam dæmonia subjiciuntur nobis in nomine tuo.
text_pt: E voltaram os setenta com alegria, dizendo: Senhor, pelo teu nome, até os demônios se nos sujeitam.
text_el: Ὑπέστρεψαν δὲ οἱ ἑβδομήκοντα [δύο] μετὰ χαρᾶς λέγοντες: κύριε, καὶ τὰ δαιμόνια ὑποτάσσεται ἡμῖν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου.

text_en: And he said to them: I saw Satan like lightning falling from heaven .
text_la: Et ait illis : Videbam Satanam sicut fulgor de cælo cadentem.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Eu via Satanás, como raio, cair do céu.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς: ἐθεώρουν τὸν Σατανᾶν ὡς ἀστραπὴν ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ πεσόντα.

text_en: Behold, I have given you power to tread upon serpents and scorpions and upon all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall hurt you.
text_la: Ecce dedi vobis potestatem calcandi supra serpentes, et scorpiones, et super omnem virtutem inimici : et nihil vobis nocebit.
text_pt: Eis que vos dou poder para pisar serpentes e escorpiões, e toda a força do inimigo, e nada vos fará dano algum.
text_el: ἰδοὺ δέδωκα ὑμῖν τὴν ἐξουσίαν τοῦ πατεῖν ἐπάνω ὄφεων καὶ σκορπίων, καὶ ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν δύναμιν τοῦ ἐχθροῦ, καὶ οὐδὲν ὑμᾶς οὐ μὴ ἀδικήσει.

text_en: But yet rejoice not in this, that spirits are subject unto you: but rejoice in this, that your names are written in heaven .
text_la: Verumtamen in hoc nolite gaudere quia spiritus vobis subjiciuntur : gaudete autem, quod nomina vestra scripta sunt in cælis.
text_pt: Mas, não vos alegreis porque se vos sujeitem os espíritos; alegrai-vos antes por estarem os vossos nomes escritos nos céus.
text_el: πλὴν ἐν τούτῳ μὴ χαίρετε ὅτι τὰ πνεύματα ὑμῖν ὑποτάσσεται, χαίρετε δὲ ὅτι τὰ ὀνόματα ὑμῶν ἐγγέγραπται ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς.

text_en: In that same hour, he rejoiced in the Holy Ghost and said: I confess to you, O Father , Lord of heaven and earth, because you have hidden these things from the wise and prudent and have revealed them to little ones. Yea, Father , for so it has seemed good in your sight.
text_la: In ipsa hora exsultavit Spiritu Sancto, et dixit : Confiteor tibi Pater, Domine cæli et terræ, quod abscondisti hæc a sapientibus et prudentibus, et revelasti ea parvulis. Etiam Pater : quoniam sic placuit ante te.
text_pt: Naquela mesma hora se alegrou Jesus no Espírito Santo, e disse: Graças te dou, ó Pai, Senhor do céu e da terra, que escondeste estas coisas aos sábios e inteligentes, e as revelaste às criancinhas; assim é, ó Pai, porque assim te aprouve.
text_el: Ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ ἠγαλλιάσατο τῷ πνεύματι τῷ ἁγίῳ καὶ εἶπεν: ἐξομολογοῦμαί σοι πάτερ, κύριε τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ τῆς γῆς, ὅτι ἀπέκρυψας ταῦτα ἀπὸ σοφῶν καὶ συνετῶν, καὶ ἀπεκάλυψας αὐτὰ νηπίοις: ναί ὁ πατήρ, ὅτι οὕτως εὐδοκία ἐγένετο ἔμπροσθέν σου.

text_en: All things are delivered to me by my Father . And no one knows who the Son is, but the Father : and who the Father is, but the Son and to whom the Son will reveal him.
text_la: Omnia mihi tradita sunt a Patre meo. Et nemo scit quis sit Filius, nisi Pater : et quis sit Pater, nisi Filius, et cui voluerit Filius revelare.
text_pt: Tudo por meu Pai foi entregue; e ninguém conhece quem é o Filho senão o Pai, nem quem é o Pai senão o Filho, e aquele a quem o Filho o quiser revelar.
text_el: Πάντα μοι παρεδόθη ὑπὸ τοῦ πατρός μου, καὶ οὐδεὶς γινώσκει τίς ἐστιν ὁ υἱὸς εἰ μὴ ὁ πατήρ, καὶ τίς ἐστιν ὁ πατὴρ εἰ μὴ ὁ υἱὸς καὶ ᾧ ἐὰν βούληται ὁ υἱὸς ἀποκαλύψαι.

text_en: And turning to his disciples , he said: Blessed are the eyes that see the things which you see.
text_la: Et conversus ad discipulos suos, dixit : Beati oculi qui vident quæ vos videtis.
text_pt: E, voltando-se para os discípulos, disse-lhes em particular: Bem-aventurados os olhos que vêem o que vós vedes.
text_el: Καὶ στραφεὶς πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς κατ' ἰδίαν εἶπεν: μακάριοι οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ οἱ βλέποντες ἃ βλέπετε.

text_en: For I say to you that many prophets and kings have desired to see the things that you see and have not seen them; and to hear the things that you hear and have not heard them.
text_la: Dico enim vobis quod multi prophetæ et reges voluerunt videre quæ vos videtis, et non viderunt : et audire quæ auditis, et non audierunt.
text_pt: Pois vos digo que muitos profetas e reis desejaram ver o que vós vedes, e não o viram; e ouvir o que ouvis, e não o ouviram.
text_el: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι πολλοὶ προφῆται καὶ βασιλεῖς ἠθέλησαν ἰδεῖν ἃ ὑμεῖς βλέπετε, καὶ οὐκ εἶδαν, καὶ ἀκοῦσαι ἃ ἀκούετε καὶ οὐκ ἤκουσαν.

text_en: And behold a certain lawyer stood up, tempting him and saying, Master, what must I do to possess eternal life?
text_la: Et ecce quidam legisperitus surrexit tentans illum, et dicens : Magister, quid faciendo vitam æternam possidebo?
text_pt: E eis que se levantou um certo doutor da lei, tentando-o, e dizendo: Mestre, que farei para herdar a vida eterna?
text_el: Καὶ ἰδοὺ νομικός τις ἀνέστη ἐκπειράζων αὐτὸν, λέγων: διδάσκαλε, τί ποιήσας ζωὴν αἰώνιον κληρονομήσω;

text_en: But he said to him: What is written in the law? How do you read it?
text_la: At ille dixit ad eum : In lege quid scriptum est? quomodo legis?
text_pt: E ele lhe disse: Que está escrito na lei? Como lês?
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν: ἐν τῷ νόμῳ τί γέγραπται; πῶς ἀναγινώσκεις;

text_en: He answering, said: You shall love the Lord your God with your whole heart and with your whole soul and with all your strength and with all your mind: and your neighbour as yourself.
text_la: Ille respondens dixit : Diliges Dominum Deum tuum ex toto corde tuo, et ex tota anima tua, et ex omnibus virtutibus tuis, et ex omni mente tua : et proximum tuum sicut teipsum.
text_pt: E, respondendo ele, disse: Amarás ao Senhor teu Deus de todo o teu coração, e de toda a tua alma, e de todas as tuas forças, e de todo o teu entendimento, e ao teu próximo como a ti mesmo.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν: ἀγαπήσεις κύριον τὸν θεόν σου ἐξ ὅλης καρδίας σου καὶ ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ ψυχῇ σου καὶ ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ ἰσχύϊ σου καὶ ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ διανοίᾳ σου, καὶ τὸν πλησίον σου ὡς σεαυτόν.

text_en: And he said to him: You have answered right. This do: and you shall live.
text_la: Dixitque illi : Recte respondisti : hoc fac, et vives.
text_pt: E disse-lhe: Respondeste bem; faze isso, e viverás.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ: ὀρθῶς ἀπεκρίθης: τοῦτο ποίει, καὶ ζήσῃ.

text_en: But he willing to justify himself, said to Jesus : And who is my neighbour?
text_la: Ille autem volens justificare seipsum, dixit ad Jesum : Et quis est meus proximus?
text_pt: Ele, porém, querendo justificar-se a si mesmo, disse a Jesus: E quem é o meu próximo?
text_el: ὁ δὲ θέλων δικαιῶσαι ἑαυτὸν εἶπεν πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν: καὶ τίς ἐστίν μου πλησίον;

text_en: And Jesus answering, said: A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho and fell among robbers, who also stripped him and having wounded him went away, leaving him half dead.
text_la: Suscipiens autem Jesus, dixit : Homo quidam descendebat ab Jerusalem in Jericho, et incidit in latrones, qui etiam despoliaverunt eum : et plagis impositis abierunt semivivo relicto.
text_pt: E, respondendo Jesus, disse: Descia um homem de Jerusalém para Jericó, e caiu nas mãos dos salteadores, os quais o despojaram, e espancando-o, se retiraram, deixando-o meio morto.
text_el: ὑπολαβὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν: ἄνθρωπός τις κατέβαινεν ἀπὸ Ἰερουσαλὴμ εἰς Ἰεριχὼ, καὶ λῃσταῖς περιέπεσεν, οἳ καὶ ἐκδύσαντες αὐτὸν καὶ πληγὰς ἐπιθέντες ἀπῆλθον, ἀφέντες ἡμιθανῆ.

text_en: And it chanced, that a certain priest went down the same way: and seeing him, passed by.
text_la: Accidit autem ut sacerdos quidam descenderet eadem via: et viso illo præterivit.
text_pt: E, ocasionalmente descia pelo mesmo caminho certo sacerdote; e, vendo-o, passou de largo.
text_el: κατὰ συγκυρίαν δὲ ἱερεύς τις κατέβαινεν [ἐν] τῇ ὁδῷ ἐκείνῃ, καὶ ἰδὼν αὐτὸν ἀντιπαρῆλθεν.

text_en: In like manner also a Levite , when he was near the place and saw him, passed by.
text_la: Similiter et Levita, cum esset secus locum, et videret eum, pertransiit.
text_pt: E de igual modo também um levita, chegando àquele lugar, e, vendo-o, passou de largo.
text_el: ὁμοίως δὲ καὶ Λευίτης κατὰ τὸν τόπον. ἐλθὼν καὶ ἰδὼν ἀντιπαρῆλθεν.

text_en: But a certain Samaritan , being on his journey, came near him: and seeing him, was moved with compassion:
text_la: Samaritanus autem quidam iter faciens, venit secus eum : et videns eum, misericordia motus est.
text_pt: Mas um samaritano, que ia de viagem, chegou ao pé dele e, vendo-o, moveu-se de íntima compaixão;
text_el: Σαμαρίτης δέ τις ὁδεύων ἦλθεν κατ' αὐτὸν καὶ ἰδὼν ἐσπλαγχνίσθη,

text_en: And going up to him, bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine: and setting him upon his own beast, brought him to an inn and took care of him.
text_la: Et appropians alligavit vulnera ejus, infundens oleum et vinum : et imponens illum in jumentum suum, duxit in stabulum, et curam ejus egit.
text_pt: E, aproximando-se, atou-lhe as feridas, deitando-lhes azeite e vinho; e, pondo-o sobre o seu animal, levou-o para uma estalagem, e cuidou dele;
text_el: καὶ προσελθὼν κατέδησεν τὰ τραύματα αὐτοῦ ἐπιχέων ἔλαιον καὶ οἶνον, ἐπιβιβάσας δὲ αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὸ ἴδιον κτῆνος ἤγαγεν αὐτὸν εἰς πανδοχεῖον καὶ ἐπεμελήθη αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And the next day he took out two pence and gave to the host and said: Take care of him; and whatsoever you shall spend over and above, I, at my return, will repay you.
