text_la: Et altera die protulit duos denarios, et dedit stabulario, et ait : Curam illius habe : et quodcumque supererogaveris, ego cum rediero reddam tibi.
text_pt: E, partindo no outro dia, tirou dois dinheiros, e deu-os ao hospedeiro, e disse-lhe: Cuida dele; e tudo o que de mais gastares eu to pagarei quando voltar.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν αὔριον ἐκβαλὼν δύο δηνάρια ἔδωκεν τῷ πανδοχεῖ καὶ εἶπεν: ἐπιμελήθητι αὐτοῦ, καὶ ὅ τι ἂν προσδαπανήσῃς ἐγὼ ἐν τῷ ἐπανέρχεσθαί με ἀποδώσω σοι.

text_en: Which of these three, in your opinion, was neighbour to him that fell among the robbers?
text_la: Quis horum trium videtur tibi proximus fuisse illi, qui incidit in latrones?
text_pt: Qual, pois, destes três te parece que foi o próximo daquele que caiu nas mãos dos salteadores?
text_el: τίς τούτων τῶν τριῶν πλησίον δοκεῖ σοι γεγονέναι τοῦ ἐμπεσόντος εἰς τοὺς λῃστάς;

text_en: But he said: He that showed mercy to him. And Jesus said to him: Go, and do in like manner.
text_la: At ille dixit : Qui fecit misericordiam in illum. Et ait illi Jesus : Vade, et tu fac similiter.
text_pt: E ele disse: O que usou de misericórdia para com ele. Disse, pois, Jesus: Vai, e faze da mesma maneira.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν: ὁ ποιήσας τὸ ἔλεος μετ' αὐτοῦ. εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς: πορεύου καὶ σὺ ποίει ὁμοίως.

text_en: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain town: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
text_la: Factum est autem, dum irent, et ipse intravit in quoddam castellum : et mulier quædam, Martha nomine, excepit illum in domum suam,
text_pt: E aconteceu que, indo eles de caminho, entrou Jesus numa aldeia; e certa mulher, por nome Marta, o recebeu em sua casa;
text_el: ἐν δὲ τῷ πορεύεσθαι αὐτοὺς αὐτὸς εἰσῆλθεν εἰς κώμην τινά: γυνὴ δέ τις ὀνόματι Μάρθα ὑπεδέξατο αὐτόν. εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν

text_en: And she had a sister called Mary. who, sitting also at the Lord's feet, heard his word.
text_la: et huic erat soror nomine Maria, quæ etiam sedens secus pedes Domini, audiebat verbum illius.
text_pt: E tinha esta uma irmã chamada Maria, a qual, assentando-se também aos pés de Jesus, ouvia a sua palavra.
text_el: καὶ τῇδε ἦν ἀδελφὴ καλουμένη Μαριάμ, ἣ καὶ παρακαθεσθεῖσα πρὸς τοὺς πόδας τοῦ κυρίου ἤκουεν τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ:

text_en: But Martha was busy about much serving. Who stood and said: Lord, have you no care that my sister has left me alone to serve? Speak to her therefore, that she help me.
text_la: Martha autem satagebat circa frequens ministerium : quæ stetit, et ait : Domine, non est tibi curæ quod soror mea reliquit me solam ministrare? dic ergo illi ut me adjuvet.
text_pt: Marta, porém, andava distraída em muitos serviços; e, aproximando-se, disse: Senhor, não se te dá de que minha irmã me deixe servir só? Dize-lhe que me ajude.
text_el: ἡ δὲ Μάρθα περιεσπᾶτο περὶ πολλὴν διακονίαν: ἐπιστᾶσα δὲ εἶπεν: κύριε, οὐ μέλει σοι ὅτι ἡ ἀδελφή μου μόνην με κατέλειπεν κατέλιπεν διακονεῖν; εἰπὸν οὖν αὐτῇ ἵνα μοι συναντιλάβηται.

text_en: And the Lord answering, said to her: Martha , Martha , you are careful and are troubled about many things:
text_la: Et respondens dixit illi Dominus : Martha, Martha, sollicita es, et turbaris erga plurima,
text_pt: E respondendo Jesus, disse-lhe: Marta, Marta, estás ansiosa e afadigada com muitas coisas, mas uma só é necessária;
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῇ ὁ κύριος: Μάρθα Μάρθα, μεριμνᾷς καὶ θορυβάζῃ περὶ πολλά, ἑνὸς δέ ἐστιν χρεία: ἢ ἑνός

text_en: But one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen the best part, which shall not be taken away from her.
text_la: porro unum est necessarium. Maria optimam partem elegit, quæ non auferetur ab ea.
text_pt: E Maria escolheu a boa parte, a qual não lhe será tirada.
text_el: Μαριὰμ γὰρ τὴν ἀγαθὴν μερίδα ἐξελέξατο, ἥτις οὐκ ἀφαιρεθήσεται αὐτῆς.

text_en: And it came to pass that as he was in a certain place praying , when he ceased, one of his disciples said to him: Lord, teach us to pray , as John also taught his disciples .
text_la: Et factum est : cum esset in quodam loco orans, ut cessavit, dixit unus ex discipulis ejus ad eum : Domine, doce nos orare, sicut docuit et Joannes discipulos suos.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, estando ele a orar num certo lugar, quando acabou, lhe disse um dos seus discípulos: Senhor, ensina-nos a orar, como também João ensinou aos seus discípulos.
text_el: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ εἶναι αὐτὸν ἐν τόπῳ τινὶ προσευχόμενον, ὡς ἐπαύσατο, εἶπέν τις τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ πρὸς αὐτόν: κύριε, δίδαξον ἡμᾶς προσεύχεσθαι, καθὼς καὶ Ἰωάννης ἐδίδαξεν τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And he said to them: When you pray , say: Father , hallowed be your name . Your kingdom come.
text_la: Et ait illis : Cum oratis, dicite : Pater, sanctificetur nomen tuum. Adveniat regnum tuum.
text_pt: E ele lhes disse: Quando orardes, dizei: Pai nosso, que estás nos céus, santificado seja o teu nome; venha o teu reino; seja feita a tua vontade, assim na terra, como no céu.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς: ὅταν προσεύχησθε, λέγετε: πάτερ, ἁγιασθήτω τὸ ὄνομά σου: ἐλθέτω ἡ βασιλεία σου:

text_en: Give us this day our daily bread.
text_la: Panem nostrum quotidianum da nobis hodie.
text_pt: Dá-nos cada dia o nosso pão cotidiano;
text_el: τὸν ἄρτον ἡμῶν τὸν ἐπιούσιον δίδου ἡμῖν τὸ καθ' ἡμέραν:

text_en: And forgive us our sins , for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation .
text_la: Et dimitte nobis peccata nostra, siquidem et ipsi dimittimus omni debenti nobis. Et ne nos inducas in tentationem.
text_pt: E perdoa-nos os nossos pecados, pois também nós perdoamos a qualquer que nos deve, e não nos conduzas à tentação, mas livra-nos do mal.
text_el: καὶ ἄφες ἡμῖν τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἡμῶν, καὶ γὰρ αὐτοὶ ἀφίομεν παντὶ ὀφείλοντι ἡμῖν: καὶ μὴ εἰσενέγκῃς ἡμᾶς εἰς πειρασμόν.

text_en: And he said to them: Which of you shall have a friend and shall go to him at midnight and shall say to him: Friend, lend me three loaves,
text_la: Et ait ad illos : Quis vestrum habebit amicum, et ibit ad illum media nocte, et dicet illi : Amice, commoda mihi tres panes,
text_pt: Disse-lhes também: Qual de vós terá um amigo, e, se for procurá-lo à meia-noite, e lhe disser: Amigo, empresta-me três pães,
text_el: Καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς: τίς ἐξ ὑμῶν ἕξει φίλον, καὶ πορεύσεται πρὸς αὐτὸν μεσονυκτίου καὶ εἴπῃ αὐτῷ: φίλε, χρῆσόν μοι τρεῖς ἄρτους,

text_en: because a friend of mine has come off his journey to me and I have not what to set before him.
text_la: quoniam amicus meus venit de via ad me, et non habeo quod ponam ante illum,
text_pt: Pois que um amigo meu chegou a minha casa, vindo de caminho, e não tenho que apresentar-lhe;
text_el: ἐπειδὴ φίλος μου παρεγένετο ἐξ ὁδοῦ πρός με καὶ οὐκ ἔχω ὃ παραθήσω αὐτῷ.

text_en: And he from within should answer and say: Trouble me not; the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I cannot rise and give you.
text_la: et ille de intus respondens dicat : Noli mihi molestus esse, jam ostium clausum est, et pueri mei mecum sunt in cubili : non possum surgere, et dare tibi.
text_pt: Se ele, respondendo de dentro, disser: Não me importunes; já está a porta fechada, e os meus filhos estão comigo na cama; não posso levantar-me para tos dar;
text_el: κἀκεῖνος ἔσωθεν ἀποκριθεὶς εἴπῃ: μή μοι κόπους πάρεχε: ἤδη ἡ θύρα κέκλεισται, καὶ τὰ παιδία μου μετ' ἐμοῦ εἰς τὴν κοίτην εἰσίν: οὐ δύναμαι ἀναστὰς δοῦναί σοι.

text_en: Yet if he shall continue knocking, I say to you, although he will not rise and give him because he is his friend; yet, because of his importunity, he will rise and give him as many as he needs.
text_la: Et si ille perseveraverit pulsans : dico vobis, etsi non dabit illi surgens eo quod amicus ejus sit, propter improbitatem tamen ejus surget, et dabit illi quotquot habet necessarios.
text_pt: Digo-vos que, ainda que não se levante a dar-lhos, por ser seu amigo, levantar-se-á, todavia, por causa da sua importunação, e lhe dará tudo o que houver mister.
text_el: λέγω ὑμῖν, εἰ καὶ οὐ δώσει αὐτῷ ἀναστὰς διὰ τὸ εἶναι φίλον αὐτοῦ, διά γε τὴν ἀναίδειαν αὐτοῦ ἐγερθεὶς δώσει αὐτῷ ὅσων χρῄζει.

text_en: And I say to you: Ask, and it shall be given you: seek, and you shall find: knock, and it shall be opened to you.
text_la: Et ego dico vobis : Petite, et dabitur vobis; quærite, et invenietis; pulsate, et aperietur vobis.
text_pt: E eu vos digo a vós: Pedi, e dar-se-vos-á; buscai, e achareis; batei, e abrir-se-vos-á;
text_el: Κἀγὼ ὑμῖν λέγω, αἰτεῖτε, καὶ δοθήσεται ὑμῖν: ζητεῖτε, καὶ εὑρήσετε: κρούετε, καὶ ἀνοιγήσεται ὑμῖν.

text_en: For every one that asks receives: and he that seeks finds: and to him that knocks it shall be opened:
text_la: Omnis enim qui petit, accipit : et qui quærit, invenit : et pulsanti aperietur.
text_pt: Porque qualquer que pede recebe; e quem busca acha; e a quem bate abrir-se-lhe-á.
text_el: πᾶς γὰρ ὁ αἰτῶν λαμβάνει, καὶ ὁ ζητῶν εὑρίσκει, καὶ τῷ κρούοντι ἀνοιγήσεται.

text_en: And which of you, if he ask his father bread, will he give him a stone? Or a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?
text_la: Quis autem ex vobis patrem petit panem, numquid lapidem dabit illi? aut piscem, numquid pro pisce serpentem dabit illi?
text_pt: E qual o pai de entre vós que, se o filho lhe pedir pão, lhe dará uma pedra? Ou, também, se lhe pedir peixe, lhe dará por peixe uma serpente?
text_el: τίνα δὲ ἐξ ὑμῶν τὸν πατέρα αἰτήσει ὁ υἱὸς ἰχθύν, μὴ ἀντὶ ἰχθύος ὄφιν αὐτῷ ἐπιδώσει;

text_en: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he reach him a scorpion?
text_la: aut si petierit ovum, numquid porriget illi scorpionem?
text_pt: Ou, também, se lhe pedir um ovo, lhe dará um escorpião?
text_el: ἢ καὶ αἰτήσει ᾠόν, ἐπιδώσει αὐτῷ σκορπίον;

text_en: If you then, being evil , know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father from heaven give the good Spirit to them that ask him?
text_la: Si ergo vos, cum sitis mali, nostis bona data dare filiis vestris : quanto magis Pater vester de cælo dabit spiritum bonum petentibus se?
text_pt: Pois se vós, sendo maus, sabeis dar boas dádivas aos vossos filhos, quanto mais dará o Pai celestial o Espírito Santo àqueles que lho pedirem?
text_el: εἰ οὖν ὑμεῖς πονηροὶ ὑπάρχοντες οἴδατε δόματα ἀγαθὰ διδόναι τοῖς τέκνοις ὑμῶν, πόσῳ μᾶλλον ὁ πατὴρ [ὁ] ἐξ οὐρανοῦ δώσει πνεῦμα ἅγιον τοῖς αἰτοῦσιν αὐτόν.

text_en: And he was casting out a devil : and the same was dumb. And when he had cast out the devil , the dumb spoke: and the multitudes, were in admiration at it.
text_la: Et erat ejiciens dæmonium, et illud erat mutum. Et cum ejecisset dæmonium, locutus est mutus, et admiratæ sunt turbæ.
text_pt: E estava ele expulsando um demônio, o qual era mudo. E aconteceu que, saindo o demônio, o mudo falou; e maravilhou-se a multidão.
text_el: Καὶ ἦν ἐκβάλλων δαιμόνιον, κωφόν: ἐγένετο δὲ τοῦ δαιμονίου ἐξελθόντος ἐλάλησεν ὁ κωφός. καὶ ἐθαύμασαν οἱ ὄχλοι:

text_en: But some of them said: He casts out devils by Beelzebub , the prince of devils .
text_la: Quidam autem ex eis dixerunt: In Beelzebub principe dæmoniorum ejicit dæmonia.
text_pt: Mas alguns deles diziam: Ele expulsa os demônios por Belzebu, príncipe dos demônios.
text_el: τινὲς δὲ ἐξ αὐτῶν εἶπον: ἐν Βεελζεβοὺλ τῷ ἄρχοντι τῶν δαιμονίων ἐκβάλλει τὰ δαιμόνια:

text_en: And others tempting, asked of him a sign from heaven .
text_la: Et alii tentantes, signum de cælo quærebant ab eo.
text_pt: E outros, tentando-o, pediam-lhe um sinal do céu.
text_el: ἕτεροι δὲ πειράζοντες σημεῖον ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἐζήτουν παρ' αὐτοῦ.

text_en: But he seeing their thoughts, said to them: Every kingdom divided against itself shall be brought to desolation; and house upon house shall fall.
text_la: Ipse autem ut vidit cogitationes eorum, dixit eis : Omne regnum in seipsum divisum desolabitur, et domus supra domum cadet.
text_pt: Mas, conhecendo ele os seus pensamentos, disse-lhes: Todo o reino, dividido contra si mesmo, será assolado; e a casa, dividida contra si mesma, cairá.
text_el: αὐτὸς δὲ εἰδὼς αὐτῶν τὰ διανοήματα εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: πᾶσα βασιλεία ἐφ' ἑαυτὴν' διαμερισθεῖσα ἐρημοῦται, καὶ οἶκος ἐπὶ οἶκον πίπτει.

text_en: And if Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? Because you say that through Beelzebub I cast out devils .
text_la: Si autem et Satanas in seipsum divisus est, quomodo stabit regnum ejus? quia dicitis in Beelzebub me ejicere dæmonia.
text_pt: E, se também Satanás está dividido contra si mesmo, como subsistirá o seu reino? Pois dizeis que eu expulso os demônios por Belzebu.
text_el: εἰ δὲ καὶ ὁ Σατανᾶς ἐφ' ἑαυτὸν διεμερίσθη, πῶς σταθήσεται ἡ βασιλεία αὐτοῦ; ὅτι λέγετε ἐν Βεελζεβοὺλ ἐκβάλλειν με τὰ δαιμόνια.

text_en: Now if I cast out devils by Beelzebub , by whom do your children cast them out ? Therefore, they shall be your judges.
text_la: Si autem ego in Beelzebub ejicio dæmonia : filii vestri in quo ejiciunt? ideo ipsi judices vestri erunt.
text_pt: E, se eu expulso os demônios por Belzebu, por quem os expulsam vossos filhos? Eles, pois, serão os vossos juízes.
text_el: εἰ δὲ ἐγὼ ἐν Βεελζεβοὺλ ἐκβάλλω τὰ δαιμόνια, οἱ υἱοὶ ὑμῶν ἐν τίνι ἐκβάλλουσιν; διὰ τοῦτο αὐτοὶ ὑμῶν κριταὶ ἔσονται.

text_en: But if I by the finger of God cast out devils , doubtless the kingdom of God has come upon you.
text_la: Porro si in digito Dei ejicio dæmonia : profecto pervenit in vos regnum Dei.
text_pt: Mas, se eu expulso os demônios pelo dedo de Deus, certamente a vós é chegado o reino de Deus.
text_el: εἰ δὲ ἐν δακτύλῳ θεοῦ ἐγὼ ἐκβάλλω τὰ δαιμόνια, ἄρα ἔφθασεν ἐφ' ὑμᾶς ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: When a strong man armed keeps his court , those things are in peace which he possesses.
text_la: Cum fortis armatus custodit atrium suum, in pace sunt ea quæ possidet.
text_pt: Quando o valente guarda, armado, a sua casa, em segurança está tudo quanto tem;
text_el: Ὅταν ὁ ἰσχυρὸς καθωπλισμένος φυλάσσῃ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ αὐλήν, ἐν εἰρήνῃ ἐστὶν τὰ ὑπάρχοντα αὐτοῦ:

text_en: But if a stronger than he come upon him and overcome him, he will take away all his armour wherein he trusted and will distribute his spoils.
text_la: Si autem fortior eo superveniens vicerit eum, universa arma ejus auferet, in quibus confidebat, et spolia ejus distribuet.
text_pt: Mas, sobrevindo outro mais valente do que ele, e vencendo-o, tira-lhe toda a sua armadura em que confiava, e reparte os seus despojos.
text_el: ἐπὰν δὲ ἰσχυρότερος αὐτοῦ ἐπελθὼν νικήσῃ αὐτόν, τὴν πανοπλίαν αὐτοῦ αἴρει ἐφ' ᾗ ἐπεποίθει, καὶ τὰ σκῦλα αὐτοῦ διαδίδωσιν.

text_en: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathers not with me scatters.
text_la: Qui non est mecum, contra me est : et qui non colligit mecum, dispergit.
text_pt: Quem não é comigo é contra mim; e quem comigo não ajunta, espalha.
text_el: ὁ μὴ ὢν μετ' ἐμοῦ κατ' ἐμοῦ ἐστιν, καὶ ὁ μὴ συνάγων μετ' ἐμοῦ σκορπίζει.

text_en: When the unclean spirit has gone out of a man , he walks through places without water, seeking rest: and not finding, he says: I will return into my house whence I came out.
text_la: Cum immundus spiritus exierit de homine, ambulat per loca inaquosa, quærens requiem : et non inveniens dicit : Revertar in domum meam unde exivi.
text_pt: Quando o espírito imundo tem saído do homem, anda por lugares secos, buscando repouso; e, não o achando, diz: Tornarei para minha casa, de onde saí.
text_el: Ὅταν τὸ ἀκάθαρτον πνεῦμα ἐξέλθῃ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου, διέρχεται δι' ἀνύδρων τόπων ζητοῦν ἀνάπαυσιν, καὶ μὴ εὑρίσκον, [τότε] λέγει: ὑποστρέψω εἰς τὸν οἶκόν μου ὅθεν ἐξῆλθον:

text_en: And when he has come, he finds it swept and garnished.
text_la: Et cum venerit, invenit eam scopis mundatam, et ornatam.
text_pt: E, chegando, acha-a varrida e adornada.
text_el: καὶ ἐλθὸν εὑρίσκει [σχολάζοντα] σεσαρωμένον καὶ κεκοσμημένον.

text_en: Then he goes and takes with him seven other spirits more wicked than himself: and entering in they dwell there. And the last state of that man becomes worse than the first.
text_la: Tunc vadit, et assumit septem alios spiritus secum, nequiores se, et ingressi habitant ibi. Et fiunt novissima hominis illius pejora prioribus.
text_pt: Então vai, e leva consigo outros sete espíritos piores do que ele e, entrando, habitam ali; e o último estado desse homem é pior do que o primeiro.
text_el: τότε πορεύεται καὶ παραλαμβάνει ἕτερα πνεύματα πονηρότερα ἑαυτοῦ ἑπτά, καὶ εἰσελθόντα κατοικεῖ ἐκεῖ, καὶ γίνεται τὰ ἔσχατα τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐκείνου χείρονα τῶν πρώτων.

text_en: And it came to pass, as he spoke these things, a certain woman from the crowd, lifting up her voice, said to him: Blessed is the womb that bore you and the paps that gave you suck.
text_la: Factum est autem, cum hæc diceret : extollens vocem quædam mulier de turba dixit illi : Beatus venter qui te portavit, et ubera quæ suxisti.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, dizendo ele estas coisas, uma mulher dentre a multidão, levantando a voz, lhe disse: Bem-aventurado o ventre que te trouxe e os peitos em que mamaste.
text_el: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ λέγειν αὐτὸν ταῦτα ἐπάρασά τις φωνὴν γυνὴ ἐκ τοῦ ὄχλου εἶπεν αὐτῷ: μακαρία ἡ κοιλία ἡ βαστάσασά σε καὶ μαστοὶ οὓς ἐθήλασας.

text_en: But he said: Yea rather, blessed are they who hear the word of God and keep it.
text_la: At ille dixit : Quinimmo beati, qui audiunt verbum Dei et custodiunt illud.
text_pt: Mas ele disse: Antes bemaventurados os que ouvem a palavra de Deus e a guardam.
text_el: αὐτὸς δὲ εἶπεν: μενοῦν μακάριοι οἱ ἀκούοντες τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ φυλάσσοντες.

text_en: And the multitudes running together, he began to say: This generation is a wicked generation . It asks a sign: and a sign shall not be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet .
text_la: Turbis autem concurrentibus cœpit dicere : Generatio hæc, generatio nequam est : signum quærit, et signum non dabitur ei, nisi signum Jonæ prophetæ.
text_pt: E, ajuntando-se a multidão, começou a dizer: Maligna é esta geração; ela pede um sinal; e não lhe será dado outro sinal, senão o sinal do profeta Jonas;
text_el: Τῶν δὲ ὄχλων ἐπαθροιζομένων ἤρξατο λέγειν: ἡ γενεὰ αὕτη γενεὰ πονηρά ἐστιν: σημεῖον ζητεῖ, καὶ σημεῖον οὐ δοθήσεται αὐτῇ εἰ μὴ τὸ σημεῖον Ἰωνᾶ.

text_en: For as Jonas was a sign to the Ninivites; so shall the Son of man also be to this generation .
text_la: Nam sicut fuit Jonas signum Ninivitis, ita erit et Filius hominis generationi isti.
text_pt: Porquanto, assim como Jonas foi sinal para os ninivitas, assim o Filho do homem o será também para esta geração.
text_el: καθὼς γὰρ ἐγένετο [ὁ] Ἰωνᾶς τοῖς Νινευίταις σημεῖον, οὕτως ἔσται καὶ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τῇ γενεᾷ ταύτῃ.

text_en: The queen of the south shall rise in the judgment with the men of this generation and shall condemn them: because she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon . And behold more than Solomon here.
text_la: Regina austri surget in judicio cum viris generationis hujus, et condemnabit illos : quia venit a finibus terræ audire sapientiam Salomonis : et ecce plus quam Salomon hic.
text_pt: A rainha do sul se levantará no juízo com os homens desta geração, e os condenará; pois até dos confins da terra veio ouvir a sabedoria de Salomão; e eis aqui está quem é maior do que Salomão.
text_el: βασίλισσα νότου ἐγερθήσεται ἐν τῇ κρίσει μετὰ τῶν ἀνδρῶν τῆς γενεᾶς ταύτης καὶ κατακρινεῖ αὐτούς: ὅτι ἦλθεν ἐκ τῶν περάτων τῆς γῆς ἀκοῦσαι τὴν σοφίαν Σολομῶνος, καὶ ἰδοὺ πλεῖον Σολομῶνος ὧδε.

text_en: The men of Ninive shall rise in the judgment with this generation and shall condemn it; Because they did penance at the preaching of Jonas. And behold more than Jonas here.
text_la: Viri Ninivitæ surgent in judicio cum generatione hac, et condemnabunt illam : quia pœnitentiam egerunt ad prædicationem Jonæ, et ecce plus quam Jonas hic.
text_pt: Os homens de Nínive se levantarão no juízo com esta geração, e a condenarão; pois se converteram com a pregação de Jonas; e eis aqui está quem é maior do que Jonas.
text_el: ἄνδρες Νινευῖται ἀναστήσονται ἐν τῇ κρίσει μετὰ τῆς γενεᾶς ταύτης καὶ κατακρινοῦσιν αὐτήν: ὅτι μετενόησαν εἰς τὸ κήρυγμα Ἰωνᾶ, καὶ ἰδοὺ πλεῖον Ἰωνᾶ ὧδε.

text_en: No man lights a candle and puts it in a hidden place, nor under a bushel: but upon a candlestick, that they that come in may see the light.
text_la: Nemo lucernam accendit, et in abscondito ponit, neque sub modio : sed supra candelabrum, ut qui ingrediuntur, lumen videant.
text_pt: E ninguém, acendendo uma candeia, a põe em oculto, nem debaixo do alqueire, mas no velador, para que os que entram vejam a luz.
text_el: Οὐδεὶς λύχνον ἅψας εἰς κρύπτην τίθησιν οὐδὲ ὑπὸ τὸν μόδιον, ἀλλ' ἐπὶ τὴν λυχνίαν, ἵνα οἱ εἰσπορευόμενοι τὸ φῶς βλέπωσιν.

text_en: The light of your body is your eye. If your eye be single, your whole body will be lightsome: but if it be evil , your body also will be darksome.
text_la: Lucerna corporis tui est oculus tuus. Si oculus tuus fuerit simplex, totum corpus tuum lucidum erit : si autem nequam fuerit, etiam corpus tuum tenebrosum erit.
text_pt: A candeia do corpo é o olho. Sendo, pois, o teu olho simples, também todo o teu corpo será luminoso; mas, se for mau, também o teu corpo será tenebroso.
text_el: ὁ λύχνος τοῦ σώματός ἐστιν ὁ ὀφθαλμός σου. ὅταν ὁ ὀφθαλμός σου ἁπλοῦς ᾖ, καὶ ὅλον τὸ σῶμά σου φωτεινόν ἐστιν: ἐπὰν δὲ πονηρὸς ᾖ, καὶ τὸ σῶμά σου σκοτεινόν.

text_en: Take heed therefore that the light which is in you be not darkness.
text_la: Vide ergo ne lumen quod in te est, tenebræ sint.
text_pt: Vê, pois, que a luz que em ti há não sejam trevas.
text_el: σκόπει οὖν μὴ τὸ φῶς τὸ ἐν σοὶ σκότος ἐστίν.

text_en: If then your whole body be lightsome, having no part of darkness: the whole shall be lightsome and, as a bright lamp, shall enlighten you.
text_la: Si ergo corpus tuum totum lucidum fuerit, non habens aliquam partem tenebrarum, erit lucidum totum, et sicut lucerna fulgoris illuminabit te.
text_pt: Se, pois, todo o teu corpo é luminoso, não tendo em trevas parte alguma, todo será luminoso, como quando a candeia te ilumina com o seu resplendor.
text_el: εἰ οὖν τὸ σῶμά σου ὅλον φωτεινόν, μὴ ἔχον μέρος τι σκοτεινόν, ἔσται φωτεινὸν ὅλον ὡς ὅταν ὁ λύχνος τῇ ἀστραπῇ φωτίζῃ σε.

text_en: And as he was speaking, a certain Pharisee prayed him that he would dine with him. And he going in, sat down to eat.
text_la: Et cum loqueretur, rogavit illum quidam pharisæus ut pranderet apud se. Et ingressus recubuit.
text_pt: E, estando ele ainda falando, rogou-lhe um fariseu que fosse jantar com ele; e, entrando, assentou-se à mesa.
text_el: Ἐν δὲ τῷ λαλῆσαι ἐρωτᾷ αὐτὸν Φαρισαῖος ὅπως ἀριστήσῃ παρ' αὐτῷ: εἰσελθὼν δὲ ἀνέπεσεν.

text_en: And the Pharisee began to say, thinking within himself, why he was not washed before dinner.
text_la: Pharisæus autem cœpit intra se reputans dicere, quare non baptizatus esset ante prandium.
text_pt: Mas o fariseu admirou-se, vendo que não se lavara antes de jantar.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Φαρισαῖος ἰδὼν ἐθαύμασεν ὅτι οὐ πρῶτον ἐβαπτίσθη πρὸ τοῦ ἀρίστου.

text_en: And the Lord said to him: Now you, Pharisees , make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter: but your inside is full of rapine and iniquity .
text_la: Et ait Dominus ad illum : Nunc vos pharisæi, quod deforis est calicis et catini, mundatis : quod autem intus est vestrum, plenum est rapina et iniquitate.
text_pt: E o Senhor lhe disse: Agora vós, os fariseus, limpais o exterior do copo e do prato; mas o vosso interior está cheio de rapina e maldade.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ κύριος πρὸς αὐτόν: νῦν ὑμεῖς οἱ Φαρισαῖοι τὸ ἔξωθεν τοῦ ποτηρίου καὶ τοῦ πίνακος καθαρίζετε, τὸ δὲ ἔσωθεν ὑμῶν γέμει ἁρπαγῆς καὶ πονηρίας.

text_en: You fools, did not he that made that which is without make also that which is within?
text_la: Stulti! nonne qui fecit quod deforis est, etiam id quod deintus est fecit?
text_pt: Loucos! Quem fez o exterior não fez também o interior?
text_el: ἄφρονες, οὐχ ὁ ποιήσας τὸ ἔξωθεν καὶ τὸ ἔσωθεν ἐποίησεν;

text_en: But yet that which remains, give alms : and behold, all things are clean unto you.
text_la: Verumtamen quod superest, date eleemosynam : et ecce omnia munda sunt vobis.
text_pt: Antes dai esmola do que tiverdes, e eis que tudo vos será limpo.
text_el: πλὴν τὰ ἐνόντα δότε ἐλεημοσύνην, καὶ ἰδοὺ πάντα καθαρὰ ὑμῖν ἐστιν.

text_en: But woe to you, Pharisees , because you tithe mint and rue and every herb and pass over judgment and the charity of God . Now these things you ought to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
text_la: Sed væ vobis, pharisæis, quia decimatis mentham, et rutam, et omne olus, et præteritis judicium et caritatem Dei : hæc autem oportuit facere, et illa non omittere.
text_pt: Mas ai de vós, fariseus, que dizimais a hortelã, e a arruda, e toda a hortaliça, e desprezais o juízo e o amor de Deus. Importava fazer estas coisas, e não deixar as outras.
text_el: ἀλλὰ οὐαὶ ὑμῖν τοῖς Φαρισαίοις, ὅτι ἀποδεκατοῦτε τὸ ἡδύοσμον καὶ τὸ πήγανον καὶ πᾶν λάχανον, καὶ παρέρχεσθε τὴν κρίσιν καὶ τὴν ἀγάπην τοῦ θεοῦ: ταῦτα δὲ ἔδει ποιῆσαι κἀκεῖνα μὴ παρεῖναι.

text_en: Woe to you, Pharisees , because you love the uppermost seats in the synagogues and salutations in the marketplace.
text_la: Væ vobis, pharisæis, quia diligitis primas cathedras in synagogis, et salutationes in foro.
text_pt: Ai de vós, fariseus, que amais os primeiros assentos nas sinagogas, e as saudações nas praças.
text_el: οὐαὶ ὑμῖν τοῖς Φαρισαίοις, ὅτι ἀγαπᾶτε τὴν πρωτοκαθεδρίαν ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς καὶ τοὺς ἀσπασμοὺς ἐν ταῖς ἀγοραῖς.

text_en: Woe to you, because you are as sepulchres that appear not: and men that walk over are not aware.
text_la: Væ vobis, quia estis ut monumenta, quæ non apparent, et homines ambulantes supra, nesciunt.
text_pt: Ai de vós, escribas e fariseus, hipócritas! que sois como as sepulturas que não aparecem, e os homens que sobre elas andam não o sabem.
text_el: οὐαὶ ὑμῖν, ὅτι ἐστὲ ὡς τὰ μνημεῖα τὰ ἄδηλα, καὶ οἱ ἄνθρωποι οἱ περιπατοῦντες ἐπάνω οὐκ οἴδασιν.

text_en: And one of the lawyers answering, said to him: Master, in saying these things, you reproach us also.
text_la: Respondens autem quidam ex legisperitis, ait illi : Magister, hæc dicens etiam contumeliam nobis facis.
text_pt: E, respondendo um dos doutores da lei, disse-lhe: Mestre, quando dizes isso, também nos afrontas a nós.
text_el: Ἀποκριθεὶς δέ τις τῶν νομικῶν λέγει αὐτῷ: διδάσκαλε, ταῦτα λέγων καὶ ἡμᾶς ὑβρίζεις.

text_en: But he said: Woe to you lawyers also, because you load men with burdens which they cannot bear and you yourselves touch not the packs with one of your fingers.
text_la: At ille ait : Et vobis legisperitis væ : quia oneratis homines oneribus, quæ portare non possunt, et ipsi uno digito vestro non tangitis sarcinas.
text_pt: E ele lhe disse: Ai de vós também, doutores da lei, que carregais os homens com cargas difíceis de transportar, e vós mesmos nem ainda com um dos vossos dedos tocais essas cargas.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν: καὶ ὑμῖν τοῖς νομικοῖς οὐαί, ὅτι φορτίζετε τοὺς ἀνθρώπους φορτία δυσβάστακτα, καὶ αὐτοὶ ἑνὶ τῶν δακτύλων ὑμῶν οὐ προσψαύετε τοῖς φορτίοις.

text_en: Woe to you who build the monuments of the prophets : and your fathers killed them.
text_la: Væ vobis, qui ædificatis monumenta prophetarum : patres autem vestri occiderunt illos.
text_pt: Ai de vós que edificais os sepulcros dos profetas, e vossos pais os mataram.
text_el: οὐαὶ ὑμῖν, ὅτι οἰκοδομεῖτε τὰ μνημεῖα τῶν προφητῶν, οἱ δὲ πατέρες ὑμῶν ἀπέκτειναν αὐτούς.

text_en: Truly you bear witness that you consent to the doings of your fathers. For they indeed killed them: and you build their sepulchres.
text_la: Profecto testificamini quod consentitis operibus patrum vestrorum : quoniam ipsi quidem eos occiderunt, vos autem ædificatis eorum sepulchra.
text_pt: Bem testificais, pois, que consentis nas obras de vossos pais; porque eles os mataram, e vós edificais os seus sepulcros.
text_el: ἄρα μάρτυρές ἐστε καὶ συνευδοκεῖτε τοῖς ἔργοις τῶν πατέρων ὑμῶν, ὅτι αὐτοὶ μὲν ἀπέκτειναν αὐτοὺς ὑμεῖς δὲ οἰκοδομεῖτε.

text_en: For this cause also the wisdom of God said: I will send to them prophets and apostles : and some of them they will kill and persecute.
text_la: Propterea et sapientia Dei dixit : Mittam ad illos prophetas, et apostolos, et ex illis occident, et persequentur:
text_pt: Por isso diz também a sabedoria de Deus: Profetas e apóstolos lhes mandarei; e eles matarão uns, e perseguirão outros;
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο καὶ ἡ σοφία τοῦ θεοῦ εἶπεν: ἀποστελῶ εἰς αὐτοὺς προφήτας καὶ ἀποστόλους, καὶ ἐξ αὐτῶν ἀποκτενοῦσιν καὶ διώξουσιν,

text_en: That the blood of all the prophets which was shed from the foundation of the world may be required of this generation ,
text_la: ut inquiratur sanguis omnium prophetarum, qui effusus est a constitutione mundi a generatione ista,
text_pt: Para que desta geração seja requerido o sangue de todos os profetas que, desde a fundação do mundo, foi derramado;
text_el: ἵνα ἐκζητηθῇ τὸ αἷμα πάντων τῶν προφητῶν τὸ ἐκκεχυμένον ἀπὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου ἀπὸ τῆς γενεᾶς ταύτης,

text_en: from the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias, who was slain between the altar and the temple . Yea I say to you: It shall be required of this generation .
text_la: a sanguine Abel, usque ad sanguinem Zachariæ, qui periit inter altare et ædem. Ita dico vobis, requiretur ab hac generatione.
text_pt: Desde o sangue de Abel, até ao sangue de Zacarias, que foi morto entre o altar e o templo; assim, vos digo, será requerido desta geração.
text_el: ἀπὸ αἵματος Ἅβελ ἕως αἵματος Ζαχαρίου τοῦ ἀπολομένου μεταξὺ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου καὶ τοῦ οἴκου: ναί λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐκζητηθήσεται ἀπὸ τῆς γενεᾶς ταύτης.

text_en: Woe to you lawyers, for you have taken away the key of knowledge . You yourselves have not entered in: and those that were entering in, you have hindered.
text_la: Væ vobis, legisperitis, quia tulistis clavem scientiæ : ipsi non introistis, et eos qui introibant, prohibuistis.
text_pt: Ai de vós, doutores da lei, que tirastes a chave da ciência; vós mesmos não entrastes, e impedistes os que entravam.
text_el: οὐαὶ ὑμῖν τοῖς νομικοῖς, ὅτι ἤρατε τὴν κλεῖδα τῆς γνώσεως: αὐτοὶ οὐκ εἰσήλθατε καὶ τοὺς εἰσερχομένους ἐκωλύσατε.

text_en: And as he was saying these things to them, the Pharisees and the lawyers began violently to urge him and to oppress his mouth about many things,
text_la: Cum autem hæc ad illos diceret, cœperunt pharisæi et legisperiti graviter insistere, et os ejus opprimere de multis,
text_pt: E, dizendo-lhes ele isto, começaram os escribas e os fariseus a apertá-lo fortemente, e a fazê-lo falar acerca de muitas coisas,
text_el: Κἀκεῖθεν ἐξελθόντος αὐτοῦ ἤρξαντο οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι δεινῶς ἐνέχειν καὶ ἀποστοματίζειν αὐτὸν περὶ πλειόνων,

text_en: lying in wait for him and seeking to catch something from his mouth, that they might accuse him.
text_la: insidiantes ei, et quærentes aliquid capere de ore ejus, ut accusarent eum.
text_pt: Armando-lhe ciladas, e procurando apanhar da sua boca alguma coisa para o acusarem.
text_el: ἐνεδρεύοντες, αὐτὸν θηρεῦσαί τι ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And when great multitudes stood about him, so that they trod one upon another, he began to say to his disciples : Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees , which is hypocrisy .
text_la: Multis autem turbis circumstantibus, ita ut se invicem conculcarent, cœpit dicere ad discipulos suos : Attendite a fermento pharisæorum, quod est hypocrisis.
text_pt: Ajuntando-se entretanto muitos milhares de pessoas, de sorte que se atropelavam uns aos outros, começou a dizer aos seus discípulos: Acautelai-vos primeiramente do fermento dos fariseus, que é a hipocrisia.
text_el: Ἐν οἷς ἐπισυναχθεισῶν τῶν μυριάδων τοῦ ὄχλου, ὥστε καταπατεῖν ἀλλήλους, ἤρξατο λέγειν πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ πρῶτον: προσέχετε ἑαυτοῖς ἀπὸ τῆς ζύμης ἥτις ἐστὶν, ὑπόκρισις τῶν Φαρισαίων.

text_en: For there is nothing covered that shall not be revealed: nor hidden that shall not be known .
text_la: Nihil autem opertum est, quod non reveletur : neque absconditum, quod non sciatur.
text_pt: Mas nada há encoberto que não haja de ser descoberto; nem oculto, que não haja de ser sabido.
text_el: οὐδὲν δὲ συγκεκαλυμμένον ἐστὶν ὃ οὐκ ἀποκαλυφθήσεται, καὶ κρυπτὸν ὃ οὐ γνωσθήσεται.

text_en: For whatsoever things you have spoken in darkness shall be published in the light: and that which you have spoken in the ear in the chambers shall be preached on the housetops.
text_la: Quoniam quæ in tenebris dixistis, in lumine dicentur : et quod in aurem locuti estis in cubiculis, prædicabitur in tectis.
text_pt: Porquanto tudo o que em trevas dissestes, à luz será ouvido; e o que falastes ao ouvido no gabinete, sobre os telhados será apregoado.
text_el: ἀνθ' ὧν ὅσα ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ εἴπατε, ἐν τῷ φωτὶ ἀκουσθήσεται, καὶ ὃ πρὸς τὸ οὖς ἐλαλήσατε ἐν τοῖς ταμείοις, κηρυχθήσεται ἐπὶ τῶν δωμάτων.

text_en: And I say to you, my friends: Be not afraid of them who kill the body and after that have no more that they can do.
text_la: Dico autem vobis amicis meis : Ne terreamini ab his qui occidunt corpus, et post hæc non habent amplius quid faciant.
text_pt: E digo-vos, amigos meus: Não temais os que matam o corpo e, depois, não têm mais que fazer.
text_el: Λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν τοῖς φίλοις μου, μὴ φοβηθῆτε ἀπὸ τῶν ἀποκτεινόντων τὸ σῶμα καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα μὴ ἐχόντων περισσότερόν τι ποιῆσαι.

text_en: But I will show you whom you shall fear: Fear him who, after he has killed, has power to cast into hell . Yea, I say to you: Fear him.
text_la: Ostendam autem vobis quem timeatis : timete eum qui, postquam occiderit, habet potestatem mittere in gehennam : ita dico vobis, hunc timete.
text_pt: Mas eu vos mostrarei a quem deveis temer; temei aquele que, depois de matar, tem poder para lançar no inferno; sim, vos digo, a esse temei.
text_el: ὑποδείξω δὲ ὑμῖν τίνα φοβηθῆτε: φοβήθητε τὸν μετὰ τὸ ἀποκτεῖναι ἔχοντα ἐξουσίαν ἐμβαλεῖν εἰς τὴν γέενναν: ναί λέγω ὑμῖν, τοῦτον φοβήθητε.

text_en: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God ?
text_la: Nonne quinque passeres veneunt dipondio, et unus ex illis non est in oblivione coram Deo?
text_pt: Não se vendem cinco passarinhos por dois ceitis? E nenhum deles está esquecido diante de Deus.
text_el: οὐχὶ πέντε στρουθία πωλοῦνται ἀσσαρίων δύο; καὶ ἓν ἐξ αὐτῶν οὐκ ἔστιν ἐπιλελησμένον ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: Yea, the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: you are of more value than many sparrows.
text_la: sed et capilli capitis vestri omnes numerati sunt. Nolite ergo timere : multis passeribus pluris estis vos.
text_pt: E até os cabelos da vossa cabeça estão todos contados. Não temais pois; mais valeis vós do que muitos passarinhos.
text_el: ἀλλὰ καὶ αἱ τρίχες τῆς κεφαλῆς ὑμῶν πᾶσαι ἠρίθμηνται. μὴ φοβεῖσθε: πολλῶν στρουθίων διαφέρετε.

text_en: And I say to you: Whosoever shall confess me before men , him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God .
text_la: Dico autem vobis : Omnis quicumque confessus fuerit me coram hominibus, et Filius hominis confitebitur illum coram angelis Dei:
text_pt: E digo-vos que todo aquele que me confessar diante dos homens também o Filho do homem o confessará diante dos anjos de Deus.
text_el: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν, πᾶς ὃς ἂν ὁμολογήσει ἐν ἐμοὶ ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ἀνθρώπων, καὶ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ὁμολογήσει ἐν αὐτῷ ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ἀγγέλων τοῦ θεοῦ:

text_en: But he that shall deny me before men shall be denied before the angels of God .
text_la: qui autem negaverit me coram hominibus, negabitur coram angelis Dei.
text_pt: Mas quem me negar diante dos homens será negado diante dos anjos de Deus.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀρνησάμενός με ἐνώπιον τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἀπαρνηθήσεται ἐνώπιον τῶν ἀγγέλων τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: And whosoever speaks a word against the Son of man , it shall be forgiven him: but to him that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost , it shall not be forgiven.
text_la: Et omnis qui dicit verbum in Filium hominis, remittetur illi : ei autem qui in Spiritum Sanctum blasphemaverit, non remittetur.
text_pt: E a todo aquele que disser uma palavra contra o Filho do homem ser-lhe-á perdoada, mas ao que blasfemar contra o Espírito Santo não lhe será perdoado.
text_el: καὶ πᾶς ὃς ἐρεῖ λόγον εἰς τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου, ἀφεθήσεται αὐτῷ: τῷ δὲ εἰς τὸ ἅγιον πνεῦμα βλασφημήσαντι οὐκ ἀφεθήσεται.

text_en: And when they shall bring you into the synagogues and to magistrates and powers, be not solicitous how or what you shall answer, or what you shall say.
text_la: Cum autem inducent vos in synagogas, et ad magistratus, et potestates, nolite solliciti esse qualiter, aut quid respondeatis, aut quid dicatis.
text_pt: E, quando vos conduzirem às sinagogas, aos magistrados e potestades, não estejais solícitos de como ou do que haveis de responder, nem do que haveis de dizer.
text_el: ὅταν δὲ εἰσφέρωσιν ὑμᾶς ἐπὶ τὰς συναγωγὰς καὶ τὰς ἀρχὰς καὶ τὰς ἐξουσίας, μὴ μεριμνήσητε πῶς [ἢ τί] ἀπολογήσησθε ἢ τί εἴπητε:

text_en: For the Holy Ghost shall teach you in the same hour what you must say.
text_la: Spiritus enim Sanctus docebit vos in ipsa hora quid oporteat vos dicere.
text_pt: Porque na mesma hora vos ensinará o Espírito Santo o que vos convenha falar.
text_el: τὸ γὰρ ἅγιον πνεῦμα διδάξει ὑμᾶς ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ ἃ δεῖ εἰπεῖν.

text_en: And one of the multitude said to him: Master, speak to my brother that he divide the inheritance with me.
text_la: Ait autem ei quidam de turba : Magister, dic fratri meo ut dividat mecum hæreditatem.
text_pt: E disse-lhe um da multidão: Mestre, dize a meu irmão que reparta comigo a herança.
text_el: Εἶπεν δέ τις ἐκ τοῦ ὄχλου αὐτῷ: διδάσκαλε, εἰπὲ τῷ ἀδελφῷ μου μερίσασθαι μετ' ἐμοῦ τὴν κληρονομίαν.

text_en: But he said to him: Man, who has appointed me judge or divider over you?
text_la: At ille dixit illi : Homo, quis me constituit judicem, aut divisorem super vos?
text_pt: Mas ele lhe disse: Homem, quem me pôs a mim por juiz ou repartidor entre vós?
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῷ: ἄνθρωπε, τίς με κατέστησεν κριτὴν ἢ μεριστὴν ἐφ' ὑμᾶς;

text_en: And he said to them: Take heed and beware of all covetousness : for a man's life does not consist in the abundance of things which he possesses.
text_la: Dixitque ad illos : Videte, et cavete ab omni avaritia : quia non in abundantia cujusquam vita ejus est ex his quæ possidet.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Acautelai-vos e guardai-vos da avareza; porque a vida de qualquer não consiste na abundância do que possui.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτούς: ὁρᾶτε καὶ φυλάσσεσθε ἀπὸ πάσης πλεονεξίας, ὅτι οὐκ ἐν τῷ περισσεύειν τινὶ ἡ ζωὴ αὐτοῦ ἐστιν ἐκ τῶν ὑπαρχόντων αὐτῷ.

text_en: And he spoke a similitude to them, saying: The land of a certain rich man brought forth plenty of fruits.
text_la: Dixit autem similitudinem ad illos, dicens : Hominis cujusdam divitis uberes fructus ager attulit:
text_pt: E propôs-lhe uma parábola, dizendo: A herdade de um homem rico tinha produzido com abundância;
text_el: Εἶπεν δὲ παραβολὴν πρὸς αὐτοὺς λέγων: ἀνθρώπου τινὸς πλουσίου εὐφόρησεν ἡ χώρα.

text_en: And he thought within himself, saying: What shall I do, because I have no room where to bestow my fruits?
text_la: et cogitabat intra se dicens : Quid faciam, quia non habeo quo congregem fructus meos?
text_pt: E arrazoava ele entre si, dizendo: Que farei? Não tenho onde recolher os meus frutos.
text_el: καὶ διελογίζετο ἐν ἑαυτῷ λέγων: τί ποιήσω, ὅτι οὐκ ἔχω ποῦ συνάξω τοὺς καρπούς μου;

text_en: And he said: This will I do: I will pull down my barns and will build greater: and into them will I gather all things that are grown to me and my goods.
text_la: Et dixit : Hoc faciam : destruam horrea mea, et majora faciam : et illuc congregabo omnia quæ nata sunt mihi, et bona mea,
text_pt: E disse: Farei isto: Derrubarei os meus celeiros, e edificarei outros maiores, e ali recolherei todas as minhas novidades e os meus bens;
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν: τοῦτο ποιήσω: καθελῶ μου τὰς ἀποθήκας καὶ μείζονας οἰκοδομήσω, καὶ συνάξω ἐκεῖ πάντα τὸν σῖτον καὶ τὰ ἀγαθά μου,

text_en: And I will say to my soul : Soul, you have much goods laid up for many years. Take your rest: eat, drink, make good cheer.
text_la: et dicam animæ meæ : Anima, habes multa bona posita in annos plurimos : requiesce, comede, bibe, epulare.
text_pt: E direi a minha alma: Alma, tens em depósito muitos bens para muitos anos; descansa, come, bebe e folga.
text_el: καὶ ἐρῶ τῇ ψυχῇ μου: ψυχή, ἔχεις πολλὰ ἀγαθὰ [κείμενα εἰς ἔτη πολλά: ἀναπαύου, φάγε, πίε], εὐφραίνου.

text_en: But God said to him: You fool, this night do they require your soul of you. And whose shall those things be which you have provided?
text_la: Dixit autem illi Deus : Stulte, hac nocte animam tuam repetunt a te : quæ autem parasti, cujus erunt?
text_pt: Mas Deus lhe disse: Louco! esta noite te pedirão a tua alma; e o que tens preparado, para quem será?
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ θεός: ἄφρων, ταύτῃ τῇ νυκτὶ τὴν ψυχήν σου αἰτοῦσιν ἀπὸ σοῦ: ἃ δὲ ἡτοίμασας, τίνι ἔσται;

text_en: So is he that lays up treasure for himself and is not rich towards God .
text_la: Sic est qui sibi thesaurizat, et non est in Deum dives.
text_pt: Assim é aquele que para si ajunta tesouros, e não é rico para com Deus.
text_el: [οὕτως ὁ θησαυρίζων ἑαυτῷ καὶ μὴ εἰς θεὸν πλουτῶν].

text_en: And he said to his disciples : Therefore I say to you: Be not solicitous for your life, what you shall eat, nor for your body, what you shall put on.
text_la: Dixitque ad discipulos suos : Ideo dico vobis, nolite solliciti esse animæ vestræ quid manducetis, neque corpori quid induamini.
text_pt: E disse aos seus discípulos: Portanto vos digo: Não estejais apreensivos pela vossa vida, sobre o que comereis, nem pelo corpo, sobre o que vestireis.
text_el: Εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς τοὺς μαθητάς [αὐτοῦ]: διὰ τοῦτο λέγω ὑμῖν, μὴ μεριμνᾶτε τῇ ψυχῇ τί φάγητε, μηδὲ τῷ σώματι [ὑμῶν] τί ἐνδύσησθε.

text_en: The life is more than the meat: and the body is more than the raiment.
text_la: Anima plus est quam esca, et corpus plus quam vestimentum.
text_pt: Mais é a vida do que o sustento, e o corpo mais do que as vestes.
text_el: ἡ γὰρ ψυχὴ πλεῖόν ἐστιν τῆς τροφῆς καὶ τὸ σῶμα τοῦ ἐνδύματος.

text_en: Consider the ravens, for they sow not, neither do they reap, neither have they storehouse nor barn, and God feeds them. How much are you more valuable than they?
text_la: Considerate corvos, quia non seminant, neque metunt, quibus non est cellarium, neque horreum, et Deus pascit illos. Quanto magis vos pluris estis illis?
text_pt: Considerai os corvos, que nem semeiam, nem segam, nem têm despensa nem celeiro, e Deus os alimenta; quanto mais valeis vós do que as aves?
text_el: κατανοήσατε τοὺς κόρακας, ὅτι οὐ σπείρουσιν οὐδὲ θερίζουσιν, οἷς οὐκ ἔστιν ταμεῖον οὐδὲ ἀποθήκη, καὶ ὁ θεὸς τρέφει αὐτούς: πόσῳ μᾶλλον ὑμεῖς διαφέρετε τῶν πετεινῶν.

text_en: And which of you by taking thought can add to his stature one cubit?
text_la: Quis autem vestrum cogitando potest adjicere ad staturam suam cubitum unum?
text_pt: E qual de vós, sendo solícito, pode acrescentar um côvado à sua estatura?
text_el: τίς δὲ ἐξ ὑμῶν μεριμνῶν δύναται ἐπὶ τὴν ἡλικίαν αὐτοῦ προσθεῖναι πῆχυν;

text_en: If then you be not able to do so much as the least thing, why are you solicitous for the rest?
text_la: Si ergo neque quod minimum est potestis, quid de ceteris solliciti estis?
text_pt: Pois, se nem ainda podeis as coisas mínimas, por que estais ansiosos pelas outras?
text_el: εἰ οὖν οὐδὲ ἐλάχιστον δύνασθε, τί περὶ τῶν λοιπῶν μεριμνᾶτε;

text_en: Consider the lilies, how they grow: they labour not, neither do they spin. But I say to you, not even Solomon in all his glory was clothed like one of these.
text_la: Considerate lilia quomodo crescunt : non laborant, neque nent : dico autem vobis, nec Salomon in omni gloria sua vestiebatur sicut unum ex istis.
text_pt: Considerai os lírios, como eles crescem; não trabalham, nem fiam; e digo-vos que nem ainda Salomão, em toda a sua glória, se vestiu como um deles.
text_el: κατανοήσατε τὰ κρίνα, πῶς αὐξάνει οὐ κοπιᾷ οὐδὲ νήθει: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν, οὐδὲ Σολομὼν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ δόξῃ αὐτοῦ περιεβάλετο ὡς ἓν τούτων.

text_en: Now, if God clothe in this manner the grass that is today in the field and tomorrow is cast into the oven: how much more you, O you of little faith ?
text_la: Si autem fœnum, quod hodie est in agro, et cras in clibanum mittitur, Deus sic vestit : quanto magis vos pusillæ fidei?
text_pt: E, se Deus assim veste a erva que hoje está no campo e amanhã é lançada no forno, quanto mais a vós, homens de pouca fé?
text_el: εἰ δὲ ἐν ἀγρῷ τὸν χόρτον ὄντα σήμερον καὶ αὔριον εἰς κλίβανον βαλλόμενον ὁ θεὸς οὕτως ἀμφιέζει, πόσῳ μᾶλλον ὑμᾶς, ὀλιγόπιστοι.

text_en: And seek not what you shall eat or what you shall drink: and be not lifted up on high.
text_la: Et vos nolite quærere quid manducetis, aut quid bibatis : et nolite in sublime tolli:
text_pt: Não pergunteis, pois, que haveis de comer, ou que haveis de beber, e não andeis inquietos.
text_el: καὶ ὑμεῖς μὴ ζητεῖτε τί φάγητε καὶ τί πίητε, καὶ μὴ μετεωρίζεσθε:

text_en: For all these things do the nations of the world seek. But your Father knows that you have need of these things.
text_la: hæc enim omnia gentes mundi quærunt. Pater autem vester scit quoniam his indigetis.
text_pt: Porque as nações do mundo buscam todas essas coisas; mas vosso Pai sabe que precisais delas.
text_el: ταῦτα γὰρ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη τοῦ κόσμου ἐπιζητοῦσιν: ὑμῶν δὲ ὁ πατὴρ οἶδεν ὅτι χρῄζετε τούτων.

text_en: But seek first the kingdom of God and his justice : and all these things shall be added unto you.
text_la: Verumtamen quærite primum regnum Dei, et justitiam ejus : et hæc omnia adjicientur vobis.
text_pt: Buscai antes o reino de Deus, e todas estas coisas vos serão acrescentadas.
text_el: πλὴν ζητεῖτε τὴν βασιλείαν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ταῦτα προστεθήσεται ὑμῖν.

text_en: Fear not, little flock, for it has pleased your Father to give you a kingdom.
text_la: Nolite timere pusillus grex, quia complacuit Patri vestro dare vobis regnum.
text_pt: Não temais, ó pequeno rebanho, porque a vosso Pai agradou dar-vos o reino.
text_el: Μὴ φοβοῦ, τὸ μικρὸν ποίμνιον: ὅτι εὐδόκησεν ὁ πατὴρ ὑμῶν δοῦναι ὑμῖν τὴν βασιλείαν.

text_en: Sell what you possess and give alms . Make to yourselves bags which grow not old, a treasure in heaven which fails not: where no thief approaches, nor moth corrupts.
text_la: Vendite quæ possidetis, et date eleemosynam. Facite vobis sacculos, qui non veterascunt, thesaurum non deficientem in cælis : quo fur non appropriat, neque tinea corrumpit.
text_pt: Vendei o que tendes, e dai esmolas. Fazei para vós bolsas que não se envelheçam; tesouro nos céus que nunca acabe, aonde não chega ladrão e a traça não rói.
text_el: Πωλήσατε τὰ ὑπάρχοντα ὑμῶν καὶ δότε ἐλεημοσύνην: ποιήσατε ἑαυτοῖς βαλλάντια μὴ παλαιούμενα, θησαυρὸν ἀνέκλειπτον ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς, ὅπου κλέπτης οὐκ ἐγγίζει οὐδὲ σὴς διαφθείρει.

text_en: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
text_la: Ubi enim thesaurus vester est, ibi et cor vestrum erit.
text_pt: Porque, onde estiver o vosso tesouro, ali estará também o vosso coração.
text_el: ὅπου γάρ ἐστιν ὁ θησαυρὸς ὑμῶν, ἐκεῖ καὶ ἡ καρδία ὑμῶν ἔσται.

text_en: Let your loins be girt and lamps burning in your hands.
text_la: Sint lumbi vestri præcincti, et lucernæ ardentes in manibus vestris,
text_pt: Estejam cingidos os vossos lombos, e acesas as vossas candeias.
text_el: Ἔστωσαν ὑμῶν αἱ ὀσφύες περιεζωσμέναι καὶ οἱ λύχνοι καιόμενοι:

text_en: And you yourselves like to men who wait for their lord, when he shall return from the wedding; that when he comes and knocks, they may open to him immediately.
text_la: et vos similes hominibus exspectantibus dominum suum quando revertatur a nuptiis : ut, cum venerit et pulsaverit, confestim aperiant ei.
text_pt: E sede vós semelhantes aos homens que esperam o seu senhor, quando houver de voltar das bodas, para que, quando vier, e bater, logo possam abrir-lhe.
text_el: καὶ ὑμεῖς ὅμοιοι ἀνθρώποις προσδεχομένοις τὸν κύριον ἑαυτῶν, πότε ἀναλύσῃ ἐκ τῶν γάμων, ἵνα ἐλθόντος καὶ κρούσαντος εὐθέως ἀνοίξωσιν αὐτῷ.

text_en: Blessed are those servants whom the Lord, when he comes, shall find watching. Amen I say to you that he will gird himself and make them sit down to meat and passing will minister unto them.
text_la: Beati servi illi quos, cum venerit dominus, invenerit vigilantes : amen dico vobis, quod præcinget se, et faciet illos discumbere, et transiens ministrabit illis.
text_pt: Bem-aventurados aqueles servos, os quais, quando o Senhor vier, achar vigiando! Em verdade vos digo que se cingirá, e os fará assentar à mesa e, chegando-se, os servirá.
text_el: μακάριοι οἱ δοῦλοι ἐκεῖνοι, οὓς ἐλθὼν ὁ κύριος εὑρήσει γρηγοροῦντας: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι περιζώσεται καὶ ἀνακλινεῖ αὐτοὺς καὶ παρελθὼν διακονήσει αὐτοῖς.

text_en: And if he shall come in the second watch or come in the third watch and find them so, blessed are those servants.
text_la: Et si venerit in secunda vigilia, et si in tertia vigilia venerit, et ita invenerit, beati sunt servi illi.
text_pt: E, se vier na segunda vigília, e se vier na terceira vigília, e os achar assim, bem-aventurados são os tais servos.
text_el: κἂν ἐν τῇ δευτέρᾳ, κἂν ἐν τῇ τρίτῃ φυλακῇ ἔλθῃ καὶ εὕρῃ οὕτως, μακάριοί εἰσιν. ἐκεῖνοι

text_en: But know this, that if the householder did know at what hour the thief would come, he would surely watch and would not suffer his house to be broken open.
text_la: Hoc autem scitote, quoniam si sciret paterfamilias, qua hora fur veniret, vigilaret utique, et non sineret perfodi domum suam.
text_pt: Sabei, porém, isto: que, se o pai de família soubesse a que hora havia de vir o ladrão, vigiaria, e não deixaria minar a sua casa.
text_el: τοῦτο δὲ γινώσκετε, ὅτι εἰ ᾔδει ὁ οἰκοδεσπότης ποίᾳ ὥρᾳ ὁ κλέπτης ἔρχεται, ἐγρηγόρησεν ἂν καὶ οὐκ ἀφῆκεν διορυχθῆναι τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Be then also ready: for at what hour you think not the Son of man will come.
text_la: Et vos estote parati : quia qua hora non putatis, Filius hominis veniet.
text_pt: Portanto, estai vós também apercebidos; porque virá o Filho do homem à hora que não imaginais.
text_el: καὶ ὑμεῖς γίνεσθε ἕτοιμοι, ὅτι ᾗ ὥρᾳ οὐ δοκεῖτε ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἔρχεται.

text_en: And Peter said to him: Lord, do you speak this parable to us, or likewise to all?
text_la: Ait autem ei Petrus : Domine, ad nos dicis hanc parabolam, an et ad omnes?
text_pt: E disse-lhe Pedro: Senhor, dizes essa parábola a nós, ou também a todos?
text_el: Εἶπεν δὲ ὁ Πέτρος: κύριε, πρὸς ἡμᾶς τὴν παραβολὴν ταύτην λέγεις ἢ καὶ πρὸς πάντας;

text_en: And the Lord said: Who do you think is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord sets over his family , to give them their measure of wheat in due season?
text_la: Dixit autem Dominus : Quis, putas, est fidelis dispensator, et prudens, quem constituit dominus supra familiam suam, ut det illis in tempore tritici mensuram?
text_pt: E disse o Senhor: Qual é, pois, o mordomo fiel e prudente, a quem o senhor pôs sobre os seus servos, para lhes dar a tempo a ração?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ κύριος: τίς ἄρα ἐστὶν ὁ πιστὸς οἰκονόμος ὁ φρόνιμος, ὃν καταστήσει ὁ κύριος ἐπὶ τῆς θεραπείας αὐτοῦ τοῦ διδόναι ἐν καιρῷ τὸ σιτομέτριον;

text_en: Blessed is that servant whom, when his lord shall come, he shall find so doing.
text_la: Beatus ille servus quem, cum venerit dominus, invenerit ita facientem.
text_pt: Bem-aventurado aquele servo a quem o seu senhor, quando vier, achar fazendo assim.
text_el: μακάριος ὁ δοῦλος ἐκεῖνος, ὃν ἐλθὼν ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ εὑρήσει ποιοῦντα οὕτως.

text_en: Verily I say to you, he will set him over all that he possesses.
text_la: Vere dico vobis, quoniam supra omnia quæ possidet, constituet illum.
text_pt: Em verdade vos digo que sobre todos os seus bens o porá.
text_el: ἀληθῶς λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐπὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς ὑπάρχουσιν αὐτοῦ καταστήσει αὐτόν.

text_en: But if that servant shall say in his heart: My Lord is long a coming; and shall begin to strike the men -servants and maid-servants, and to eat and to drink and be drunk:
text_la: Quod si dixerit servus ille in corde suo : Moram facit dominus meus venire : et cœperit percutere servos, et ancillas, et edere, et bibere, et inebriari:
text_pt: Mas, se aquele servo disser em seu coração: O meu senhor tarda em vir; e começar a espancar os criados e criadas, e a comer, e a beber, e a embriagar-se,
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ εἴπῃ ὁ δοῦλος ἐκεῖνος ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ: χρονίζει ὁ κύριός μου ἔρχεσθαι, καὶ ἄρξηται τύπτειν τοὺς παῖδας καὶ τὰς παιδίσκας, ἐσθίειν τε καὶ πίνειν καὶ μεθύσκεσθαι:

text_en: The lord of that servant will come in the day that he hopes not, and at the hour that he knows not: and shall separate him and shall appoint him his portion with unbelievers.
text_la: veniet dominus servi illius in die qua non sperat, et hora qua nescit, et dividet eum, partemque ejus cum infidelibus ponet.
text_pt: Virá o senhor daquele servo no dia em que o não espera, e numa hora que ele não sabe, e separá-lo-á, e lhe dará a sua parte com os infiéis.
text_el: ἥξει ὁ κύριος τοῦ δούλου ἐκείνου ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ᾗ οὐ προσδοκᾷ καὶ ἐν ὥρᾳ ᾗ οὐ γινώσκει, καὶ διχοτομήσει αὐτὸν, καὶ τὸ μέρος αὐτοῦ μετὰ τῶν ἀπίστων θήσει.

text_en: And that servant, who knew the will of his lord and prepared not himself and did not according to his will , shall be beaten with many stripes.
text_la: Ille autem servus qui cognovit voluntatem domini sui, et non præparavit, et non facit secundum voluntatem ejus, vapulabit multis:
text_pt: E o servo que soube a vontade do seu senhor, e não se aprontou, nem fez conforme a sua vontade, será castigado com muitos açoites;
text_el: ἐκεῖνος δὲ ὁ δοῦλος ὁ γνοὺς τὸ θέλημα τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ καὶ μὴ ἑτοιμάσας ἢ ποιήσας πρὸς τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ δαρήσεται πολλάς:

text_en: But he that knew not and did things worthy of stripes shall be beaten with few stripes. And unto whomsoever much is given, of him much shall be required: and to whom they have committed much, of him they will demand the more.
text_la: qui autem non cognovit, et fecit digna plagis, vapulabit paucis. Omni autem cui multum datum est, multum quæretur ab eo : et cui commendaverunt multum, plus petent ab eo.
text_pt: Mas o que a não soube, e fez coisas dignas de açoites, com poucos açoites será castigado. E, a qualquer que muito for dado, muito se lhe pedirá, e ao que muito se lhe confiou, muito mais se lhe pedirá.
text_el: ὁ δὲ μὴ γνούς, ποιήσας δὲ ἄξια πληγῶν, δαρήσεται ὀλίγας. παντὶ δὲ ᾧ ἐδόθη πολύ, πολὺ ζητηθήσεται παρ' αὐτοῦ, καὶ ᾧ παρέθεντο πολύ, περισσότερον αἰτήσουσιν αὐτόν.

text_en: I have come to cast fire on the earth. And what will I, but that it be kindled?
text_la: Ignem veni mittere in terram, et quid volo nisi ut accendatur?
text_pt: Vim lançar fogo na terra; e que mais quero, se já está aceso?
text_el: Πῦρ ἦλθον βαλεῖν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν, καὶ τί θέλω εἰ ἤδη ἀνήφθη.

text_en: And I have a baptism wherewith I am to be baptized . And how am I straitened until it be accomplished?
text_la: Baptismo autem habeo baptizari : et quomodo coarctor usque dum perficiatur?
text_pt: Importa, porém, que seja batizado com um certo batismo; e como me angustio até que venha a cumprir-se!
text_el: βάπτισμα δὲ ἔχω βαπτισθῆναι, καὶ πῶς συνέχομαι ἕως ὅτου τελεσθῇ.

text_en: Do you think that I have come to give peace on earth? I tell you, no; but separation.
text_la: Putatis quia pacem veni dare in terram? non, dico vobis, sed separationem:
text_pt: Cuidais vós que vim trazer paz à terra? Não, vos digo, mas antes dissensão;
text_el: δοκεῖτε ὅτι εἰρήνην παρεγενόμην δοῦναι ἐν τῇ γῇ; οὐχί, λέγω ὑμῖν, ἀλλ' ἢ διαμερισμόν.

text_en: For there shall be from henceforth five in one house divided: three against two, and two against three.
text_la: erunt enim ex hoc quinque in domo una divisi, tres in duos, et duo in tres
text_pt: Porque daqui em diante estarão cinco divididos numa casa: três contra dois, e dois contra três.
text_el: ἔσονται γὰρ ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν πέντε ἐν ἑνὶ οἴκῳ διαμεμερισμένοι, τρεῖς ἐπὶ δυσὶν καὶ δύο ἐπὶ τρισίν

text_en: The father shall be divided against the son and the son against his father: the mother against the daughter and the daughter against her mother: the mother-in-law against the daughter-in-law and the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.
text_la: dividentur : pater in filium, et filius in patrem suum, mater in filiam, et filia in matrem, socrus in nurum suam, et nurus in socrum suam.
text_pt: O pai estará dividido contra o filho, e o filho contra o pai; a mãe contra a filha, e a filha contra a mãe; a sogra contra sua nora, e a nora contra sua sogra.
text_el: διαμερισθήσονται, πατὴρ ἐπὶ υἱῷ καὶ υἱὸς ἐπὶ πατρί, μήτηρ ἐπὶ θυγατέρα καὶ θυγάτηρ ἐπὶ τὴν μητέρα, πενθερὰ ἐπὶ τὴν νύμφην αὐτῆς καὶ νύμφη ἐπὶ τὴν πενθεράν.

text_en: And he said also to the multitudes: When you see a cloud rising from the west, presently you say: A shower is coming. And so it happens.
text_la: Dicebat autem et ad turbas : Cum videritis nubem orientem ab occasu, statim dicitis : Nimbus venit : et ita fit.
text_pt: E dizia também à multidão: Quando vedes a nuvem que vem do ocidente, logo dizeis: Lá vem chuva, e assim sucede.
text_el: Ἔλεγεν δὲ καὶ τοῖς ὄχλοις: ὅταν ἴδητε νεφέλην ἀνατέλλουσαν ἐπὶ δυσμῶν, εὐθέως λέγετε ὅτι ὄμβρος ἔρχεται, καὶ γίνεται οὕτως:

text_en: And when you see the south wind blow, you say: There will heat. And it comes to pass.
text_la: Et cum austrum flantem, dicitis : Quia æstus erit : et fit.
text_pt: E, quando assopra o sul, dizeis: Haverá calma; e assim sucede.
text_el: καὶ ὅταν νότον πνέοντα, λέγετε ὅτι καύσων ἔσται, καὶ γίνεται.

text_en: You hypocrites , you know how to discern the face of the heaven and of the earth: but how is it that you do not discern this time?
text_la: Hypocritæ! faciem cæli et terræ nostis probare : hoc autem tempus quomodo non probatis?
text_pt: Hipócritas, sabeis discernir a face da terra e do céu; como não sabeis então discernir este tempo?
text_el: ὑποκριταί, τὸ πρόσωπον τῆς γῆς καὶ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ οἴδατε δοκιμάζειν, τὸν καιρὸν δὲ τοῦτον πῶς οὐκ οἴδατε δοκιμάζειν;

text_en: And why, even of yourselves, do you not judge that which is just ?
text_la: quid autem et a vobis ipsis non judicatis quod justum est?
text_pt: E por que não julgais também por vós mesmos o que é justo?
text_el: Τί δὲ καὶ ἀφ' ἑαυτῶν οὐ κρίνετε τὸ δίκαιον;

text_en: And when you go with your adversary to the prince, whilst you are in the way, endeavour to be delivered from him: lest perhaps he draw you to be judge, and the judge deliver you to the exacter, and the exacter cast you into prison .
text_la: Cum autem vadis cum adversario tuo ad principem, in via da operam liberari ab illo, ne forte trahat te ad judicem, et judex tradat te exactori, et exactor mittat te in carcerem.
text_pt: Quando, pois, vais com o teu adversário ao magistrado, procura livrar-te dele no caminho; para que não suceda que te conduza ao juiz, e o juiz te entregue ao meirinho, e o meirinho te encerre na prisão.
text_el: ὡς γὰρ ὑπάγεις μετὰ τοῦ ἀντιδίκου σου ἐπ' ἄρχοντα, ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ δὸς ἐργασίαν ἀπηλλάχθαι [ἀπ]' αὐτοῦ, μήποτε κατασύρῃ σε πρὸς τὸν κριτήν, καὶ ὁ κριτής σε παραδώσει τῷ πράκτορι, καὶ ὁ πράκτωρ σε βαλεῖ εἰς φυλακήν.

text_en: I say to you, you shall not go out thence until you pay the very last mite.
text_la: Dico tibi, non exies inde, donec etiam novissimum minutum reddas.
text_pt: Digo-te que não sairás dali enquanto não pagares o derradeiro ceitil.
text_el: λέγω σοι, οὐ μὴ ἐξέλθῃς ἐκεῖθεν ἕως καὶ τὸ ἔσχατον λεπτὸν ἀποδῷς.

text_en: And there were present, at that very time, some that told him of the Galileans , whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices .
text_la: Aderant autem quidam ipso in tempore, nuntiantes illi de Galilæis, quorum sanguinem Pilatus miscuit cum sacrificiis eorum.
text_pt: E, Naquele mesmo tempo, estavam presentes ali alguns que lhe falavam dos galileus, cujo sangue Pilatos misturara com os seus sacrifícios.
text_el: Παρῆσαν δέ τινες ἐν αὐτῷ τῷ καιρῷ ἀπαγγέλλοντες αὐτῷ περὶ τῶν Γαλιλαίων ὧν τὸ αἷμα Πιλᾶτος ἔμιξεν μετὰ τῶν θυσιῶν αὐτῶν.

text_en: And he answering, said to them: Think you that these Galileans were sinners above all the men of Galilee , because they suffered such things?
text_la: Et respondens dixit illis : Putatis quod hi Galilæi præ omnibus Galilæis peccatores fuerint, quia talia passi sunt?
text_pt: E, respondendo Jesus, disse-lhes: Cuidais vós que esses galileus foram mais pecadores do que todos os galileus, por terem padecido tais coisas?
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: δοκεῖτε ὅτι οἱ Γαλιλαῖοι οὗτοι ἁμαρτωλοὶ παρὰ πάντας τοὺς Γαλιλαίους ἐγένοντο, ὅτι ταῦτα πεπόνθασιν;

text_en: No, I say to you: but unless you shall do penance , you shall all likewise perish.
text_la: Non, dico vobis : sed nisi pœnitentiam habueritis, omnes similiter peribitis.
text_pt: Não, vos digo; antes, se não vos arrependerdes, todos de igual modo perecereis.
text_el: οὐχί λέγω ὑμῖν, ἀλλ' ἐὰν μὴ μετανοῆτε, πάντες ὁμοίως ἀπολεῖσθε.

text_en: Or those eighteen upon whom the tower fell in Siloe and slew them: think you that they also were debtors above all the men that dwelt in Jerusalem ?
text_la: Sicut illi decem et octo, supra quos cecidit turris in Siloë, et occidit eos : putatis quia et ipsi debitores fuerint præter omnes homines habitantes in Jerusalem?
text_pt: E aqueles dezoito, sobre os quais caiu a torre de Siloé e os matou, cuidais que foram mais culpados do que todos quantos homens habitam em Jerusalém?
text_el: ἢ ἐκεῖνοι οἱ δεκαοκτὼ, ἐφ' οὓς ἔπεσεν ὁ πύργος ἐν τῷ Σιλωὰμ καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν αὐτούς, δοκεῖτε ὅτι αὐτοὶ ὀφειλέται ἐγένοντο παρὰ πάντας τοὺς ἀνθρώπους τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Ἰερουσαλήμ;

text_en: No, I say to you: but except you do penance , you shall all likewise perish.
text_la: Non, dico vobis : sed si pœnitentiam non egeritis, omnes similiter peribitis.
text_pt: Não, vos digo; antes, se não vos arrependerdes, todos de igual modo perecereis.
text_el: οὐχί λέγω ὑμῖν, ἀλλ' ἐὰν μὴ μετανοήσητε, πάντες ὡσαύτως ἀπολεῖσθε.

text_en: He spoke also this parable : A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard: and he came seeking fruit on it and found none.
text_la: Dicebat autem et hanc similitudinem : Arborem fici habebat quidam plantatam in vinea sua, et venit quærens fructum in illa, et non invenit.
text_pt: E dizia esta parábola: Um certo homem tinha uma figueira plantada na sua vinha, e foi procurar nela fruto, não o achando;
text_el: Ἔλεγεν δὲ ταύτην τὴν παραβολήν. Συκῆν εἶχέν τις πεφυτευμένην ἐν τῷ ἀμπελῶνι αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἦλθεν ζητῶν καρπὸν ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ οὐχ εὗρεν.

text_en: And he said to the dresser of the vineyard: Behold, for these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree and I find none. Cut it down therefore. Why cumbers it the ground?
text_la: Dixit autem ad cultorem vineæ : Ecce anni tres sunt ex quo venio quærens fructum in ficulnea hac, et non invenio : succide ergo illam : ut quid etiam terram occupat?
text_pt: E disse ao vinhateiro: Eis que há três anos venho procurar fruto nesta figueira, e não o acho. Corta-a; por que ocupa ainda a terra inutilmente?
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς τὸν ἀμπελουργόν: ἰδοὺ τρία ἔτη ἀφ' οὗ ἔρχομαι ζητῶν καρπὸν ἐν τῇ συκῇ ταύτῃ καὶ οὐχ εὑρίσκω: ἔκκοψον αὐτήν: ἱνατί καὶ τὴν γῆν καταργεῖ;

text_en: But he answering, said to him: Lord, let it alone this year also, until I dig about it and dung it.
text_la: At ille respondens, dicit illi : Domine dimitte illam et hoc anno, usque dum fodiam circa illam, et mittam stercora,
text_pt: E, respondendo ele, disse-lhe: Senhor, deixa-a este ano, até que eu a escave e a esterque;
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς λέγει αὐτῷ: κύριε, ἄφες αὐτὴν καὶ τοῦτο τὸ ἔτος, ἕως ὅτου σκάψω περὶ αὐτὴν καὶ βάλω κόπρια:

text_en: And if happily it bear fruit: but if not, then after that you shall cut it down.
text_la: et siquidem fecerit fructum : sin autem, in futurum succides eam.
text_pt: E, se der fruto, ficará e, se não, depois a mandarás cortar.
text_el: κἂν μὲν ποιήσῃ καρπὸν εἰς τὸ μέλλον: εἰ δὲ μή γε, ἐκκόψεις αὐτήν.

text_en: And he was teaching in their synagogue on their sabbath .
text_la: Erat autem docens in synagoga eorum sabbatis.
text_pt: E ensinava no sábado, numa das sinagogas.
text_el: Ἦν δὲ διδάσκων ἐν μιᾷ τῶν συναγωγῶν ἐν τοῖς σάββασιν.

text_en: And behold there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. And she was bowed together: neither could she look upwards at all.
text_la: Et ecce mulier, quæ habebat spiritum infirmitatis annis decem et octo : et erat inclinata, nec omnino poterat sursum respicere.
text_pt: E eis que estava ali uma mulher que tinha um espírito de enfermidade, havia já dezoito anos; e andava curvada, e não podia de modo algum endireitar-se.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ γυνὴ πνεῦμα ἔχουσα ἀσθενείας ἔτη δεκαοκτώ, καὶ ἦν συγκύπτουσα καὶ μὴ δυναμένη ἀνακύψαι εἰς τὸ παντελές.

text_en: Whom when Jesus saw, he called her unto him and said to her: Woman , you are delivered from your infirmity.
text_la: Quam cum videret Jesus, vocavit eam ad se, et ait illi : Mulier, dimissa es ab infirmitate tua.
text_pt: E, vendo-a Jesus, chamou-a a si, e disse-lhe: Mulher, estás livre da tua enfermidade.
text_el: ἰδὼν δὲ αὐτὴν ὁ Ἰησοῦς προσεφώνησεν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ: γύναι, ἀπολέλυσαι τῆς ἀσθενείας σου,

text_en: And he laid his hands upon her: and immediately she was made straight and glorified God .
text_la: Et imposuit illi manus, et confestim erecta est, et glorificabat Deum.
text_pt: E pôs as mãos sobre ela, e logo se endireitou, e glorificava a Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέθηκεν αὐτῇ τὰς χεῖρας: καὶ παραχρῆμα ἀνωρθώθη, καὶ ἐδόξαζεν τὸν θεόν.

text_en: And the ruler of the synagogue being angry that Jesus had healed on the sabbath answering, said to the multitude: Six days there are wherein you ought to work. In them therefore come and be healed: and not on the sabbath day .
text_la: Respondens autem archisynagogus, indignans quia sabbato curasset Jesus, dicebat turbæ : Sex dies sunt in quibus oportet operari : in his ergo venite, et curamini, et non in die sabbati.
text_pt: E, tomando a palavra o príncipe da sinagoga, indignado porque Jesus curava no sábado, disse à multidão: Seis dias há em que é mister trabalhar; nestes, pois, vinde para serdes curados, e não no dia de sábado.
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ ἀρχισυνάγωγος, ἀγανακτῶν ὅτι τῷ σαββάτῳ ἐθεράπευσεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς, ἔλεγεν τῷ ὄχλῳ ὅτι ἓξ ἡμέραι εἰσὶν ἐν αἷς δεῖ ἐργάζεσθαι: ἐν αὐταῖς οὖν ἐρχόμενοι θεραπεύεσθε καὶ μὴ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ σαββάτου.

text_en: And the Lord answering him, said: You hypocrites , does not every one of you, on the sabbath day , loose his ox or his ass from the manger and lead them to water?
text_la: Respondens autem ad illum Dominus, dixit : Hypocritæ, unusquisque vestrum sabbato non solvit bovem suum, aut asinum a præsepio, et ducit adaquare?
text_pt: Respondeu-lhe, porém, o Senhor, e disse: Hipócrita, no sábado não desprende da manjedoura cada um de vós o seu boi, ou jumento, e não o leva a beber?
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ κύριος καὶ εἶπεν: ὑποκριταί, ἕκαστος ὑμῶν τῷ σαββάτῳ οὐ λύει τὸν βοῦν αὐτοῦ ἢ τὸν ὄνον ἀπὸ τῆς φάτνης καὶ ἀπάγων ποτίζει;

text_en: And ought not this daughter of Abraham , whom Satan has bound, lo, these eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day ?
text_la: Hanc autem filiam Abrahæ, quam alligavit Satanas, ecce decem et octo annis, non oportuit solvi a vinculo isto die sabbati?
text_pt: E não convinha soltar desta prisão, no dia de sábado, esta filha de Abraão, a qual há dezoito anos Satanás tinha presa?
text_el: ταύτην δὲ θυγατέρα Ἀβραὰμ οὖσαν, ἣν ἔδησεν ὁ Σατανᾶς ἰδοὺ δέκα καὶ ὀκτὼ ἔτη, οὐκ ἔδει λυθῆναι ἀπὸ τοῦ δεσμοῦ τούτου τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ σαββάτου;

text_en: And when he said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the things that were gloriously done by him.
text_la: Et cum hæc diceret, erubescebant omnes adversarii ejus : et omnis populus gaudebat in universis, quæ gloriose fiebant ab eo.
text_pt: E, dizendo ele isto, todos os seus adversários ficaram envergonhados, e todo o povo se alegrava por todas as coisas gloriosas que eram feitas por ele.
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα λέγοντος αὐτοῦ κατῃσχύνοντο πάντες οἱ ἀντικείμενοι αὐτῷ, καὶ πᾶς ὁ ὄχλος ἔχαιρεν ἐπὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐνδόξοις τοῖς γινομένοις ὑπ' αὐτοῦ.

text_en: He said therefore: To what is the kingdom of God like, and whereunto shall I resemble it?
text_la: Dicebat ergo : Cui simile est regnum Dei, et cui simile æstimabo illud?
text_pt: E dizia: A que é semelhante o reino de Deus, e a que o compararei?
text_el: Ἔλεγεν οὖν: τίνι ὁμοία ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ τίνι ὁμοιώσω αὐτήν;

text_en: It is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took and cast into his garden: and it grew and became a great tree, and the birds of the air lodged in the branches thereof.
text_la: Simile est grano sinapis, quod acceptum homo misit in hortum suum, et crevit, et factum est in arborem magnam : et volucres cæli requieverunt in ramis ejus.
text_pt: É semelhante ao grão de mostarda que um homem, tomando-o, lançou na sua horta; e cresceu, e fez-se grande árvore, e em seus ramos se aninharam as aves do céu.
text_el: ὁμοία ἐστὶν κόκκῳ σινάπεως, ὃν λαβὼν ἄνθρωπος ἔβαλεν εἰς κῆπον ἑαυτοῦ, καὶ ηὔξησεν καὶ ἐγένετο εἰς δένδρον, καὶ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ κατεσκήνωσεν ἐν τοῖς κλάδοις αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And again he said: Whereunto shall I esteem the kingdom of God to be like?
text_la: Et iterum dixit : Cui simile æstimabo regnum Dei?
text_pt: E disse outra vez: A que compararei o reino de Deus?
text_el: Καὶ πάλιν εἶπεν: τίνι ὁμοιώσω τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ;

text_en: It is like to leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
text_la: Simile est fermento, quod acceptum mulier abscondit in farinæ sata tria, donec fermentaretur totum.
text_pt: É semelhante ao fermento que uma mulher, tomando-o, escondeu em três medidas de farinha, até que tudo levedou.
text_el: ὁμοία ἐστὶν ζύμῃ, ἣν λαβοῦσα γυνὴ ἔκρυψεν εἰς ἀλεύρου σάτα τρία, ἕως οὗ ἐζυμώθη ὅλον.

text_en: And he went through the cities and towns teaching and making his journey to Jerusalem .
text_la: Et ibat per civitates et castella, docens, et iter faciens in Jerusalem.
text_pt: E percorria as cidades e as aldeias, ensinando, e caminhando para Jerusalém.
text_el: Καὶ διεπορεύετο κατὰ πόλεις καὶ κώμας διδάσκων καὶ πορείαν ποιούμενος εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα.

text_en: And a certain man said to him: Lord, are they few that are saved? But he said to them:
text_la: Ait autem illi quidam : Domine, si pauci sunt, qui salvantur? Ipse autem dixit ad illos:
text_pt: E disse-lhe um: Senhor, são poucos os que se salvam? E ele lhe respondeu:
text_el: Εἶπεν δέ τις αὐτῷ: κύριε, εἰ ὀλίγοι οἱ σῳζόμενοι; ὁ δὲ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς:

text_en: Strive to enter by the narrow gate: for many, I say to you, shall seek to enter and shall not be able.
text_la: Contendite intrare per angustam portam : quia multi, dico vobis, quærent intrare, et non poterunt.
text_pt: Porfiai por entrar pela porta estreita; porque eu vos digo que muitos procurarão entrar, e não poderão.
text_el: ἀγωνίζεσθε εἰσελθεῖν διὰ τῆς στενῆς θύρας, ὅτι πολλοί, λέγω ὑμῖν, ζητήσουσιν εἰσελθεῖν καὶ οὐκ ἰσχύσουσιν.

text_en: But when the master of the house shall be gone in and shall shut the door, you shall begin to stand without; and knock at the door, saying: Lord, open to us. And he answering, shall say to you: I know you not, whence you are.
text_la: Cum autem intraverit paterfamilias, et clauserit ostium, incipietis foris stare, et pulsare ostium, dicentes : Domine, aperi nobis : et respondens dicet vobis : Nescio vos unde sitis:
text_pt: Quando o pai de família se levantar e cerrar a porta, e começardes, de fora, a bater à porta, dizendo: Senhor, Senhor, abre-nos; e, respondendo ele, vos disser: Não sei de onde vós sois;
text_el: ἀφ' οὗ ἂν ἐγερθῇ ὁ οἰκοδεσπότης καὶ ἀποκλείσῃ τὴν θύραν, καὶ ἄρξησθε ἔξω ἑστάναι καὶ κρούειν τὴν θύραν λέγοντες: κύριε, ἄνοιξον ἡμῖν, καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ἐρεῖ ὑμῖν: οὐκ οἶδα ὑμᾶς πόθεν ἐστέ.

text_en: Then you shall begin to say: We have eaten and drunk in your presence: and you have taught in our streets.
text_la: tunc incipietis dicere : Manducavimus coram te, et bibimus, et in plateis nostris docuisti.
text_pt: Então começareis a dizer: Temos comido e bebido na tua presença, e tu tens ensinado nas nossas ruas.
text_el: τότε ἄρξεσθε λέγειν: ἐφάγομεν ἐνώπιόν σου καὶ ἐπίομεν, καὶ ἐν ταῖς πλατείαις ἡμῶν ἐδίδαξας:

text_en: And he shall say to you: I know you not, whence you are. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity .
text_la: Et dicet vobis : Nescio vos unde sitis : discedite a me omnes operarii iniquitatis.
text_pt: E ele vos responderá: Digo-vos que não vos conheço nem sei de onde vós sois; apartai-vos de mim, vós todos os que praticais a iniqüidade.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖ: λέγων ὑμῖν, οὐκ οἶδα πόθεν ἐστέ: ἀπόστητε ἀπ' ἐμοῦ πάντες ἐργάται ἀδικίας.

text_en: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth; when you shall see Abraham and Isaac and Jacob and all the prophets , in the kingdom of God : and you yourselves thrust out.
text_la: Ibi erit fletus et stridor dentium : cum videritis Abraham, et Isaac, et Jacob, et omnes prophetas in regno Dei, vos autem expelli foras.
text_pt: Ali haverá choro e ranger de dentes, quando virdes Abraão, e Isaque, e Jacó, e todos os profetas no reino de Deus, e vós lançados fora.
text_el: ἐκεῖ ἔσται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων, ὅταν ὄψησθε Ἀβραὰμ καὶ Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Ἰακὼβ καὶ πάντας τοὺς προφήτας ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ θεοῦ, ὑμᾶς δὲ ἐκβαλλομένους ἔξω.

text_en: And there shall come from the east and the west and the north and the south: and shall sit down in the kingdom of God .
text_la: Et venient ab oriente, et occidente, et aquilone, et austro, et accumbent in regno Dei.
text_pt: E virão do oriente, e do ocidente, e do norte, e do sul, e assentar-se-ão à mesa no reino de Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἥξουσιν ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν καὶ δυσμῶν καὶ ἀπὸ Βορρᾶ καὶ νότου καὶ ἀνακλιθήσονται ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: And behold, they are last that shall be first: and they are first that shall be last.
text_la: Et ecce sunt novissimi qui erunt primi, et sunt primi qui erunt novissimi.
text_pt: E eis que derradeiros há que serão os primeiros; e primeiros há que serão os derradeiros.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ εἰσὶν ἔσχατοι οἳ ἔσονται πρῶτοι, καὶ εἰσὶν πρῶτοι οἳ ἔσονται ἔσχατοι.

text_en: The same day, there came some of the Pharisees , saying to him: Depart, and get you hence, for Herod has a mind to kill you.
text_la: In ipsa die accesserunt quidam pharisæorum, dicentes illi : Exi, et vade hinc : quia Herodes vult te occidere.
text_pt: Naquele mesmo dia chegaram uns fariseus, dizendo-lhe: Sai, e retira-te daqui, porque Herodes quer matar-te.
text_el: Ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ προσῆλθάν τινες Φαρισαῖοι λέγοντες αὐτῷ: ἔξελθε καὶ πορεύου ἐντεῦθεν, ὅτι Ἡρῴδης θέλει σε ἀποκτεῖναι.

text_en: And he said to them: Go and tell that fox: Behold, I cast out devils and do cures, today and tomorrow, and the third day I am consummated.
text_la: Et ait illis : Ite, et dicite vulpi illi : Ecce ejicio dæmonia, et sanitates perficio hodie, et cras, et tertia die consummor.
text_pt: E respondeu-lhes: Ide, e dizei àquela raposa: Eis que eu expulso demônios, e efetuo curas, hoje e amanhã, e no terceiro dia sou consumado.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: πορευθέντες εἴπατε τῇ ἀλώπεκι ταύτῃ: ἰδοὺ ἐκβάλλω δαιμόνια καὶ ἰάσεις ἀποτελῶ σήμερον καὶ αὔριον, καὶ τῇ τρίτῃ τελειοῦμαι.

text_en: Nevertheless, I must walk today and tomorrow and the day following, because it cannot be that a prophet perish, out of Jerusalem .
text_la: Verumtamen oportet me hodie et cras et sequenti die ambulare: quia non capit prophetam perire extra Jerusalem.
text_pt: Importa, porém, caminhar hoje, amanhã, e no dia seguinte, para que não suceda que morra um profeta fora de Jerusalém.
text_el: πλὴν δεῖ με σήμερον καὶ αὔριον καὶ τῇ ἐχομένῃ πορεύεσθαι, ὅτι οὐκ ἐνδέχεται προφήτην ἀπολέσθαι ἔξω Ἰερουσαλήμ.

text_en: Jerusalem , Jerusalem , that kills the prophets ; and stone them that are sent to you, how often would I have gathered your children as the bird does her brood under her wings, and you would not?
text_la: Jerusalem, Jerusalem, quæ occidis prophetas, et lapidas eos qui mittuntur ad te, quoties volui congregare filios tuos quemadmodum avis nidum suum sub pennis, et noluisti?
text_pt: Jerusalém, Jerusalém, que matas os profetas, e apedrejas os que te são enviados! Quantas vezes quis eu ajuntar os teus filhos, como a galinha os seus pintos debaixo das asas, e não quiseste?
text_el: Ἰερουσαλὴμ Ἰερουσαλήμ, ἡ ἀποκτείνουσα τοὺς προφήτας καὶ λιθοβολοῦσα τοὺς ἀπεσταλμένους πρὸς αὐτήν, ποσάκις ἠθέλησα ἐπισυνάξαι τὰ τέκνα σου ὃν τρόπον ὄρνις τὴν ἑαυτῆς νοσσιὰν ὑπὸ τὰς πτέρυγας, καὶ οὐκ ἠθελήσατε.

text_en: Behold your house shall be left to you desolate. And I say to you that you shall not see me till the time come when you shall say: Blessed is he that comes in the name of the Lord .
text_la: Ecce relinquetur vobis domus vestra deserta. Dico autem vobis, quia non videbitis me donec veniat cum dicetis : Benedictus qui venit in nomine Domini.
text_pt: Eis que a vossa casa se vos deixará deserta. E em verdade vos digo que não me vereis até que venha o tempo em que digais: Bendito aquele que vem em nome do Senhor.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἀφίεται ὑμῖν ὁ οἶκος ὑμῶν. λέγω [δὲ] ὑμῖν οὐ μὴ ἴδητέ με ἕως εἴπητε: εὐλογημένος ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου.

text_en: And it came to pass, when Jesus went into the house of one of the Pharisees , on the sabbath day , that they watched him.
text_la: Et factum est cum intraret Jesus in domum cujusdam principis pharisæorum sabbato manducare panem, et ipsi observabant eum.
text_pt: Aconteceu num sábado que, entrando ele em casa de um dos principais dos fariseus para comer pão, eles o estavam observando.
text_el: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἐλθεῖν αὐτὸν εἰς οἶκόν τινος τῶν ἀρχόντων τῶν Φαρισαίων σαββάτῳ φαγεῖν ἄρτον, καὶ αὐτοὶ ἦσαν παρατηρούμενοι αὐτόν.

text_en: And behold, there was a certain man before him that had the dropsy.
text_la: Et ecce homo quidam hydropicus erat ante illum.
text_pt: E eis que estava ali diante dele um certo homem hidrópico.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄνθρωπός τις ἦν ὑδρωπικὸς ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And Jesus answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees , saying: Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day ?
text_la: Et respondens Jesus dixit ad legisperitos et pharisæos, dicens : Si licet sabbato curare?
text_pt: E Jesus, tomando a palavra, falou aos doutores da lei, e aos fariseus, dizendo: É lícito curar no sábado?
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν πρὸς τοὺς νομικοὺς καὶ Φαρισαίους λέγων: ἔξεστιν τῷ σαββάτῳ θεραπεῦσαι ἢ οὔ;

text_en: But they held their peace. But he taking him, healed him and sent him away.
text_la: At illi tacuerunt. Ipse vero apprehensum sanavit eum, ac dimisit.
text_pt: Eles, porém, calaram-se. E, tomando-o, o curou e despediu.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἡσύχασαν. καὶ ἐπιλαβόμενος ἰάσατο αὐτὸν καὶ ἀπέλυσεν.

text_en: And answering them, he said: Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fall into a pit and will not immediately draw him out, on the sabbath day ?
text_la: Et respondens ad illos dixit : Cujus vestrum asinus, aut bos in puteum cadet, et non continuo extrahet illum die sabbati?
text_pt: E respondendo-lhes disse: Qual será de vós o que, caindo-lhe num poço, em dia de sábado, o jumento ou o boi, o não tire logo?
text_el: καὶ πρὸς αὐτοὺς εἶπεν: τίνος ὑμῶν υἱὸς ἢ βοῦς εἰς φρέαρ πεσεῖται, καὶ οὐκ εὐθέως ἀνασπάσει αὐτὸν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ σαββάτου;

text_en: And they could not answer him to these things.
text_la: Et non poterant ad hæc respondere illi.
text_pt: E nada lhe podiam replicar sobre isto.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἴσχυσαν ἀνταποκριθῆναι πρὸς ταῦτα.

text_en: And he spoke a parable also to them that were invited, marking how they chose the first seats at the table, saying to them:
text_la: Dicebat autem et ad invitatos parabolam, intendens quomodo primos accubitus eligerent, dicens ad illos:
text_pt: E disse aos convidados uma parábola, reparando como escolhiam os primeiros assentos, dizendo-lhes:
text_el: Ἔλεγεν δὲ πρὸς τοὺς κεκλημένους παραβολήν, ἐπέχων πῶς τὰς πρωτοκλισίας ἐξελέγοντο, λέγων πρὸς αὐτούς:

text_en: When you are invited to a wedding, sit not down in the first place, lest perhaps one more honourable than you be invited by him:
text_la: Cum invitatus fueris ad nuptias, non discumbas in primo loco, ne forte honoratior te sit invitatus ab illo.
