text_pt: Quando por alguém fores convidado às bodas, não te assentes no primeiro lugar; não aconteça que esteja convidado outro mais digno do que tu;
text_el: ὅταν κληθῇς ὑπό τινος εἰς γάμους, μὴ κατακλιθῇς εἰς τὴν πρωτοκλισίαν, μήποτε ἐντιμότερός σου ᾖ κεκλημένος ὑπ' αὐτοῦ,

text_en: And he that invited you and him, come and say to you: Give this man place. And then you begin with shame to take the lowest place.
text_la: Et veniens is, qui te et illum vocavit, dicat tibi : Da huic locum : et tunc incipias cum rubore novissimum locum tenere.
text_pt: E, vindo o que te convidou a ti e a ele, te diga: Dá o lugar a este; e então, com vergonha, tenhas de tomar o derradeiro lugar.
text_el: καὶ ἐλθὼν ὁ σὲ καὶ αὐτὸν καλέσας ἐρεῖ σοι: δὸς τούτῳ τόπον, καὶ τότε ἄρξῃ μετὰ αἰσχύνης τὸν ἔσχατον τόπον κατέχειν.

text_en: But when you are invited, go, sit down in the lowest place; that when he who invited you comes, he may say to you: Friend, go up higher. Then shall you have glory before them that sit at table with you.
text_la: Sed cum vocatus fueris, vade, recumbe in novissimo loco : ut, cum venerit qui te invitavit, dicat tibi : Amice, ascende superius. Tunc erit tibi gloria coram simul discumbentibus:
text_pt: Mas, quando fores convidado, vai, e assenta-te no derradeiro lugar, para que, quando vier o que te convidou, te diga: Amigo, sobe mais para cima. Então terás honra diante dos que estiverem contigo à mesa.
text_el: ἀλλ' ὅταν κληθῇς πορευθεὶς ἀνάπεσε εἰς τὸν ἔσχατον τόπον, ἵνα ὅταν ἔλθῃ ὁ κεκληκώς σε ἐρεῖ σοι: φίλε, προσανάβηθι ἀνώτερον: τότε ἔσται σοι δόξα ἐνώπιον πάντων τῶν συνανακειμένων σοι.

text_en: Because every one that exalts himself shall be humbled : and he that humbles himself shall be exalted.
text_la: quia omnis, qui se exaltat, humiliabitur : et qui se humiliat, exaltabitur.
text_pt: Porquanto qualquer que a si mesmo se exaltar será humilhado, e aquele que a si mesmo se humilhar será exaltado.
text_el: ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ὑψῶν ἑαυτὸν ταπεινωθήσεται, καὶ ὁ ταπεινῶν ἑαυτὸν ὑψωθήσεται.

text_en: And he said to him also that had invited him: When you make a dinner or a supper, call not your friends nor your brethren nor your kinsmen nor your neighbours who are rich; lest perhaps they also invite you again, and a recompense be made to you.
text_la: Dicebat autem et ei, qui invitaverat : Cum facis prandium, aut cœnam, noli vocare amicos tuos, neque fratres tuos, neque cognatos, neque vicinos divites : ne forte te et ipsi reinvitent, et fiat tibi retributio;
text_pt: E dizia também ao que o tinha convidado: Quando deres um jantar, ou uma ceia, não chames os teus amigos, nem os teus irmãos, nem os teus parentes, nem vizinhos ricos, para que não suceda que também eles te tornem a convidar, e te seja isso recompensado.
text_el: Ἔλεγεν δὲ καὶ τῷ κεκληκότι αὐτόν: ὅταν ποιῇς ἄριστον ἢ δεῖπνον, μὴ φώνει τοὺς φίλους σου μηδὲ τοὺς ἀδελφούς σου μηδὲ τοὺς συγγενεῖς σου μηδὲ γείτονας πλουσίους, μήποτε καὶ αὐτοὶ ἀντικαλέσωσίν σε καὶ γένηται ἀνταπόδομά σοι.

text_en: But when you make a feast, call the poor, the maimed, the lame and the blind.
text_la: sed cum facis convivium, voca pauperes, debiles, claudos, et cæcos:
text_pt: Mas, quando fizeres convite, chama os pobres, aleijados, mancos e cegos,
text_el: ἀλλ' ὅταν δοχὴν ποιῇς, κάλει πτωχούς, ἀναπείρους, χωλούς, τυφλούς,

text_en: And you shall be blessed , because they have not wherewith to make you recompense: for recompense shall be made you at the resurrection of the just .
text_la: et beatus eris, quia non habent retribuere tibi : retribuetur enim tibi in resurrectione justorum.
text_pt: E serás bem-aventurado; porque eles não têm com que to recompensar; mas recompensado te será na ressurreição dos justos.
text_el: καὶ μακάριος ἔσῃ, ὅτι οὐκ ἔχουσιν ἀνταποδοῦναί σοι: ἀνταποδοθήσεται γάρ σοι ἐν τῇ ἀναστάσει τῶν δικαίων.

text_en: When one of them that sat at table with him had heard these things, he said to him: Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God .
text_la: Hæc cum audisset quidam de simul discumbentibus, dixit illi : Beatus qui manducabit panem in regno Dei.
text_pt: E, ouvindo isto, um dos que estavam com ele à mesa, disse-lhe: Bem-aventurado o que comer pão no reino de Deus.
text_el: Ἀκούσας δέ τις τῶν συνανακειμένων ταῦτα εἶπεν αὐτῷ: μακάριος ὅστις φάγεται ἄρτον ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: But he said to him: A certain man made a great supper and invited many.
text_la: At ipse dixit ei : Homo quidam fecit cœnam magnam, et vocavit multos.
text_pt: Porém, ele lhe disse: Um certo homem fez uma grande ceia, e convidou a muitos.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῷ, ἄνθρωπός τις ἐποίει δεῖπνον μέγα, καὶ ἐκάλεσεν πολλούς,

text_en: And he sent his servant at the hour of supper to say to them that were invited, that they should come: for now all things are ready.
text_la: Et misit servum suum hora cœnæ dicere invitatis ut venirent, quia jam parata sunt omnia.
text_pt: E à hora da ceia mandou o seu servo dizer aos convidados: Vinde, que já tudo está preparado.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν τὸν δοῦλον αὐτοῦ τῇ ὥρᾳ τοῦ δείπνου εἰπεῖν τοῖς κεκλημένοις: ἔρχεσθε, ὅτι ἤδη ἕτοιμά ἐστιν.

text_en: And they began all at once to make excuse. The first said to him: I have bought a farm and I must needs go out and see it. I pray you, hold me excused.
text_la: Et cœperunt simul omnes excusare. Primus dixit ei : Villam emi, et necesse habeo exire, et videre illam : rogo te, habe me excusatum.
text_pt: E todos à uma começaram a escusar-se. Disse-lhe o primeiro: Comprei um campo, e importa ir vê-lo; rogo-te que me hajas por escusado.
text_el: καὶ ἤρξαντο ἀπὸ μιᾶς πάντες παραιτεῖσθαι. ὁ πρῶτος εἶπεν αὐτῷ: ἀγρὸν ἠγόρασα καὶ ἔχω ἀνάγκην ἐξελθὼν ἰδεῖν αὐτόν: ἐρωτῶ σε, ἔχε με παρῃτημένον.

text_en: And another said: I have bought five yoke of oxen and I go to try them. I pray you, hold me excused.
text_la: Et alter dixit : Juga boum emi quinque, et eo probare illa : rogo te, habe me excusatum.
text_pt: E outro disse: Comprei cinco juntas de bois, e vou experimentá-los; rogo-te que me hajas por escusado.
text_el: καὶ ἕτερος εἶπεν: ζεύγη βοῶν ἠγόρασα πέντε καὶ πορεύομαι δοκιμάσαι αὐτά: ἐρωτῶ σε, ἔχε με παρῃτημένον.

text_en: And another said: I have married a wife; and therefore I cannot come.
text_la: Et alius dixit : Uxorem duxi, et ideo non possum venire.
text_pt: E outro disse: Casei, e portanto não posso ir.
text_el: καὶ ἕτερος εἶπεν: γυναῖκα ἔγημα καὶ διὰ τοῦτο οὐ δύναμαι ἐλθεῖν.

text_en: And the servant returning, told these things to his lord. Then the master of the house, being angry , said to his servant: Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city; and bring in hither the poor and the feeble and the blind and the lame.
text_la: Et reversus servus nuntiavit hæc domino suo. Tunc iratus paterfamilias, dixit servo suo : Exi cito in plateas et vicos civitatis : et pauperes, ac debiles, et cæcos, et claudos introduc huc.
text_pt: E, voltando aquele servo, anunciou estas coisas ao seu senhor. Então o pai de família, indignado, disse ao seu servo: Sai depressa pelas ruas e bairros da cidade, e traze aqui os pobres, e aleijados, e mancos e cegos.
text_el: καὶ παραγενόμενος ὁ δοῦλος ἀπήγγειλεν τῷ κυρίῳ αὐτοῦ ταῦτα. τότε ὀργισθεὶς ὁ οἰκοδεσπότης εἶπεν τῷ δούλῳ αὐτοῦ: ἔξελθε ταχέως εἰς τὰς πλατείας καὶ ῥύμας τῆς πόλεως, καὶ τοὺς πτωχοὺς καὶ ἀναπείρους καὶ τυφλοὺς καὶ χωλοὺς εἰσάγαγε ὧδε.

text_en: And the servant said: Lord, it is done as you have commanded; and yet there is room.
text_la: Et ait servus : Domine, factum est ut imperasti, et adhuc locus est.
text_pt: E disse o servo: Senhor, feito está como mandaste; e ainda há lugar.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ δοῦλος: κύριε, γέγονεν ὃ ἐπέταξας, καὶ ἔτι τόπος ἐστίν.

text_en: And the Lord said to the servant: Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
text_la: Et ait dominus servo : Exi in vias, et sæpes : et compelle intrare, ut impleatur domus mea.
text_pt: E disse o senhor ao servo: Sai pelos caminhos e valados, e força-os a entrar, para que a minha casa se encha.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ κύριος πρὸς τὸν δοῦλον: ἔξελθε εἰς τὰς ὁδοὺς καὶ φραγμοὺς καὶ ἀνάγκασον εἰσελθεῖν, ἵνα γεμισθῇ μου ὁ οἶκος:

text_en: But I say unto you that none of those men that were invited shall taste of my supper.
text_la: Dico autem vobis quod nemo virorum illorum qui vocati sunt, gustabit cœnam meam.
text_pt: Porque eu vos digo que nenhum daqueles homens que foram convidados provará a minha ceia.
text_el: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐδεὶς τῶν ἀνδρῶν ἐκείνων τῶν κεκλημένων γεύσεταί μου τοῦ δείπνου.

text_en: And there went great multitudes with him. And turning, he said to them:
text_la: Ibant autem turbæ multæ cum eo: et conversus dixit ad illos:
text_pt: Ora, ia com ele uma grande multidão; e, voltando-se, disse-lhe:
text_el: Συνεπορεύοντο δὲ αὐτῷ ὄχλοι πολλοί, καὶ στραφεὶς εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς:

text_en: If any man come to me, and hate not his father and mother and wife and children and brethren and sisters, yea and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple .
text_la: Si quis venit ad me, et non odit patrem suum, et matrem, et uxorem, et filios, et fratres, et sorores, adhuc autem et animam suam, non potest meus esse discipulus.
text_pt: Se alguém vier a mim, e não aborrecer a seu pai, e mãe, e mulher, e filhos, e irmãos, e irmãs, e ainda também a sua própria vida, não pode ser meu discípulo.
text_el: εἴ τις ἔρχεται πρός με καὶ οὐ μισεῖ τὸν πατέρα ἑαυτοῦ καὶ τὴν μητέρα καὶ τὴν γυναῖκα καὶ τὰ τέκνα καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς καὶ τὰς ἀδελφάς, ἔτι τε καὶ τὴν ψυχὴν ἑαυτοῦ, οὐ δύναται εἶναί μου μαθητής.

text_en: And whosoever does not carry his cross and come after me cannot be my disciple .
text_la: Et qui non bajulat crucem suam, et venit post me, non potest meus esse discipulus.
text_pt: E qualquer que não levar a sua cruz, e não vier após mim, não pode ser meu discípulo.
text_el: ὅστις οὐ βαστάζει τὸν σταυρὸν ἑαυτοῦ καὶ ἔρχεται ὀπίσω μου, οὐ δύναται εἶναί μου μαθητής.

text_en: For which of you, having a mind to build a tower, does not first sit down and reckon the charges that are necessary, whether he have wherewithal to finish it:
text_la: Quis enim ex vobis volens turrim ædificare, non prius sedens computat sumptus, qui necessarii sunt, si habeat ad perficiendum,
text_pt: Pois qual de vós, querendo edificar uma torre, não se assenta primeiro a fazer as contas dos gastos, para ver se tem com que a acabar?
text_el: Τίς γὰρ ἐξ ὑμῶν θέλων πύργον οἰκοδομῆσαι οὐχὶ πρῶτον καθίσας ψηφίζει τὴν δαπάνην, εἰ ἔχει εἰς ἀπαρτισμόν;

text_en: Lest, after he has laid the foundation and is not able to finish it, all that see it begin to mock him,
text_la: ne, posteaquam posuerit fundamentum, et non potuerit perficere, omnes qui vident, incipiant illudere ei,
text_pt: Para que não aconteça que, depois de haver posto os alicerces, e não a podendo acabar, todos os que a virem comecem a escarnecer dele,
text_el: ἵνα μήποτε θέντος αὐτοῦ θεμέλιον καὶ μὴ ἰσχύοντος ἐκτελέσαι πάντες οἱ θεωροῦντες ἄρξωνται αὐτῷ ἐμπαίζειν,

text_en: saying: This man began to build and was not able to finish.
text_la: dicentes : Quia hic homo cœpit ædificare, et non potuit consummare?
text_pt: Dizendo: Este homem começou a edificar e não pôde acabar.
text_el: λέγοντες ὅτι οὗτος ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἤρξατο οἰκοδομεῖν καὶ οὐκ ἴσχυσεν ἐκτελέσαι.

text_en: Or, what king, about to go to make war against another king, does not first sit down and think whether he be able, with ten thousand, to meet him that, with twenty thousand, comes against him?
text_la: Aut quis rex iturus committere bellum adversus alium regem, non sedens prius cogitat, si possit cum decem millibus occurrere ei, qui cum viginti millibus venit ad se?
text_pt: Ou qual é o rei que, indo à guerra a pelejar contra outro rei, não se assenta primeiro a tomar conselho sobre se com dez mil pode sair ao encontro do que vem contra ele com vinte mil?
text_el: Ἢ τίς βασιλεὺς πορευόμενος ἑτέρῳ βασιλεῖ συμβαλεῖν εἰς πόλεμον οὐχὶ καθίσας πρῶτον βουλεύσεται εἰ δυνατός ἐστιν ἐν δέκα χιλιάσιν ὑπαντῆσαι τῷ μετὰ εἴκοσι χιλιάδων ἐρχομένῳ ἐπ' αὐτόν;

text_en: Or else, while the other is yet afar off, sending an embassy, he desires conditions of peace.
text_la: Alioquin adhuc illo longe agente, legationem mittens rogat ea quæ pacis sunt.
text_pt: De outra maneira, estando o outro ainda longe, manda embaixadores, e pede condições de paz.
text_el: εἰ δὲ μή γε, ἔτι αὐτοῦ πόρρω ὄντος πρεσβείαν ἀποστείλας ἐρωτᾷ πρὸς εἰρήνην.

text_en: So likewise every one of you that does not renounce all that he possesses cannot be my disciple .
text_la: Sic ergo omnis ex vobis, qui non renuntiat omnibus quæ possidet, non potest meus esse discipulus.
text_pt: Assim, pois, qualquer de vós, que não renuncia a tudo quanto tem, não pode ser meu discípulo.
text_el: οὕτως οὖν πᾶς ἐξ ὑμῶν ὃς οὐκ ἀποτάσσεται πᾶσιν τοῖς ἑαυτοῦ ὑπάρχουσιν οὐ δύναται εἶναί μου μαθητής.

text_en: Salt is good . But if the salt shall lose its savour, wherewith shall it be seasoned?
text_la: Bonum est sal : si autem sal evanuerit, in quo condietur?
text_pt: Bom é o sal; mas, se o sal degenerar, com que se há de salgar?
text_el: Καλὸν οὖν τὸ ἅλας: ἐὰν δὲ καὶ τὸ ἅλας μωρανθῇ, ἐν τίνι ἀρτυθήσεται;

text_en: It is neither profitable for the land nor for the dunghill: but shall be cast out. He that has ears to hear, let him hear.
text_la: Neque in terram, neque in sterquilinium utile est, sed foras mittetur. Qui habet aures audiendi, audiat.
text_pt: Nem presta para a terra, nem para o monturo; lançam-no fora. Quem tem ouvidos para ouvir, ouça.
text_el: οὔτε εἰς γῆν οὔτε εἰς κοπρίαν εὔθετόν ἐστιν: ἔξω βάλλουσιν αὐτό. ὁ ἔχων ὦτα ἀκούειν ἀκουέτω.

text_en: Now the publicans and sinners drew near unto him to hear him.
text_la: Erant autem appropinquantes ei publicani, et peccatores ut audirent illum.
text_pt: E Chegavam-se a ele todos os publicanos e pecadores para o ouvir.
text_el: Ἦσαν δὲ αὐτῷ ἐγγίζοντες πάντες οἱ τελῶναι καὶ οἱ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἀκούειν αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And the Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying: This man receives sinners and eats with them.
text_la: Et murmurabant pharisæi, et scribæ, dicentes : Quia hic peccatores recipit, et manducat cum illis.
text_pt: E os fariseus e os escribas murmuravam, dizendo: Este recebe pecadores, e come com eles.
text_el: καὶ διεγόγγυζον οἵ τε Φαρισαῖοι καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς λέγοντες ὅτι οὗτος ἁμαρτωλοὺς προσδέχεται καὶ συνεσθίει αὐτοῖς.

text_en: And he spoke to them this parable , saying:
text_la: Et ait ad illos parabolam istam dicens:
text_pt: E ele lhes propôs esta parábola, dizendo:
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτοὺς τὴν παραβολὴν ταύτην λέγων:

text_en: What man of you that has an hundred sheep, and if he shall lose one of them, does he not leave the ninety-nine in the desert and go after that which was lost, until he find it?
text_la: Quis ex vobis homo, qui habet centum oves, et si perdiderit unam ex illis, nonne dimittit nonaginta novem in deserto, et vadit ad illam quæ perierat, donec inveniat eam?
text_pt: Que homem dentre vós, tendo cem ovelhas, e perdendo uma delas, não deixa no deserto as noventa e nove, e vai após a perdida até que venha a achá-la?
text_el: τίς ἄνθρωπος ἐξ ὑμῶν ἔχων ἑκατὸν πρόβατα καὶ ἀπολέσας ἐξ αὐτῶν ἓν οὐ καταλείπει τὰ ἐνενήκοντα ἐννέα ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ καὶ πορεύεται ἐπὶ τὸ ἀπολωλὸς, ἕως εὕρῃ αὐτό;

text_en: And when he has found it, lay it upon his shoulders, rejoicing?
text_la: Et cum invenerit eam, imponit in humeros suos gaudens:
text_pt: E achando-a, a põe sobre os seus ombros, jubiloso;
text_el: καὶ εὑρὼν ἐπιτίθησιν ἐπὶ τοὺς ὤμους αὐτοῦ χαίρων,

text_en: And coming home, call together his friends and neighbours, saying to them: Rejoice with me, because I have found my sheep that was lost?
text_la: et veniens domum convocat amicos et vicinos, dicens illis : Congratulamini mihi, quia inveni ovem meam, quæ perierat.
text_pt: E, chegando a casa, convoca os amigos e vizinhos, dizendo-lhes: Alegrai-vos comigo, porque já achei a minha ovelha perdida.
text_el: καὶ ἐλθὼν εἰς τὸν οἶκον συγκαλεῖ τοὺς φίλους καὶ τοὺς γείτονας, λέγων αὐτοῖς: συγχάρητέ μοι, ὅτι εὗρον τὸ πρόβατόν μου τὸ ἀπολωλός.

text_en: I say to you that even so there shall be joy in heaven upon one sinner that does penance , more than upon ninety-nine just who need not penance .
text_la: Dico vobis quod ita gaudium erit in cælo super uno peccatore pœnitentiam agente, quam super nonaginta novem justis, qui non indigent pœnitentia.
text_pt: Digo-vos que assim haverá alegria no céu por um pecador que se arrepende, mais do que por noventa e nove justos que não necessitam de arrependimento.
text_el: λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὕτως χαρὰ ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ἔσται ἐπὶ ἑνὶ ἁμαρτωλῷ μετανοοῦντι ἢ ἐπὶ ἐνενήκοντα ἐννέα δικαίοις οἵτινες οὐ χρείαν ἔχουσιν μετανοίας.

text_en: Or what woman having ten groats , if she lose one groat , does not light a candle and sweep the house and seek diligently until she find it?
text_la: Aut quæ mulier habens drachmas decem, si perdiderit drachmam unam, nonne accendit lucernam, et everrit domum, et quærit diligenter, donec inveniat?
text_pt: Ou qual a mulher que, tendo dez dracmas, se perder uma dracma, não acende a candeia, e varre a casa, e busca com diligência até a achar?
text_el: Ἢ τίς γυνὴ δραχμὰς ἔχουσα δέκα, ἐὰν ἀπολέσῃ δραχμὴν μίαν, οὐχὶ ἅπτει λύχνον καὶ σαροῖ τὴν οἰκίαν καὶ ζητεῖ ἐπιμελῶς ἕως οὗ εὕρῃ;

text_en: And when she has found it, call together her friends and neighbours, saying: Rejoice with me, because I have found the groat which I had lost.
text_la: Et cum invenerit convocat amicas et vicinas, dicens : Congratulamini mihi, quia inveni drachmam quam perdideram.
text_pt: E achando-a, convoca as amigas e vizinhas, dizendo: Alegrai-vos comigo, porque já achei a dracma perdida.
text_el: καὶ εὑροῦσα συγκαλεῖ τὰς φίλας καὶ γείτονας λέγουσα: συγχάρητέ μοι, ὅτι εὗρον τὴν δραχμὴν ἣν ἀπώλεσα.

text_en: So I say to you, there shall be joy before the angels of God upon one sinner doing penance .
text_la: Ita, dico vobis, gaudium erit coram angelis Dei super uno peccatore pœnitentiam agente.
text_pt: Assim vos digo que há alegria diante dos anjos de Deus por um pecador que se arrepende.
text_el: οὕτως, λέγω ὑμῖν, γίνεται χαρὰ ἐνώπιον τῶν ἀγγέλων τοῦ θεοῦ ἐπὶ ἑνὶ ἁμαρτωλῷ μετανοοῦντι.

text_en: And he said: A certain man had two sons.
text_la: Ait autem : Homo quidam habuit duos filios:
text_pt: E disse: Um certo homem tinha dois filhos;
text_el: Εἶπεν δέ: ἄνθρωπός τις εἶχεν δύο υἱούς.

text_en: And the younger of them said to his father: Father, give me the portion of substance that falls to me. And he divided unto them his substance.
text_la: et dixit adolescentior ex illis patri : Pater, da mihi portionem substantiæ, quæ me contingit. Et divisit illis substantiam.
text_pt: E o mais moço deles disse ao pai: Pai, dá-me a parte dos bens que me pertence. E ele repartiu por eles a fazenda.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ νεώτερος αὐτῶν τῷ πατρί: πάτερ, δός μοι τὸ ἐπιβάλλον μέρος τῆς οὐσίας. ὁ δὲ διεῖλεν αὐτοῖς τὸν βίον.

text_en: And not many days after, the younger son, gathering all together, went abroad into a far country: and there wasted his substance, living riotously.
text_la: Et non post multos dies, congregatis omnibus, adolescentior filius peregre profectus est in regionem longinquam, et ibi dissipavit substantiam suam vivendo luxuriose.
text_pt: E, poucos dias depois, o filho mais novo, ajuntando tudo, partiu para uma terra longínqua, e ali desperdiçou os seus bens, vivendo dissolutamente.
text_el: καὶ μετ' οὐ πολλὰς ἡμέρας συναγαγὼν πάντα ὁ νεώτερος υἱὸς ἀπεδήμησεν εἰς χώραν μακράν, καὶ ἐκεῖ διεσκόρπισεν τὴν οὐσίαν αὐτοῦ ζῶν ἀσώτως.

text_en: And after he had spent all, there came a mighty famine in that country: and he began to be in want.
text_la: Et postquam omnia consummasset, facta est fames valida in regione illa, et ipse cœpit egere.
text_pt: E, havendo ele gastado tudo, houve naquela terra uma grande fome, e começou a padecer necessidades.
text_el: δαπανήσαντος δὲ αὐτοῦ πάντα ἐγένετο λιμὸς ἰσχυρὰ κατὰ τὴν χώραν ἐκείνην, καὶ αὐτὸς ἤρξατο ὑστερεῖσθαι.

text_en: And he went and cleaved to one of the citizens of that country. And he sent him into his farm to feed swine.
text_la: Et abiit, et adhæsit uni civium regionis illius : et misit illum in villam suam ut pasceret porcos.
text_pt: E foi, e chegou-se a um dos cidadãos daquela terra, o qual o mandou para os seus campos, a apascentar porcos.
text_el: καὶ πορευθεὶς ἐκολλήθη ἑνὶ τῶν πολιτῶν τῆς χώρας ἐκείνης, καὶ ἔπεμψεν αὐτὸν εἰς τοὺς ἀγροὺς αὐτοῦ βόσκειν χοίρους:

text_en: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks the swine ate: and no man gave unto him.
text_la: Et cupiebat implere ventrem suum de siliquis, quas porci manducabant : et nemo illi dabat.
text_pt: E desejava encher o seu estômago com as bolotas que os porcos comiam, e ninguém lhe dava nada.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεθύμει χορτασθῆναι ἐκ τῶν κερατίων ὧν ἤσθιον οἱ χοῖροι, καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐδίδου αὐτῷ.

text_en: And returning to himself, he said: How many hired servants in my father's house abound with bread, and I here perish with hunger!
text_la: In se autem reversus, dixit : Quanti mercenarii in domo patris mei abundant panibus, ego autem hic fame pereo!
text_pt: E, tornando em si, disse: Quantos jornaleiros de meu pai têm abundância de pão, e eu aqui pereço de fome!
text_el: εἰς ἑαυτὸν δὲ ἐλθὼν ἔφη: πόσοι μίσθιοι τοῦ πατρός μου περισσεύονται ἄρτων: ἐγὼ δὲ λιμῷ ὧδε ἀπόλλυμαι.

text_en: I will arise and will go to my father and say to him: Father, I have sinned against heaven and before you.
text_la: surgam, et ibo ad patrem meum, et dicam ei : Pater, peccavi in cælum, et coram te:
text_pt: Levantar-me-ei, e irei ter com meu pai, e dir-lhe-ei: Pai, pequei contra o céu e perante ti;
text_el: ἀναστὰς πορεύσομαι πρὸς τὸν πατέρα μου καὶ ἐρῶ αὐτῷ: πάτερ, ἥμαρτον εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ ἐνώπιόν σου,

text_en: I am not worthy to be called your son: make me as one of your hired servants.
text_la: jam non sum dignus vocari filius tuus : fac me sicut unum de mercenariis tuis.
text_pt: Já não sou digno de ser chamado teu filho; faze-me como um dos teus jornaleiros.
text_el: οὐκέτι εἰμὶ ἄξιος κληθῆναι υἱός σου: ποίησόν με ὡς ἕνα τῶν μισθίων σου.

text_en: And rising up, he came to his father. And when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him and was moved with compassion and running to him fell upon his neck and kissed him.
text_la: Et surgens venit ad patrem suum. Cum autem adhuc longe esset, vidit illum pater ipsius, et misericordia motus est, et accurrens cecidit super collum ejus, et osculatus est eum.
text_pt: E, levantando-se, foi para seu pai; e, quando ainda estava longe, viu-o seu pai, e se moveu de íntima compaixão e, correndo, lançou-se-lhe ao pescoço e o beijou.
text_el: καὶ ἀναστὰς ἦλθεν πρὸς τὸν πατέρα ἑαυτοῦ. ἔτι δὲ αὐτοῦ μακρὰν ἀπέχοντος εἶδεν αὐτὸν ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐσπλαγχνίσθη, καὶ δραμὼν ἐπέπεσεν ἐπὶ τὸν τράχηλον αὐτοῦ καὶ κατεφίλησεν αὐτόν.

text_en: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son.
text_la: Dixitque ei filius : Pater, peccavi in cælum, et coram te : jam non sum dignus vocari filius tuus.
text_pt: E o filho lhe disse: Pai, pequei contra o céu e perante ti, e já não sou digno de ser chamado teu filho.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ υἱὸς αὐτῷ: πάτερ, ἥμαρτον εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ ἐνώπιόν σου, οὐκέτι εἰμὶ ἄξιος κληθῆναι υἱός σου. [ποίησόν με ὡς ἕνα τῶν μισθίων σου]{punk.}

text_en: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put {it} on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on {his} feet:
text_la: Dixit autem pater ad servos suos : Cito proferte stolam primam, et induite illum, et date annulum in manum ejus, et calceamenta in pedes ejus:
text_pt: Mas o pai disse aos seus servos: Trazei depressa a melhor roupa; e vesti-lho, e ponde-lhe um anel na mão, e alparcas nos pés;

text_en: And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill {it}; and let us eat, and be merry:
text_la: et adducite vitulum saginatum, et occidite, et manducemus, et epulemur:
text_pt: E trazei o bezerro cevado, e matai-o; e comamos, e alegremo-nos;

text_en: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.
text_la: quia hic filius meus mortuus erat, et revixit : perierat, et inventus est. Et cœperunt epulari.
text_pt: Porque este meu filho estava morto, e reviveu, tinha-se perdido, e foi achado. E começaram a alegrar-se.

text_en: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard musick and dancing.
text_la: Erat autem filius ejus senior in agro : et cum veniret, et appropinquaret domui, audivit symphoniam et chorum:
text_pt: E o seu filho mais velho estava no campo; e quando veio, e chegou perto de casa, ouviu a música e as danças.

text_en: And he called one of the servants, and asked what these things meant.
text_la: et vocavit unum de servis, et interrogavit quid hæc essent.
text_pt: E, chamando um dos servos, perguntou-lhe que era aquilo.

text_en: And he said unto him, Thy brother is come; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf, because he hath received him safe and sound.
text_la: Isque dixit illi : Frater tuus venit, et occidit pater tuus vitulum saginatum, quia salvum illum recepit.
text_pt: E ele lhe disse: Veio teu irmão; e teu pai matou o bezerro cevado, porque o recebeu são e salvo.

text_en: And he was angry, and would not go in: therefore came his father out, and intreated him.
text_la: Indignatus est autem, et nolebat introire. Pater ergo illius egressus, cœpit rogare illum.
text_pt: Mas ele se indignou, e não queria entrar.

text_en: And he answering said to {his} father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment: and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:
text_la: At ille respondens, dixit patri suo : Ecce tot annis servio tibi, et numquam mandatum tuum præterivi : et numquam dedisti mihi hædum ut cum amicis meis epularer.
text_pt: E saindo o pai, instava com ele. Mas, respondendo ele, disse ao pai: Eis que te sirvo há tantos anos, sem nunca transgredir o teu mandamento, e nunca me deste um cabrito para alegrar-me com os meus amigos;

text_en: But as soon as this thy son was come, which hath devoured thy living with harlots, thou hast killed for him the fatted calf.
text_la: Sed postquam filius tuus hic, qui devoravit substantiam suam cum meretricibus, venit, occidisti illi vitulum saginatum.
text_pt: Vindo, porém, este teu filho, que desperdiçou os teus bens com as meretrizes, mataste-lhe o bezerro cevado.

text_en: And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that I have is thine.
text_la: At ipse dixit illi : Fili, tu semper mecum es, et omnia mea tua sunt:
text_pt: E ele lhe disse: Filho, tu sempre estás comigo, e todas as minhas coisas são tuas;

text_en: It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.
text_la: epulari autem, et gaudere oportebat, quia frater tuus hic mortuus erat, et revixit; perierat, et inventus est.
text_pt: Mas era justo alegrarmo-nos e folgarmos, porque este teu irmão estava morto, e reviveu; e tinha-se perdido, e achou-se.

text_en: And he said also to his disciples : There was a certain rich man who had a steward: and the same was accused unto him, that he had wasted his goods.
text_la: Dicebat autem et ad discipulos suos : Homo quidam erat dives, qui habebat villicum : et hic diffamatus est apud illum quasi dissipasset bona ipsius.
text_pt: E dizia também aos seus discípulos: Havia um certo homem rico, o qual tinha um mordomo; e este foi acusado perante ele de dissipar os seus bens.
text_el: Ἔλεγεν δὲ καὶ πρὸς τοὺς μαθητάς: ἄνθρωπός τις ἦν πλούσιος ὃς εἶχεν οἰκονόμον, καὶ οὗτος διεβλήθη αὐτῷ ὡς διασκορπίζων τὰ ὑπάρχοντα αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And he called him and said to him: How is it that I hear this of you? Give an account of your stewardship: for now you can be steward no longer.
text_la: Et vocavit illum, et ait illi : Quid hoc audio de te? redde rationem villicationis tuæ : jam enim non poteris villicare.
text_pt: E ele, chamando-o, disse-lhe: Que é isto que ouço de ti? Dá contas da tua mordomia, porque já não poderás ser mais meu mordomo.
text_el: καὶ φωνήσας αὐτὸν εἶπεν αὐτῷ: τί τοῦτο ἀκούω περὶ σοῦ; ἀπόδος τὸν λόγον τῆς οἰκονομίας σου: οὐ γὰρ δύνῃ ἔτι οἰκονομεῖν.

text_en: And the steward said within himself: What shall I do, because my lord takes away from me the stewardship? To dig I am not able; to beg I am ashamed.
text_la: Ait autem villicus intra se : Quid faciam, quia dominus meus aufert a me villicationem? Fodere non valeo, mendicare erubesco.
text_pt: E o mordomo disse consigo: Que farei, pois que o meu senhor me tira a mordomia? Cavar, não posso; de mendigar, tenho vergonha.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ ἐν ἑαυτῷ ὁ οἰκονόμος: τί ποιήσω, ὅτι ὁ κύριός μου ἀφαιρεῖται τὴν οἰκονομίαν ἀπ' ἐμοῦ; σκάπτειν οὐκ ἰσχύω, ἐπαιτεῖν αἰσχύνομαι.

text_en: I know what I will do, that when I shall be removed from the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.
text_la: Scio quid faciam, ut, cum amotus fuero a villicatione, recipiant me in domos suas.
text_pt: Eu sei o que hei de fazer, para que, quando for desapossado da mordomia, me recebam em suas casas.
text_el: ἔγνων τί ποιήσω, ἵνα ὅταν μετασταθῶ ἐκ τῆς οἰκονομίας δέξωνταί με εἰς τοὺς οἴκους ἑαυτῶν.

text_en: Therefore, calling together every one of his lord's debtors, he said to the first: How much do you owe my lord?
text_la: Convocatis itaque singulis debitoribus domini sui, dicebat primo : Quantum debes domino meo?
text_pt: E, chamando a si cada um dos devedores do seu senhor, disse ao primeiro: Quanto deves ao meu senhor?
text_el: καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος ἕνα ἕκαστον τῶν χρεοφειλετῶν τοῦ κυρίου ἑαυτοῦ ἔλεγεν τῷ πρώτῳ: πόσον ὀφείλεις τῷ κυρίῳ μου;

text_en: But he said: An hundred barrels of oil. And he said to him: Take your bill and sit down quickly and write fifty.
text_la: At ille dixit : Centum cados olei. Dixitque illi : Accipe cautionem tuam : et sede cito, scribe quinquaginta.
text_pt: E ele respondeu: Cem medidas de azeite. E disse-lhe: Toma a tua obrigação, e assentando-te já, escreve cinqüenta.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν: ἑκατὸν βάτους ἐλαίου. ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῷ: δέξαι σου τὰ γράμματα καὶ καθίσας ταχέως γράψον πεντήκοντα.

text_en: Then he said to another: And how much do you owe? Who said: An hundred quarters of wheat. He said to him: Take your bill and write eighty.
text_la: Deinde alii dixit : Tu vero quantum debes? Qui ait : Centum coros tritici. Ait illi : Accipe litteras tuas, et scribe octoginta.
text_pt: Disse depois a outro: E tu, quanto deves? E ele respondeu: Cem alqueires de trigo. E disse-lhe: Toma a tua obrigação, e escreve oitenta.
text_el: ἔπειτα ἑτέρῳ εἶπεν: σὺ δὲ πόσον ὀφείλεις; ὁ δὲ εἶπεν: ἑκατὸν κόρους σίτου. λέγει αὐτῷ: δέξαι σου τὰ γράμματα καὶ γράψον ὀγδοήκοντα.

text_en: And the lord commended the unjust steward, forasmuch as he had done wisely: for the children of this world are wiser in their generation than the children of light.
text_la: Et laudavit dominus villicum iniquitatis, quia prudenter fecisset : quia filii hujus sæculi prudentiores filiis lucis in generatione sua sunt.
text_pt: E louvou aquele senhor o injusto mordomo por haver procedido prudentemente, porque os filhos deste mundo são mais prudentes na sua geração do que os filhos da luz.
text_el: καὶ ἐπῄνεσεν ὁ κύριος τὸν οἰκονόμον τῆς ἀδικίας ὅτι φρονίμως ἐποίησεν: ὅτι οἱ υἱοὶ τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου φρονιμώτεροι ὑπὲρ τοὺς υἱοὺς τοῦ φωτὸς εἰς τὴν γενεὰν τὴν ἑαυτῶν εἰσιν.

text_en: And I say to you: Make unto you friends of the mammon of iniquity : that when you shall fail, they may receive you into everlasting dwellings.
text_la: Et ego vobis dico : facite vobis amicos de mammona iniquitatis : ut, cum defeceritis, recipiant vos in æterna tabernacula.
text_pt: E eu vos digo: Granjeai amigos com as riquezas da injustiça; para que, quando estas vos faltarem, vos recebam eles nos tabernáculos eternos.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ ὑμῖν λέγω, ἑαυτοῖς ποιήσατε φίλους ἐκ τοῦ μαμωνᾶ τῆς ἀδικίας, ἵνα ὅταν ἐκλίπῃ δέξωνται ὑμᾶς εἰς τὰς αἰωνίους σκηνάς.

text_en: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in that which is greater: and he that is unjust in that which is little is unjust also in that which is greater.
text_la: Qui fidelis est in minimo, et in majori fidelis est : et qui in modico iniquus est, et in majori iniquus est.
text_pt: Quem é fiel no mínimo, também é fiel no muito; quem é injusto no mínimo, também é injusto no muito.
text_el: ὁ πιστὸς ἐν ἐλαχίστῳ καὶ ἐν πολλῷ πιστός ἐστιν, καὶ ὁ ἐν ἐλαχίστῳ ἄδικος καὶ ἐν πολλῷ ἄδικός ἐστιν.

text_en: If then you have not been faithful in the unjust mammon , who will trust you with that which is the true ?
text_la: Si ergo in iniquo mammona fideles non fuistis quod verum est, quis credet vobis?
text_pt: Pois, se nas riquezas injustas não fostes fiéis, quem vos confiará as verdadeiras?
text_el: εἰ οὖν ἐν τῷ ἀδίκῳ μαμωνᾷ πιστοὶ οὐκ ἐγένεσθε, τὸ ἀληθινὸν τίς ὑμῖν πιστεύσει;

text_en: And if you have not been faithful in that which is another's, who will give you that which is your own?
text_la: Et si in alieno fideles non fuistis, quod vestrum est, quis dabit vobis?
text_pt: E, se no alheio não fostes fiéis, quem vos dará o que é vosso?
text_el: καὶ εἰ ἐν τῷ ἀλλοτρίῳ πιστοὶ οὐκ ἐγένεσθε, τὸ ἡμέτερον τίς δώσει ὑμῖν;

text_en: No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one and love the other: or he will hold to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and mammon .
text_la: Nemo servus potest duobus dominis servire : aut enim unum odiet, et alterum diliget : aut uni adhærebit, et alterum contemnet. Non potestis Deo servire et mammonæ.
text_pt: Nenhum servo pode servir dois senhores; porque, ou há de odiar um e amar o outro, ou se há de chegar a um e desprezar o outro. Não podeis servir a Deus e a Mamom.
text_el: οὐδεὶς οἰκέτης δύναται δυσὶ κυρίοις δουλεύειν: ἢ γὰρ τὸν ἕνα μισήσει καὶ τὸν ἕτερον ἀγαπήσει, ἢ ἑνὸς ἀνθέξεται καὶ τοῦ ἑτέρου καταφρονήσει. οὐ δύνασθε θεῷ δουλεύειν καὶ μαμωνᾷ.

text_en: Now the Pharisees , who were covetous , heard all these things: and they derided him.
text_la: Audiebant autem omnia hæc pharisæi, qui erant avari : et deridebant illum.
text_pt: E os fariseus, que eram avarentos, ouviam todas estas coisas, e zombavam dele.
text_el: Ἤκουον δὲ ταῦτα πάντα οἱ Φαρισαῖοι φιλάργυροι ὑπάρχοντες, καὶ ἐξεμυκτήριζον αὐτόν.

text_en: And he said to them: you are they who justify yourselves before men , but God knows your hearts. For that which is high to men is an abomination before God .
text_la: Et ait illis : Vos estis qui justificatis vos coram hominibus : Deus autem novit corda vestra : quia quod hominibus altum est, abominatio est ante Deum.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Vós sois os que vos justificais a vós mesmos diante dos homens, mas Deus conhece os vossos corações, porque o que entre os homens é elevado, perante Deus é abominação.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: ὑμεῖς ἐστε οἱ δικαιοῦντες ἑαυτοὺς ἐνώπιον τῶν ἀνθρώπων, ὁ δὲ θεὸς γινώσκει τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν: ὅτι τὸ ἐν ἀνθρώποις ὑψηλὸν βδέλυγμα ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: The law and the prophets were until John . From that time the kingdom of God is preached: and every one uses violence towards it.
text_la: Lex et prophetæ usque ad Joannem : ex eo regnum Dei evangelizatur, et omnis in illud vim facit.
text_pt: A lei e os profetas duraram até João; desde então é anunciado o reino de Deus, e todo o homem emprega força para entrar nele.
text_el: ὁ νόμος καὶ οἱ προφῆται μέχρι Ἰωάννου: ἀπὸ τότε ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ εὐαγγελίζεται καὶ πᾶς εἰς αὐτὴν βιάζεται.

text_en: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass than one tittle of the law to fall.
text_la: Facilius est autem cælum et terram præterire, quam de lege unum apicem cadere.
text_pt: E é mais fácil passar o céu e a terra do que cair um til da lei.
text_el: εὐκοπώτερον δέ ἐστιν τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν παρελθεῖν ἢ τοῦ νόμου μίαν κεραίαν πεσεῖν.

text_en: Every one that puts away his wife and marries another commits adultery : and he that marries her that is put away from her husband commits adultery .
text_la: Omnis qui dimittit uxorem suam et alteram ducit, mœchatur : et qui dimissam a viro ducit, mœchatur.
text_pt: Qualquer que deixa sua mulher, e casa com outra, adultera; e aquele que casa com a repudiada pelo marido, adultera também.
text_el: πᾶς ὁ ἀπολύων τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ καὶ γαμῶν ἑτέραν μοιχεύει, καὶ ὁ ἀπολελυμένην ἀπὸ ἀνδρὸς γαμῶν μοιχεύει.

text_en: There was a certain rich man who was clothed in purple and fine linen and feasted sumptuously every day.
text_la: Homo quidam erat dives, qui induebatur purpura et bysso, et epulabatur quotidie splendide.
text_pt: Ora, havia um homem rico, e vestia-se de púrpura e de linho finíssimo, e vivia todos os dias regalada e esplendidamente.
text_el: Ἄνθρωπος δέ τις ἦν πλούσιος, καὶ ἐνεδιδύσκετο πορφύραν καὶ βύσσον εὐφραινόμενος καθ' ἡμέραν λαμπρῶς.

text_en: And there was a certain beggar, named Lazarus , who lay at his gate, full of sores,
text_la: Et erat quidam mendicus, nomine Lazarus, qui jacebat ad januam ejus, ulceribus plenus,
text_pt: Havia também um certo mendigo, chamado Lázaro, que jazia cheio de chagas à porta daquele;
text_el: πτωχὸς δέ τις ὀνόματι Λάζαρος ἐβέβλητο πρὸς τὸν πυλῶνα αὐτοῦ εἱλκωμένος

text_en: desiring to be filled with the crumbs that fell from the rich man's table. And no one did give him: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.
text_la: cupiens saturari de micis quæ cadebant de mensa divitis, et nemo illi dabat : sed et canes veniebant, et lingebant ulcera ejus.
text_pt: E desejava alimentar-se com as migalhas que caíam da mesa do rico; e os próprios cães vinham lamber-lhe as chagas.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιθυμῶν χορτασθῆναι ἀπὸ τῶν πιπτόντων ἀπὸ τῆς τραπέζης τοῦ πλουσίου: ἀλλὰ καὶ οἱ κύνες ἐρχόμενοι ἐπέλειχον τὰ ἕλκη αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And it came to pass that the beggar died and was carried by the angels into Abraham's bosom . And the rich man also died: and he was buried in hell.
text_la: Factum est autem ut moreretur mendicus, et portaretur ab angelis in sinum Abrahæ. Mortuus est autem et dives, et sepultus est in inferno.
text_pt: E aconteceu que o mendigo morreu, e foi levado pelos anjos para o seio de Abraão; e morreu também o rico, e foi sepultado.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἀποθανεῖν τὸν πτωχὸν καὶ ἀπενεχθῆναι αὐτὸν ὑπὸ τῶν ἀγγέλων εἰς τὸν κόλπον Ἀβραάμ: ἀπέθανεν δὲ καὶ ὁ πλούσιος καὶ ἐτάφη.

text_en: And lifting up his eyes when he was in torments, he saw Abraham afar off and Lazarus in his bosom :
text_la: Elevans autem oculos suos, cum esset in tormentis, vidit Abraham a longe, et Lazarum in sinu ejus:
text_pt: E no inferno, ergueu os olhos, estando em tormentos, e viu ao longe Abraão, e Lázaro no seu seio.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ ᾅδῃ ἐπάρας τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ, ὑπάρχων ἐν βασάνοις, ὁρᾷ Ἀβραὰμ ἀπὸ μακρόθεν καὶ Λάζαρον ἐν τοῖς κόλποις αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And he cried and said: Father Abraham , have mercy on me and send Lazarus , that he may dip the tip of his finger in water to cool my tongue: for I am tormented in this flame.
text_la: et ipse clamans dixit : Pater Abraham, miserere mei, et mitte Lazarum ut intingat extremum digiti sui in aquam, ut refrigeret linguam meam, quia crucior in hac flamma.
text_pt: E, clamando, disse: Pai Abraão, tem misericórdia de mim, e manda a Lázaro, que molhe na água a ponta do seu dedo e me refresque a língua, porque estou atormentado nesta chama.
text_el: καὶ αὐτὸς φωνήσας εἶπεν: πάτερ Ἀβραάμ, ἐλέησόν με καὶ πέμψον Λάζαρον ἵνα βάψῃ τὸ ἄκρον τοῦ δακτύλου αὐτοῦ ὕδατος καὶ καταψύξῃ τὴν γλῶσσάν μου, ὅτι ὀδυνῶμαι ἐν τῇ φλογὶ ταύτῃ.

text_en: And Abraham said to him: Son, remember that you received good things in your lifetime, and likewise Lazarus evil things: but now he is comforted and you are tormented.
text_la: Et dixit illi Abraham : Fili, recordare quia recepisti bona in vita tua, et Lazarus similiter mala : nunc autem hic consolatur, tu vero cruciaris:
text_pt: Disse, porém, Abraão: Filho, lembra-te de que recebeste os teus bens em tua vida, e Lázaro somente males; e agora este é consolado e tu atormentado.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ἀβραάμ: τέκνον, μνήσθητι ὅτι ἀπέλαβες τὰ ἀγαθά σου ἐν τῇ ζωῇ σου, καὶ Λάζαρος ὁμοίως τὰ κακά: νῦν δὲ ὧδε παρακαλεῖται, σὺ δὲ ὀδυνᾶσαι.

text_en: And besides all this, between us and you, there is fixed a great chaos: so that they who would pass from hence to you cannot, nor from thence come hither.
text_la: et in his omnibus inter nos et vos chaos magnum firmatum est : ut hi qui volunt hinc transire ad vos, non possint, neque inde huc transmeare.
text_pt: E, além disso, está posto um grande abismo entre nós e vós, de sorte que os que quisessem passar daqui para vós não poderiam, nem tampouco os de lá passar para cá.
text_el: καὶ ἐν πᾶσι τούτοις μεταξὺ ἡμῶν καὶ ὑμῶν χάσμα μέγα ἐστήρικται, ὅπως οἱ θέλοντες διαβῆναι ἔνθεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς μὴ δύνωνται, μηδὲ ἐκεῖθεν πρὸς ἡμᾶς διαπερῶσιν.

text_en: And he said: Then, father, I beseech you that you would send him to my father's house, for I have five brethren,
text_la: Et ait : Rogo ergo te, pater, ut mittas eum in domum patris mei:
text_pt: E disse ele: Rogo-te, pois, ó pai, que o mandes à casa de meu pai,
text_el: εἶπεν δέ: ἐρωτῶ σε οὖν, πάτερ, ἵνα πέμψῃς αὐτὸν εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ πατρός μου:

text_en: that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torments.
text_la: habeo enim quinque fratres : ut testetur illis, ne et ipsi veniant in hunc locum tormentorum.
text_pt: Pois tenho cinco irmãos; para que lhes dê testemunho, a fim de que não venham também para este lugar de tormento.
text_el: ἔχω γὰρ πέντε ἀδελφούς, ὅπως διαμαρτύρηται αὐτοῖς, ἵνα μὴ καὶ αὐτοὶ ἔλθωσιν εἰς τὸν τόπον τοῦτον τῆς βασάνου.

text_en: And Abraham said to him: They have Moses and the prophets . Let them hear them.
text_la: Et ait illi Abraham : Habent Moysen et prophetas : audiant illos.
text_pt: Disse-lhe Abraão: Têm Moisés e os profetas; ouçam-nos.
text_el: λέγει δὲ Ἀβραάμ: ἔχουσι Μωϋσέα καὶ τοὺς προφήτας: ἀκουσάτωσαν αὐτῶν.

text_en: But he said: No, father Abraham : but if one went to them from the dead, they will do penance .
text_la: At ille dixit : Non, pater Abraham : sed si quis ex mortuis ierit ad eos, pœnitentiam agent.
text_pt: E disse ele: Não, pai Abraão; mas, se algum dentre os mortos fosse ter com eles, arrepender-se-iam.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν: οὐχί, πάτερ Ἀβραάμ, ἀλλ' ἐάν τις ἀπὸ νεκρῶν πορευθῇ πρὸς αὐτοὺς, μετανοήσουσιν.

text_en: And he said to him: If they hear not Moses and the prophets , neither will they believe , if one rise again from the dead.
text_la: Ait autem illi : Si Moysen et prophetas non audiunt, neque si quis ex mortuis resurrexerit, credent.
text_pt: Porém, Abraão lhe disse: Se não ouvem a Moisés e aos profetas, tampouco acreditarão, ainda que algum dos mortos ressuscite.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ: εἰ Μωϋσέως καὶ τῶν προφητῶν οὐκ ἀκούουσιν, οὐδ' ἐάν τις ἐκ νεκρῶν ἀναστῇ πεισθήσονται.

text_en: And he said to his disciples : It is impossible that scandals should not come. But woe to him through whom they come!
text_la: Et ait ad discipulos suos : Impossibile est ut non veniant scandala : væ autem illi per quem veniunt.
text_pt: E disse aos discípulos: É impossível que não venham escândalos, mas ai daquele por quem vierem!
text_el: Εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ: ἀνένδεκτόν ἐστιν τοῦ τὰ σκάνδαλα μὴ ἐλθεῖν, πλὴν οὐαὶ δι' οὗ ἔρχεται:

text_en: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck and he cast into the sea, than that he should scandalize one of these little ones.
text_la: Utilius est illi si lapis molaris imponatur circa collum ejus, et projiciatur in mare quam ut scandalizet unum de pusillis istis.
text_pt: Melhor lhe fora que lhe pusessem ao pescoço uma mó de atafona, e fosse lançado ao mar, do que fazer tropeçar um destes pequenos.
text_el: λυσιτελεῖ αὐτῷ εἰ λίθος μυλικὸς περίκειται περὶ τὸν τράχηλον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔρριπται εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν, ἢ ἵνα σκανδαλίσῃ τῶν μικρῶν τούτων ἕνα.

text_en: Take heed to yourselves. If your brother sin against you, reprove him: and if he do penance , forgive him.
text_la: Attendite vobis : Si peccaverit in te frater tuus, increpa illum : et si pœnitentiam egerit, dimitte illi.
text_pt: Olhai por vós mesmos. E, se teu irmão pecar contra ti, repreende-o e, se ele se arrepender, perdoa-lhe.
text_el: προσέχετε ἑαυτοῖς. ἐὰν ἁμάρτῃ ὁ ἀδελφός σου, ἐπιτίμησον αὐτῷ, καὶ ἐὰν μετανοήσῃ, ἄφες αὐτῷ:

text_en: And if he sin against you seven times in a day, and seven times in a day be converted unto you, saying: I repent: forgive him.
text_la: Et si septies in die peccaverit in te, et septies in die conversus fuerit ad te, dicens : Pœnitet me, dimitte illi.
text_pt: E, se pecar contra ti sete vezes no dia, e sete vezes no dia vier ter contigo, dizendo: Arrependo-me; perdoa-lhe.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν ἑπτάκις τῆς ἡμέρας ἁμαρτήσῃ εἰς σὲ καὶ ἑπτάκις ἐπιστρέψῃ πρὸς σὲ λέγων: μετανοῶ, ἀφήσεις αὐτῷ.

text_en: And the apostles said to the Lord: Increase our faith .
text_la: Et dixerunt apostoli Domino : Adauge nobis fidem.
text_pt: Disseram então os apóstolos ao Senhor: Acrescenta-nos a fé.
text_el: Καὶ εἶπαν οἱ ἀπόστολοι τῷ κυρίῳ: πρόσθες ἡμῖν πίστιν.

text_en: And the Lord said: If you had faith like to a grain of mustard seed, you might say to this mulberry tree: Be rooted up and transplanted into the sea. And it would obey you.
text_la: Dixit autem Dominus : Si habueritis fidem sicut granum sinapis, dicetis huic arbori moro : Eradicare, et transplantare in mare, et obediet vobis.
text_pt: E disse o Senhor: Se tivésseis fé como um grão de mostarda, diríeis a esta amoreira: Desarraiga-te daqui, e planta-te no mar; e ela vos obedeceria.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ κύριος: εἰ ἔχετε πίστιν ὡς κόκκον σινάπεως, ἐλέγετε ἂν τῇ συκαμίνῳ ταύτῃ: ἐκριζώθητι καὶ φυτεύθητι ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ, καὶ ὑπήκουσεν ἂν ὑμῖν.

text_en: But which of you, having a servant ploughing or feeding cattle, will say to him, when he has come from the field: Immediately go. Sit down to meat.
text_la: Quis autem vestrum habens servum arantem aut pascentem, qui regresso de agro dicat illi : Statim transi, recumbe:
text_pt: E qual de vós terá um servo a lavrar ou a apascentar gado, a quem, voltando ele do campo, diga: Chega-te, e assenta-te à mesa?
text_el: Τίς δὲ ἐξ ὑμῶν δοῦλον ἔχων ἀροτριῶντα ἢ ποιμαίνοντα, ὃς εἰσελθόντι ἐκ τοῦ ἀγροῦ ἐρεῖ αὐτῷ: εὐθέως παρελθὼν ἀνάπεσε;

text_en: And will not rather say to him: Make ready my supper and gird yourself and serve me, whilst I eat and drink; and afterwards you shall eat and drink?
text_la: et non dicat ei : Para quod cœnem, et præcinge te, et ministra mihi donec manducem, et bibam, et post hæc tu manducabis, et bibes?
text_pt: E não lhe diga antes: Prepara-me a ceia, e cinge-te, e serve-me até que tenha comido e bebido, e depois comerás e beberás tu?
text_el: ἀλλ' οὐχὶ ἐρεῖ αὐτῷ: ἑτοίμασον τί δειπνήσω, καὶ περιζωσάμενος διακόνει μοι ἕως φάγω καὶ πίω, καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα φάγεσαι καὶ πίεσαι σύ;

text_en: Does he thank that servant for doing the things which he commanded him?
text_la: Numquid gratiam habet servo illi, quia fecit quæ ei imperaverat?
text_pt: Porventura dá graças ao tal servo, porque fez o que lhe foi mandado? Creio que não.
text_el: μὴ ἔχει χάριν τῷ δούλῳ ὅτι ἐποίησεν τὰ διαταχθέντα;

text_en: I think not. So you also, when you shall have done all these things that are commanded you, say: We are unprofitable servants; we have done that which we ought to do.
text_la: non puto. Sic et vos cum feceritis omnia quæ præcepta sunt vobis, dicite : Servi inutiles sumus : quod debuimus facere, fecimus.
text_pt: Assim também vós, quando fizerdes tudo o que vos for mandado, dizei: Somos servos inúteis, porque fizemos somente o que devíamos fazer.
text_el: οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς, ὅταν ποιήσητε πάντα τὰ διαταχθέντα ὑμῖν, λέγετε ὅτι δοῦλοι ἀχρεῖοί ἐσμεν, ὃ ὠφείλομεν ποιῆσαι πεποιήκαμεν.

text_en: And it came to pass, as he was going to Jerusalem , he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee .
text_la: Et factum est, dum iret in Jerusalem, transibat per mediam Samariam et Galilæam.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, indo ele a Jerusalém, passou pelo meio de Samaria e da Galiléia;
text_el: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ πορεύεσθαι εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ καὶ αὐτὸς διήρχετο διὰ μέσον Σαμαρείας καὶ Γαλιλαίας.

text_en: And as he entered into a certain town, there met him ten men that were lepers , who stood afar off.
text_la: Et cum ingrederetur quoddam castellum, occurrerunt ei decem viri leprosi, qui steterunt a longe:
text_pt: E, entrando numa certa aldeia, saíram-lhe ao encontro dez homens leprosos, os quais pararam de longe;
text_el: καὶ εἰσερχομένου αὐτοῦ εἴς τινα κώμην ἀπήντησαν δέκα λεπροὶ ἄνδρες, οἳ ἀνέστησαν πόρρωθεν,

text_en: And lifted up their voice, saying: Jesus , Master, have mercy on us.
text_la: et levaverunt vocem, dicentes : Jesu præceptor, miserere nostri.
text_pt: E levantaram a voz, dizendo: Jesus, Mestre, tem misericórdia de nós.
text_el: καὶ αὐτοὶ ἦραν φωνὴν λέγοντες: Ἰησοῦ ἐπιστάτα, ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς.

text_en: Whom when he saw, he said: Go, show yourselves to the priests . And it came to pass, as they went, they were made clean.
text_la: Quos ut vidit, dixit : Ite, ostendite vos sacerdotibus. Et factum est, dum irent, mundati sunt.
text_pt: E ele, vendo-os, disse-lhes: Ide, e mostrai-vos aos sacerdotes. E aconteceu que, indo eles, ficaram limpos.
text_el: καὶ ἰδὼν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: πορευθέντες ἐπιδείξατε ἑαυτοὺς τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν. καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ὑπάγειν αὐτοὺς ἐκαθαρίσθησαν.

text_en: And one of them, when he saw that he was made clean, went back, with a loud voice glorifying God .
text_la: Unus autem ex illis, ut vidit quia mundatus est, regressus est, cum magna voce magnificans Deum,
text_pt: E um deles, vendo que estava são, voltou glorificando a Deus em alta voz;
text_el: εἷς δὲ ἐξ αὐτῶν, ἰδὼν ὅτι ἰάθη, ὑπέστρεψεν μετὰ φωνῆς μεγάλης δοξάζων τὸν θεόν,

text_en: And he fell on his face before his feet, giving thanks. And this was a Samaritan .
text_la: et cecidit in faciem ante pedes ejus, gratias agens : et hic erat Samaritanus.
text_pt: E caiu aos seus pés, com o rosto em terra, dando-lhe graças; e este era samaritano.
text_el: καὶ ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον παρὰ τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ εὐχαριστῶν αὐτῷ: καὶ αὐτὸς ἦν Σαμαρίτης.

text_en: And Jesus answering, said: Were not ten made clean? And where are the nine?
text_la: Respondens autem Jesus, dixit : Nonne decem mundati sunt? et novem ubi sunt?
text_pt: E, respondendo Jesus, disse: Não foram dez os limpos? E onde estão os nove?
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν: οὐχ οἱ δέκα ἐκαθαρίσθησαν; οἱ [δὲ] ἐννέα ποῦ;

text_en: There is no one found to return and give glory to God , but this stranger.
text_la: Non est inventus qui rediret, et daret gloriam Deo, nisi hic alienigena.
text_pt: Não houve quem voltasse para dar glória a Deus senão este estrangeiro?
text_el: οὐχ εὑρέθησαν ὑποστρέψαντες δοῦναι δόξαν τῷ θεῷ εἰ μὴ ὁ ἀλλογενὴς οὗτος;

text_en: And he said to him: Arise, go your way; for your faith has made you whole.
text_la: Et ait illi : Surge, vade : quia fides tua te salvum fecit.
text_pt: E disse-lhe: Levanta-te, e vai; a tua fé te salvou.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ: ἀναστὰς πορεύου: ἡ πίστις σου σέσωκέν σε.

text_en: And being asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God should come, he answering them and said: The kingdom of God comes not with observation.
text_la: Interrogatus autem a pharisæis : Quando venit regnum Dei? respondens eis, dixit : Non venit regnum Dei cum observatione:
text_pt: E, interrogado pelos fariseus sobre quando havia de vir o reino de Deus, respondeu-lhes, e disse: O reino de Deus não vem com aparência exterior.
text_el: Ἐπερωτηθεὶς δὲ ὑπὸ τῶν Φαρισαίων πότε ἔρχεται ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ, ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς καὶ εἶπεν: οὐκ ἔρχεται ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ μετὰ παρατηρήσεως,

text_en: Neither shall they say: Behold here, or behold there. For lo, the kingdom of God is within you.
text_la: neque dicent : Ecce hic, aut ecce illic. Ecce enim regnum Dei intra vos est.
text_pt: Nem dirão: Ei-lo aqui, ou: Ei-lo ali; porque eis que o reino de Deus está entre vós.
text_el: οὐδὲ ἐροῦσιν: ἰδοὺ ὧδε ἤ, ἐκεῖ: ἰδοὺ γὰρ ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ ἐντὸς ὑμῶν ἐστιν.

text_en: And he said to his disciples : The days will come when you shall desire to see one day of the Son of man . And you shall not see it.
text_la: Et ait ad discipulos suos : Venient dies quando desideretis videre unum diem Filii hominis, et non videbitis.
text_pt: E disse aos discípulos: Dias virão em que desejareis ver um dos dias do Filho do homem, e não o vereis.
text_el: Εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς τοὺς μαθητάς: ἐλεύσονται: ἡμέραι ὅτε ἐπιθυμήσετε μίαν τῶν ἡμερῶν τοῦ υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἰδεῖν, καὶ οὐκ ὄψεσθε.

text_en: And they will say to you: See here, and see there. Go not after, nor follow them.
text_la: Et dicent vobis : Ecce hic, et ecce illic. Nolite ire, neque sectemini:
text_pt: E dir-vos-ão: Ei-lo aqui, ou: Ei-lo ali. Não vades, nem os sigais;
text_el: καὶ ἐροῦσιν ὑμῖν: ἰδοὺ ἐκεῖ, ἤ ἰδοὺ ὧδε: μὴ [ἀπέλθητε μηδὲ] διώξητε.

text_en: For as the lightning that lightens from under heaven shines unto the parts that are under heaven , so shall the Son of man be in his day.
text_la: nam, sicut fulgur coruscans de sub cælo in ea quæ sub cælo sunt, fulget : ita erit Filius hominis in die sua.
text_pt: Porque, como o relâmpago ilumina desde uma extremidade inferior do céu até à outra extremidade, assim será também o Filho do homem no seu dia.
text_el: ὥσπερ γὰρ ἡ ἀστραπὴ ἀστράπτουσα ἐκ τῆς ὑπὸ τὸν οὐρανὸν εἰς τὴν ὑπ' οὐρανὸν λάμπει, οὕτως ἔσται ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου

text_en: But first he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation .
text_la: Primum autem oportet illum multa pati, et reprobari a generatione hac.
text_pt: Mas primeiro convém que ele padeça muito, e seja reprovado por esta geração.
text_el: πρῶτον δὲ δεῖ αὐτὸν πολλὰ παθεῖν καὶ ἀποδοκιμασθῆναι ἀπὸ τῆς γενεᾶς ταύτης.

text_en: And as it came to pass in the days of Noe , so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man .
text_la: Et sicut factum est in diebus Noë, ita erit et in diebus Filii hominis:
text_pt: E, como aconteceu nos dias de Noé, assim será também nos dias do Filho do homem.
text_el: καὶ καθὼς ἐγένετο ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Νῶε, οὕτως ἔσται καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις τοῦ υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου:

text_en: They ate and drank, they married wives and were given in marriage , until the day that Noe entered into the ark and the flood came and destroyed them all.
text_la: edebant et bibebant : uxores ducebant et dabantur ad nuptias, usque in diem, qua intravit Noë in arcam : et venit diluvium, et perdidit omnes.
text_pt: Comiam, bebiam, casavam, e davam-se em casamento, até ao dia em que Noé entrou na arca, e veio o dilúvio, e os consumiu a todos.
text_el: ἤσθιον, ἔπινον, ἐγάμουν, ἐγαμίζοντο, ἄχρι ἧς ἡμέρας εἰσῆλθεν Νῶε εἰς τὴν κιβωτόν, καὶ ἦλθεν ὁ κατακλυσμὸς καὶ ἀπώλεσεν πάντας.

text_en: Likewise as it came to pass in the days of Lot . They ate and drank, they bought and sold, they planted and built.
text_la: Similiter sicut factum est in diebus Lot : edebant et bibebant, emebant et vendebant, plantabant et ædificabant:
text_pt: Como também da mesma maneira aconteceu nos dias de Ló: Comiam, bebiam, compravam, vendiam, plantavam e edificavam;
text_el: ὁμοίως καθὼς ἐγένετο ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Λώτ: ἤσθιον, ἔπινον, ἠγόραζον, ἐπώλουν, ἐφύτευον, ᾠκοδόμουν:

text_en: And in the day that Lot went out of Sodom , it rained fire and brimstone from heaven and destroyed them all.
text_la: qua die autem exiit Lot a Sodomis, pluit ignem et sulphur de cælo, et omnes perdidit:
text_pt: Mas no dia em que Ló saiu de Sodoma choveu do céu fogo e enxofre, e os consumiu a todos.
text_el: ᾗ δὲ ἡμέρᾳ ἐξῆλθεν Λὼτ ἀπὸ Σοδόμων, ἔβρεξεν πῦρ καὶ θεῖον ἀπ' οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἀπώλεσεν πάντας.

text_en: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man shall be revealed.
text_la: secundum hæc erit qua die Filius hominis revelabitur.
text_pt: Assim será no dia em que o Filho do homem se há de manifestar.
text_el: κατὰ τὰ αὐτὰ ἔσται ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἀποκαλύπτεται.

text_en: In that hour, he that shall be on the housetop, and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away: and he that shall be in the field, in like manner, let him not return back.
text_la: In illa hora, qui fuerit in tecto, et vasa ejus in domo, ne descendat tollere illa : et qui in agro, similiter non redeat retro.
text_pt: Naquele dia, quem estiver no telhado, tendo as suas alfaias em casa, não desça a tomá-las; e, da mesma sorte, o que estiver no campo não volte para trás.
text_el: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ὃς ἔσται ἐπὶ τοῦ δώματος καὶ τὰ σκεύη αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ, μὴ καταβάτω ἆραι αὐτά, καὶ ὁ ἐν ἀγρῷ ὁμοίως μὴ ἐπιστρεψάτω εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω.

text_en: Remember Lot's wife.
text_la: Memores estote uxoris Lot.
text_pt: Lembrai-vos da mulher de Ló.
text_el: μνημονεύετε τῆς γυναικὸς Λώτ.

text_en: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it: and whosoever shall lose it shall preserve it.
text_la: Quicumque quæsierit animam suam salvam facere, perdet illam : et quicumque perdiderit illam, vivificabit eam.
text_pt: Qualquer que procurar salvar a sua vida, perdê-la-á, e qualquer que a perder, salvá-la-á.
text_el: ὃς ἐὰν ζητήσῃ τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ περιποιήσασθαι, ἀπολέσει αὐτήν, ὃς δ' ἂν ἀπολέσει, ζῳογονήσει αὐτήν.

text_en: I say to you: In that night there shall be two men in one bed. The one shall be taken and the other shall be left.
text_la: Dico vobis : In illa nocte erunt duo in lecto uno : unus assumetur, et alter relinquetur:
text_pt: Digo-vos que naquela noite estarão dois numa cama; um será tomado, e outro será deixado.
text_el: λέγω ὑμῖν, ταύτῃ τῇ νυκτὶ ἔσονται δύο ἐπὶ κλίνης [μιᾶς], ὁ εἷς παραλημφθήσεται καὶ ὁ ἕτερος ἀφεθήσεται:

text_en: Two women shall be grinding together. The one shall be taken and the other shall be left.
text_la: duæ erunt molentes in unum : una assumetur, et altera relinquetur:
text_pt: Duas estarão juntas, moendo; uma será tomada, e outra será deixada.
text_el: ἔσονται δύο ἀλήθουσαι ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό, ἡ μία παραλημφθήσεται ἡ δὲ ἑτέρα ἀφεθήσεται.

text_en: Two men shall be in the field. The one shall be taken and the other shall be left.
text_la: duo in agro : unus assumetur, et alter relinquetur.
text_pt: Dois estarão no campo; um será tomado, e o outro será deixado.

text_en: They answering, say to him: Where, Lord? Who said to them: Wheresoever the body shall be, thither will the eagles also be gathered together.
text_la: Respondentes dicunt illi : Ubi Domine? Qui dixit illis : Ubicumque fuerit corpus, illuc congregabuntur et aquilæ.
text_pt: E, respondendo, disseram-lhe: Onde, Senhor? E ele lhes disse: Onde estiver o corpo, aí se ajuntarão as águias.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθέντες λέγουσιν αὐτῷ: ποῦ, κύριε; ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: ὅπου τὸ σῶμα, ἐκεῖ καὶ οἱ ἀετοὶ ἐπισυναχθήσονται.

text_en: And he spoke also a parable to them, that we ought always to pray and not to faint,
text_la: Dicebat autem et parabolam ad illos, quoniam oportet semper orare et non deficere,
text_pt: E contou-lhes também uma parábola sobre o dever de orar sempre, e nunca desfalecer,
text_el: Ἔλεγεν δὲ παραβολὴν αὐτοῖς πρὸς τὸ δεῖν πάντοτε προσεύχεσθαι αὐτοὺς καὶ μὴ ἐγκακεῖν,

text_en: saying: There was a judge in a certain city, who feared not God nor regarded man .
text_la: dicens : Judex quidam erat in quadam civitate, qui Deum non timebat, et hominem non reverebatur.
text_pt: Dizendo: Havia numa cidade um certo juiz, que nem a Deus temia, nem respeitava o homem.
text_el: λέγων: κριτής τις ἦν ἔν τινι πόλει τὸν θεὸν μὴ φοβούμενος καὶ ἄνθρωπον μὴ ἐντρεπόμενος.

text_en: And there was a certain widow in that city; and she came to him, saying: Avenge me of my adversary.
text_la: Vidua autem quædam erat in civitate illa, et veniebat ad eum, dicens : Vindica me de adversario meo.
text_pt: Havia também, naquela mesma cidade, uma certa viúva, que ia ter com ele, dizendo: Faze-me justiça contra o meu adversário.
text_el: χήρα δὲ ἦν ἐν τῇ πόλει ἐκείνῃ, καὶ ἤρχετο πρὸς αὐτὸν λέγουσα: ἐκδίκησόν με ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀντιδίκου μου.

text_en: And he would not for a long time. But afterwards he said within himself: Although I fear not God nor regard man ,
text_la: Et nolebat per multum tempus. Post hæc autem dixit intra se : Etsi Deum non timeo, nec hominem revereor:
text_pt: E por algum tempo não quis atendê-la; mas depois disse consigo: Ainda que não temo a Deus, nem respeito os homens,
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἤθελεν ἐπὶ χρόνον: μετὰ ταῦτα δὲ εἶπεν ἐν ἑαυτῷ: εἰ καὶ τὸν θεὸν οὐ φοβοῦμαι οὐδὲ ἄνθρωπον ἐντρέπομαι,

text_en: yet because this widow is troublesome to me, I will avenge her, lest continually coming she weary me.
text_la: tamen quia molesta est mihi hæc vidua, vindicabo illam, ne in novissimo veniens sugillet me.
text_pt: Todavia, como esta viúva me molesta, hei de fazer-lhe justiça, para que enfim não volte, e me importune muito.
text_el: διά γε τὸ παρέχειν μοι κόπον τὴν χήραν ταύτην, ἐκδικήσω αὐτήν, ἵνα μὴ εἰς τέλος ἐρχομένη ὑπωπιάζῃ με.

text_en: And the Lord said: Hear what the unjust judge says.
text_la: Ait autem Dominus : Audite quid judex iniquitatis dicit:
text_pt: E disse o Senhor: Ouvi o que diz o injusto juiz.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ κύριος, ἀκούσατε τί ὁ κριτὴς τῆς ἀδικίας λέγει:

text_en: And will not God revenge his elect who cry to him day and night? And will he have patience in their regard?
text_la: Deus autem non faciet vindictam electorum suorum clamantium ad se die ac nocte, et patientiam habebit in illis?
text_pt: E Deus não fará justiça aos seus escolhidos, que clamam a ele de dia e de noite, ainda que tardio para com eles?
text_el: ὁ δὲ θεὸς οὐ μὴ ποιήσῃ τὴν ἐκδίκησιν τῶν ἐκλεκτῶν αὐτοῦ τῶν βοώντων αὐτῷ ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτός, καὶ μακροθυμεῖ ἐπ' αὐτοῖς;

text_en: I say to you that he will quickly revenge them. But yet the Son of man , when he comes, shall he find, think you, faith on earth?
text_la: Dico vobis quia cito faciet vindictam illorum. Verumtamen Filius hominis veniens, putas, inveniet fidem in terra?
text_pt: Digo-vos que depressa lhes fará justiça. Quando porém vier o Filho do homem, porventura achará fé na terra?
text_el: λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ποιήσει τὴν ἐκδίκησιν αὐτῶν ἐν τάχει. πλὴν ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐλθὼν ἆρα εὑρήσει τὴν πίστιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς;

text_en: And to some who trusted in themselves as just and despised others, he spoke also this parable :
text_la: Dixit autem et ad quosdam qui in se confidebant tamquam justi, et aspernabantur ceteros, parabolam istam:
text_pt: E disse também esta parábola a uns que confiavam em si mesmos, crendo que eram justos, e desprezavam os outros:
text_el: Εἶπεν δὲ καὶ πρός τινας τοὺς πεποιθότας ἐφ' ἑαυτοῖς ὅτι εἰσὶν δίκαιοι καὶ ἐξουθενοῦντας τοὺς λοιποὺς τὴν παραβολὴν ταύτην:

text_en: Two men went up into the temple to pray : the one a Pharisee and the other a publican .
text_la: Duo homines ascenderunt in templum ut orarent : unus pharisæus et alter publicanus.
text_pt: Dois homens subiram ao templo, para orar; um, fariseu, e o outro, publicano.
text_el: Ἄνθρωποι δύο ἀνέβησαν εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν προσεύξασθαι, εἷς Φαρισαῖος καὶ ὁ ἕτερος τελώνης.

text_en: The Pharisee standing, prayed thus with himself: O God , I give you thanks that I am not as the rest of men , extortioners, unjust , adulterers , as also is this publican .
text_la: Pharisæus stans, hæc apud se orabat : Deus, gratias ago tibi, quia non sum sicut ceteri hominum : raptores, injusti, adulteri, velut etiam hic publicanus:
text_pt: O fariseu, estando em pé, orava consigo desta maneira: Ó Deus, graças te dou porque não sou como os demais homens, roubadores, injustos e adúlteros; nem ainda como este publicano.
text_el: ὁ Φαρισαῖος σταθεὶς ταῦτα πρὸς ἑαυτὸν προσηύχετο: ὁ θεός, εὐχαριστῶ σοι ὅτι οὐκ εἰμὶ ὥσπερ οἱ λοιποὶ τῶν ἀνθρώπων, ἅρπαγες, ἄδικοι, μοιχοί, ἢ καὶ ὡς οὗτος ὁ τελώνης:

text_en: I fast twice in a week: I give tithes of all that I possess.
text_la: jejuno bis in sabbato, decimas do omnium quæ possideo.
text_pt: Jejuo duas vezes na semana, e dou os dízimos de tudo quanto possuo.
text_el: νηστεύω δὶς τοῦ σαββάτου, ἀποδεκατεύω πάντα ὅσα κτῶμαι.

text_en: And the publican , standing afar off, would not so much as lift up his eyes towards heaven ; but struck his breast , saying: O God , be merciful to me a sinner.
text_la: Et publicanus a longe stans, nolebat nec oculos ad cælum levare : sed percutiebat pectus suum, dicens : Deus propitius esto mihi peccatori.
text_pt: O publicano, porém, estando em pé, de longe, nem ainda queria levantar os olhos ao céu, mas batia no peito, dizendo: Ó Deus, tem misericórdia de mim, pecador!
text_el: ὁ δὲ τελώνης μακρόθεν ἑστὼς οὐκ ἤθελεν οὐδὲ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ἐπᾶραι εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν, ἀλλ' ἔτυπτεν τὸ στῆθος ἑαυτοῦ λέγων: ὁ θεός, ἱλάσθητί μοι τῷ ἁμαρτωλῷ.

text_en: I say to you, this man went down into his house justified rather than the other: because every one that exalts himself shall be humbled : and he that humbles himself shall be exalted.
text_la: Dico vobis, descendit hic justificatus in domum suam ab illo : quia omnis qui se exaltat, humiliabitur, et qui se humiliat, exaltabitur.
text_pt: Digo-vos que este desceu justificado para sua casa, e não aquele; porque qualquer que a si mesmo se exalta será humilhado, e qualquer que a si mesmo se humilha será exaltado.
text_el: λέγω ὑμῖν, κατέβη οὗτος δεδικαιωμένος εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ παρ' ἐκεῖνον: ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ὑψῶν ἑαυτὸν ταπεινωθήσεται, ὁ δὲ ταπεινῶν ἑαυτὸν ὑψωθήσεται.

text_en: And they brought unto him also infants, that he might touch them. Which when the disciples saw, they rebuked them.
text_la: Afferebant autem ad illum et infantes, ut eos tangeret. Quod cum viderent discipuli, increpabant illos.
text_pt: E traziam-lhe também meninos, para que ele lhes tocasse; e os discípulos, vendo isto, repreendiam-nos.
text_el: Προσέφερον δὲ αὐτῷ καὶ τὰ βρέφη ἵνα αὐτῶν ἅπτηται: ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἐπετίμων αὐτοῖς.

text_en: But Jesus , calling them together, said: Suffer children to come to me and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God .
text_la: Jesus autem convocans illos, dixit : Sinite pueros venire ad me, et nolite vetare eos : talium est enim regnum Dei.
text_pt: Mas Jesus, chamando-os para si, disse: Deixai vir a mim os meninos, e não os impeçais, porque dos tais é o reino de Deus.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς προσεκαλέσατο [αὐτὰ] λέγων: ἄφετε τὰ παιδία ἔρχεσθαι πρός με καὶ μὴ κωλύετε αὐτά: τῶν γὰρ τοιούτων ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: Amen , I say to you: Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a child shall not enter into it.
text_la: Amen dico vobis, quicumque non acceperit regnum Dei sicut puer, non intrabit in illud.
text_pt: Em verdade vos digo que, qualquer que não receber o reino de Deus como menino, não entrará nele.
text_el: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὃς ἂν μὴ δέξηται τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ ὡς παιδίον, οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθῃ εἰς αὐτήν.

text_en: And a certain ruler asked him, saying: Good master, what shall I do to possess everlasting life?
text_la: Et interrogavit eum quidam princeps, dicens : Magister bone, quid faciens vitam æternam possidebo?
text_pt: E perguntou-lhe um certo príncipe, dizendo: Bom Mestre, que hei de fazer para herdar a vida eterna?
text_el: Καὶ ἐπηρώτησέν τις αὐτὸν ἄρχων λέγων: διδάσκαλε ἀγαθέ, τί ποιήσας ζωὴν αἰώνιον κληρονομήσω;

text_en: And Jesus said to him: Why do you call me good ? None is good but God alone.
text_la: Dixit autem ei Jesus : Quid me dicis bonum? nemo bonus nisi solus Deus.
text_pt: Jesus lhe disse: Por que me chamas bom? Ninguém há bom, senão um, que é Deus.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς: τί με λέγεις ἀγαθόν; οὐδεὶς ἀγαθὸς εἰ μὴ εἷς [ὁ] θεός.

text_en: You know the commandments: You shall not kill. You shall not commit adultery : You shall not steal: You shall not bear false witness: Honour your father and mother.
text_la: Mandata nosti : non occides; non mœchaberis; non furtum facies; non falsum testimonium dices; honora patrem tuum et matrem.
text_pt: Sabes os mandamentos: Não adulterarás, não matarás, não furtarás, não dirás falso testemunho, honra a teu pai e a tua mãe.
text_el: τὰς ἐντολὰς οἶδας: μὴ μοιχεύσῃς, μὴ φονεύσῃς, μὴ κλέψῃς, μὴ ψευδομαρτυρήσῃς, τίμα τὸν πατέρα σου καὶ τὴν μητέρα.

text_en: Who said: All these things have I kept from my youth.
text_la: Qui ait : Hæc omnia custodivi a juventute mea.
text_pt: E disse ele: Todas essas coisas tenho observado desde a minha mocidade.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν: ταῦτα πάντα ἐφύλαξα ἐκ νεότητος.

text_en: Which when Jesus had heard, he said to him: Yet one thing is wanting to you. Sell all whatever you have and give to the poor: and you shall have treasure in heaven . And come, follow me.
text_la: Quo audito, Jesus ait ei : Adhuc unum tibi deest : omnia quæcumque habes vende, et da pauperibus, et habebis thesaurum in cælo : et veni, sequere me.
text_pt: E quando Jesus ouviu isto, disse-lhe: Ainda te falta uma coisa; vende tudo quanto tens, reparte-o pelos pobres, e terás um tesouro no céu; vem, e segue-me.
text_el: ἀκούσας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ: ἔτι ἕν σοι λείπει: πάντα ὅσα ἔχεις πώλησον καὶ διάδος πτωχοῖς, καὶ ἕξεις θησαυρὸν ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς, καὶ δεῦρο ἀκολούθει μοι.

text_en: He having heard these things, became sorrowful: for he was very rich.
text_la: His ille auditis, contristatus est : quia dives erat valde.
text_pt: Mas, ouvindo ele isto, ficou muito triste, porque era muito rico.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀκούσας ταῦτα περίλυπος ἐγενήθη, ἦν γὰρ πλούσιος σφόδρα.

text_en: And Jesus seeing him become sorrowful, said: How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God :
text_la: Videns autem Jesus illum tristem factum, dixit : Quam difficile, qui pecunias habent, in regnum Dei intrabunt!
text_pt: E, vendo Jesus que ele ficara muito triste, disse: Quão dificilmente entrarão no reino de Deus os que têm riquezas!
text_el: ἰδὼν δὲ αὐτὸν [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν: πῶς δυσκόλως οἱ τὰ χρήματα ἔχοντες εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ εἰσπορεύονται:

text_en: For it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God .
text_la: facilius est enim camelum per foramen acus transire quam divitem intrare in regnum Dei.
text_pt: Porque é mais fácil entrar um camelo pelo fundo de uma agulha do que entrar um rico no reino de Deus.
text_el: εὐκοπώτερον γάρ ἐστιν κάμηλον διὰ τρήματος βελόνης εἰσελθεῖν ἢ πλούσιον εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ εἰσελθεῖν.

text_en: And they that heard it said: Who then can be saved?
text_la: Et dixerunt qui audiebant : Et quis potest salvus fieri?
text_pt: E os que ouviram isto disseram: Logo quem pode salvar-se?
text_el: εἶπαν δὲ οἱ ἀκούσαντες: καὶ τίς δύναται σωθῆναι;

text_en: He said to them: The things that are impossible with men are possible with God .
text_la: Ait illis : Quæ impossibilia sunt apud homines, possibilia sunt apud Deum.
text_pt: Mas ele respondeu: As coisas que são impossíveis aos homens são possíveis a Deus.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν: τὰ ἀδύνατα παρὰ ἀνθρώποις δυνατὰ παρὰ τῷ θεῷ ἐστιν.

text_en: Then Peter said: Behold, we have left all things and have followed you.
text_la: Ait autem Petrus: Ecce nos dimisimus omnia et secuti sumus te.
text_pt: E disse Pedro: Eis que nós deixamos tudo e te seguimos.
text_el: Εἶπεν δὲ ὁ Πέτρος: ἰδοὺ ἡμεῖς ἀφέντες τὰ ἴδια ἠκολουθήσαμέν σοι.

text_en: Who said to them: Amen , I say to you, there is no man that has left home or parents or brethren or wife or children, for the kingdom of God's sake,
text_la: Qui dixit eis : Amen dico vobis, nemo est qui reliquit domum, aut parentes, aut fratres, aut uxorem, aut filios propter regnum Dei,
text_pt: E ele lhes disse: Na verdade vos digo que ninguém há, que tenha deixado casa, ou pais, ou irmãos, ou mulher, ou filhos, pelo reino de Deus,
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὅτι οὐδείς ἐστιν ὃς ἀφῆκεν οἰκίαν ἢ γυναῖκα ἢ ἀδελφοὺς ἢ γονεῖς ἢ τέκνα ἕνεκεν τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ θεοῦ,

text_en: who shall not receive much more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.
text_la: et non recipiat multo plura in hoc tempore, et in sæculo venturo vitam æternam.
text_pt: Que não haja de receber muito mais neste mundo, e na idade vindoura a vida eterna.
text_el: ὃς οὐχὶ μὴ λάβῃ πολλαπλασίονα ἐν τῷ καιρῷ τούτῳ, καὶ ἐν τῷ αἰῶνι τῷ ἐρχομένῳ ζωὴν αἰώνιον.

text_en: Then Jesus took unto him the twelve and said to them: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem ; and all things shall be accomplished which were written by the prophets concerning the Son of man .
text_la: Assumpsit autem Jesus duodecim, et ait illis : Ecce ascendimus Jerosolymam, et consummabuntur omnia quæ scripta sunt per prophetas de Filio hominis:
text_pt: E, tomando consigo os doze, disse-lhes: Eis que subimos a Jerusalém, e se cumprirá no Filho do homem tudo o que pelos profetas foi escrito;
text_el: Παραλαβὼν δὲ τοὺς δώδεκα εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς: ἰδοὺ ἀναβαίνομεν εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ, καὶ τελεσθήσεται πάντα τὰ γεγραμμένα διὰ τῶν προφητῶν τῷ υἱῷ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου:

text_en: For he shall be delivered to the Gentiles and shall be mocked and scourged and spit upon.
text_la: tradetur enim gentibus, et illudetur, et flagellabitur, et conspuetur:
text_pt: Pois há de ser entregue aos gentios, e escarnecido, injuriado e cuspido;
text_el: παραδοθήσεται γὰρ τοῖς ἔθνεσιν καὶ ἐμπαιχθήσεται καὶ ὑβρισθήσεται καὶ ἐμπτυσθήσεται,

text_en: And after they have scourged him, they will put him to death. And the third day he shall rise again .
text_la: et postquam flagellaverint, occident eum, et tertia die resurget.
text_pt: E, havendo-o açoitado, o matarão; e ao terceiro dia ressuscitará.
text_el: καὶ μαστιγώσαντες ἀποκτενοῦσιν αὐτόν, καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ ἀναστήσεται.

text_en: And they understood none of these things, and this word was hid from them: and they understood not the things that were said.
text_la: Et ipsi nihil horum intellexerunt, et erat verbum istud absconditum ab eis, et non intelligebant quæ dicebantur.
text_pt: E eles nada disto entendiam, e esta palavra lhes era encoberta, não percebendo o que se lhes dizia.
text_el: καὶ αὐτοὶ οὐδὲν τούτων συνῆκαν, καὶ ἦν τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο κεκρυμμένον ἀπ' αὐτῶν, καὶ οὐκ ἐγίνωσκον τὰ λεγόμενα.

text_en: Now it came to pass, when he drew near to Jericho , that a certain blind man sat by the way side, begging.
text_la: Factum est autem, cum appropinquaret Jericho, cæcus quidam sedebat secus viam, mendicans.
text_pt: E aconteceu que chegando ele perto de Jericó, estava um cego assentado junto do caminho, mendigando.
text_el: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ ἐγγίζειν αὐτὸν εἰς Ἰεριχὼ τυφλός τις ἐκάθητο παρὰ τὴν ὁδὸν ἐπαιτῶν.

text_en: And when he heard the multitude passing by, he asked what this meant.
text_la: Et cum audiret turbam prætereuntem, interrogabat quid hoc esset.
text_pt: E, ouvindo passar a multidão, perguntou que era aquilo.
text_el: ἀκούσας δὲ ὄχλου διαπορευομένου ἐπυνθάνετο τί εἴη τοῦτο:

text_en: And they told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.
text_la: Dixerunt autem ei quod Jesus Nazarenus transiret.
text_pt: E disseram-lhe que Jesus Nazareno passava.
text_el: ἀπήγγειλαν δὲ αὐτῷ ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ὁ Ναζωραῖος παρέρχεται.

text_en: And he cried out, saying: Jesus , Son of David , have mercy on me.
text_la: Et clamavit, dicens : Jesu, fili David, miserere mei.
text_pt: Então clamou, dizendo: Jesus, Filho de Davi, tem misericórdia de mim.
text_el: καὶ ἐβόησεν λέγων: Ἰησοῦ υἱὲ Δαυίδ, ἐλέησόν με.

text_en: And they that went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried out much more: Son of David , have mercy on me.
text_la: Et qui præibant, increpabant eum ut taceret. Ipse vero multo magis clamabat : Fili David, miserere mei.
text_pt: E os que iam passando repreendiam-no para que se calasse; mas ele clamava ainda mais: Filho de Davi, tem misericórdia de mim!
text_el: καὶ οἱ προάγοντες ἐπετίμων αὐτῷ ἵνα σιγήσῃ: αὐτὸς δὲ πολλῷ μᾶλλον ἔκραζεν: υἱὲ Δαυίδ, ἐλέησόν με.

text_en: And Jesus standing, commanded him to be brought unto him. And when he had come near, he asked him,
text_la: Stans autem Jesus jussit illum adduci ad se. Et cum appropinquasset, interrogavit illum,
text_pt: Então Jesus, parando, mandou que lho trouxessem; e, chegando ele, perguntou-lhe,
text_el: σταθεὶς δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἐκέλευσεν αὐτὸν ἀχθῆναι πρὸς αὐτόν. ἐγγίσαντος δὲ αὐτοῦ ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτόν:

text_en: saying; What will you that I do to you? But he said: Lord, that I may see.
text_la: dicens : Quid tibi vis faciam? At ille dixit : Domine, ut videam.
text_pt: Dizendo: Que queres que te faça? E ele disse: Senhor, que eu veja.
text_el: τί σοι θέλεις ποιήσω; ὁ δὲ εἶπεν: κύριε, ἵνα ἀναβλέψω.

text_en: And Jesus said to him: Receive your sight: your faith has made you whole.
text_la: Et Jesus dixit illi : Respice, fides tua te salvum fecit.
text_pt: E Jesus lhe disse: Vê; a tua fé te salvou.
text_el: καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ: ἀνάβλεψον: ἡ πίστις σου σέσωκέν σε.

text_en: And immediately he saw and followed him, glorifying God . And all the people, when they saw it, gave praise to God .
text_la: Et confestim vidit, et sequebatur illum magnificans Deum. Et omnis plebs ut vidit, dedit laudem Deo.
text_pt: E logo viu, e seguia-o, glorificando a Deus. E todo o povo, vendo isto, dava louvores a Deus.
text_el: καὶ παραχρῆμα ἀνέβλεψεν, καὶ ἠκολούθει αὐτῷ δοξάζων τὸν θεόν. καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἰδὼν ἔδωκεν αἶνον τῷ θεῷ.

text_en: And entering he walked through Jericho .
text_la: Et ingressus perambulabat Jericho.
text_pt: E, tendo Jesus entrado em Jericó, ia passando.
text_el: Καὶ εἰσελθὼν διήρχετο τὴν Ἰεριχώ.

text_en: And behold, there was a man named Zacheus, who was the chief of the publicans : and he was rich.
text_la: Et ecce vir nomine Zachæus : et hic princeps erat publicanorum, et ipse dives:
text_pt: E eis que havia ali um homem chamado Zaqueu; e era este um chefe dos publicanos, e era rico.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀνὴρ ὀνόματι καλούμενος Ζακχαῖος, καὶ αὐτὸς ἦν ἀρχιτελώνης καὶ αὐτὸς πλούσιος.

text_en: And he sought to see Jesus who he was: and he could not for the crowd, because he was low of stature.
text_la: et quærebat videre Jesum, quis esset : et non poterat præ turba, quia statura pusillus erat.
text_pt: E procurava ver quem era Jesus, e não podia, por causa da multidão, pois era de pequena estatura.
text_el: καὶ ἐζήτει ἰδεῖν τὸν Ἰησοῦν τίς ἐστιν, καὶ οὐκ ἠδύνατο ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄχλου, ὅτι τῇ ἡλικίᾳ μικρὸς ἦν.

text_en: And running before, he climbed up into a sycamore tree, that he might see him: for he was to pass that way.
text_la: Et præcurrens ascendit in arborem sycomorum ut videret eum: quia inde erat transiturus.
text_pt: E, correndo adiante, subiu a uma figueira brava para o ver; porque havia de passar por ali.
text_el: καὶ προδραμὼν εἰς τὸ ἔμπροσθεν ἀνέβη ἐπὶ συκομορέαν, ἵνα ἴδῃ αὐτόν, ὅτι ἐκείνης ἤμελλεν διέρχεσθαι.

text_en: And when Jesus had come to the place, looking up, he saw him and said to him: Zacheus, make haste and come down: for this day I must abide in your house.
text_la: Et cum venisset ad locum, suspiciens Jesus vidit illum, et dixit ad eum : Zachæe, festinans descende : quia hodie in domo tua oportet me manere.
text_pt: E quando Jesus chegou àquele lugar, olhando para cima, viu-o e disse-lhe: Zaqueu, desce depressa, porque hoje me convém pousar em tua casa.
text_el: καὶ ὡς ἦλθεν ἐπὶ τὸν τόπον, ἀναβλέψας [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν: Ζακχαῖε, σπεύσας κατάβηθι: σήμερον γὰρ ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ σου δεῖ με μεῖναι.

text_en: And he made haste and came down and received him with joy .
text_la: Et festinans descendit, et excepit illum gaudens.
text_pt: E, apressando-se, desceu, e recebeu-o alegremente.
text_el: καὶ σπεύσας κατέβη, καὶ ὑπεδέξατο αὐτὸν χαίρων.

text_en: And when all saw it, they murmured, saying, that he had gone to be a guest with a man that was a sinner.
text_la: Et cum viderent omnes, murmurabant, dicentes quod ad hominem peccatorem divertisset.
text_pt: E, vendo todos isto, murmuravam, dizendo que entrara para ser hóspede de um homem pecador.
text_el: καὶ ἰδόντες πάντες διεγόγγυζον, λέγοντες ὅτι παρὰ ἁμαρτωλῷ ἀνδρὶ εἰσῆλθεν καταλῦσαι.
