text_en: But Zacheus standing, said to the Lord: Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have wronged any man of anything, I restore him fourfold.
text_la: Stans autem Zachæus, dixit ad Dominum : Ecce dimidium bonorum meorum, Domine, do pauperibus : et si quid aliquem defraudavi, reddo quadruplum.
text_pt: E, levantando-se Zaqueu, disse ao Senhor: Senhor, eis que eu dou aos pobres metade dos meus bens; e, se nalguma coisa tenho defraudado alguém, o restituo quadruplicado.
text_el: σταθεὶς δὲ Ζακχαῖος εἶπεν πρὸς τὸν κύριον: ἰδοὺ τὰ ἡμίσιά μου τῶν ὑπαρχόντων, κύριε, [τοῖς] πτωχοῖς δίδωμι, καὶ εἴ τινός τι ἐσυκοφάντησα ἀποδίδωμι τετραπλοῦν.

text_en: Jesus said to him: This day is salvation come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham .
text_la: Ait Jesus ad eum : Quia hodie salus domui huic facta est : eo quod et ipse filius sit Abrahæ.
text_pt: E disse-lhe Jesus: Hoje veio a salvação a esta casa, pois também este é filho de Abraão.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτὸν [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς ὅτι σήμερον σωτηρία τῷ οἴκῳ τούτῳ ἐγένετο, καθότι καὶ αὐτὸς υἱὸς Ἀβραάμ: [ἐστιν]

text_en: For the Son of man has come to seek and to save that which was lost.
text_la: Venit enim Filius hominis quærere, et salvum facere quod perierat.
text_pt: Porque o Filho do homem veio buscar e salvar o que se havia perdido.
text_el: ἦλθεν γὰρ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ζητῆσαι καὶ σῶσαι τὸ ἀπολωλός.

text_en: As they were hearing these things, he added and spoke a parable , because he was near to Jerusalem and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately be manifested.
text_la: Hæc illis audientibus adjiciens, dixit parabolam, eo quod esset prope Jerusalem : et quia existimarent quod confestim regnum Dei manifestaretur.
text_pt: E, ouvindo eles estas coisas, ele prosseguiu, e contou uma parábola; porquanto estava perto de Jerusalém, e cuidavam que logo se havia de manifestar o reino de Deus.
text_el: Ἀκουόντων δὲ αὐτῶν ταῦτα προσθεὶς εἶπεν παραβολὴν, διὰ τὸ ἐγγὺς εἶναι Ἰερουσαλὴμ αὐτὸν καὶ δοκεῖν αὐτοὺς ὅτι παραχρῆμα μέλλει ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ ἀναφαίνεσθαι.

text_en: He said therefore: a certain nobleman went into a far country, to receive for himself a kingdom and to return.
text_la: Dixit ergo : Homo quidam nobilis abiit in regionem longinquam accipere sibi regnum, et reverti.
text_pt: Disse pois: Certo homem nobre partiu para uma terra remota, a fim de tomar para si um reino e voltar depois.
text_el: εἶπεν οὖν: ἄνθρωπός τις εὐγενὴς ἐπορεύθη εἰς χώραν μακρὰν, λαβεῖν ἑαυτῷ βασιλείαν καὶ ὑποστρέψαι.

text_en: And calling his ten servants, he gave them ten pounds and said to them: Trade till I come.
text_la: Vocatis autem decem servis suis, dedit eis decem mnas, et ait ad illos : Negotiamini dum venio.
text_pt: E, chamando dez servos seus, deu-lhes dez minas, e disse-lhes: Negociai até que eu venha.
text_el: καλέσας δὲ δέκα δούλους ἑαυτοῦ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς δέκα μνᾶς, καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς: πραγματεύσασθαι ἐν ᾧ ἔρχομαι.

text_en: But his citizens hated him and they sent an embassage after him, saying: We will not have this man to reign over us.
text_la: Cives autem ejus oderant eum : et miserunt legationem post illum, dicentes : Nolumus hunc regnare super nos.
text_pt: Mas os seus concidadãos odiavam-no, e mandaram após ele embaixadores, dizendo: Não queremos que este reine sobre nós.
text_el: οἱ δὲ πολῖται αὐτοῦ ἐμίσουν αὐτόν, καὶ ἀπέστειλαν πρεσβείαν ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ λέγοντες: οὐ θέλομεν τοῦτον βασιλεῦσαι ἐφ' ἡμᾶς.

text_en: And it came to pass that he returned, having received the kingdom: and he commanded his servants to be called, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading,
text_la: Et factum est ut rediret accepto regno : et jussit vocari servos, quibus dedit pecuniam, ut sciret quantum quisque negotiatus esset.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, voltando ele, depois de ter tomado o reino, disse que lhe chamassem aqueles servos, a quem tinha dado o dinheiro, para saber o que cada um tinha ganhado, negociando.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἐπανελθεῖν αὐτὸν λαβόντα τὴν βασιλείαν, καὶ εἶπεν φωνηθῆναι αὐτῷ τοὺς δούλους τούτους οἷς δεδώκει τὸ ἀργύριον, ἵνα γνοῖ τί διεπραγματεύσαντο.

text_en: and the first came saying: Lord, your pound has gained ten pounds.
text_la: Venit autem primus dicens : Domine, mna tua decem mnas acquisivit.
text_pt: E veio o primeiro, dizendo: Senhor, a tua mina rendeu dez minas.
text_el: παρεγένετο δὲ ὁ πρῶτος λέγων: κύριε, ἡ μνᾶ σου δέκα προσηργάσατο μνᾶς.

text_en: And he said to him: Well done, you good servant, because you have been faithful in a little, you shall have power over ten cities.
text_la: Et ait illi : Euge bone serve, quia in modico fuisti fidelis, eris potestatem habens super decem civitates.
text_pt: E ele lhe disse: Bem está, servo bom, porque no mínimo foste fiel, sobre dez cidades terás autoridade.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ: εὖγε, ἀγαθὲ δοῦλε, ὅτι ἐν ἐλαχίστῳ πιστὸς ἐγένου, ἴσθι ἐξουσίαν ἔχων ἐπάνω δέκα πόλεων.

text_en: And the second came, saying: Lord, your pound has gained five pounds.
text_la: Et alter venit, dicens : Domine, mna tua fecit quinque mnas.
text_pt: E veio o segundo, dizendo: Senhor, a tua mina rendeu cinco minas.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν ὁ δεύτερος λέγων: ἡ μνᾶ σου, κύριε, ἐποίησεν πέντε μνᾶς.

text_en: And he said to him: Be also over five cities.
text_la: Et huic ait : Et tu esto super quinque civitates.
text_pt: E a este disse também: Sê tu também sobre cinco cidades.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ καὶ τούτῳ: καὶ σὺ ἐπάνω γίνου πέντε πόλεων.

text_en: And another came, saying: Lord, behold here is your pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin.
text_la: Et alter venit, dicens : Domine, ecce mna tua, quam habui repositam in sudario:
text_pt: E veio outro, dizendo: Senhor, aqui está a tua mina, que guardei num lenço;
text_el: καὶ ὁ ἕτερος ἦλθεν λέγων: κύριε, ἰδοὺ ἡ μνᾶ σου, ἣν εἶχον ἀποκειμένην ἐν σουδαρίῳ:

text_en: For I feared you, because you are an austere man : you take up what you did not lay down: and you reap that which you did not sow.
text_la: timui enim te, quia homo austerus es : tollis quod non posuisti, et metis quod non seminasti.
text_pt: Porque tive medo de ti, que és homem rigoroso, que tomas o que não puseste, e segas o que não semeaste.
text_el: ἐφοβούμην γάρ σε, ὅτι ἄνθρωπος αὐστηρὸς εἶ, αἴρεις ὃ οὐκ ἔθηκας, καὶ θερίζεις ὃ οὐκ ἔσπειρας.

text_en: He said to him: Out of your own mouth I judge you, you wicked servant. You knew that I was an austere man , taking up what I laid not down and reaping that which I did not sow.
text_la: Dicit ei : De ore tuo te judico, serve nequam. Sciebas quod ego homo austerus sum, tollens quod non posui, et metens quod non seminavi:
text_pt: Porém, ele lhe disse: Mau servo, pela tua boca te julgarei. Sabias que eu sou homem rigoroso, que tomo o que não pus, e sego o que não semeei;
text_el: λέγει αὐτῷ: ἐκ τοῦ στόματός σου κρίνω σε, πονηρὲ δοῦλε. ᾔδεις ὅτι ἐγὼ ἄνθρωπος αὐστηρός εἰμι, αἴρων ὃ οὐκ ἔθηκα, καὶ θερίζων ὃ οὐκ ἔσπειρα;

text_en: And why then did you not give my money into the bank, that at my coming I might have exacted it with usury ?
text_la: et quare non dedisti pecuniam meam ad mensam, ut ego veniens cum usuris utique exegissem illam?
text_pt: Por que não puseste, pois, o meu dinheiro no banco, para que eu, vindo, o exigisse com os juros?
text_el: καὶ διὰ τί οὐκ ἔδωκάς μου τὸ ἀργύριον ἐπὶ τράπεζαν; κἀγὼ ἐλθὼν σὺν τόκῳ ἂν αὐτὸ ἔπραξα.

text_en: And he said to them that stood by: Take the pound away from him and give it to him that has ten pounds.
text_la: Et astantibus dixit : Auferte ab illo mnam, et date illi qui decem mnas habet.
text_pt: E disse aos que estavam com ele: Tirai-lhe a mina, e dai-a ao que tem dez minas.
text_el: καὶ τοῖς παρεστῶσιν εἶπεν: ἄρατε ἀπ' αὐτοῦ τὴν μνᾶν καὶ δότε τῷ τὰς δέκα μνᾶς ἔχοντι.

text_en: And they said to him: Lord, he has ten pounds.
text_la: Et dixerunt ei : Domine, habet decem mnas.
text_pt: (E disseram-lhe eles: Senhor, ele tem dez minas. )
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ: κύριε, ἔχει δέκα μνᾶς.

text_en: But I say to you that to every one that has shall be given, and he shall abound: and from him that has not, even that which he has shall be taken from him.
text_la: Dico autem vobis, quia omni habenti dabitur, et abundabit : ab eo autem qui non habet, et quod habet auferetur ab eo.
text_pt: Pois eu vos digo que a qualquer que tiver ser-lhe-á dado, mas ao que não tiver, até o que tem lhe será tirado.
text_el: λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι παντὶ τῷ ἔχοντι δοθήσεται, ἀπὸ δὲ τοῦ μὴ ἔχοντος καὶ ὃ ἔχει ἀρθήσεται.

text_en: But as for those my enemies, who would not have me reign over them, bring them hither and kill them before me.
text_la: Verumtamen inimicos meos illos, qui noluerunt me regnare super se, adducite huc : et interficite ante me.
text_pt: E quanto àqueles meus inimigos que não quiseram que eu reinasse sobre eles, trazei-os aqui, e matai-os diante de mim.
text_el: πλὴν τοὺς ἐχθρούς μου τούτους τοὺς μὴ θελήσαντάς με βασιλεῦσαι ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἀγάγετε ὧδε καὶ κατασφάξατε αὐτοὺς ἔμπροσθέν μου.

text_en: And having said these things, he went before, going up to Jerusalem .
text_la: Et his dictis, præcedebat ascendens Jerosolymam.
text_pt: E, dito isto, ia caminhando adiante, subindo para Jerusalém.
text_el: Καὶ εἰπὼν ταῦτα ἐπορεύετο ἔμπροσθεν ἀναβαίνων, εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα.

text_en: And it came to pass, when he had come near to Bethphage and Bethania , unto the mount called Olivet , he sent two of his disciples ,
text_la: Et factum est, cum appropinquasset ad Bethphage et Bethaniam, ad montem qui vocatur Oliveti, misit duos discipulos suos,
text_pt: E aconteceu que, chegando perto de Betfagé, e de Betânia, ao monte chamado das Oliveiras, mandou dois dos seus discípulos,
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἤγγισεν εἰς Βηθφαγὴ καὶ Βηθανιὰ πρὸς τὸ ὄρος τὸ καλούμενον Ἐλαιῶν, ἀπέστειλεν δύο τῶν μαθητῶν

text_en: saying: Go into the town which is over against you, at your entering into which you shall find the colt of an ass tied, on which no man ever has sitten: loose him and bring him hither.
text_la: dicens : Ite in castellum quod contra est : in quod introëuntes, invenietis pullum asinæ alligatum, cui nemo umquam hominum sedit : solvite illum, et adducite.
text_pt: Dizendo: Ide à aldeia que está defronte, e aí, ao entrar, achareis preso um jumentinho em que nenhum homem ainda montou; soltai-o e trazei-o.
text_el: λέγων: ὑπάγετε εἰς τὴν κατέναντι κώμην, ἐν ᾗ εἰσπορευόμενοι εὑρήσετε πῶλον δεδεμένον, ἐφ' ὃν οὐδεὶς πώποτε ἀνθρώπων ἐκάθισεν, καὶ λύσαντες αὐτὸν ἀγάγετε.

text_en: And if any man shall ask you: Why do you loose him? You shall say thus unto him: Because the Lord has need of his service.
text_la: Et si quis vos interrogaverit : Quare solvitis? sic dicetis ei : Quia Dominus operam ejus desiderat.
text_pt: E, se alguém vos perguntar: Por que o soltais? assim lhe direis: Porque o Senhor o há de mister.
text_el: καὶ ἐάν τις ὑμᾶς ἐρωτᾷ: διὰ τί λύετε; οὕτως ἐρεῖτε: ὅτι ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ χρείαν ἔχει.

text_en: And they that were sent went their way and found the colt standing, as he said unto them.
text_la: Abierunt autem qui missi erant : et invenerunt, sicut dixit illis, stantem pullum.
text_pt: E, indo os que haviam sido mandados, acharam como lhes dissera.
text_el: ἀπελθόντες δὲ οἱ ἀπεσταλμένοι εὗρον καθὼς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς.

text_en: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said to them: Why loose you the colt?
text_la: Solventibus autem illis pullum, dixerunt domini ejus ad illos : Quid solvitis pullum?
text_pt: E, quando soltaram o jumentinho, seus donos lhes disseram: Por que soltais o jumentinho?
text_el: λυόντων δὲ αὐτῶν τὸν πῶλον εἶπαν οἱ κύριοι αὐτοῦ πρὸς αὐτούς: τί λύετε τὸν πῶλον;

text_en: But they said: Because the Lord has need of him.
text_la: At illi dixerunt : Quia Dominus eum necessarium habet.
text_pt: E eles responderam: O Senhor o há de mister.
text_el: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν: ὅτι ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ χρείαν ἔχει.

text_en: And they brought him to Jesus . And casting their garments on the colt, they set Jesus thereon.
text_la: Et duxerunt illum ad Jesum. Et jactantes vestimenta sua supra pullum, imposuerunt Jesum.
text_pt: E trouxeram-no a Jesus; e, lançando sobre o jumentinho as suas vestes, puseram Jesus em cima.
text_el: καὶ ἤγαγον αὐτὸν πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν, καὶ ἐπιρίψαντες αὐτῶν τὰ ἱμάτια ἐπὶ τὸν πῶλον ἐπεβίβασαν τὸν Ἰησοῦν.

text_en: And as he went, they spread their clothes underneath in the way.
text_la: Eunte autem illo, substernebant vestimenta sua in via:
text_pt: E, indo ele, estendiam no caminho as suas vestes.
text_el: πορευομένου δὲ αὐτοῦ ὑπεστρώννυον τὰ ἱμάτια ἑαυτῶν ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ.

text_en: And when he was now coming near the descent of Mount Olivet , the whole multitude of his disciples began with joy to praise God with a loud voice, for all the mighty works they had seen,
text_la: et cum appropinquaret jam ad descensum montis Oliveti, cœperunt omnes turbæ discipulorum gaudentes laudare Deum voce magna super omnibus, quas viderant, virtutibus,
text_pt: E, quando já chegava perto da descida do Monte das Oliveiras, toda a multidão dos discípulos, regozijando-se, começou a dar louvores a Deus em alta voz, por todas as maravilhas que tinham visto,
text_el: ἐγγίζοντος δὲ αὐτοῦ ἤδη πρὸς τῇ καταβάσει τοῦ ὄρους τῶν ἐλαιῶν ἤρξαντο ἅπαν τὸ πλῆθος τῶν μαθητῶν χαίροντες αἰνεῖν τὸν θεὸν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ περὶ πασῶν ὧν εἶδον δυνάμεων,

text_en: saying: Blessed be the king who comes in the name of the Lord ! Peace in heaven and glory on high!
text_la: dicentes : Benedictus, qui venit rex in nomine Domini : pax in cælo, et gloria in excelsis.
text_pt: Dizendo: Bendito o Rei que vem em nome do Senhor; paz no céu, e glória nas alturas.
text_el: λέγοντες: εὐλογημένος ὁ ἐρχόμενος ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου: ἐν οὐρανῷ εἰρήνη, καὶ δόξα ἐν ὑψίστοις.

text_en: And some of the Pharisees , from amongst the multitude, said to him: Master, rebuke your disciples .
text_la: Et quidam pharisæorum de turbis dixerunt ad illum : Magister, increpa discipulos tuos.
text_pt: E disseram-lhe de entre a multidão alguns dos fariseus: Mestre, repreende os teus discípulos.
text_el: Καί τινες τῶν Φαρισαίων ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄχλου εἶπαν πρὸς αὐτόν: διδάσκαλε, ἐπιτίμησον τοῖς μαθηταῖς σου.

text_en: To whom he said: I say to you that if these shall hold their peace, the stones will cry out.
text_la: Quibus ipse ait : Dico vobis, quia si hi tacuerint, lapides clamabunt.
text_pt: E, respondendo ele, disse-lhes: Digo-vos que, se estes se calarem, as próprias pedras clamarão.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν: λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐὰν οὗτοι σιωπήσουσιν, οἱ λίθοι κράξουσιν.

text_en: And when he drew near, seeing the city, he wept over it, saying:
text_la: Et ut appropinquavit, videns civitatem flevit super illam, dicens:
text_pt: E, quando ia chegando, vendo a cidade, chorou sobre ela,
text_el: Καὶ ὡς ἤγγισεν, ἰδὼν τὴν πόλιν ἔκλαυσεν ἐπ' αὐτήν,

text_en: If you also had known , and that in this your day, the things that are to your peace: but now they are hidden from your eyes.
text_la: Quia si cognovisses et tu, et quidem in hac die tua, quæ ad pacem tibi : nunc autem abscondita sunt ab oculis tuis.
text_pt: Dizendo: Ah! se tu conhecesses também, ao menos neste teu dia, o que à tua paz pertence! Mas agora isto está encoberto aos teus olhos.
text_el: λέγων ὅτι εἰ ἔγνως ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ καὶ σὺ τὰ πρὸς εἰρήνην: νῦν δὲ ἐκρύβη ἀπὸ ὀφθαλμῶν σου.

text_en: For the days shall come upon you: and your enemies shall cast a trench about you and compass you round and straiten you on every side,
text_la: Quia venient dies in te : et circumdabunt te inimici tui vallo, et circumdabunt te : et coangustabunt te undique:
text_pt: Porque dias virão sobre ti, em que os teus inimigos te cercarão de trincheiras, e te sitiarão, e te estreitarão de todos os lados;
text_el: ὅτι ἥξουσιν ἡμέραι ἐπὶ σὲ, καὶ παρεμβαλοῦσιν οἱ ἐχθροί σου χάρακά σοι καὶ περικυκλώσουσίν σε καὶ συνέξουσίν σε πάντοθεν,

text_en: and beat you flat to the ground, and your children who are in you. And they shall not leave in you a stone upon a stone: because you have not known the time of your visitation.
text_la: et ad terram prosternent te, et filios tuos, qui in te sunt, et non relinquent in te lapidem super lapidem : eo quod non cognoveris tempus visitationis tuæ.
text_pt: E te derrubarão, a ti e aos teus filhos que dentro de ti estiverem, e não deixarão em ti pedra sobre pedra, pois que não conheceste o tempo da tua visitação.
text_el: καὶ ἐδαφιοῦσίν σε καὶ τὰ τέκνα σου ἐν σοί, καὶ οὐκ ἀφήσουσιν λίθον ἐπὶ λίθον ἐν σοί, ἀνθ' ὧν οὐκ ἔγνως τὸν καιρὸν τῆς ἐπισκοπῆς σου.

text_en: And entering into the temple , he began to cast out them that sold therein and them that bought.
text_la: Et ingressus in templum, cœpit ejicere vendentes in illo, et ementes,
text_pt: E, entrando no templo, começou a expulsar todos os que nele vendiam e compravam,
text_el: Καὶ εἰσελθὼν εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν ἤρξατο ἐκβάλλειν τοὺς πωλοῦντας,

text_en: Saying to them: It is written: My house is the house of prayer . But you have made it a den of thieves .
text_la: dicens illis : Scriptum est : Quia domus mea domus orationis est : vos autem fecistis illam speluncam latronum.
text_pt: Dizendo-lhes: Está escrito: A minha casa é casa de oração; mas vós fizestes dela covil de salteadores.
text_el: λέγων αὐτοῖς: γέγραπται: καὶ ἔσται ὁ οἶκός μου οἶκος προσευχῆς: ὑμεῖς δὲ αὐτὸν ἐποιήσατε σπήλαιον λῃστῶν.

text_en: And he was teaching daily in the temple . And the chief priests and the scribes and the rulers of the people sought to destroy him.
text_la: Et erat docens quotidie in templo. Principes autem sacerdotum, et scribæ, et princeps plebis quærebant illum perdere:
text_pt: E todos os dias ensinava no templo; mas os principais dos sacerdotes, e os escribas, e os principais do povo procuravam matá-lo.
text_el: Καὶ ἦν διδάσκων τὸ καθ' ἡμέραν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ: οἱ δὲ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς ἐζήτουν αὐτὸν ἀπολέσαι καὶ οἱ πρῶτοι τοῦ λαοῦ,

text_en: And they found not what to do to him: for all the people were very attentive to hear him.
text_la: et non inveniebant quid facerent illi. Omnis enim populus suspensus erat, audiens illum.
text_pt: E não achavam meio de o fazer, porque todo o povo pendia para ele, escutando-o.
text_el: καὶ οὐχ εὕρισκον τὸ τί ποιήσωσιν: ὁ λαὸς γὰρ ἅπας ἐξεκρέματο αὐτοῦ ἀκούων.

text_en: And it came to pass that on one of the days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the gospel , the chief priests and the scribes , with the ancients, met together,
text_la: Et factum est in una dierum, docente illo populum in templo, et evangelizante, convenerunt principes sacerdotum, et scribæ cum senioribus,
text_pt: E aconteceu num daqueles dias que, estando ele ensinando o povo no templo, e anunciando o evangelho, sobrevieram os principais dos sacerdotes e os escribas com os anciãos,
text_el: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν μιᾷ τῶν ἡμερῶν διδάσκοντος αὐτοῦ τὸν λαὸν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καὶ εὐαγγελιζομένου ἐπέστησαν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς σὺν τοῖς πρεσβυτέροις,

text_en: and spoke to him, saying: Tell us, by what authority do you these things? Or, who is he that has given you this authority?
text_la: et aiunt dicentes ad illum : Dic nobis in qua potestate hæc facis? aut quis est qui dedit tibi hanc potestatem?
text_pt: E falaram-lhe, dizendo: Dize-nos, com que autoridade fazes estas coisas? Ou, quem é que te deu esta autoridade?
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν λέγοντες πρὸς αὐτόν: εἰπὸν ἡμῖν ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιεῖς, ἢ τίς ἐστιν ὁ δούς σοι τὴν ἐξουσίαν ταύτην.

text_en: And Jesus answering, said to them: I will also ask you one thing. Answer me:
text_la: Respondens autem Jesus, dixit ad illos : Interrogabo vos et ego unum verbum. Respondete mihi:
text_pt: E, respondendo ele, disse-lhes: Também eu vos farei uma pergunta: Dizei-me pois:
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς: ἐρωτήσω ὑμᾶς κἀγὼ λόγον, καὶ εἴπατέ μοι:

text_en: The baptism of John , was it from heaven , or of men ?
text_la: baptismus Joannis de cælo erat, an ex hominibus?
text_pt: O batismo de João era do céu ou dos homens?
text_el: τὸ βάπτισμα Ἰωάννου ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἦν ἢ ἐξ ἀνθρώπων;

text_en: But they thought within themselves, saying: If we shall say, From heaven : he will say: Why then did you not believe in him?
text_la: At illi cogitabant intra se, dicentes : Quia si dixerimus : De cælo, dicet : Quare ergo non credidistis illi?
text_pt: E eles arrazoavam entre si, dizendo: Se dissermos: Do céu, ele nos dirá: Então por que o não crestes?
text_el: οἱ δὲ συνελογίσαντο πρὸς ἑαυτοὺς λέγοντες ὅτι ἐὰν εἴπωμεν: ἐξ οὐρανοῦ, ἐρεῖ: διὰ τί οὐκ ἐπιστεύσατε αὐτῷ;

text_en: But if we say, of men : the whole people will stone us. For they are persuaded that John was a prophet .
text_la: Si autem dixerimus : Ex hominibus, plebs universa lapidabit nos : certi sunt enim Joannem prophetam esse.
text_pt: E se dissermos: Dos homens; todo o povo nos apedrejará, pois têm por certo que João era profeta.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ εἴπωμεν: ἐξ ἀνθρώπων, ὁ λαὸς ἅπας καταλιθάσει ἡμᾶς: πεπεισμένος γάρ ἐστιν Ἰωάννην προφήτην εἶναι.

text_en: And they answered that they knew not whence it was.
text_la: Et responderunt se nescire unde esset.
text_pt: E responderam que não sabiam de onde era.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθησαν μὴ εἰδέναι πόθεν.

text_en: And Jesus said to them: Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.
text_la: Et Jesus ait illis : Neque ego dico vobis in qua potestate hæc facio.
text_pt: E Jesus lhes disse: Tampouco vos direi com que autoridade faço isto.
text_el: καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: οὐδὲ ἐγὼ λέγω ὑμῖν ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιῶ.

text_en: And he began to speak to the people this parable : A certain man planted a vineyard and let it out to husbandmen: and he was abroad for a long time.
text_la: Cœpit autem dicere ad plebem parabolam hanc : Homo plantavit vineam, et locavit eam colonis : et ipse peregre fuit multis temporibus.
text_pt: E começou a dizer ao povo esta parábola: Certo homem plantou uma vinha, e arrendou-a a uns lavradores, e partiu para fora da terra por muito tempo;
text_el: Ἤρξατο δὲ πρὸς τὸν λαὸν λέγειν τὴν παραβολὴν ταύτην. ἄνθρωπός ἐφύτευσεν ἀμπελῶνα καὶ ἐξέδετο αὐτὸν γεωργοῖς, καὶ ἀπεδήμησεν χρόνους ἱκανούς.

text_en: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard. Who, beating him, sent him away empty.
text_la: Et in tempore misit ad cultores servum, ut de fructu vineæ darent illi. Qui cæsum dimiserunt eum inanem.
text_pt: E no tempo próprio mandou um servo aos lavradores, para que lhe dessem dos frutos da vinha; mas os lavradores, espancando-o, mandaram-no vazio.
text_el: καὶ καιρῷ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς τοὺς γεωργοὺς δοῦλον, ἵνα ἀπὸ τοῦ καρποῦ τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος δώσουσιν αὐτῷ: οἱ δὲ γεωργοὶ ἐξαπέστειλαν αὐτὸν δείραντες κενόν.

text_en: And again he sent another servant. But they beat him also and, treating him reproachfully, sent him away empty.
text_la: Et addidit alterum servum mittere. Illi autem hunc quoque cædentes, et afficientes contumelia, dimiserunt inanem.
text_pt: E tornou ainda a mandar outro servo; mas eles, espancando também a este, e afrontando-o, mandaram-no vazio.
text_el: καὶ προσέθετο ἕτερον πέμψαι δοῦλον: οἱ δὲ κἀκεῖνον δείραντες καὶ ἀτιμάσαντες ἐξαπέστειλαν κενόν.

text_en: And again he sent the third: and they wounded him also and cast him out.
text_la: Et addidit tertium mittere : qui et illum vulnerantes ejecerunt.
text_pt: E tornou ainda a mandar um terceiro; mas eles, ferindo também a este, o expulsaram.
text_el: καὶ προσέθετο τρίτον πέμψαι: οἱ δὲ καὶ τοῦτον τραυματίσαντες ἐξέβαλον.

text_en: Then the lord of the vineyard said: What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be, when they see him, they will reverence him.
text_la: Dixit autem dominus vineæ : Quid faciam? Mittam filium meum dilectum : forsitan, cum hunc viderint, verebuntur.
text_pt: E disse o senhor da vinha: Que farei? Mandarei o meu filho amado; talvez que, vendo, o respeitem.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ κύριος τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος: τί ποιήσω; πέμψω τὸν υἱόν μου τὸν ἀγαπητόν: ἴσως τοῦτον ἐντραπήσονται.

text_en: Whom, when the husbandmen saw, they thought within themselves, saying: This is the heir. Let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.
text_la: Quem cum vidissent coloni, cogitaverunt intra se, dicentes : Hic est hæres, occidamus illum, ut nostra fiat hæreditas.
text_pt: Mas, vendo-o os lavradores, arrazoaram entre si, dizendo: Este é o herdeiro; vinde, matemo-lo, para que a herança seja nossa.
text_el: ἰδόντες δὲ αὐτὸν οἱ γεωργοὶ διελογίζοντο πρὸς ἀλλήλους λέγοντες: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ κληρονόμος: ἀποκτείνωμεν αὐτόν, ἵνα ἡμῶν γένηται ἡ κληρονομία.

text_en: So casting him out of the vineyard, they killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them?
text_la: Et ejectum illum extra vineam, occiderunt. Quid ergo faciet illis dominus vineæ?
text_pt: E, lançando-o fora da vinha, o mataram. Que lhes fará, pois, o senhor da vinha?
text_el: καὶ ἐκβαλόντες αὐτὸν ἔξω τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος ἀπέκτειναν. τί οὖν ποιήσει αὐτοῖς ὁ κύριος τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος;

text_en: He will come and will destroy these husbandmen and will give the vineyard to others. Which they hearing, said to him: God forbid.
text_la: veniet, et perdet colonos istos, et dabit vineam aliis. Quo audito, dixerunt illi : Absit.
text_pt: Irá, e destruirá estes lavradores, e dará a outros a vinha. E, ouvindo eles isto, disseram: Não seja assim!
text_el: ἐλεύσεται καὶ ἀπολέσει τοὺς γεωργοὺς τούτους, καὶ δώσει τὸν ἀμπελῶνα ἄλλοις. ἀκούσαντες δὲ εἶπαν: μὴ γένοιτο.

text_en: But he looking on them, said: What is this then that is written, The stone, which the builders rejected, the same has become the head of the corner ?
text_la: Ille autem aspiciens eos, ait : Quid est ergo hoc quod scriptum est : Lapidem quem reprobaverunt ædificantes, hic factus est in caput anguli?
text_pt: Mas ele, olhando para eles, disse: Que é isto, pois, que está escrito? A pedra, que os edificadores reprovaram, Essa foi feita cabeça da esquina.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἐμβλέψας αὐτοῖς εἶπεν: τί οὖν ἐστιν τὸ γεγραμμένον τοῦτο: λίθον ὃν ἀπεδοκίμασαν οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες, οὗτος ἐγενήθη εἰς κεφαλὴν γωνίας;

text_en: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be bruised: and upon whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
text_la: Omnis qui ceciderit super illum lapidem, conquassabitur : super quem autem ceciderit, comminuet illum.
text_pt: Qualquer que cair sobre aquela pedra ficará em pedaços, e aquele sobre quem ela cair será feito em pó.
text_el: πᾶς ὁ πεσὼν ἐπ' ἐκεῖνον τὸν λίθον συνθλασθήσεται: ἐφ' ὃν δ' ἂν πέσῃ, λικμήσει αὐτόν.

text_en: And the chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him the same hour: but they feared the people, for they knew that he spoke this parable to them.
text_la: Et quærebant principes sacerdotum et scribæ mittere in illum manus illa hora, et timuerunt populum : cognoverunt enim quod ad ipsos dixerit similitudinem hanc.
text_pt: E os principais dos sacerdotes e os escribas procuravam lançar mão dele naquela mesma hora; mas temeram o povo; porque entenderam que contra eles dissera esta parábola.
text_el: καὶ ἐζήτησαν οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς ἐπιβαλεῖν ἐπ' αὐτὸν τὰς χεῖρας ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ, καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν τὸν λαόν: ἔγνωσαν γὰρ ὅτι πρὸς αὐτοὺς εἶπεν τὴν παραβολὴν ταύτην.

text_en: And being upon the watch, they sent spies, who should feign themselves just , that they might take hold of him in his words, that they might deliver him up to the authority and power of the governor.
text_la: Et observantes miserunt insidiatores, qui se justos simularent, ut caperent eum in sermone, ut traderent illum principatui, et potestati præsidis.
text_pt: E, observando-o, mandaram espias, que se fingissem justos, para o apanharem nalguma palavra, e o entregarem à jurisdição e poder do presidente.
text_el: Καὶ παρατηρήσαντες ἀπέστειλαν ἐγκαθέτους ὑποκρινομένους ἑαυτοὺς δικαίους εἶναι, ἵνα ἐπιλάβωνται αὐτοῦ λόγου, ὥστε παραδοῦναι αὐτὸν τῇ ἀρχῇ καὶ τῇ ἐξουσίᾳ τοῦ ἡγεμόνος.

text_en: And they asked him, saying: Master, we know that you speak and teach rightly: and you do not respect any person, but teach the way of God in truth .
text_la: Et interrogaverunt eum, dicentes : Magister, scimus quia recte dicis et doces : et non accipis personam, sed viam Dei in veritate doces.
text_pt: E perguntaram-lhe, dizendo: Mestre, nós sabemos que falas e ensinas bem e retamente, e que não consideras a aparência da pessoa, mas ensinas com verdade o caminho de Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἐπηρώτησαν αὐτὸν λέγοντες: διδάσκαλε, οἴδαμεν ὅτι ὀρθῶς λέγεις καὶ διδάσκεις καὶ οὐ λαμβάνεις πρόσωπον, ἀλλ' ἐπ' ἀληθείας τὴν ὁδὸν τοῦ θεοῦ διδάσκεις:

text_en: Is it lawful for us to give tribute to Caesar , or no?
text_la: Licet nobis tributum dare Cæsari, an non?
text_pt: É-nos lícito dar tributo a César ou não?
text_el: ἔξεστιν ἡμᾶς Καίσαρι φόρον δοῦναι ἢ οὔ;

text_en: But he, considering their guile, said to them: Why tempt you me?
text_la: Considerans autem dolum illorum, dixit ad eos : Quid me tentatis?
text_pt: E, entendendo ele a sua astúcia, disse-lhes: Por que me tentais?
text_el: κατανοήσας δὲ αὐτῶν τὴν πανουργίαν εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς:

text_en: Show me a penny. Whose image and inscription has it? They answering, said to him: Caesar's .
text_la: ostendite mihi denarium. Cujus habet imaginem et inscriptionem? Respondentes dixerunt ei : Cæsaris.
text_pt: Mostrai-me uma moeda. De quem tem a imagem e a inscrição? E, respondendo eles, disseram: De César.
text_el: δείξατέ μοι δηνάριον. τίνος ἔχει εἰκόνα καὶ ἐπιγραφήν; οἱ δὲ εἶπαν: Καίσαρος.

text_en: And he said to them: Render therefore to Caesar the things, that are Caesar's : and to God the things that are God's .
text_la: Et ait illis : Reddite ergo quæ sunt Cæsaris, Cæsari : et quæ sunt Dei, Deo.
text_pt: Disse-lhes então: Dai, pois, a César o que é de César, e a Deus o que é de Deus.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς: τοίνυν ἀπόδοτε τὰ Καίσαρος Καίσαρι καὶ τὰ τοῦ θεοῦ τῷ θεῷ.

text_en: And they could not reprehend his word before the people: and wondering at his answer, they held their peace.
text_la: Et non potuerunt verbum ejus reprehendere coram plebe : et mirati in responso ejus, tacuerunt.
text_pt: E não puderam apanhá-lo em palavra alguma diante do povo; e, maravilhados da sua resposta, calaram-se.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἴσχυσαν ἐπιλαβέσθαι τοῦ ῥήματος ἐναντίον τοῦ λαοῦ, καὶ θαυμάσαντες ἐπὶ τῇ ἀποκρίσει αὐτοῦ ἐσίγησαν.

text_en: And there came to him some of the Sadducees , who deny that there is any resurrection: and they asked him,
text_la: Accesserunt autem quidam sadducæorum, qui negant esse resurrectionem, et interrogaverunt eum,
text_pt: E, chegando-se alguns dos saduceus, que dizem não haver ressurreição, perguntaram-lhe,
text_el: Προσελθόντες δέ τινες τῶν Σαδδουκαίων, οἱ λέγοντες ἀνάστασιν μὴ εἶναι, ἐπηρώτησαν αὐτὸν

text_en: saying: Master, Moses wrote unto us: If any man's brother die, having a wife, and he leave no children, that his brother should take her to wife and raise up seed unto his brother.
text_la: dicentes : Magister, Moyses scripsit nobis : Si frater alicujus mortuus fuerit habens uxorem, et hic sine liberis fuerit, ut accipiat eam frater ejus uxorem, et suscitet semen fratri suo.
text_pt: Dizendo: Mestre, Moisés nos deixou escrito que, se o irmão de algum falecer, tendo mulher, e não deixar filhos, o irmão dele tome a mulher, e suscite posteridade a seu irmão.
text_el: λέγοντες: διδάσκαλε, Μωϋσῆς ἔγραψεν ἡμῖν, ἐάν τινος ἀδελφὸς ἀποθάνῃ ἔχων γυναῖκα, καὶ οὗτος ἄτεκνος ᾖ, ἵνα λάβῃ ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ τὴν γυναῖκα καὶ ἐξαναστήσῃ σπέρμα τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife and died without children.
text_la: Septem ergo fratres erant : et primus accepit uxorem, et mortuus est sine filiis.
text_pt: Houve, pois, sete irmãos, e o primeiro tomou mulher, e morreu sem filhos;
text_el: ἑπτὰ οὖν ἀδελφοὶ ἦσαν. καὶ ὁ πρῶτος λαβὼν γυναῖκα ἀπέθανεν ἄτεκνος:

text_en: And the next took her to wife: and he also died childless.
text_la: Et sequens accepit illam, et ipse mortuus est sine filio.
text_pt: E tomou-a o segundo por mulher, e ele morreu sem filhos.
text_el: καὶ ὁ δεύτερος

text_en: And the third took her. And in like manner, all the seven: and they left no children and died.
text_la: Et tertius accepit illam. Similiter et omnes septem, et non reliquerunt semen, et mortui sunt.
text_pt: E tomou-a o terceiro, e igualmente também os sete; e morreram, e nào deixaram filhos.
text_el: καὶ ὁ τρίτος ἔλαβεν αὐτήν, ὡσαύτως δὲ καὶ οἱ ἑπτὰ οὐ κατέλιπον τέκνα καὶ ἀπέθανον.

text_en: Last of all the woman died also.
text_la: Novissime omnium mortua est et mulier.
text_pt: E por último, depois de todos, morreu também a mulher.
text_el: ὕστερον καὶ ἡ γυνὴ ἀπέθανεν.

text_en: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife of them shall she be? For all the seven had her to wife.
text_la: In resurrectione ergo, cujus eorum erit uxor? siquidem septem habuerunt eam uxorem.
text_pt: Portanto, na ressurreição, de qual deles será a mulher, pois que os sete por mulher a tiveram?
text_el: ἡ γυνὴ οὖν ἐν τῇ ἀναστάσει τίνος αὐτῶν γίνεται γυνή; οἱ γὰρ ἑπτὰ ἔσχον αὐτὴν γυναῖκα.

text_en: And Jesus said to them: The children of this world marry and are given in marriage :
text_la: Et ait illis Jesus : Filii hujus sæculi nubunt, et traduntur ad nuptias:
text_pt: E, respondendo Jesus, disse-lhes: Os filhos deste mundo casam-se, e dão-se em casamento;
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς: οἱ υἱοὶ τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου γαμοῦσιν καὶ γαμίσκονται,

text_en: But they that shall be accounted worthy of that world and of the resurrection from the dead shall neither be married nor take wives.
text_la: illi vero qui digni habebuntur sæculo illo, et resurrectione ex mortuis, neque nubent, neque ducent uxores:
text_pt: Mas os que forem havidos por dignos de alcançar o mundo vindouro, e a ressurreição dentre os mortos, nem hão de casar, nem ser dados em casamento;
text_el: οἱ δὲ καταξιωθέντες τοῦ αἰῶνος ἐκείνου τυχεῖν καὶ τῆς ἀναστάσεως τῆς ἐκ νεκρῶν οὔτε γαμοῦσιν οὔτε γαμίζονται:

text_en: Neither can they die any more for they are equal to the angels and are the children of God , being the children of the resurrection.
text_la: neque enim ultra mori potuerunt : æquales enim angelis sunt, et filii sunt Dei, cum sint filii resurrectionis.
text_pt: Porque já não podem mais morrer; pois são iguais aos anjos, e são filhos de Deus, sendo filhos da ressurreição.
text_el: οὐδὲ γὰρ ἀποθανεῖν ἔτι δύνανται, ἰσάγγελοι γάρ εἰσιν, καὶ υἱοί εἰσιν θεοῦ τῆς ἀναστάσεως υἱοὶ ὄντες.

text_en: Now that the dead rise again , Moses also showed at the bush, when he called the Lord: The God of Abraham and the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob .
text_la: Quia vero resurgant mortui, et Moyses ostendit secus rubum, sicut dicit Dominum, Deum Abraham, et Deum Isaac, et Deum Jacob.
text_pt: E que os mortos hão de ressuscitar também o mostrou Moisés junto da sarça, quando chama ao Senhor Deus de Abraão, e Deus de Isaque, e Deus de Jacó.
text_el: ὅτι δὲ ἐγείρονται οἱ νεκροὶ, καὶ Μωϋσῆς ἐμήνυσεν ἐπὶ τῆς βάτου, ὡς λέγει κύριον τὸν θεὸν Ἀβραὰμ καὶ θεὸν Ἰσαὰκ καὶ θεὸν Ἰακώβ:

text_en: For he is not the God of the dead, but of the living: for all live to him.
text_la: Deus autem non est mortuorum, sed vivorum : omnes enim vivunt ei.
text_pt: Ora, Deus não é Deus de mortos, mas de vivos; porque para ele vivem todos.
text_el: θεὸς δὲ οὐκ ἔστιν νεκρῶν ἀλλὰ ζώντων: πάντες γὰρ αὐτῷ ζῶσιν.

text_en: And some of the scribes answering, said to him: Master, you have said well.
text_la: Respondentes autem quidam scribarum, dixerunt ei : Magister, bene dixisti.
text_pt: E, respondendo alguns dos escribas, disseram: Mestre, disseste bem.
text_el: ἀποκριθέντες δέ τινες τῶν γραμματέων εἶπαν: διδάσκαλε, καλῶς εἶπας:

text_en: And after that they dared not ask him any more questions.
text_la: Et amplius non audebant eum quidquam interrogare.
text_pt: E não ousavam perguntar-lhe mais coisa alguma.
text_el: οὐκέτι γὰρ ἐτόλμων ἐπερωτᾶν αὐτὸν οὐδέν.

text_en: But he said to them: How say they that Christ is the son of David ?
text_la: Dixit autem ad illos : Quomodo dicunt Christum filium esse David?
text_pt: E ele lhes disse: Como dizem que o Cristo é filho de Davi?
text_el: Εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτούς: πῶς λέγουσιν τὸν Χριστὸν εἶναι Δαυὶδ υἱόν,

text_en: And David himself says in the book of Psalms: The Lord said to my Lord, sit on my right hand,
text_la: et ipse David dicit in libro Psalmorum : Dixit Dominus Domino meo : sede a dextris meis,
text_pt: Visto como o mesmo Davi diz no livro dos Salmos: Disse o SENHOR ao meu Senhor: Assenta-te à minha direita,
text_el: αὐτὸς γὰρ Δαυὶδ λέγει ἐν βίβλῳ ψαλμῶν: εἶπεν κύριος τῷ κυρίῳ μου: κάθου ἐκ δεξιῶν μου

text_en: till I make your enemies your footstool.
text_la: donec ponam inimicos tuos scabellum pedum tuorum.
text_pt: Até que eu ponha os teus inimigos por escabelo de teus pés.
text_el: ἕως ἂν θῶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου ὑποπόδιον τῶν ποδῶν σου;

text_en: David then calls him Lord. And how is he his son?
text_la: David ergo Dominum illum vocat : et quomodo filius ejus est?
text_pt: Se Davi lhe chama Senhor, como é ele seu filho?
text_el: Δαυὶδ οὖν αὐτὸν κύριον καλεῖ, καὶ πῶς αὐτοῦ υἱός ἐστιν;

text_en: And in the hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples :
text_la: Audiente autem omni populo, dixit discipulis suis:
text_pt: E, ouvindo-o todo o povo, disse Jesus aos seus discípulos:
text_el: Ἀκούοντος δὲ παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ εἶπεν τοῖς μαθηταῖς:

text_en: Beware of the scribes , who desire to walk in long robes and love salutations in the market place and the first chairs in the synagogues and the chief rooms at feasts:
text_la: Attendite a scribis, qui volunt ambulare in stolis, et amant salutationes in foro, et primas cathedras in synagogis, et primos discubitus in conviviis,
text_pt: Guardai-vos dos escribas, que querem andar com vestes compridas; e amam as saudações nas praças, e as principais cadeiras nas sinagogas, e os primeiros lugares nos banquetes;
text_el: προσέχετε ἀπὸ τῶν γραμματέων τῶν θελόντων περιπατεῖν ἐν στολαῖς καὶ φιλούντων ἀσπασμοὺς ἐν ταῖς ἀγοραῖς καὶ πρωτοκαθεδρίας ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς καὶ πρωτοκλισίας ἐν τοῖς δείπνοις,

text_en: Who devour the houses of widows , feigning long prayer . These shall receive greater damnation.
text_la: qui devorant domos viduarum, simulantes longam orationem : hi accipient damnationem majorem.
text_pt: Que devoram as casas das viúvas, fazendo, por pretexto, largas orações. Estes receberão maior condenação.
text_el: οἳ κατεσθίουσιν τὰς οἰκίας τῶν χηρῶν καὶ προφάσει μακρὰ προσεύχονται: οὗτοι λήμψονται περισσότερον κρίμα.

text_en: And looking on, he saw the rich men cast their gifts into the treasury.
text_la: Respiciens autem, vidit eos qui mittebant munera sua in gazophylacium, divites.
text_pt: E, olhando ele, viu os ricos lançarem as suas ofertas na arca do tesouro;
text_el: Ἀναβλέψας δὲ εἶδεν τοὺς βάλλοντας εἰς τὸ γαζοφυλάκιον τὰ δῶρα αὐτῶν πλουσίους.

text_en: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in two brass mites.
text_la: Vidit autem et quamdam viduam pauperculam mittentem æra minuta duo.
text_pt: E viu também uma pobre viúva lançar ali duas pequenas moedas;
text_el: εἶδεν δέ τινα χήραν πενιχρὰν βάλλουσαν ἐκεῖ λεπτὰ δύο,

text_en: And he said: Verily, I say to you that this poor widow has cast in more than they all.
text_la: Et dixit : Vere dico vobis, quia vidua hæc pauper plus quam omnes misit.
text_pt: E disse: Em verdade vos digo que lançou mais do que todos, esta pobre viúva;
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν: ἀληθῶς λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἡ χήρα αὕτη ἡ πτωχὴ πλεῖον πάντων ἔβαλεν:

text_en: For all these have of their abundance cast into the offerings of God : but she of her want has cast in all the living that she had.
text_la: Nam omnes hi ex abundanti sibi miserunt in munera Dei : hæc autem ex eo quod deest illi, omnem victum suum quem habuit, misit.
text_pt: Porque todos aqueles deitaram para as ofertas de Deus do que lhes sobeja; mas esta, da sua pobreza, deitou todo o sustento que tinha.
text_el: πάντες γὰρ οὗτοι ἐκ τοῦ περισσεύοντος αὐτοῖς ἔβαλον εἰς τὰ δῶρα, αὕτη δὲ ἐκ τοῦ ὑστερήματος αὐτῆς πάντα τὸν βίον ὃν εἶχεν ἔβαλεν.

text_en: And some saying of the temple that it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said:
text_la: Et quibusdam dicentibus de templo quod bonis lapidibus et donis ornatum esset, dixit:
text_pt: E, dizendo alguns a respeito do templo, que estava ornado de formosas pedras e dádivas, disse:
text_el: Καί τινων λεγόντων περὶ τοῦ ἱεροῦ, ὅτι λίθοις καλοῖς καὶ ἀναθήμασιν κεκόσμηται, εἶπεν:

text_en: These things which you see, the days will come in which there shall not be left a stone upon a stone that shall not be thrown down.
text_la: Hæc quæ videtis, venient dies in quibus non relinquetur lapis super lapidem, qui non destruatur.
text_pt: Quanto a estas coisas que vedes, dias virão em que não se deixará pedra sobre pedra, que não seja derrubada.
text_el: ταῦτα ἃ θεωρεῖτε, ἐλεύσονται ἡμέραι ἐν αἷς οὐκ ἀφεθήσεται λίθος ἐπὶ λίθῳ, ὧδε ὃς οὐ καταλυθήσεται.

text_en: And they asked him, saying: Master, when shall these things be? And what shall be the sign when they shall begin to come to pass?
text_la: Interrogaverunt autem illum, dicentes : Præceptor, quando hæc erunt, et quod signum cum fieri incipient?
text_pt: E perguntaram-lhe, dizendo: Mestre, quando serão, pois, estas coisas? E que sinal haverá quando isto estiver para acontecer?
text_el: ἐπηρώτησαν δὲ αὐτὸν λέγοντες: διδάσκαλε, πότε οὖν ταῦτα ἔσται; καὶ τί τὸ σημεῖον ὅταν μέλλῃ ταῦτα γίνεσθαι;

text_en: Who said: Take heed you be not seduced: for many will come in my name , saying: I am he and the time is at hand. Go not therefore after them.
text_la: Qui dixit : Videte ne seducamini : multi enim venient in nomine meo, dicentes quia ego sum : et tempus appropinquavit : nolite ergo ire post eos.
text_pt: Disse então ele: Vede não vos enganem, porque virão muitos em meu nome, dizendo: Sou eu, e o tempo está próximo. Não vades, portanto, após eles.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν: βλέπετε μὴ πλανηθῆτε: πολλοὶ γὰρ ἐλεύσονται ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου, λέγοντες: ἐγώ εἰμι, καί ὁ καιρὸς ἤγγικεν: μὴ πορευθῆτε ὀπίσω αὐτῶν.

text_en: And when you shall hear of wars and seditions, be not terrified . These things must first come to pass: but the end is not yet presently.
text_la: Cum autem audieritis prælia et seditiones, nolite terreri : oportet primum hæc fieri, sed nondum statim finis.
text_pt: E, quando ouvirdes de guerras e sedições, não vos assusteis. Porque é necessário que isto aconteça primeiro, mas o fim não será logo.
text_el: ὅταν δὲ ἀκούσητε πολέμους καὶ ἀκαταστασίας, μὴ πτοηθῆτε: δεῖ γὰρ ταῦτα γενέσθαι πρῶτον, ἀλλ' οὐκ εὐθέως τὸ τέλος.

text_en: Then he said to them: Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.
text_la: Tunc dicebat illis : Surget gens contra gentem, et regnum adversus regnum.
text_pt: Então lhes disse: Levantar-se-á nação contra nação, e reino contra reino;
text_el: τότε ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς: ἐγερθήσεται ἔθνος ἐπ' ἔθνος καὶ βασιλεία ἐπὶ βασιλείαν,

text_en: And there shall be great earthquakes in divers places and pestilences and famines and terrors from heaven : and there shall be great signs.
text_la: Et terræmotus magni erunt per loca, et pestilentiæ, et fames, terroresque de cælo, et signa magna erunt.
text_pt: E haverá em vários lugares grandes terremotos, e fomes e pestilências; haverá também coisas espantosas, e grandes sinais do céu.
text_el: σεισμοί τε μεγάλοι καὶ κατὰ τόπους λοιμοὶ καὶ λιμοὶ ἔσονται, φόβητρά τε καὶ ἀπ' οὐρανοῦ' σημεῖα μεγάλα ἔσται.

text_en: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues and into prisons, dragging you before kings and governors, for my name's sake.
text_la: Sed ante hæc omnia injicient vobis manus suas, et persequentur tradentes in synagogas et custodias, trahentes ad reges et præsides propter nomen meum:
text_pt: Mas antes de todas estas coisas lançarão mão de vós, e vos perseguirão, entregando-vos às sinagogas e às prisões, e conduzindo-vos à presença de reis e presidentes, por amor do meu nome.
text_el: Πρὸ δὲ τούτων πάντων ἐπιβαλοῦσιν ἐφ' ὑμᾶς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν καὶ διώξουσιν, παραδιδόντες εἰς τὰς συναγωγὰς καὶ φυλακάς, ἀπαγομένους ἐπὶ βασιλεῖς καὶ ἡγεμόνας ἕνεκεν τοῦ ὀνόματός μου:

text_en: And it shall happen unto you for a testimony.
text_la: continget autem vobis in testimonium.
text_pt: E vos acontecerá isto para testemunho.
text_el: ἀποβήσεται ὑμῖν εἰς μαρτύριον.

text_en: Lay it up therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before how you shall answer:
text_la: Ponite ergo in cordibus vestris non præmeditari quemadmodum respondeatis:
text_pt: Proponde, pois, em vossos corações não premeditar como haveis de responder;
text_el: θέτε οὖν ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν μὴ προμελετᾶν ἀπολογηθῆναι:

text_en: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to resist and gainsay.
text_la: ego enim dabo vobis os et sapientiam, cui non poterunt resistere et contradicere omnes adversarii vestri.
text_pt: Porque eu vos darei boca e sabedoria a que não poderão resistir nem contradizer todos quantos se vos opuserem.
text_el: ἐγὼ γὰρ δώσω ὑμῖν στόμα καὶ σοφίαν, ᾗ οὐ δυνήσονται ἀντιστῆναι ἢ ἀντειπεῖν ἅπαντες οἱ ἀντικείμενοι ὑμῖν.

text_en: And you shall be betrayed by your parents and brethren and kinsmen and friends: and some of you they will put to death .
text_la: Trademini autem a parentibus, et fratribus, et cognatis, et amicis, et morte afficient ex vobis:
text_pt: E até pelos pais, e irmãos, e parentes, e amigos sereis entregues; e matarão alguns de vós.
text_el: παραδοθήσεσθε δὲ καὶ ὑπὸ γονέων καὶ ἀδελφῶν καὶ συγγενῶν καὶ φίλων, καὶ θανατώσουσιν ἐξ ὑμῶν,

text_en: And you shall be hated by all men for my name's sake.
text_la: et eritis odio omnibus propter nomen meum:
text_pt: E de todos sereis odiados por causa do meu nome.
text_el: καὶ ἔσεσθε μισούμενοι ὑπὸ πάντων διὰ τὸ ὄνομά μου.

text_en: But a hair of your head shall not perish.
text_la: et capillus de capite vestro non peribit.
text_pt: Mas não perecerá um único cabelo da vossa cabeça.
text_el: καὶ θρὶξ ἐκ τῆς κεφαλῆς ὑμῶν οὐ μὴ ἀπόληται:

text_en: In your patience you shall possess your souls .
text_la: In patientia vestra possidebitis animas vestras.
text_pt: Na vossa paciência possuí as vossas almas.
text_el: ἐν τῇ ὑπομονῇ ὑμῶν κτήσεσθε τὰς ψυχὰς ὑμῶν.

text_en: And when you shall see Jerusalem compassed about with an army, then know that the desolation thereof is at hand.
text_la: Cum autem videritis circumdari ab exercitu Jerusalem, tunc scitote quia appropinquavit desolatio ejus:
text_pt: Mas, quando virdes Jerusalém cercada de exércitos, sabei então que é chegada a sua desolação.
text_el: Ὅταν δὲ ἴδητε κυκλουμένην ὑπὸ στρατοπέδων Ἰερουσαλήμ, τότε γνῶτε ὅτι ἤγγικεν ἡ ἐρήμωσις αὐτῆς.

text_en: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains: and those who are in the midst thereof depart out: and those who are in the countries not enter into it.
text_la: tunc qui in Judæa sunt, fugiant ad montes, et qui in medio ejus, discedant : et qui in regionibus, non intrent in eam,
text_pt: Então, os que estiverem na Judéia, fujam para os montes; os que estiverem no meio da cidade, saiam; e os que nos campos não entrem nela.
text_el: τότε οἱ ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ φευγέτωσαν εἰς τὰ ὄρη, καὶ οἱ ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς ἐκχωρείτωσαν, καὶ οἱ ἐν ταῖς χώραις μὴ εἰσερχέσθωσαν εἰς αὐτήν,

text_en: For these are the days of vengeance, that all things may be fulfilled, that are written.
text_la: quia dies ultionis hi sunt, ut impleantur omnia quæ scripta sunt.
text_pt: Porque dias de vingança são estes, para que se cumpram todas as coisas que estão escritas.
text_el: ὅτι ἡμέραι ἐκδικήσεως αὗταί εἰσιν τοῦ πλησθῆναι πάντα τὰ γεγραμμένα.

text_en: But woe to them that are with child and give suck in those days: for there shall be great distress in the land and wrath upon this people.
text_la: Væ autem prægnantibus et nutrientibus in illis diebus! erit enim pressura magna super terram, et ira populo huic.
text_pt: Mas ai das grávidas, e das que criarem naqueles dias! porque haverá grande aperto na terra, e ira sobre este povo.
text_el: οὐαὶ ταῖς ἐν γαστρὶ ἐχούσαις καὶ ταῖς θηλαζούσαις ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις: ἔσται γὰρ ἀνάγκη μεγάλη ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ὀργὴ τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ,

text_en: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword and shall be led away captives into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down by the Gentiles till the times of the nations be fulfilled.
text_la: Et cadent in ore gladii, et captivi ducentur in omnes gentes, et Jerusalem calcabitur a gentibus, donec impleantur tempora nationum.
text_pt: E cairão ao fio da espada, e para todas as nações serão levados cativos; e Jerusalém será pisada pelos gentios, até que os tempos dos gentios se completem.
text_el: καὶ πεσοῦνται στόματι μαχαίρης καὶ αἰχμαλωτισθήσονται εἰς τὰ ἔθνη πάντα, καὶ Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἔσται πατουμένη ὑπὸ ἐθνῶν, ἄχρι οὗ πληρωθῶσιν [καὶ ἔσονται] καιροὶ ἐθνῶν.

text_en: And there shall be signs in the sun and in the moon and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, by reason of the confusion of the roaring of the sea, and of the waves:
text_la: Et erunt signa in sole, et luna, et stellis, et in terris pressura gentium præ confusione sonitus maris, et fluctuum:
text_pt: E haverá sinais no sol e na lua e nas estrelas; e na terra angústia das nações, em perplexidade pelo bramido do mar e das ondas.
text_el: Καὶ ἔσονται σημεῖα ἐν ἡλίῳ καὶ σελήνῃ καὶ ἄστροις, καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς συνοχὴ ἐθνῶν ἐν ἀπορίᾳ ἤχους θαλάσσης καὶ σάλου,

text_en: Men withering away for fear and expectation of what shall come upon the whole world. For the powers of heaven shall be moved.
text_la: arescentibus hominibus præ timore, et exspectatione, quæ supervenient universo orbi : nam virtutes cælorum movebuntur:
text_pt: Homens desmaiando de terror, na expectação das coisas que sobrevirão ao mundo; porquanto as virtudes do céu serão abaladas.
text_el: ἀποψυχόντων ἀνθρώπων ἀπὸ φόβου καὶ προσδοκίας τῶν ἐπερχομένων τῇ οἰκουμένῃ, αἱ γὰρ δυνάμεις τῶν οὐρανῶν σαλευθήσονται.

text_en: And then they shall see the Son of man coming in a cloud, with great power and majesty.
text_la: et tunc videbunt Filium hominis venientem in nube cum potestate magna et majestate.
text_pt: E então verão vir o Filho do homem numa nuvem, com poder e grande glória.
text_el: καὶ τότε ὄψονται τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐρχόμενον ἐν νεφέλῃ μετὰ δυνάμεως καὶ δόξης πολλῆς.

text_en: But when these things begin to come to pass, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is at hand.
text_la: His autem fieri incipientibus, respicite, et levate capita vestra : quoniam appropinquat redemptio vestra.
text_pt: Ora, quando estas coisas começarem a acontecer, olhai para cima e levantai as vossas cabeças, porque a vossa redenção está próxima.
text_el: ἀρχομένων δὲ τούτων γίνεσθαι ἀνακύψατε καὶ ἐπάρατε τὰς κεφαλὰς ὑμῶν, διότι ἐγγίζει ἡ ἀπολύτρωσις ὑμῶν.

text_en: And he spoke to them a similitude. See the fig tree and all the trees:
text_la: Et dixit illis similitudinem : Videte ficulneam, et omnes arbores:
text_pt: E disse-lhes uma parábola: Olhai para a figueira, e para todas as árvores;
text_el: Καὶ εἶπεν παραβολὴν αὐτοῖς. ἴδετε τὴν συκῆν καὶ πάντα τὰ δένδρα:

text_en: When they now shoot forth their fruit, you know that summer is near;
text_la: cum producunt jam ex se fructum, scitis quoniam prope est æstas.
text_pt: Quando já têm rebentado, vós sabeis por vós mesmos, vendo-as, que perto está já o verão.
text_el: ὅταν προβάλωσιν ἤδη, βλέποντες ἀφ' ἑαυτῶν γινώσκετε ὅτι ἤδη ἐγγὺς τὸ θέρος ἐστίν.

text_en: so you also, when you shall see these things come to pass, know that the kingdom of God is at hand.
text_la: Ita et vos cum videritis hæc fieri, scitote quoniam prope est regnum Dei.
text_pt: Assim também vós, quando virdes acontecer estas coisas, sabei que o reino de Deus está perto.
text_el: οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς, ὅταν ἴδητε ταῦτα γινόμενα, γινώσκετε ὅτι ἐγγύς ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: Amen , I say to you, this generation shall not pass away till all things be fulfilled.
text_la: Amen dico vobis, quia non præteribit generatio hæc, donec omnia fiant.
text_pt: Em verdade vos digo que não passará esta geração até que tudo aconteça.
text_el: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐ μὴ παρέλθῃ ἡ γενεὰ αὕτη ἕως [ἂν] πάντα γένηται.

text_en: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
text_la: Cælum et terra transibunt : verba autem mea non transibunt.
text_pt: Passará o céu e a terra, mas as minhas palavras não hão de passar.
text_el: ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ παρελεύσονται, οἱ δὲ λόγοι μου οὐ μὴ παρελεύσονται.

text_en: And take heed to yourselves, lest perhaps your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting and drunkenness and the cares of this life: and that day come upon you suddenly.
text_la: Attendite autem vobis, ne forte graventur corda vestra in crapula, et ebrietate, et curis hujus vitæ, et superveniat in vos repentina dies illa:
text_pt: E olhai por vós, não aconteça que os vossos corações se carreguem de glutonaria, de embriaguez, e dos cuidados da vida, e venha sobre vós de improviso aquele dia.
text_el: Προσέχετε δὲ ἑαυτοῖς μήποτε βαρηθῶσιν αἱ καρδίαι ὑμῶν ἐν κραιπάλῃ καὶ μέθῃ καὶ μερίμναις βιωτικαῖς, καὶ ἐπιστῇ ἐφ' ὑμᾶς αἰφνίδιος ἡ ἡμέρα ἐκείνη

text_en: For as a snare shall it come upon all that sit upon the face of the whole earth.
text_la: tamquam laqueus enim superveniet in omnes qui sedent super faciem omnis terræ.
text_pt: Porque virá como um laço sobre todos os que habitam na face de toda a terra.
text_el: ὡς παγὶς: ἐπεισελεύσεται γὰρ ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς καθημένους ἐπὶ πρόσωπον πάσης τῆς γῆς.

text_en: Watch, therefore, praying at all times, that you may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that are to come and to stand before the Son of man .
text_la: Vigilate itaque, omni tempore orantes, ut digni habeamini fugere ista omnia quæ futura sunt, et stare ante Filium hominis.
text_pt: Vigiai, pois, em todo o tempo, orando, para que sejais havidos por dignos de evitar todas estas coisas que hão de acontecer, e de estar em pé diante do Filho do homem.
text_el: ἀγρυπνεῖτε δὲ ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ δεόμενοι ἵνα κατισχύσητε ἐκφυγεῖν ταῦτα πάντα τὰ μέλλοντα γίνεσθαι, καὶ σταθῆναι ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου.

text_en: And in the daytime, he was teaching in the temple : but at night going out, he abode in the mount that is called Olivet .
text_la: Erat autem diebus docens in templo : noctibus vero exiens, morabatur in monte qui vocatur Oliveti.
text_pt: E de dia ensinava no templo, e à noite, saindo, ficava no monte chamado das Oliveiras.
text_el: Ἦν δὲ τὰς ἡμέρας ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ διδάσκων, τὰς δὲ νύκτας ἐξερχόμενος ηὐλίζετο εἰς τὸ ὄρος τὸ καλούμενον Ἐλαιῶν.

text_en: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple , to hear him.
text_la: Et omnis populus manicabat ad eum in templo audire eum.
text_pt: E todo o povo ia ter com ele ao templo, de manhã cedo, para o ouvir.
text_el: καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ὤρθριζεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ ἀκούειν αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Now the feast of unleavened bread , which is called the pasch , was at hand.
text_la: Appropinquabat autem dies festus azymorum, qui dicitur Pascha:
text_pt: Estava, pois, perto a festa dos pães ázimos, chamada a páscoa.
text_el: Ἤγγιζεν δὲ ἡ ἑορτὴ τῶν ἀζύμων ἡ λεγομένη πάσχα,

text_en: And the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put Jesus to death: but they feared the people.
text_la: et quærebant principes sacerdotum, et scribæ, quomodo Jesum interficerent : timebant vero plebem.
text_pt: E os principais dos sacerdotes, e os escribas, andavam procurando como o matariam; porque temiam o povo.
text_el: καὶ ἐζήτουν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς τὸ πῶς ἀνέλωσιν αὐτόν: ἐφοβοῦντο γὰρ τὸν λαόν.

text_en: And Satan entered into Judas, who was surnamed Iscariot , one of the twelve.
text_la: Intravit autem Satanas in Judam, qui cognominabatur Iscariotes, unum de duodecim:
text_pt: Entrou, porém, Satanás em Judas, que tinha por sobrenome Iscariotes, o qual era do número dos doze.
text_el: Εἰσῆλθεν δὲ Σατανᾶς εἰς Ἰούδαν τὸν καλούμενον Ἰσκαριώτην, ὄντα ἐκ τοῦ ἀριθμοῦ τῶν δώδεκα:

text_en: And he went and discoursed with the chief priests and the magistrates, how he might betray him to them.
text_la: et abiit, et locutus est cum principibus sacerdotum, et magistratibus, quemadmodum illum traderet eis.
text_pt: E foi, e falou com os principais dos sacerdotes, e com os capitães, de como lho entregaria;
text_el: καὶ ἀπελθὼν συνελάλησεν τοῖς ἀρχιερεῦσιν καὶ στρατηγοῖς τὸ πῶς αὐτοῖς παραδῷ αὐτόν.

text_en: And they were glad and covenanted to give him money.
text_la: Et gavisi sunt, et pacti sunt pecuniam illi dare.
text_pt: Os quais se alegraram, e convieram em lhe dar dinheiro.
text_el: καὶ ἐχάρησαν, καὶ συνέθεντο αὐτῷ ἀργύριον δοῦναι:

text_en: And he promised. And he sought opportunity to betray him in the absence of the multitude.
text_la: Et spopondit, et quærebat opportunitatem ut traderet illum sine turbis.
text_pt: E ele concordou; e buscava oportunidade para lho entregar sem alvoroço.
text_el: καὶ ἐξωμολόγησεν, καὶ ἐζήτει εὐκαιρίαν τοῦ παραδοῦναι αὐτὸν ἄτερ ὄχλου αὐτοῖς.

text_en: And the day of the unleavened bread came, on which it was necessary that the pasch should be killed.
text_la: Venit autem dies azymorum, in qua necesse erat occidi pascha.
text_pt: Chegou, porém, o dia dos ázimos, em que importava sacrificar a páscoa.
text_el: Ἦλθεν δὲ ἡ ἡμέρα τῶν ἀζύμων, ᾗ ἔδει θύεσθαι τὸ πάσχα,

text_en: And he sent Peter and John , saying: Go, and prepare for us the pasch , that we may eat.
text_la: Et misit Petrum et Joannem, dicens : Euntes parate nobis pascha, ut manducemus.
text_pt: E mandou a Pedro e a João, dizendo: Ide, preparai-nos a páscoa, para que a comamos.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Πέτρον καὶ Ἰωάννην εἰπών: πορευθέντες ἑτοιμάσατε ἡμῖν τὸ πάσχα ἵνα φάγωμεν.

text_en: But they said: Where will you that we prepare?
text_la: At illi dixerunt : Ubi vis paremus?
text_pt: E eles lhe perguntaram: Onde queres que a preparemos?
text_el: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτῷ: ποῦ θέλεις ἑτοιμάσωμεν;

text_en: And he said to them: Behold, as you go into the city, there shall meet you a man carrying a pitcher of water: follow him into the house where he enters in.
text_la: Et dixit ad eos : Ecce introëuntibus vobis in civitatem occurret vobis homo quidam amphoram aquæ portans : sequimini eum in domum, in quam intrat,
text_pt: E ele lhes disse: Eis que, quando entrardes na cidade, encontrareis um homem, levando um cântaro de água; segui-o até à casa em que ele entrar.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: ἰδοὺ εἰσελθόντων ὑμῶν εἰς τὴν πόλιν συναντήσει ὑμῖν ἄνθρωπος κεράμιον ὕδατος βαστάζων: ἀκολουθήσατε αὐτῷ εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν εἰς ἣν εἰσπορεύεται.

text_en: And you shall say to the goodman of the house: The master says to you: Where is the guest chamber, where I may eat the pasch with my disciples ?
text_la: et dicetis patrifamilias domus : Dicit tibi Magister : Ubi est diversorium, ubi pascha cum discipulis meis manducem?
text_pt: E direis ao pai de família da casa: O Mestre te diz: Onde está o aposento em que hei de comer a páscoa com os meus discípulos?
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖτε τῷ οἰκοδεσπότῃ τῆς οἰκίας: λέγει σοι ὁ διδάσκαλος: ποῦ ἐστιν τὸ κατάλυμα ὅπου τὸ πάσχα μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν μου φάγω;

text_en: And he will show you a large dining room, furnished. And there prepare.
text_la: Et ipse ostendet vobis cœnaculum magnum stratum, et ibi parate.
text_pt: Então ele vos mostrará um grande cenáculo mobilado; aí fazei preparativos.
text_el: κἀκεῖνος ὑμῖν δείξει ἀνάγαιον μέγα ἐστρωμένον: ἐκεῖ ἑτοιμάσατε.

text_en: And they going, found as he had said to them and made ready the pasch .
text_la: Euntes autem invenerunt sicut dixit illis, et paraverunt pascha.
text_pt: E, indo eles, acharam como lhes havia sido dito; e prepararam a páscoa.
text_el: ἀπελθόντες δὲ εὗρον καθὼς εἰρήκει αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἡτοίμασαν τὸ πάσχα.

text_en: And when the hour had come, he sat down: and the twelve apostles with him.
text_la: Et cum facta esset hora, discubuit, et duodecim apostoli cum eo.
text_pt: E, chegada a hora, pôs-se à mesa, e com ele os doze apóstolos.
text_el: Καὶ ὅτε ἐγένετο ἡ ὥρα, ἀνέπεσεν, καὶ οἱ ἀπόστολοι σὺν αὐτῷ.

text_en: And he said to them: With desire I have desired to eat this pasch with you, before I suffer.
text_la: Et ait illis : Desiderio desideravi hoc pascha manducare vobiscum, antequam patiar.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Desejei muito comer convosco esta páscoa, antes que padeça;
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς: ἐπιθυμίᾳ ἐπεθύμησα τοῦτο τὸ πάσχα φαγεῖν μεθ' ὑμῶν πρὸ τοῦ με παθεῖν:

text_en: For I say to you that from this time I will not eat it, till it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God .
text_la: Dico enim vobis, quia ex hoc non manducabo illud, donec impleatur in regno Dei.
text_pt: Porque vos digo que não a comerei mais até que ela se cumpra no reino de Deus.
text_el: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐ μὴ φάγω αὐτὸ ἕως ὅτου πληρωθῇ ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: And having taken the chalice, he gave thanks and said: Take and divide it among you.
text_la: Et accepto calice gratias egit, et dixit : Accipite, et dividite inter vos.
text_pt: E, tomando o cálice, e havendo dado graças, disse: Tomai-o, e reparti-o entre vós;
text_el: καὶ δεξάμενος ποτήριον εὐχαριστήσας εἶπεν: λάβετε τοῦτο καὶ διαμερίσατε εἰς ἑαυτούς:

text_en: For I say to you that I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, till the kingdom of God come.
text_la: Dico enim vobis quod non bibam de generatione vitis donec regnum Dei veniat.
text_pt: Porque vos digo que já não beberei do fruto da vide, até que venha o reino de Deus.
text_el: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν οὐ μὴ πίω ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν ἀπὸ τοῦ γενήματος τῆς ἀμπέλου ἕως οὗ ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ ἔλθῃ.

text_en: And taking bread, he gave thanks and broke and gave to them, saying: This is my body, which is given for you. Do this for a commemoration of me.
text_la: Et accepto pane gratias egit, et fregit, et dedit eis, dicens : Hoc est corpus meum, quod pro vobis datur : hoc facite in meam commemorationem.
text_pt: E, tomando o pão, e havendo dado graças, partiu-o, e deu-lho, dizendo: Isto é o meu corpo, que por vós é dado; fazei isto em memória de mim.
text_el: Καὶ λαβὼν ἄρτον εὐχαριστήσας ἔκλασεν καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς λέγων: τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ σῶμά μου τὸ ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν διδόμενον: τοῦτο ποιεῖτε εἰς τὴν ἐμὴν ἀνάμνησιν.

text_en: In like manner, the chalice also, after he had supped, saying: This is the chalice, the new testament in my blood, which shall be shed for you.
text_la: Similiter et calicem, postquam cœnavit, dicens : Hic est calix novum testamentum in sanguine meo, qui pro vobis fundetur.
text_pt: Semelhantemente, tomou o cálice, depois da ceia, dizendo: Este cálice é o novo testamento no meu sangue, que é derramado por vós.
text_el: καὶ τὸ ποτήριον ὡσαύτως μετὰ τὸ δειπνῆσαι, λέγων: τοῦτο τὸ ποτήριον ἡ καινὴ διαθήκη ἐν τῷ αἵματί μου, τὸ ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ἐκξυννόμενον]].

text_en: But yet behold: the hand of him that betrays me is with me on the table.
text_la: Verumtamen ecce manus tradentis me, mecum est in mensa.
text_pt: Mas eis que a mão do que me trai está comigo à mesa.
text_el: Πλὴν ἰδοὺ ἡ χεὶρ τοῦ παραδιδόντος με μετ' ἐμοῦ ἐπὶ τῆς τραπέζης:

text_en: And the Son of man indeed goes, according to that which is determined: but yet, woe to that man by whom he shall be betrayed.
text_la: Et quidem Filius hominis, secundum quod definitum est, vadit : verumtamen væ homini illi per quem tradetur.
text_pt: E, na verdade, o Filho do homem vai segundo o que está determinado; mas ai daquele homem por quem é traído!
text_el: ὅτι ὁ υἱὸς μὲν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου κατὰ τὸ ὡρισμένον πορεύεται, πλὴν οὐαὶ τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ ἐκείνῳ δι' οὗ παραδίδοται.

text_en: And they began to inquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.
text_la: Et ipsi cœperunt quærere inter se quis esset ex eis qui hoc facturus esset.
text_pt: E começaram a perguntar entre si qual deles seria o que havia de fazer isto.
text_el: καὶ αὐτοὶ ἤρξαντο συζητεῖν πρὸς ἑαυτοὺς τὸ τίς ἄρα εἴη ἐξ αὐτῶν ὁ τοῦτο μέλλων πράσσειν.

text_en: And there was also a strife amongst them, which of them should seem to be the greater.
text_la: Facta est autem et contentio inter eos, quis eorum videretur esse major.
text_pt: E houve também entre eles contenda, sobre qual deles parecia ser o maior.
text_el: Ἐγένετο δὲ καὶ φιλονεικία ἐν αὐτοῖς, τὸ τίς αὐτῶν δοκεῖ εἶναι μείζων.

text_en: And he said to them: The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them; and they that have power over them are called beneficent.
text_la: Dixit autem eis : Reges gentium dominantur eorum : et qui potestatem habent super eos, benefici vocantur.
text_pt: E ele lhes disse: Os reis dos gentios dominam sobre eles, e os que têm autoridade sobre eles são chamados benfeitores.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: οἱ βασιλεῖς τῶν ἐθνῶν κυριεύουσιν αὐτῶν, καὶ οἱ ἐξουσιάζοντες αὐτῶν εὐεργέται καλοῦνται.

text_en: But you not so: but he that is the greater among you, let him become as the younger: and he that is the leader, as he that serves.
text_la: Vos autem non sic : sed qui major est in vobis, fiat sicut minor : et qui præcessor est, sicut ministrator.
text_pt: Mas não sereis vós assim; antes o maior entre vós seja como o menor; e quem governa como quem serve.
text_el: ὑμεῖς δὲ οὐχ οὕτως, ἀλλ' ὁ μείζων ἐν ὑμῖν γινέσθω ὡς ὁ νεώτερος, καὶ ὁ ἡγούμενος ὡς ὁ διακονῶν.

text_en: For which is greater, he that sits at table or he that serves? Is not he that sits at table? But I am in the midst of you, as he that serves.
text_la: Nam quis major est, qui recumbit, an qui ministrat? nonne qui recumbit? Ego autem in medio vestrum sum, sicut qui ministrat:
text_pt: Pois qual é maior: quem está à mesa, ou quem serve? Porventura não é quem está à mesa? Eu, porém, entre vós sou como aquele que serve.
text_el: τίς γὰρ μείζων, ὁ ἀνακείμενος ἢ ὁ διακονῶν; οὐχὶ ὁ ἀνακείμενος; ἐγὼ δὲ ἐν μέσῳ ὑμῶν εἰμι ὡς ὁ διακονῶν.

text_en: And you are they who have continued with me in my temptations :
text_la: vos autem estis, qui permansistis mecum in tentationibus meis.
text_pt: E vós sois os que tendes permanecido comigo nas minhas tentações.
text_el: ὑμεῖς δέ ἐστε οἱ διαμεμενηκότες μετ' ἐμοῦ ἐν τοῖς πειρασμοῖς μου:

text_en: And I dispose to you, as my Father has disposed to me, a kingdom;
text_la: Et ego dispono vobis sicut disposuit mihi Pater meus regnum,
text_pt: E eu vos destino o reino, como meu Pai mo destinou,
text_el: κἀγὼ διατίθεμαι ὑμῖν καθὼς διέθετό μοι ὁ πατήρ μου βασιλείαν,

text_en: that you may eat and drink at my table, in my kingdom: and may sit upon thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel .
text_la: ut edatis et bibatis super mensam meam in regno meo, et sedeatis super thronos judicantes duodecim tribus Israël.
text_pt: Para que comais e bebais à minha mesa no meu reino, e vos assenteis sobre tronos, julgando as doze tribos de Israel.
text_el: ἵνα ἔσθητε καὶ πίνητε ἐπὶ τῆς τραπέζης μου ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ μου, καὶ καθῆσθε ἐπὶ θρόνων τὰς δώδεκα φυλὰς κρίνοντες τοῦ Ἰσραήλ.

text_en: And the Lord said: Simon , Simon , behold Satan has desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat.
text_la: Ait autem Dominus : Simon, Simon, ecce Satanas expetivit vos ut cribraret sicut triticum:
text_pt: Disse também o Senhor: Simão, Simão, eis que Satanás vos pediu para vos cirandar como trigo;
text_el: Σίμων Σίμων, ἰδοὺ ὁ Σατανᾶς ἐξῃτήσατο ὑμᾶς τοῦ σινιάσαι ὡς τὸν σῖτον:

text_en: But I have prayed for you, that your faith fail not: and you, being once converted , confirm your brethren.
text_la: ego autem rogavi pro te ut non deficiat fides tua : et tu aliquando conversus, confirma fratres tuos.
text_pt: Mas eu roguei por ti, para que a tua fé não desfaleça; e tu, quando te converteres, confirma teus irmãos.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ ἐδεήθην περὶ σοῦ ἵνα μὴ ἐκλίπῃ ἡ πίστις σου. καὶ σύ ποτε ἐπιστρέψας στήρισον τοὺς ἀδελφούς σου.

text_en: Who said to him: Lord, I am ready to go with you, both into prison and to death.
text_la: Qui dixit ei : Domine, tecum paratus sum et in carcerem et in mortem ire.
text_pt: E ele lhe disse: Senhor, estou pronto a ir contigo até à prisão e à morte.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῷ: κύριε, μετὰ σοῦ ἕτοιμός εἰμι καὶ εἰς φυλακὴν καὶ εἰς θάνατον πορεύεσθαι.

text_en: And he said: I say to you, Peter , the cock shall not crow this day, till you thrice deny that you know me. And he said to them:
text_la: At ille dixit : Dico tibi, Petre, non cantabit hodie gallus, donec ter abneges nosse me. Et dixit eis:
text_pt: Mas ele disse: Digo-te, Pedro, que não cantará hoje o galo antes que três vezes negues que me conheces.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν: λέγω σοι, Πέτρε, οὐ φωνήσει σήμερον ἀλέκτωρ ἕως τρίς με ἀπαρνήσῃ εἰδέναι.

text_en: When I sent you without purse and scrip and shoes, did you want anything?
text_la: Quando misi vos sine sacculo, et pera, et calceamentis, numquid aliquid defuit vobis?
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Quando vos mandei sem bolsa, alforje, ou alparcas, faltou-vos porventura alguma coisa? Eles responderam: Nada.
text_el: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: ὅτε ἀπέστειλα ὑμᾶς ἄτερ βαλλαντίου καὶ πήρας καὶ ὑποδημάτων, μή τινος ὑστερήσατε; οἱ δὲ εἶπαν: οὐθενός.

text_en: But they said: Nothing. Then said he unto them: But now he that has a purse, let him take it, and likewise a scrip: and he that has not, let him sell his coat and buy a sword.
text_la: At illi dixerunt : Nihil. Dixit ergo eis : Sed nunc qui habet sacculum, tollat; similiter et peram : et qui non habet, vendat tunicam suam et emat gladium.
text_pt: Disse-lhes pois: Mas agora, aquele que tiver bolsa, tome-a, como também o alforje; e, o que não tem espada, venda a sua capa e compre-a;
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς: ἀλλὰ νῦν ὁ ἔχων βαλλάντιον ἀράτω, ὁμοίως καὶ πήραν, καὶ ὁ μὴ ἔχων πωλησάτω τὸ ἱμάτιον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀγορασάτω μάχαιραν.

text_en: For I say to you that this that is written must yet be fulfilled in me. And with the wicked was he reckoned. For the things concerning me have an end.
text_la: Dico enim vobis, quoniam adhuc hoc quod scriptum est, oportet impleri in me : Et cum iniquis deputatus est. Etenim ea quæ sunt de me finem habent.
text_pt: Porquanto vos digo que importa que em mim se cumpra aquilo que está escrito: E com os malfeitores foi contado. Porque o que está escrito de mim terá cumprimento.
text_el: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι τοῦτο τὸ γεγραμμένον δεῖ τελεσθῆναι ἐν ἐμοί, τὸ: καὶ μετὰ ἀνόμων ἐλογίσθη: καὶ γὰρ τὸ περὶ ἐμοῦ τέλος ἔχει.

text_en: But they said: Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said to them: It is enough.
text_la: At illi dixerunt : Domine, ecce duo gladii hic. At ille dixit eis : Satis est.
text_pt: E eles disseram: Senhor, eis aqui duas espadas. E ele lhes disse: Basta.
text_el: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν: κύριε, ἰδοὺ μάχαιραι ὧδε δύο. ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: ἱκανόν ἐστιν.

text_en: And going out, he went, according to his custom, to the Mount of Olives . And his disciples also followed him.
text_la: Et egressus ibat secundum consuetudinem in monte Olivarum. Secuti sunt autem illum et discipuli.
text_pt: E, saindo, foi, como costumava, para o Monte das Oliveiras; e também os seus discípulos o seguiram.
text_el: Καὶ ἐξελθὼν ἐπορεύθη κατὰ τὸ ἔθος εἰς τὸ ὄρος τῶν ἐλαιῶν: ἠκολούθησαν δὲ αὐτῷ [καὶ] οἱ μαθηταί.

text_en: And when he had come to the place, he said to them: Pray , lest you enter into temptation .
text_la: Et cum pervenisset ad locum, dixit illis : Orate ne intretis in tentationem.
text_pt: E quando chegou àquele lugar, disse-lhes: Orai, para que não entreis em tentação.
text_el: γενόμενος δὲ ἐπὶ τοῦ τόπου εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: προσεύχεσθε μὴ εἰσελθεῖν εἰς πειρασμόν.

text_en: And he was withdrawn away from them a stone's cast. And kneeling down, he prayed .
text_la: Et ipse avulsus est ab eis quantum jactus est lapidis: et positis genibus orabat,
text_pt: E apartou-se deles cerca de um tiro de pedra; e, pondo-se de joelhos, orava,
text_el: καὶ αὐτὸς ἀπεσπάσθη ἀπ' αὐτῶν ὡσεὶ λίθου βολήν, καὶ θεὶς τὰ γόνατα προσηύχετο

text_en: Saying: Father , if you will, remove this chalice from me: but yet not my will, but yours be done.
text_la: dicens : Pater, si vis, transfer calicem istum a me : verumtamen non mea voluntas, sed tua fiat.
text_pt: Dizendo: Pai, se queres, passa de mim este cálice; todavia não se faça a minha vontade, mas a tua.
text_el: λέγων: πάτερ, εἰ βούλει παρένεγκε τοῦτο τὸ ποτήριον ἀπ' ἐμοῦ: πλὴν μὴ τὸ θέλημά μου ἀλλὰ τὸ σὸν γινέσθω.

text_en: And there appeared to him an angel from heaven , strengthening him. And being in an agony , he prayed the longer.
text_la: Apparuit autem illi angelus de cælo, confortans eum. Et factus in agonia, prolixius orabat.
text_pt: E apareceu-lhe um anjo do céu, que o fortalecia.
text_el: [[ὤφθη δὲ αὐτῷ ἄγγελος ἀπὸ' τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐνισχύων αὐτόν.

text_en: And his sweat became as drops of blood, trickling down upon the ground.
text_la: Et factus est sudor ejus sicut guttæ sanguinis decurrentis in terram.
text_pt: E, posto em agonia, orava mais intensamente. E o seu suor tornou-se como grandes gotas de sangue, que corriam até ao chão.
text_el: καὶ γενόμενος ἐν ἀγωνίᾳ ἐκτενέστερον προσηύχετο: καὶ ἐγένετο ὁ ἱδρὼς αὐτοῦ ὡσεὶ θρόμβοι αἵματος καταβαίνοντες ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν.]]

text_en: And when he rose up from prayer and had come to the disciples , he found them sleeping for sorrow.
text_la: Et cum surrexisset ab oratione et venisset ad discipulos suos, invenit eos dormientes præ tristitia.
text_pt: E, levantando-se da oração, veio para os seus discípulos, e achou-os dormindo de tristeza.
text_el: καὶ ἀναστὰς ἀπὸ τῆς προσευχῆς ἐλθὼν πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς εὗρεν κοιμωμένους αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ τῆς λύπης,

text_en: And he said to them: Why sleep you? Arise: pray : lest you enter into temptation .
text_la: Et ait illis : Quid dormitis? surgite, orate, ne intretis in tentationem.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Por que estais dormindo? Levantai-vos, e orai, para que não entreis em tentação.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: τί καθεύδετε; ἀναστάντες προσεύχεσθε, ἵνα μὴ εἰσέλθητε εἰς πειρασμόν.

text_en: As he was yet speaking, behold a multitude; and he that was called Judas , one of the twelve, went before them and drew near to Jesus , for to kiss him.
text_la: Adhuc eo loquente, ecce turba : et qui vocabatur Judas, unus de duodecim, antecedebat eos, et appropinquavit Jesu ut oscularetur eum.
text_pt: E, estando ele ainda a falar, surgiu uma multidão; e um dos doze, que se chamava Judas, ia adiante dela, e chegou-se a Jesus para o beijar.
text_el: Ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος ἰδοὺ ὄχλος, καὶ ὁ λεγόμενος Ἰούδας εἷς τῶν δώδεκα προήρχετο αὐτούς, καὶ ἤγγισεν τῷ Ἰησοῦ φιλῆσαι αὐτόν.

text_en: And Jesus said to him: Judas , do you betray the Son of man with a kiss ?
text_la: Jesus autem dixit illi : Juda, osculo Filium hominis tradis?
text_pt: E Jesus lhe disse: Judas, com um beijo trais o Filho do homem?
text_el: Ἰησοῦς δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῷ: Ἰούδα, φιλήματι τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδίδως;

text_en: And they that were about him, seeing what would follow, said to him: Lord, shall we strike with the sword?
text_la: Videntes autem hi qui circa ipsum erant, quod futurum erat, dixerunt ei : Domine, si percutimus in gladio?
text_pt: E, vendo os que estavam com ele o que ia suceder, disseram-lhe: Senhor, feriremos à espada?
text_el: ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ περὶ αὐτὸν τὸ ἐσόμενον εἶπαν: κύριε, εἰ πατάξομεν ἐν μαχαίρῃ;

text_en: And one of them struck the servant of the high priest and cut off his right ear.
text_la: Et percussit unus ex illis servum principis sacerdotum, et amputavit auriculam ejus dexteram.
text_pt: E um deles feriu o servo do sumo sacerdote, e cortou-lhe a orelha direita.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάταξεν εἷς τις ἐξ αὐτῶν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως τὸν δοῦλον καὶ ἀφεῖλεν τὸ οὖς αὐτοῦ τὸ δεξιόν.

text_en: But Jesus answering, said: Allow thus far. And when he had touched his ear, he healed him.
text_la: Respondens autem Jesus, ait : Sinite usque huc. Et cum tetigisset auriculam ejus, sanavit eum.
text_pt: E, respondendo Jesus, disse: Deixai-os; basta. E, tocando-lhe a orelha, o curou.
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν: ἐᾶτε ἕως τούτου. καὶ ἁψάμενος τοῦ ὠτίου ἰάσατο αὐτόν.

text_en: And Jesus said to the chief priests and magistrates of the temple and the ancients, that had come unto him: Have you come out, as it were against a thief , with swords and clubs?
text_la: Dixit autem Jesus ad eos qui venerant ad se principes sacerdotum, et magistratus templi, et seniores : Quasi ad latronem existis cum gladiis et fustibus?
text_pt: E disse Jesus aos principais dos sacerdotes, e capitães do templo, e anciãos, que tinham ido contra ele: Saístes, como a um salteador, com espadas e varapaus?
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ἰησοῦς πρὸς τοὺς παραγενομένους ἐπ' αὐτὸν ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ στρατηγοὺς τοῦ ἱεροῦ καὶ πρεσβυτέρους: ὡς ἐπὶ λῃστὴν ἐξήλθατε μετὰ μαχαιρῶν καὶ ξύλων:

text_en: When I was daily with you in the temple , you did not stretch forth your hands against me: but this is your hour and the power of darkness.
text_la: Cum quotidie vobiscum fuerim in templo, non extendistis manus in me : sed hæc est hora vestra, et potestas tenebrarum.
text_pt: Tenho estado todos os dias convosco no templo, e não estendestes as mãos contra mim, mas esta é a vossa hora e o poder das trevas.
text_el: καθ' ἡμέραν ὄντος μου μεθ' ὑμῶν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ οὐκ ἐξετείνατε τὰς χεῖρας ἐπ' ἐμέ. ἀλλ' αὕτη ἐστὶν ὑμῶν ἡ ὥρα καὶ ἡ ἐξουσία τοῦ σκότους.

text_en: And apprehending him, they led him to the high priest's house. But Peter followed afar off.
text_la: Comprehendentes autem eum, duxerunt ad domum principis sacerdotum : Petrus vero sequebatur a longe.
text_pt: Então, prendendo-o, o levaram, e o puseram em casa do sumo sacerdote. E Pedro seguia-o de longe.
text_el: συλλαβόντες δὲ αὐτὸν ἤγαγον καὶ εἰσήγαγον εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως: ὁ δὲ Πέτρος ἠκολούθει μακρόθεν.

text_en: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall and were sitting about it, Peter was in the midst of them.
text_la: Accenso autem igne in medio atrii et circumsedentibus illis, erat Petrus in medio eorum.
text_pt: E, havendo-se acendido fogo no meio do pátio, estando todos sentados, assentou-se Pedro entre eles.
text_el: περιαψάντων δὲ πῦρ ἐν μέσῳ τῆς αὐλῆς καὶ συγκαθισάντων ἐκάθητο ὁ Πέτρος μέσος αὐτῶν.

text_en: Whom when a certain servant maid had seen sitting at the light and had earnestly beheld him, she said: This man also was with him.
text_la: Quem cum vidisset ancilla quædam sedentem ad lumen, et eum fuisset intuita, dixit : Et hic cum illo erat.
text_pt: E como certa criada, vendo-o estar assentado ao fogo, pusesse os olhos nele, disse: Este também estava com ele.
text_el: ἰδοῦσα δὲ αὐτὸν παιδίσκη τις καθήμενον πρὸς τὸ φῶς καὶ ἀτενίσασα αὐτῷ εἶπεν: καὶ οὗτος σὺν αὐτῷ ἦν.

text_en: But he denied him, saying: Woman , I know him not.
text_la: At ille negavit eum, dicens : Mulier, non novi illum.
text_pt: Porém, ele negou-o, dizendo: Mulher, não o conheço.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἠρνήσατο λέγων: οὐκ οἶδα αὐτόν, γύναι.

text_en: And after a little while, another seeing him, said: You also are one of them. But Peter said: O man , I am not.
text_la: Et post pusillum alius videns eum, dixit : Et tu de illis es. Petrus vero ait : O homo, non sum.
text_pt: E, um pouco depois, vendo-o outro, disse: Tu és também deles. Mas Pedro disse: Homem, não sou.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ βραχὺ ἕτερος ἰδὼν αὐτὸν ἔφη: καὶ σὺ ἐξ αὐτῶν εἶ. ὁ δὲ Πέτρος ἔφη: ἄνθρωπε, οὐκ εἰμί.

text_en: And after the space, as it were of one hour, another certain man affirmed, saying: Of a truth , this man was also with him: for he is also a Galilean .
text_la: Et intervallo facto quasi horæ unius, alius quidam affirmabat, dicens : Vere et hic cum illo erat : nam et Galilæus est.
text_pt: E, passada quase uma hora, um outro afirmava, dizendo: Também este verdadeiramente estava com ele, pois também é galileu.
text_el: καὶ διαστάσης ὡσεὶ ὥρας μιᾶς ἄλλος τις διϊσχυρίζετο λέγων: ἐπ' ἀληθείας καὶ οὗτος μετ' αὐτοῦ ἦν: καὶ γὰρ Γαλιλαῖός ἐστιν.

text_en: And Peter said: Man, I know not what you say. And immediately, as he was yet speaking, the cock crew.
text_la: Et ait Petrus : Homo, nescio quid dicis. Et continuo, adhuc illo loquente, cantavit gallus.
text_pt: E Pedro disse: Homem, não sei o que dizes. E logo, estando ele ainda a falar, cantou o galo.
