text_el: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ Πέτρος: ἄνθρωπε, οὐκ οἶδα ὃ λέγεις. καὶ παραχρῆμα ἔτι λαλοῦντος αὐτοῦ ἐφώνησεν ἀλέκτωρ,

text_en: And the Lord turning looked on Peter . And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, as he had said: Before the cock crow, you shall deny thrice.
text_la: Et conversus Dominus respexit Petrum, et recordatus est Petrus verbi Domini, sicut dixerat : Quia priusquam gallus cantet, ter me negabis.
text_pt: E, virando-se o Senhor, olhou para Pedro, e Pedro lembrou-se da palavra do Senhor, como lhe havia dito: Antes que o galo cante hoje, me negarás três vezes.
text_el: καὶ στραφεὶς ὁ κύριος ἐνέβλεψεν τῷ Πέτρῳ, καὶ ὑπεμνήσθη ὁ Πέτρος τοῦ ῥήματος τοῦ κυρίου, ὡς εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὅτι πρὶν ἀλέκτορα φωνῆσαι σήμερον ἀπαρνήσῃ με τρίς.

text_en: And Peter going out, wept bitterly.
text_la: Et egressus foras Petrus flevit amare.
text_pt: E, saindo Pedro para fora, chorou amargamente.
text_el: [καὶ ἐξελθὼν ἔξω ἔκλαυσεν πικρῶς].

text_en: And the men that held him mocked him and struck him.
text_la: Et viri qui tenebant illum, illudebant ei, cædentes.
text_pt: E os homens que detinham Jesus zombavam dele, ferindo-o.
text_el: Καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες οἱ συνέχοντες αὐτὸν ἐνέπαιζον αὐτῷ δέροντες,

text_en: And they blindfolded him and smote his face. And they asked him saying: Prophesy : Who is it that struck you?
text_la: Et velaverunt eum, et percutiebant faciem ejus : et interrogabant eum, dicentes : Prophetiza, quis est, qui te percussit?
text_pt: E, vendando-lhe os olhos, feriam-no no rosto, e perguntavam-lhe, dizendo: Profetiza, quem é que te feriu?
text_el: καὶ περικαλύψαντες αὐτὸν ἐπηρώτων λέγοντες: προφήτευσον, τίς ἐστιν ὁ παίσας σε;

text_en: And blaspheming , many other things they said against him.
text_la: Et alia multa blasphemantes dicebant in eum.
text_pt: E outras muitas coisas diziam contra ele, blasfemando.
text_el: καὶ ἕτερα πολλὰ βλασφημοῦντες ἔλεγον εἰς αὐτόν.

text_en: And as soon as it was day, the ancients of the people and the chief priests and scribes came together. And they brought him into their council saying: If you be the Christ , tell us.
text_la: Et ut factus est dies, convenerunt seniores plebis, et principes sacerdotum, et scribæ, et duxerunt illum in concilium suum, dicentes : Si tu es Christus, dic nobis.
text_pt: E logo que foi dia ajuntaram-se os anciãos do povo, e os principais dos sacerdotes e os escribas, e o conduziram ao seu concílio, e lhe perguntaram:
text_el: Καὶ ὡς ἐγένετο ἡμέρα, συνήχθη τὸ πρεσβυτέριον τοῦ λαοῦ, ἀρχιερεῖς τε καὶ γραμματεῖς, καὶ ἀπήγαγον αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ συνέδριον αὐτῶν,

text_en: And he says to them: If I shall tell you, you will not believe me.
text_la: Et ait illis : Si vobis dixero, non credetis mihi:
text_pt: És tu o Cristo? Dize-no-lo. Ele replicou: Se vo-lo disser, não o crereis;
text_el: λέγοντες: εἰ σὺ εἶ ὁ Χριστός, εἰπὸν ἡμῖν. εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς: ἐὰν ὑμῖν εἴπω οὐ μὴ πιστεύσητε:

text_en: And if I shall also ask you, you will not answer me, nor let me go.
text_la: si autem et interrogavero, non respondebitis mihi, neque dimittetis.
text_pt: E também, se vos perguntar, não me respondereis, nem me soltareis.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἐρωτήσω, οὐ μὴ ἀποκριθῆτε.

text_en: But hereafter the Son of man shall be sitting on the right hand of the power of God .
text_la: Ex hoc autem erit Filius hominis sedens a dextris virtutis Dei.
text_pt: Desde agora o Filho do homem se assentará à direita do poder de Deus.
text_el: ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν δὲ ἔσται ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου καθήμενος ἐκ δεξιῶν τῆς δυνάμεως τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: Then said they all: Are you then the Son of God ? Who said: You say that I am.
text_la: Dixerunt autem omnes : Tu ergo es Filius Dei? Qui ait : Vos dicitis, quia ego sum.
text_pt: E disseram todos: Logo, és tu o Filho de Deus? E ele lhes disse: Vós dizeis que eu sou.
text_el: εἶπαν δὲ πάντες: σὺ οὖν εἶ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ; ὁ δὲ πρὸς αὐτοὺς ἔφη: ὑμεῖς λέγετε, ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι.

text_en: And they said: What need we any further testimony? For we ourselves have heard it from his own mouth.
text_la: At illi dixerunt : Quid adhuc desideramus testimonium? ipsi enim audivimus de ore ejus.
text_pt: Então disseram: De que mais testemunho necessitamos? pois nós mesmos o ouvimos da sua boca.
text_el: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν: τί ἔτι ἔχομεν μαρτυρίας χρείαν; αὐτοὶ γὰρ ἠκούσαμεν ἀπὸ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And the whole multitude of them, rising up, led him to Pilate .
text_la: Et surgens omnis multitudo eorum, duxerunt illum ad Pilatum.
text_pt: E, levantando-se toda a multidão deles, o levaram a Pilatos.
text_el: Καὶ ἀναστὰν ἅπαν τὸ πλῆθος αὐτῶν ἤγαγον αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὸν Πιλᾶτον.

text_en: And they began to accuse him, saying: We have found this man perverting our nation and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar and saying that he is Christ the king .
text_la: Cœperunt autem illum accusare, dicentes : Hunc invenimus subvertentem gentem nostram, et prohibentem tributa dare Cæsari, et dicentem se Christum regem esse.
text_pt: E começaram a acusá-lo, dizendo: Havemos achado este pervertendo a nação, proibindo dar o tributo a César, e dizendo que ele mesmo é Cristo, o rei.
text_el: ἤρξαντο δὲ κατηγορεῖν αὐτοῦ λέγοντες: τοῦτον εὕραμεν διαστρέφοντα τὸ ἔθνος ἡμῶν καὶ κωλύοντα φόρους Καίσαρι διδόναι, καὶ λέγοντα ἑαυτὸν Χριστὸν βασιλέα εἶναι.

text_en: And Pilate asked him, saying: Are you the king of the Jews ? But he answering, said: You say it.
text_la: Pilatus autem interrogavit eum, dicens : Tu es rex Judæorum? At ille respondens ait : Tu dicis.
text_pt: E Pilatos perguntou-lhe, dizendo: Tu és o Rei dos Judeus? E ele, respondendo, disse-lhe: Tu o dizes.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Πιλᾶτος ἠρώτησεν αὐτὸν λέγων: σὺ εἶ ὁ βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων; ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς αὐτῷ ἔφη: σὺ λέγεις.

text_en: And Pilate said to the chief priests and to the multitudes: I find no cause in this man .
text_la: Ait autem Pilatus ad principes sacerdotum et turbas : Nihil invenio causæ in hoc homine.
text_pt: E disse Pilatos aos principais dos sacerdotes, e à multidão: Não acho culpa alguma neste homem.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Πιλᾶτος εἶπεν πρὸς τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ τοὺς ὄχλους: οὐδὲν εὑρίσκω αἴτιον ἐν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ τούτῳ.

text_en: But they were more earnest, saying: He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea , beginning from Galilee to this place.
text_la: At illi invalescebant, dicentes : Commovet populum docens per universam Judæam, incipiens a Galilæa usque huc.
text_pt: Mas eles insistiam cada vez mais, dizendo: Alvoroça o povo ensinando por toda a Judéia, começando desde a Galiléia até aqui.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἐπίσχυον λέγοντες ὅτι ἀνασείει τὸν λαὸν, διδάσκων καθ' ὅλης τῆς Ἰουδαίας καὶ ἀρξάμενος ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας ἕως ὧδε.

text_en: But Pilate hearing Galilee , asked if the man were of Galilee ?
text_la: Pilatus autem audiens Galilæam, interrogavit si homo Galilæus esset.
text_pt: Então Pilatos, ouvindo falar da Galiléia perguntou se aquele homem era galileu.
text_el: Πιλᾶτος δὲ ἀκούσας ἐπηρώτησεν εἰ [ὁ] ἄνθρωπος Γαλιλαῖός ἐστιν,

text_en: And when he understood that he was of Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him away to Herod , who was also himself at Jerusalem in those days.
text_la: Et ut cognovit quod de Herodis potestate esset, remisit eum ad Herodem, qui et ipse Jerosolymis erat illis diebus.
text_pt: E, sabendo que era da jurisdição de Herodes, remeteu-o a Herodes, que também naqueles dias estava em Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιγνοὺς ὅτι ἐκ τῆς ἐξουσίας Ἡρῴδου ἐστὶν, ἀνέπεμψεν αὐτὸν πρὸς Ἡρῴδην, ὄντα καὶ αὐτὸν ἐν Ἱεροσολύμοις ἐν ταύταις ταῖς ἡμέραις.

text_en: And Herod seeing Jesus , was very glad: for he was desirous of a long time to see him, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to see some sign wrought by him.
text_la: Herodes autem viso Jesu, gavisus est valde. Erat enim cupiens ex multo tempore videre eum, eo quod audierat multa de eo, et sperabat signum aliquod videre ab eo fieri.
text_pt: E Herodes, quando viu a Jesus, alegrou-se muito; porque havia muito que desejava vê-lo, por ter ouvido dele muitas coisas; e esperava que lhe veria fazer algum sinal.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἡρῴδης ἰδὼν τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἐχάρη λίαν: ἦν γὰρ ἐξ ἱκανῶν χρόνων θέλων ἰδεῖν αὐτὸν διὰ τὸ ἀκούειν περὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἤλπιζέν τι σημεῖον ἰδεῖν ὑπ' αὐτοῦ γινόμενον.

text_en: And he questioned him in many words. But he answered him nothing.
text_la: Interrogabat autem eum multis sermonibus. At ipse nihil illi respondebat.
text_pt: E interrogava-o com muitas palavras, mas ele nada lhe respondia.
text_el: ἐπηρώτα δὲ αὐτὸν ἐν λόγοις ἱκανοῖς: αὐτὸς δὲ οὐδὲν ἀπεκρίνατο αὐτῷ.

text_en: And the chief priests and the scribes stood by, earnestly accusing him.
text_la: Stabant autem principes sacerdotum et scribæ constanter accusantes eum.
text_pt: E estavam os principais dos sacerdotes, e os escribas, acusando-o com grande veemência.
text_el: εἱστήκεισαν δὲ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς εὐτόνως κατηγοροῦντες αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And Herod with his army set him at nought and mocked him, putting on him a white garment: and sent him back to Pilate .
text_la: Sprevit autem illum Herodes cum exercitu suo : et illusit indutum veste alba, et remisit ad Pilatum.
text_pt: E Herodes, com os seus soldados, desprezou-o e, escarnecendo dele, vestiu-o de uma roupa resplandecente e tornou a enviá-lo a Pilatos.
text_el: ἐξουθενήσας δὲ αὐτὸν ὁ Ἡρῴδης σὺν τοῖς στρατεύμασιν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐμπαίξας περιβαλὼν ἐσθῆτα λαμπρὰν ἀνέπεμψεν αὐτὸν τῷ Πιλάτῳ.

text_en: And Herod and Pilate were made friends, that same day: for before they were enemies one to another.
text_la: Et facti sunt amici Herodes et Pilatus in ipsa die: nam antea inimici erant ad invicem.
text_pt: E no mesmo dia, Pilatos e Herodes entre si se fizeram amigos; pois dantes andavam em inimizade um com o outro.
text_el: ἐγένοντο δὲ φίλοι ὅ τε Ἡρῴδης καὶ ὁ Πιλᾶτος ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ μετ' ἀλλήλων: προϋπῆρχον γὰρ ἐν ἔχθρᾳ ὄντες πρὸς αὐτούς.

text_en: And Pilate , calling together the chief priests and the magistrates and the people,
text_la: Pilatus autem, convocatis principibus sacerdotum, et magistratibus, et plebe,
text_pt: E, convocando Pilatos os principais dos sacerdotes, e os magistrados, e o povo,
text_el: Πιλᾶτος δὲ συγκαλεσάμενος τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ τοὺς ἄρχοντας καὶ τὸν λαὸν

text_en: said to them: You have presented unto me this man as one that perverts the people. And behold I, having examined him before you, find no cause in this man , in those things wherein you accuse him.
text_la: dixit ad illos : Obtulistis mihi hunc hominem, quasi avertentem populum, et ecce ego coram vobis interrogans, nullam causam inveni in homine isto ex his in quibus eum accusatis.
text_pt: Disse-lhes: Haveis-me apresentado este homem como pervertedor do povo; e eis que, examinando-o na vossa presença, nenhuma culpa, das de que o acusais, acho neste homem.
text_el: εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς: προσηνέγκατέ μοι τὸν ἄνθρωπον τοῦτον ὡς ἀποστρέφοντα τὸν λαόν, καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐνώπιον ὑμῶν ἀνακρίνας οὐθὲν εὗρον ἐν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ τούτῳ αἴτιον ὧν κατηγορεῖτε κατ' αὐτοῦ,

text_en: No, nor Herod neither. For, I sent you to him: and behold, nothing worthy of death is done to him.
text_la: Sed neque Herodes : nam remisi vos ad illum, et ecce nihil dignum morte actum est ei.
text_pt: Nem mesmo Herodes, porque a ele vos remeti, e eis que não tem feito coisa alguma digna de morte.
text_el: ἀλλ' οὐδὲ Ἡρῴδης: ἀνέπεμψεν γὰρ αὐτὸν πρὸς ἡμᾶς: καὶ ἰδοὺ οὐδὲν ἄξιον θανάτου ἐστὶν πεπραγμένον αὐτῷ.

text_en: I will chastise him therefore and release him.
text_la: Emendatum ergo illum dimittam.
text_pt: Castigá-lo-ei, pois, e soltá-lo-ei.
text_el: παιδεύσας οὖν αὐτὸν ἀπολύσω.

text_en: Now of necessity he was to release unto them one upon the feast day.
text_la: Necesse autem habebat dimittere eis per diem festum unum.
text_pt: E era-lhe necessário soltar-lhes um pela festa.

text_en: But the whole multitude together cried out, saying: Away with this man , and release unto us Barabbas:
text_la: Exclamavit autem simul universa turba, dicens : Tolle hunc, et dimitte nobis Barabbam:
text_pt: Mas toda a multidão clamou a uma, dizendo: Fora daqui com este, e solta-nos Barrabás.
text_el: ἀνέκραγον δὲ παμπληθεὶ λέγοντες: αἶρε τοῦτον, ἀπόλυσον δὲ ἡμῖν τὸν Βαραββᾶν:

text_en: Who, for a certain sedition made in the city and for a murder , was cast into prison .
text_la: qui erat propter seditionem quamdam factam in civitate et homicidium missus in carcerem.
text_pt: O qual fora lançado na prisão por causa de uma sedição feita na cidade, e de um homicídio.
text_el: ὅστις ἦν διὰ στάσιν τινὰ γενομένην ἐν τῇ πόλει καὶ φόνον βληθεὶς ἐν τῇ φυλακῇ.

text_en: And Pilate again spoke to them, desiring to release Jesus .
text_la: Iterum autem Pilatus locutus est ad eos, volens dimittere Jesum.
text_pt: Falou, pois, outra vez Pilatos, querendo soltar a Jesus.
text_el: πάλιν δὲ ὁ Πιλᾶτος προσεφώνησεν, αὐτοῖς θέλων ἀπολῦσαι τὸν Ἰησοῦν.

text_en: But they cried again, saying: Crucify him, Crucify him.
text_la: At illi succlamabant, dicentes : Crucifige, crucifige eum.
text_pt: Mas eles clamavam em contrário, dizendo: Crucifica-o, crucifica-o.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἐπεφώνουν λέγοντες: σταύρου, σταύρου αὐτόν.

text_en: And he said to them the third time: Why, what evil has this man done? I find no cause of death in him. I will chastise him therefore and let him go.
text_la: Ille autem tertio dixit ad illos : Quid enim mali fecit iste? nullam causam mortis invenio in eo : corripiam ergo illum et dimittam.
text_pt: Então ele, pela terceira vez, lhes disse: Mas que mal fez este? Não acho nele culpa alguma de morte. Castigá-lo-ei pois, e soltá-lo-ei.
text_el: ὁ δὲ τρίτον εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς: τί γὰρ κακὸν ἐποίησεν οὗτος; οὐδὲν αἴτιον θανάτου εὗρον ἐν αὐτῷ: παιδεύσας οὖν αὐτὸν ἀπολύσω.

text_en: But they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And their voices prevailed.
text_la: At illi instabant vocibus magnis postulantes ut crucifigeretur: et invalescebant voces eorum.
text_pt: Mas eles instavam com grandes gritos, pedindo que fosse crucificado. E os seus gritos, e os dos principais dos sacerdotes, prevaleciam.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἐπέκειντο φωναῖς μεγάλαις αἰτούμενοι αὐτὸν σταυρωθῆναι, καὶ κατίσχυον αἱ φωναὶ αὐτῶν.

text_en: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.
text_la: Et Pilatus adjudicavit fieri petitionem eorum.
text_pt: Então Pilatos julgou que devia fazer o que eles pediam.
text_el: καὶ Πιλᾶτος ἐπέκρινεν γενέσθαι τὸ αἴτημα αὐτῶν:

text_en: And he released unto them him who for murder and sedition had been cast into prison , whom they had desired. But Jesus he delivered up to their will.
text_la: Dimisit autem illis eum qui propter homicidium et seditionem missus fuerat in carcerem, quem petebant : Jesum vero tradidit voluntati eorum.
text_pt: E soltou-lhes o que fora lançado na prisão por uma sedição e homicídio, que era o que pediam; mas entregou Jesus à vontade deles.
text_el: ἀπέλυσεν δὲ τὸν διὰ στάσιν καὶ φόνον βεβλημένον εἰς φυλακὴν, ὃν ᾐτοῦντο, τὸν δὲ Ἰησοῦν παρέδωκεν τῷ θελήματι αὐτῶν.

text_en: And as they led him away, they laid hold of one Simon of Cyrene , coming from the country; and they laid the cross on him to carry after Jesus .
text_la: Et cum ducerent eum, apprehenderunt Simonem quemdam Cyrenensem venientem de villa : et imposuerunt illi crucem portare post Jesum.
text_pt: E quando o iam levando, tomaram um certo Simão, cireneu, que vinha do campo, e puseram-lhe a cruz às costas, para que a levasse após Jesus.
text_el: Καὶ ὡς ἀπήγαγον αὐτόν, ἐπιλαβόμενοι Σίμωνά τινα Κυρηναῖον ἐρχόμενον ἀπ' ἀγροῦ ἐπέθηκαν αὐτῷ τὸν σταυρὸν φέρειν ὄπισθεν τοῦ Ἰησοῦ.

text_en: And there followed him a great multitude of people and of women , who bewailed and lamented him.
text_la: Sequebatur autem illum multa turba populi et mulierum, quæ plangebant et lamentabantur eum.
text_pt: E seguia-o grande multidão de povo e de mulheres, as quais batiam nos peitos, e o lamentavam.
text_el: ἠκολούθει δὲ αὐτῷ πολὺ πλῆθος τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ γυναικῶν, αἳ ἐκόπτοντο καὶ ἐθρήνουν αὐτόν.

text_en: But Jesus turning to them, said: Daughters of Jerusalem , weep not over me; but weep for yourselves and for your children.
text_la: Conversus autem ad illas Jesus, dixit : Filiæ Jerusalem, nolite flere super me, sed super vos ipsas flete et super filios vestros.
text_pt: Jesus, porém, voltando-se para elas, disse: Filhas de Jerusalém, não choreis por mim; chorai antes por vós mesmas, e por vossos filhos.
text_el: στραφεὶς δὲ πρὸς αὐτὰς Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν: θυγατέρες Ἰερουσαλήμ, μὴ κλαίετε ἐπ' ἐμέ: πλὴν ἐφ' ἑαυτὰς κλαίετε καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν,

text_en: For behold, the days shall come, wherein they will say: Blessed are the barren and the wombs that have not borne and the paps that have not given suck.
text_la: Quoniam ecce venient dies in quibus dicent : Beatæ steriles, et ventres qui non genuerunt, et ubera quæ non lactaverunt.
text_pt: Porque eis que hão de vir dias em que dirão: Bem-aventuradas as estéreis, e os ventres que não geraram, e os peitos que não amamentaram!
text_el: ὅτι ἰδοὺ ἔρχονται ἡμέραι ἐν αἷς ἐροῦσιν: μακάριαι αἱ στεῖραι καὶ αἱ κοιλίαι αἳ οὐκ ἐγέννησαν, καὶ μαστοὶ οἳ οὐκ ἔθρεψαν.

text_en: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains: Fall upon us. And to the hills: Cover us.
text_la: Tunc incipient dicere montibus : Cadite super nos; et collibus : Operite nos.
text_pt: Então começarão a dizer aos montes: Caí sobre nós, e aos outeiros: Cobri-nos.
text_el: τότε ἄρξονται λέγειν τοῖς ὄρεσιν: πέσετε ἐφ' ἡμᾶς, καὶ τοῖς βουνοῖς: καλύψατε ἡμᾶς:

text_en: For if in the green wood they do these things, what shall be done in the dry?
text_la: Quia si in viridi ligno hæc faciunt, in arido quid fiet?
text_pt: Porque, se ao madeiro verde fazem isto, que se fará ao seco?
text_el: ὅτι εἰ ἐν ὑγρῷ ξύλῳ ταῦτα ποιοῦσιν, ἐν τῷ ξηρῷ τί γένηται;

text_en: And there were also two other malefactors led with him to be put to death.
text_la: Ducebantur autem et alii duo nequam cum eo, ut interficerentur.
text_pt: E também conduziram outros dois, que eram malfeitores, para com ele serem mortos.
text_el: ἤγοντο δὲ καὶ ἕτεροι κακοῦργοι δύο σὺν αὐτῷ ἀναιρεθῆναι.

text_en: And when they had come to the place which is called Calvary , they crucified him there: and the robbers, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.
text_la: Et postquam venerunt in locum qui vocatur Calvariæ, ibi crucifixerunt eum : et latrones, unum a dextris, et alterum a sinistris.
text_pt: E, quando chegaram ao lugar chamado a Caveira, ali o crucificaram, e aos malfeitores, um à direita e outro à esquerda.
text_el: Καὶ ὅτε ἦλθον ἐπὶ τὸν τόπον τὸν καλούμενον κρανίον, ἐκεῖ ἐσταύρωσαν αὐτὸν καὶ τοὺς κακούργους, ὃν μὲν ἐκ δεξιῶν, ὃν δὲ ἐξ ἀριστερῶν.

text_en: And Jesus said: Father , forgive them, for they know not what they do. But they, dividing his garments, cast lots.
text_la: Jesus autem dicebat : Pater, dimitte illis : non enim sciunt quid faciunt. Dividentes vero vestimenta ejus, miserunt sortes.
text_pt: E dizia Jesus: Pai, perdoa-lhes, porque não sabem o que fazem. E, repartindo as suas vestes, lançaram sortes.
text_el: [[ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἔλεγεν: πάτερ, ἄφες αὐτοῖς, οὐ γὰρ οἴδασιν τί ποιοῦσιν.]] διαμεριζόμενοι δὲ τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ ἔβαλον κλῆρον.

text_en: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers with them derided him, saying: He saved others: let him save himself, if he be Christ , the elect of God .
text_la: Et stabat populus spectans, et deridebant eum principes cum eis, dicentes : Alios salvos fecit, se salvum faciat, si hic est Christus Dei electus.
text_pt: E o povo estava olhando. E também os príncipes zombavam dele, dizendo: Aos outros salvou, salve-se a si mesmo, se este é o Cristo, o escolhido de Deus.
text_el: καὶ εἱστήκει ὁ λαὸς θεωρῶν. ἐξεμυκτήριζον δὲ καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες λέγοντες: ἄλλους ἔσωσεν, σωσάτω ἑαυτόν, εἰ οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Χριστὸς τοῦ θεοῦ ὁ ἐκλεκτός.

text_en: And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him and offering him vinegar,
text_la: Illudebant autem ei et milites accedentes, et acetum offerentes ei,
text_pt: E também os soldados o escarneciam, chegando-se a ele, e apresentando-lhe vinagre.
text_el: ἐνέπαιξαν δὲ αὐτῷ καὶ οἱ στρατιῶται προσερχόμενοι, ὄξος προσφέροντες αὐτῷ

text_en: and saying: If you be the king of the Jews , save yourself.
text_la: et dicentes : Si tu es rex Judæorum, salvum te fac.
text_pt: E dizendo: Se tu és o Rei dos Judeus, salva-te a ti mesmo.
text_el: καὶ λέγοντες: εἰ σὺ εἶ ὁ βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων, σῶσον σεαυτόν.

text_en: And there was also a superscription written over him in letters of Greek and Latin and Hebrew THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
text_la: Erat autem et superscriptio scripta super eum litteris græcis, et latinis, et hebraicis : Hic est rex Judæorum.
text_pt: E também por cima dele, estava um título, escrito em letras gregas, romanas, e hebraicas: ESTE É O REI DOS JUDEUS.
text_el: ἦν δὲ καὶ ἐπιγραφὴ ἐπ' αὐτῷ: ὁ βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων οὗτος.

text_en: And one of those robbers who were hanged blasphemed him, saying: If you be Christ , save yourself and us.
text_la: Unus autem de his, qui pendebant, latronibus, blasphemabat eum, dicens : Si tu es Christus, salvum fac temetipsum et nos.
text_pt: E um dos malfeitores que estavam pendurados blasfemava dele, dizendo: Se tu és o Cristo, salva-te a ti mesmo, e a nós.
text_el: Εἷς δὲ τῶν κρεμασθέντων κακούργων ἐβλασφήμει αὐτὸν: οὐχὶ σὺ εἶ ὁ Χριστός; σῶσον σεαυτὸν καὶ ἡμᾶς.

text_en: But the other answering, rebuked him, saying: Neither do you fear God , seeing; you are under the same condemnation?
text_la: Respondens autem alter increpabat eum, dicens : Neque tu times Deum, quod in eadem damnatione es.
text_pt: Respondendo, porém, o outro, repreendia-o, dizendo: Tu nem ainda temes a Deus, estando na mesma condenação?
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ ἕτερος ἐπιτιμῶν αὐτῷ ἔφη: οὐδὲ φοβῇ σὺ τὸν θεόν, ὅτι ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ κρίματι εἶ;

text_en: And we indeed justly : for we receive the due reward of our deeds. But this man has done no evil .
text_la: Et nos quidem juste, nam digna factis recipimus : hic vero nihil mali gessit.
text_pt: E nós, na verdade, com justiça, porque recebemos o que os nossos feitos mereciam; mas este nenhum mal fez.
text_el: καὶ ἡμεῖς μὲν δικαίως, ἄξια γὰρ ὧν ἐπράξαμεν ἀπολαμβάνομεν: οὗτος δὲ οὐδὲν ἄτοπον ἔπραξεν.

text_en: And he said to Jesus : Lord, remember me when you shall come into your kingdom .
text_la: Et dicebat ad Jesum : Domine, memento mei cum veneris in regnum tuum.
text_pt: E disse a Jesus: Senhor, lembra-te de mim, quando entrares no teu reino.
text_el: καὶ ἔλεγεν: Ἰησοῦ, μνήσθητί μου ὅταν ἔλθῃς εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν σου.

text_en: And Jesus said to him: Amen I say to you: This day you shall be with me in paradise .
text_la: Et dixit illi Jesus : Amen dico tibi : hodie mecum eris in paradiso.
text_pt: E disse-lhe Jesus: Em verdade te digo que hoje estarás comigo no Paraíso.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ: ἀμήν σοι λέγω, σήμερον μετ' ἐμοῦ ἔσῃ ἐν τῷ παραδείσῳ.

text_en: And it was almost the sixth hour : and there was darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour .
text_la: Erat autem fere hora sexta, et tenebræ factæ sunt in universam terram usque ad horam nonam.
text_pt: E era já quase a hora sexta, e houve trevas em toda a terra até à hora nona, escurecendo-se o sol;
text_el: Καὶ ἦν ἤδη ὡσεὶ ὥρα ἕκτη καὶ σκότος ἐγένετο ἐφ' ὅλην τὴν γῆν ἕως ὥρας ἐνάτης,

text_en: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.
text_la: Et obscuratus est sol, et velum templi scissum est medium.
text_pt: E rasgou-se ao meio o véu do templo.
text_el: τοῦ ἡλίου ἐκλείποντος: ἐσχίσθη δὲ τὸ καταπέτασμα τοῦ ναοῦ μέσον.

text_en: And Jesus crying with a loud voice, said: Father , into your hands I commend my spirit. And saying this, he gave up the ghost .
text_la: Et clamans voce magna Jesus ait : Pater, in manus tuas commendo spiritum meum. Et hæc dicens, expiravit.
text_pt: E, clamando Jesus com grande voz, disse: Pai, nas tuas mãos entrego o meu espírito. E, havendo dito isto, expirou.
text_el: καὶ φωνήσας φωνῇ μεγάλῃ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν: πάτερ, εἰς χεῖράς σου παρατίθεμαι τὸ πνεῦμά μου. τοῦτο δὲ εἰπὼν ἐξέπνευσεν.

text_en: Now, the centurion , seeing what was done, glorified God , saying: Indeed this was a just man .
text_la: Videns autem centurio quod factum fuerat, glorificavit Deum, dicens : Vere hic homo justus erat.
text_pt: E o centurião, vendo o que tinha acontecido, deu glória a Deus, dizendo: Na verdade, este homem era justo.
text_el: ἰδὼν δὲ ὁ ἑκατοντάρχης τὸ γενόμενον ἐδόξαζεν τὸν θεὸν λέγων: ὄντως ὁ ἄνθρωπος οὗτος δίκαιος ἦν.

text_en: And all the multitude of them that had come together to that sight and saw the things that were done returned, striking their breasts.
text_la: Et omnis turba eorum, qui simul aderant ad spectaculum istud, et videbant quæ fiebant, percutientes pectora sua revertebantur.
text_pt: E toda a multidão que se ajuntara a este espetáculo, vendo o que havia acontecido, voltava batendo nos peitos.
text_el: καὶ πάντες οἱ συμπαραγενόμενοι ὄχλοι ἐπὶ τὴν θεωρίαν ταύτην, θεωρήσαντες τὰ γενόμενα, τύπτοντες τὰ στήθη ὑπέστρεφον.

text_en: And all his acquaintance and the women that had followed him from Galilee stood afar off, beholding these things.
text_la: Stabant autem omnes noti ejus a longe, et mulieres, quæ secutæ eum erant a Galilæa, hæc videntes.
text_pt: E todos os seus conhecidos, e as mulheres que juntamente o haviam seguido desde a Galiléia, estavam de longe vendo estas coisas.
text_el: εἱστήκεισαν δὲ πάντες οἱ γνωστοὶ αὐτῷ ἀπὸ μακρόθεν, καὶ γυναῖκες αἱ συνακολουθοῦσαι αὐτῷ ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας, ὁρῶσαι ταῦτα.

text_en: And behold there was a man named Joseph who was a counsellor, a good and a just man ,
text_la: Et ecce vir nomine Joseph, qui erat decurio, vir bonus et justus:
text_pt: E eis que um homem por nome José, senador, homem de bem e justo,
text_el: Καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀνὴρ ὀνόματι Ἰωσὴφ βουλευτὴς ὑπάρχων, ἀνὴρ ἀγαθὸς καὶ δίκαιος

text_en: (the same had not consented to their counsel and doings) of Arimathea, a city of Judea : who also himself looked for the kingdom of God .
text_la: hic non consenserat consilio, et actibus eorum : ab Arimathæa civitate Judææ, qui exspectabat et ipse regnum Dei:
text_pt: Que não tinha consentido no conselho e nos atos dos outros, de Arimatéia, cidade dos judeus, e que também esperava o reino de Deus;
text_el: οὗτος οὐκ ἦν συγκατατεθειμένος τῇ βουλῇ καὶ τῇ πράξει αὐτῶν, ἀπὸ Ἁριμαθαίας πόλεως τῶν Ἰουδαίων, ὃς προσεδέχετο τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ,

text_en: This man went to Pilate and begged the body of Jesus .
text_la: hic accessit ad Pilatum et petiit corpus Jesu:
text_pt: Esse, chegando a Pilatos, pediu o corpo de Jesus.
text_el: οὗτος προσελθὼν τῷ Πιλάτῳ ᾐτήσατο τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ,

text_en: And taking him down, he wrapped him in fine linen and laid him in a sepulchre that was hewed in stone, wherein never yet any man had been laid.
text_la: et depositum involvit sindone, et posuit eum in monumento exciso, in quo nondum quisquam positus fuerat.
text_pt: E, havendo-o tirado, envolveu-o num lençol, e pô-lo num sepulcro escavado numa penha, onde ninguém ainda havia sido posto.
text_el: καὶ καθελὼν ἐνετύλιξεν αὐτὸ σινδόνι, καὶ ἔθηκεν αὐτὸν ἐν μνήματι λαξευτῷ οὗ οὐκ ἦν οὐδεὶς οὔπω κείμενος.

text_en: And it was the day of the Parasceve : and the sabbath drew on.
text_la: Et dies erat parasceves, et sabbatum illucescebat.
text_pt: E era o dia da preparação, e amanhecia o sábado.
text_el: καὶ ἡμέρα ἦν παρασκευῆς, καὶ σάββατον ἐπέφωσκεν.

text_en: And the women that had come with him from Galilee , following after, saw the sepulchre and how his body was laid.
text_la: Subsecutæ autem mulieres, quæ cum eo venerant de Galilæa, viderunt monumentum, et quemadmodum positum erat corpus ejus.
text_pt: E as mulheres, que tinham vindo com ele da Galiléia, seguiram também e viram o sepulcro, e como foi posto o seu corpo.
text_el: Κατακολουθήσασαι δὲ αἱ γυναῖκες, αἵτινες ἦσαν συνεληλυθυῖαι ἐκ τῆς Γαλιλαίας αὐτῷ, ἐθεάσαντο τὸ μνημεῖον καὶ ὡς ἐτέθη τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ,

text_en: And returning, they prepared spices and ointments : and on the sabbath day they rested, according to the commandment.
text_la: Et revertentes paraverunt aromata, et unguenta : et sabbato quidem siluerunt secundum mandatum.
text_pt: E, voltando elas, prepararam especiarias e ungüentos; e no sábado repousaram, conforme o mandamento.
text_el: ὑποστρέψασαι δὲ ἡτοίμασαν ἀρώματα καὶ μύρα: καὶ τὸ μὲν σάββατον ἡσύχασαν κατὰ τὴν ἐντολήν.

text_en: And on the first day of the week , very early in the morning, they came to the sepulchre , bringing the spices which they had prepared.
text_la: Una autem sabbati valde diluculo venerunt ad monumentum, portantes quæ paraverant aromata:
text_pt: E no primeiro dia da semana, muito de madrugada, foram elas ao sepulcro, levando as especiarias que tinham preparado, e algumas outras com elas.
text_el: Τῇ δὲ μιᾷ τῶν σαββάτων ὄρθρου βαθέως ἐπὶ τὸ μνῆμα ἦλθον φέρουσαι ἃ ἡτοίμασαν ἀρώματα.

text_en: And they found the stone rolled back from the sepulchre .
text_la: et invenerunt lapidem revolutum a monumento.
text_pt: E acharam a pedra revolvida do sepulcro.
text_el: εὗρον δὲ τὸν λίθον ἀποκεκυλισμένον ἀπὸ τοῦ μνημείου,

text_en: And going in, they found not the body of the Lord Jesus .
text_la: Et ingressæ non invenerunt corpus Domini Jesu.
text_pt: E, entrando, não acharam o corpo do Senhor Jesus.
text_el: εἰσελθοῦσαι δὲ οὐχ εὗρον τὸ σῶμα [[τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ]].

text_en: And it came to pass, as they were astonished in their mind at this, behold, two men stood by them, in shining apparel.
text_la: Et factum est, dum mente consternatæ essent de isto, ecce duo viri steterunt secus illas in veste fulgenti.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, estando elas muito perplexas a esse respeito, eis que pararam junto delas dois homens, com vestes resplandecentes.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἀπορεῖσθαι αὐτὰς περὶ τούτου, καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄνδρες δύο ἐπέστησαν αὐταῖς ἐν ἐσθῆτι ἀστραπτούσῃ:

text_en: And as they were afraid and bowed down their countenance towards the ground, they said unto them: Why seek you the living with the dead?
text_la: Cum timerent autem, et declinarent vultum in terram, dixerunt ad illas : Quid quæritis viventem cum mortuis?
text_pt: E, estando elas muito atemorizadas, e abaixando o rosto para o chão, eles lhes disseram: Por que buscais o vivente entre os mortos?
text_el: ἐμφόβων δὲ γενομένων αὐτῶν καὶ κλινουσῶν τὰ πρόσωπα εἰς τὴν γῆν εἶπαν πρὸς αὐτάς: τί ζητεῖτε τὸν ζῶντα μετὰ τῶν νεκρῶν;

text_en: He is not here, but is risen. Remember how he spoke unto you, when he was yet in Galilee ,
text_la: non est hic, sed surrexit : recordamini qualiter locutus est vobis, cum adhuc in Galilæa esset,
text_pt: Não está aqui, mas ressuscitou. Lembrai-vos como vos falou, estando ainda na Galiléia,
text_el: [[οὐκ ἔστιν ὧδε, ἀλλὰ ἠγέρθη]]. μνήσθητε ὡς ἐλάλησεν ὑμῖν ἔτι ὢν ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ,

text_en: saying: The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men and be crucified and the third day rise again .
text_la: dicens : Quia oportet Filium hominis tradi in manus hominum peccatorum, et crucifigi, et die tertia resurgere.
text_pt: Dizendo: Convém que o Filho do homem seja entregue nas mãos de homens pecadores, e seja crucificado, e ao terceiro dia ressuscite.
text_el: λέγων τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ὅτι δεῖ παραδοθῆναι εἰς χεῖρας ἀνθρώπων ἁμαρτωλῶν καὶ σταυρωθῆναι καὶ τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ ἀναστῆναι.

text_en: And they remembered his words.
text_la: Et recordatæ sunt verborum ejus.
text_pt: E lembraram-se das suas palavras.
text_el: καὶ ἐμνήσθησαν τῶν ῥημάτων αὐτοῦ,

text_en: And going back from the sepulchre , they told all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.
text_la: Et regressæ a monumento nuntiaverunt hæc omnia illis undecim, et ceteris omnibus.
text_pt: E, voltando do sepulcro, anunciaram todas estas coisas aos onze e a todos os demais.
text_el: καὶ ὑποστρέψασαι [ἀπὸ τοῦ μνημείου] ἀπήγγειλαν ταῦτα πάντα τοῖς ἕνδεκα καὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς λοιποῖς.

text_en: And it was Mary Magdalen and Joanna and Mary of James and the other women that were with them, who told these things to the apostles .
text_la: Erat autem Maria Magdalene, et Joanna, et Maria Jacobi, et ceteræ quæ cum eis erant, quæ dicebant ad apostolos hæc.
text_pt: E eram Maria Madalena, e Joana, e Maria, mãe de Tiago, e as outras que com elas estavam, as que diziam estas coisas aos apóstolos.
text_el: ἦσαν δὲ ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ Μαρία καὶ Ἰωάννα καὶ Μαρία ἡ Ἰακώβου, καὶ αἱ λοιπαὶ σὺν αὐταῖς ἔλεγον πρὸς τοὺς ἀποστόλους ταῦτα.

text_en: And these words seemed to them as idle tales: and they did not believe them.
text_la: Et visa sunt ante illos sicut deliramentum verba ista, et non crediderunt illis.
text_pt: E as suas palavras lhes pareciam como desvario, e não as creram.
text_el: καὶ ἐφάνησαν ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν ὡσεὶ λῆρος τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα, καὶ ἠπίστουν αὐταῖς.

text_en: But Peter rising up, ran to the sepulchre and, stooping down, he saw the linen cloths laid by themselves: and went away wondering in himself at that which had come to pass.
text_la: Petrus autem surgens cucurrit ad monumentum : et procumbens vidit linteamina sola posita, et abiit secum mirans quod factum fuerat.
text_pt: Pedro, porém, levantando-se, correu ao sepulcro e, abaixando-se, viu só os lençóis ali postos; e retirou-se, admirando consigo aquele caso.
text_el: [[Ὀ δὲ Πέτρος ἀναστὰς ἔδραμεν ἐπὶ τὸ μνημεῖον καὶ παρακύψας βλέπει τὰ ὀθόνια μόνα καὶ ἀπῆλθεν πρὸς ἑαυτὸν θαυμάζων τὸ γεγονός]]

text_en: And behold, two of them went, the same day, to a town which was sixty furlongs from Jerusalem , named Emmaus.
text_la: Et ecce duo ex illis ibant ipsa die in castellum, quod erat in spatio stadiorum sexaginta ab Jerusalem, nomine Emmaus.
text_pt: E eis que no mesmo dia iam dois deles para uma aldeia, que distava de Jerusalém sessenta estádios, cujo nome era Emaús.
text_el: Καὶ ἰδοὺ δύο ἐξ αὐτῶν ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἦσαν πορευόμενοι εἰς κώμην ἀπέχουσαν σταδίους ἑξήκοντα ἀπὸ Ἰερουσαλήμ, ᾗ ὄνομα Ἐμμαοῦς,

text_en: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.
text_la: Et ipsi loquebantur ad invicem de his omnibus quæ acciderant.
text_pt: E iam falando entre si de tudo aquilo que havia sucedido.
text_el: καὶ αὐτοὶ ὡμίλουν πρὸς ἀλλήλους περὶ πάντων τῶν συμβεβηκότων τούτων.

text_en: And it came to pass that while they talked and reasoned with themselves, Jesus himself also, drawing near, went with them.
text_la: Et factum est, dum fabularentur, et secum quærerent : et ipse Jesus appropinquans ibat cum illis:
text_pt: E aconteceu que, indo eles falando entre si, e fazendo perguntas um ao outro, o mesmo Jesus se aproximou, e ia com eles.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ὁμιλεῖν αὐτοὺς καὶ συζητεῖν, [καὶ] αὐτὸς Ἰησοῦς ἐγγίσας συνεπορεύετο αὐτοῖς:

text_en: But their eyes were held, that they should not know him.
text_la: oculi autem illorum tenebantur ne eum agnoscerent.
text_pt: Mas os olhos deles estavam como que fechados, para que o não conhecessem.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτῶν ἐκρατοῦντο τοῦ μὴ ἐπιγνῶναι αὐτόν.

text_en: And he said to them: What are these discourses that you hold one with another as you walk and are sad?
text_la: Et ait ad illos : Qui sunt hi sermones, quos confertis ad invicem ambulantes, et estis tristes?
text_pt: E ele lhes disse: Que palavras são essas que, caminhando, trocais entre vós, e por que estais tristes?
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτούς: τίνες οἱ λόγοι οὗτοι, οὓς ἀντιβάλλετε πρὸς ἀλλήλους περιπατοῦντες; καὶ ἐστάθησαν σκυθρωποί.

text_en: And the one of them, whose name was Cleophas , answering, said to him: Are you only a stranger in Jerusalem , and have not known the things that have been done there in these days?
text_la: Et respondens unus, cui nomen Cleophas, dixit ei : Tu solus peregrinus es in Jerusalem, et non cognovisti quæ facta sunt in illa his diebus?
text_pt: E, respondendo um, cujo nome era Cléopas, disse-lhe: És tu só peregrino em Jerusalém, e não sabes as coisas que nela têm sucedido nestes dias?
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ εἷς, ὀνόματι Κλεοπᾶς, εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν: σὺ μόνος παροικεῖς Ἰερουσαλὴμ καὶ οὐκ ἔγνως τὰ γενόμενα ἐν αὐτῇ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ταύταις;

text_en: To whom he said: What things? And they said: Concerning Jesus of Nazareth , who was a prophet , mighty in work and word before God and all the people.
text_la: Quibus ille dixit : Quæ? Et dixerunt : De Jesu Nazareno, qui fuit vir propheta, potens in opere et sermone coram Deo et omni populo:
text_pt: E ele lhes perguntou: Quais? E eles lhe disseram: As que dizem respeito a Jesus Nazareno, que foi homem profeta, poderoso em obras e palavras diante de Deus e de todo o povo;
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: ποῖα; οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτῷ: τὰ περὶ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Ναζαρηνοῦ, ὃς ἐγένετο ἀνὴρ προφήτης δυνατὸς ἐν ἔργῳ καὶ λόγῳ ἐναντίον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ,

text_en: And how our chief priests and princes delivered him to be condemned to death and crucified him.
text_la: et quomodo eum tradiderunt summi sacerdotes et principes nostri in damnationem mortis, et crucifixerunt eum:
text_pt: E como os principais dos sacerdotes e os nossos príncipes o entregaram à condenação de morte, e o crucificaram.
text_el: ὅπως τε παρέδωκαν αὐτὸν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες ἡμῶν εἰς κρίμα θανάτου καὶ ἐσταύρωσαν αὐτόν.

text_en: But we hoped that it was he that should have redeemed Israel . And now besides all this, today is the third day since these things were done.
text_la: nos autem sperabamus quia ipse esset redempturus Israël : et nunc super hæc omnia, tertia dies est hodie quod hæc facta sunt.
text_pt: E nós esperávamos que fosse ele o que remisse Israel; mas agora, sobre tudo isso, é já hoje o terceiro dia desde que essas coisas aconteceram.
text_el: ἡμεῖς δὲ ἠλπίζομεν ὅτι αὐτός ἐστιν ὁ μέλλων λυτροῦσθαι τὸν Ἰσραήλ: ἀλλά γε καὶ σὺν πᾶσιν τούτοις τρίτην ταύτην ἡμέραν ἄγει ἀφ' οὗ ταῦτα ἐγένετο.

text_en: Yea and certain women also of our company affrighted us who, before it was light, were at the sepulchre ,
text_la: Sed et mulieres quædam ex nostris terruerunt nos, quæ ante lucem fuerunt ad monumentum,
text_pt: É verdade que também algumas mulheres dentre nós nos maravilharam, as quais de madrugada foram ao sepulcro;
text_el: ἀλλὰ καὶ γυναῖκές τινες ἐξ ἡμῶν ἐξέστησαν ἡμᾶς, γενόμεναι ὀρθριναὶ ἐπὶ τὸ μνημεῖον,

text_en: and not finding his body, came, saying that they had all seen a vision of angels , who say that he is alive.
text_la: et non invento corpore ejus, venerunt, dicentes se etiam visionem angelorum vidisse, qui dicunt eum vivere.
text_pt: E, não achando o seu corpo, voltaram, dizendo que também tinham visto uma visão de anjos, que dizem que ele vive.
text_el: καὶ μὴ εὑροῦσαι τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ ἦλθον λέγουσαι καὶ ὀπτασίαν ἀγγέλων ἑωρακέναι, οἳ λέγουσιν αὐτὸν ζῆν.

text_en: And some of our people went to the sepulchre and found it so as the women had said: but him they found not.
text_la: Et abierunt quidam ex nostris ad monumentum : et ita invenerunt sicut mulieres dixerunt, ipsum vero non invenerunt.
text_pt: E alguns dos que estavam conosco foram ao sepulcro, e acharam ser assim como as mulheres haviam dito; porém, a ele não o viram.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆλθόν τινες τῶν σὺν ἡμῖν ἐπὶ τὸ μνημεῖον, καὶ εὗρον οὕτως καθὼς αἱ γυναῖκες εἶπον, αὐτὸν δὲ οὐκ εἶδον.

text_en: Then he said to them: O foolish and slow of heart to believe in all things, which the prophets have spoken.
text_la: Et ipse dixit ad eos : O stulti, et tardi corde ad credendum in omnibus quæ locuti sunt prophetæ!
text_pt: E ele lhes disse: Ó néscios, e tardos de coração para crer tudo o que os profetas disseram!
text_el: καὶ αὐτὸς εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς: ὦ ἀνόητοι καὶ βραδεῖς τῇ καρδίᾳ τοῦ πιστεύειν ἐπὶ πᾶσιν οἷς ἐλάλησαν οἱ προφῆται.

text_en: Ought not Christ to have suffered these things and so, to enter into his glory ?
text_la: Nonne hæc oportuit pati Christum, et ita intrare in gloriam suam?
text_pt: Porventura não convinha que o Cristo padecesse estas coisas e entrasse na sua glória?
text_el: οὐχὶ ταῦτα ἔδει παθεῖν τὸν Χριστὸν καὶ εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ;

text_en: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets , he expounded to them in all the scriptures the things that were concerning him.
text_la: Et incipiens a Moyse, et omnibus prophetis, interpretabatur illis in omnibus scripturis quæ de ipso erant.
text_pt: E, começando por Moisés, e por todos os profetas, explicava-lhes o que dele se achava em todas as Escrituras.
text_el: καὶ ἀρξάμενος ἀπὸ Μωϋσέως καὶ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν προφητῶν διερμήνευσεν αὐτοῖς ἐν πάσαις ταῖς γραφαῖς τὰ περὶ ἑαυτοῦ.

text_en: And they drew near to the town whither they were going: and he made as though he would go farther.
text_la: Et appropinquaverunt castello quo ibant : et ipse se finxit longius ire.
text_pt: E chegaram à aldeia para onde iam, e ele fez como quem ia para mais longe.
text_el: καὶ ἤγγισαν εἰς τὴν κώμην οὗ ἐπορεύοντο, καὶ αὐτὸς προσεποιήσατο πορρώτερον πορεύεσθαι:

text_en: But they constrained him, saying: Stay with us, because it is towards evening and the day is now far spent. And he went in with them.
text_la: Et coëgerunt illum, dicentes : Mane nobiscum, quoniam advesperascit, et inclinata est jam dies. Et intravit cum illis.
text_pt: E eles o constrangeram, dizendo: Fica conosco, porque já é tarde, e já declinou o dia. E entrou para ficar com eles.
text_el: καὶ παρεβιάσαντο αὐτὸν λέγοντες: μεῖνον μεθ' ἡμῶν, ὅτι πρὸς ἑσπέραν ἐστὶν καὶ κέκλικεν ἤδη ἡ ἡμέρα. καὶ εἰσῆλθεν τοῦ μεῖναι σὺν αὐτοῖς.

text_en: And it came to pass, whilst he was at table with them, he took bread and blessed and broke and gave to them.
text_la: Et factum est, dum recumberet cum eis, accepit panem, et benedixit, ac fregit, et porrigebat illis.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, estando com eles à mesa, tomando o pão, o abençoou e partiu-o, e lho deu.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ κατακλιθῆναι αὐτὸν μετ' αὐτῶν, λαβὼν τὸν ἄρτον εὐλόγησεν καὶ κλάσας ἐπεδίδου αὐτοῖς:

text_en: And their eyes were opened: and they knew him. And he vanished out of their sight.
text_la: Et aperti sunt oculi eorum, et cognoverunt eum : et ipse evanuit ex oculis eorum.
text_pt: Abriram-se-lhes então os olhos, e o conheceram, e ele desapareceu-lhes.
text_el: αὐτῶν δὲ διηνοίχθησαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ καὶ ἐπέγνωσαν αὐτόν: καὶ αὐτὸς ἄφαντος ἐγένετο ἀπ' αὐτῶν.

text_en: And they said one to the other: Was not our heart burning within us, whilst he spoke in the way and opened to us the scriptures ?
text_la: Et dixerunt ad invicem : Nonne cor nostrum ardens erat in nobis dum loqueretur in via, et aperiret nobis Scripturas?
text_pt: E disseram um para o outro: Porventura não ardia em nós o nosso coração quando, pelo caminho, nos falava, e quando nos abria as Escrituras?
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς ἀλλήλους: οὐχὶ ἡ καρδία ἡμῶν καιομένη ἦν ὡς ἐλάλει ἡμῖν ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ, ὡς διήνοιγεν ἡμῖν τὰς γραφάς;

text_en: And rising up, the same hour, they went back to Jerusalem : and they found the eleven gathered together, and those that were with them,
text_la: Et surgentes eadem hora regressi sunt in Jerusalem : et invenerunt congregatos undecim, et eos qui cum illis erant,
text_pt: E na mesma hora, levantando-se, tornaram para Jerusalém, e acharam congregados os onze, e os que estavam com eles,
text_el: Καὶ ἀναστάντες αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ ὑπέστρεψαν εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ, καὶ εὗρον ἠθροισμένους τοὺς ἕνδεκα καὶ τοὺς σὺν αὐτοῖς,

text_en: saying: The Lord is risen indeed and has appeared to Simon .
text_la: dicentes : Quod surrexit Dominus vere, et apparuit Simoni.
text_pt: Os quais diziam: Ressuscitou verdadeiramente o Senhor, e já apareceu a Simão.
text_el: λέγοντας ὅτι ὄντως ἠγέρθη ὁ κύριος καὶ ὤφθη Σίμωνι.

text_en: And they told what things were done in the way: and how they knew him in the breaking of bread.
text_la: Et ipsi narrabant quæ gesta erant in via, et quomodo cognoverunt eum in fractione panis.
text_pt: E eles lhes contaram o que lhes acontecera no caminho, e como deles fora conhecido no partir do pão.
text_el: καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐξηγοῦντο τὰ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ καὶ ὡς ἐγνώσθη αὐτοῖς ἐν τῇ κλάσει τοῦ ἄρτου.

text_en: Now, whilst they were speaking these things, Jesus stood in the midst of them and says to them: Peace be to you. It is I: Fear not.
text_la: Dum autem hæc loquuntur, stetit Jesus in medio eorum, et dicit eis : Pax vobis : ego sum, nolite timere.
text_pt: E falando eles destas coisas, o mesmo Jesus se apresentou no meio deles, e disse-lhes: Paz seja convosco.
text_el: Ταῦτα δὲ αὐτῶν λαλούντων αὐτὸς ἔστη ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν. [[καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς εἰρήνη ὑμῖν]]

text_en: But they being troubled and frightened, supposed that they saw a spirit.
text_la: Conturbati vero et conterriti, existimabant se spiritum videre.
text_pt: E eles, espantados e atemorizados, pensavam que viam algum espírito.
text_el: πτοηθέντες δὲ καὶ ἔμφοβοι γενόμενοι ἐδόκουν πνεῦμα θεωρεῖν.

text_en: And he said to them: Why are you troubled, and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?
text_la: Et dixit eis : Quid turbati estis, et cogitationes ascendunt in corda vestra?
text_pt: E ele lhes disse: Por que estais perturbados, e por que sobem tais pensamentos aos vossos corações?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: τί τεταραγμένοι ἐστέ, καὶ διὰ τί διαλογισμοὶ ἀναβαίνουσιν ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ ὑμῶν;

text_en: See my hands and feet, that it is I myself. Handle, and see: for a spirit has not flesh and bones, as you see me to have.
text_la: videte manus meas, et pedes, quia ego ipse sum; palpate et videte, quia spiritus carnem et ossa non habet, sicut me videtis habere.
text_pt: Vede as minhas mãos e os meus pés, que sou eu mesmo; apalpai-me e vede, pois um espírito não tem carne nem ossos, como vedes que eu tenho.
text_el: ἴδετε τὰς χεῖράς μου καὶ τοὺς πόδας μου, ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι αὐτός: ψηλαφήσατέ με καὶ ἴδετε, ὅτι πνεῦμα σάρκα καὶ ὀστέα οὐκ ἔχει καθὼς ἐμὲ θεωρεῖτε ἔχοντα.

text_en: And when he had said this, he showed them his hands and feet.
text_la: Et cum hoc dixisset, ostendit eis manus et pedes.
text_pt: E, dizendo isto, mostrou-lhes as mãos e os pés.
text_el: [[Καὶ τοῦτο εἰπὼν ἔδειξεν αὐτοῖς τὰς χεῖρας καὶ τοὺς πόδας.]]

text_en: But while they yet believed not and wondered for joy , he said: Have you here anything to eat?
text_la: Adhuc autem illis non credentibus, et mirantibus præ gaudio, dixit : Habetis hic aliquid quod manducetur?
text_pt: E, não o crendo eles ainda por causa da alegria, e estando maravilhados, disse-lhes: Tendes aqui alguma coisa que comer?
text_el: ἔτι δὲ ἀπιστούντων αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τῆς χαρᾶς καὶ θαυμαζόντων εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: ἔχετέ τι βρώσιμον ἐνθάδε;

text_en: And they offered him a piece of a broiled fish and a honeycomb.
text_la: At illi obtulerunt ei partem piscis assi et favum mellis.
text_pt: Então eles apresentaram-lhe parte de um peixe assado, e um favo de mel;
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἐπέδωκαν αὐτῷ ἰχθύος ὀπτοῦ μέρος:

text_en: And when he had eaten before them, taking the remains, he gave to them.
text_la: Et cum manducasset coram eis, sumens reliquias dedit eis.
text_pt: O que ele tomou, e comeu diante deles.
text_el: καὶ λαβὼν ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν ἔφαγεν.

text_en: And he said to them: These are the words which I spoke to you while I was yet with you, that all things must needs be fulfilled which are written in the law of Moses and in the prophets and in the psalms, concerning me.
text_la: Et dixit ad eos : Hæc sunt verba quæ locutus sum ad vos cum adhuc essem vobiscum, quoniam necesse est impleri omnia quæ scripta sunt in lege Moysi, et prophetis, et Psalmis de me.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: São estas as palavras que vos disse estando ainda convosco: Que convinha que se cumprisse tudo o que de mim estava escrito na lei de Moisés, e nos profetas e nos Salmos.
text_el: Εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτούς: οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι μου οὓς ἐλάλησα πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἔτι ὢν σὺν ὑμῖν, ὅτι δεῖ πληρωθῆναι πάντα τὰ γεγραμμένα ἐν τῷ νόμῳ Μωϋσέως καὶ τοῖς προφήταις καὶ ψαλμοῖς περὶ ἐμοῦ.

text_en: Then he opened their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures .
text_la: Tunc aperuit illis sensum ut intelligerent Scripturas,
text_pt: Então abriu-lhes o entendimento para compreenderem as Escrituras.
text_el: τότε διήνοιξεν αὐτῶν τὸν νοῦν τοῦ συνιέναι τὰς γραφάς.

text_en: And he said to them: Thus it is written, and thus it behoved Christ to suffer and to rise again from the dead , the third day:
text_la: et dixit eis : Quoniam sic scriptum est, et sic oportebat Christum pati, et resurgere a mortuis tertia die:
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Assim está escrito, e assim convinha que o Cristo padecesse, e ao terceiro dia ressuscitasse dentre os mortos,
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὅτι οὕτως γέγραπται παθεῖν τὸν Χριστὸν καὶ ἀναστῆναι ἐκ νεκρῶν τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ,

text_en: And that penance and remission of sins should be preached in his name , unto all nations, beginning at Jerusalem .
text_la: et prædicari in nomine ejus pœnitentiam, et remissionem peccatorum in omnes gentes, incipientibus ab Jerosolyma.
text_pt: E em seu nome se pregasse o arrependimento e a remissão dos pecados, em todas as nações, começando por Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ κηρυχθῆναι ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ μετάνοιαν εἰς ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν εἰς πάντα τὰ ἔθνη, ἀρξάμενοι ἀπὸ Ἰερουσαλήμ.

text_en: And you are witnesses of these things.
text_la: Vos autem testes estis horum.
text_pt: E destas coisas sois vós testemunhas.
text_el: ὑμεῖς μάρτυρες τούτων.

text_en: And I send the promise of my Father upon you: but stay you in the city till you be endued with power from on high.
text_la: Et ego mitto promissum Patris mei in vos; vos autem sedete in civitate, quoadusque induamini virtute ex alto.
text_pt: E eis que sobre vós envio a promessa de meu Pai; ficai, porém, na cidade de Jerusalém, até que do alto sejais revestidos de poder.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐξαποστέλλω τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν τοῦ πατρός μου ἐφ' ὑμᾶς: ὑμεῖς δὲ καθίσατε ἐν τῇ πόλει ἕως οὗ ἐνδύσησθε ἐξ ὕψους δύναμιν.

text_en: And he led them out as far as Bethania : and lifting up his hands, he blessed them.
text_la: Eduxit autem eos foras in Bethaniam, et elevatis manibus suis benedixit eis.
text_pt: E levou-os fora, até betânia; e, levantando as suas mãos, os abençoou.
text_el: Ἐξήγαγεν δὲ αὐτοὺς ἕως πρὸς Βηθανίαν, καὶ ἐπάρας τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ εὐλόγησεν αὐτούς.

text_en: And it came to pass, whilst he blessed them, he departed from them and was carried up to heaven .
text_la: Et factum est, dum benediceret illis, recessit ab eis, et ferebatur in cælum.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, abençoando-os ele, se apartou deles e foi elevado ao céu.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ εὐλογεῖν αὐτὸν αὐτοὺς διέστη ἀπ' αὐτῶν [[καὶ ἀνεφέρετο εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν]]

text_en: And they adoring went back into Jerusalem with great joy .
text_la: Et ipsi adorantes regressi sunt in Jerusalem cum gaudio magno:
text_pt: E, adorando-o eles, tornaram com grande júbilo para Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ αὐτοὶ [[προσκυνήσαντες αὐτὸν]] ὑπέστρεψαν εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ μετὰ χαρᾶς μεγάλης,

text_en: And they were always in the temple , praising and blessing God . Amen .
text_la: et erant semper in templo, laudantes et benedicentes Deum. Amen.
text_pt: E estavam sempre no templo, louvando e bendizendo a Deus. Amém.
text_el: καὶ ἦσαν διὰ παντὸς ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ εὐλογοῦντες τὸν θεόν.
